memories.description: Dobby wants to come and see me sometimes. I can have a kid-like little house-elf friend popping in.
memories.source_text: “Harry Potter . . . can Dobby come and see you sometimes, sir?” Dobby asked tentatively.

memories.description: Winky is ashamed about being freed and she isn't getting paid. She's struggling badly with the change.
memories.source_text: “Winky is a disgraced elf, but Winky is not yet getting paid!” she squeaked.

memories.description: Winky's state worries me. She seems devoted to Crouch even though she's better off free, and that could make things awkward.
memories.source_text: “Let’s hope they don’t look too closely at Winky,” said Harry.

memories.description: Winky thinks Bagman is bad and Crouch doesn't like him. There are secrets these elves are protecting about their masters.
memories.source_text: “Mr Bagman comes too?” squeaked Winky, and to Harry’s great surprise (and Ron’s and Hermione’s too, by the looks on their faces), she looked angry again. “Mr Bagman is a bad wizard! A very bad wizard!”

memories.description: She told me she\'s already going with someone else. Fine. Cho\'s going with Cedric Diggory. That stings but I can deal with it.
memories.source_text: "I\'ve already said I\'ll go with someone else."

memories.description: Cho is going with Cedric Diggory. End of story.
memories.source_text: "Who\'re you going with?" "Oh \- Cedric," she said. "Cedric Diggory."

memories.description: Fleur is part veela through her grandmother. That explains why she looks like she\'s casting charms at people.
memories.source_text: "She\'s part veela," said Harry.

memories.description: Parvati said yes when I asked her to the ball. Good, now at least someone has agreed to come with me.
memories.source_text: "Yes, all right then," she said finally, blushing furiously.

memories.description: Parvati thinks her sister Padma might go with Ron. That could sort Ron out if she actually asks her.
memories.source_text: "I suppose my sister might . . . Padma, you know . . . in Ravenclaw. I\'ll ask her if you like."

memories.description: Cedric turned a rock into a dog to distract the dragon and it actually worked for a bit.
memories.source_text: [Cedric did this weird thing where he Transfigured a rock on the ground turned it into a dog he was trying to make the dragon go for the dog instead of him.]

memories.description: Cedric did get the egg but got burned because the dragon changed its mind and went after him.
memories.source_text: [he did get the egg but he got burned as well the dragon changed its mind halfway through and decided it would rather have him than the Labrador he only just got away.]

memories.description: Fleur tried a charm to put the dragon to sleep; it dozed but then sneezed out fire and set her skirt alight and she doused it with wand water.
memories.source_text: [And that Fleur girl tried this sort of charm I think she was trying to put it into a trance well that kind of worked too it went all sleepy but then it snored and this great jet of flame shot out and her skirt caught fire she put it out with a bit of water out of her wand.]

memories.description: Krum hit the dragon in the eye with a spell instead of flying and was probably the best after me but he caused the dragon to rampage and crush eggs so they docked his marks.
memories.source_text: [Krum you won t believe this but he didn t even think of flying he was probably the best after you though Hit it with some sort of spell right in the eye Only thing is it went trampling around in agony and squashed half the real eggs they took marks off for that he wasn t supposed to do any damage to them.]

memories.description: The judges mark out of ten each. Maxime, Crouch, Dumbledore, Bagman and Karkaroff all gave their scores and Bagman even gave me a ten while Karkaroff gave me a four.
memories.source_text: [It s marks out of ten from each one Madame Maxime ... Mr. Crouch ... Dumbledore ... Ludo Bagman ten ... Karkaroff ... four.]

memories.description: I didn't care about Karkaroff's low score. Ron standing up for me felt way more important than the points.
memories.source_text: [But Harry didn t care he wouldn t have cared if Karkaroff had given him zero Ron s indignation on his behalf was worth about a hundred points to him.]

memories.description: Romantic or not I noticed Ron's support makes everything lighter. I appreciate him loads even if I did not say it out loud.
memories.source_text: [Ron s indignation on his behalf was worth about a hundred points to him he didn t tell Ron this of course but his heart felt lighter than air as he turned to leave the enclosure.]

memories.description: Moody can see through my Invisibility Cloak. He saw me there on the stairs.
memories.source_text: Moody’s magical eye travel over Snape, and then, unmistakably, onto himself.

memories.description: Snape recognizes my things and suspected I was the intruder. He put two and two together and thought the map and egg were mine.
memories.source_text: That egg is Potter’s egg. That piece of parchment belongs to Potter.

memories.description: I saw who broke into Snape’s office and it was Barty Crouch.
memories.source_text: It was Mr. Crouch.

memories.description: Moody clearly respects Crouch and thinks Crouch is a big deal in catching Dark wizards. Crouch being involved makes this more serious than I thought.
memories.source_text: Put it this way, Potter, they say old Mad-Eye's obsessed with catching Dark wizards but I'm nothing compared to Barty Crouch.

memories.description: Moody took the Marauder’s Map from me and wants to keep it to use. I owe him a favor now.
memories.source_text: Can I borrow this?

memories.description: Filch thinks the egg is a Triwizard clue and that Peeves stole it from a champion.
memories.source_text: It’s the property of the champion he stole it from.

memories.description: Hagrid's proud of me. He's shouting encouragement, telling me to show them and to beat them all.
memories.source_text: Tha’s my boy, you show ’em, Harry, you show ’em. Beat ’em all.

memories.description: I told Hagrid I'm doing great with the egg. I'm trying to sound confident and keep him happy.
memories.source_text: Great. Really great.

memories.description: I felt Hagrid rooting for me. He thinks if I win it'll prove you don't have to be pureblood to be great at magic. That made me want to try even harder.
memories.source_text: "Yeh know wha', Harry? ... Yeh know what I'd love, Harry? I'd love yeh ter win, I really would. It'd show 'em all ... Yeh don' have ter be pureblood ter do it."

memories.description: I know Hagrid sees a bit of himself in me and he cares. I'm closer to him now and I don't want to let him down.
memories.source_text: "Yeh know wha', Harry? ... when I firs' met you, you reminded me o' me a bit. Mum an' Dad gone, an' you was feelin' like yeh wouldn' fit in at Hogwarts ... an' now look at yeh, Harry! School champion!"

memories.description: Dumbledore really believes in giving people second chances. If he trusts someone it matters. That's why I trust him more.
memories.source_text: "Dumbledore was the one who stuck up for me after Dad went. Got me the gamekeeper job ... Gives 'em second chances ... tha's what sets him apar' from other Heads"

memories.description: Okay. I'm standing up even though I feel like my stomach's dropped and everyone is watching.
memories.source_text: "Okay," said Harry, standing up, his fork falling onto his plate with a clatter.

memories.description: I sound flat and distant. I can tell I'm not the same calm me right now, I'm on edge.
memories.source_text: "Yeah," said Harry in a voice that was most unlike his own.

memories.description: Don't panic. Keep a cool head. There are wizards ready to step in. Just do my best and people won't think less of me.
memories.source_text: "Now, don't panic," she said, "just keep a cool head. . . . We've got wizards standing by to control the situation if it gets out of hand. . . . The main thing is just to do your best, and nobody will think any the worse of you. . . . Are you all right?"

memories.description: I have to go into the tent with the other champions and wait. Bagman will tell us the procedure. Good luck to me.
memories.source_text: "You’re to go in here with the other champions," said Professor McGonagall, in a rather shaky sort of voice, "and wait for your turn, Potter. Mr. Bagman is in there . . . he’ll be telling you the — the procedure. . . . Good luck."

memories.description: I tell people I'm fine even when I'm terrified. I don't trust that I actually feel fine.
memories.source_text: "Yes," Harry heard himself say. "Yes, I'm fine."

memories.description: I'm so nervous I can imagine losing control and lashing out. That's how bad it feels.
memories.source_text: It was a state of nervousness so advanced that he wondered whether he mightn’t just lose his head when they tried to lead him out to his dragon, and start trying to curse everyone in sight.

memories.description: Cedric found us. He mouthed that he got lost but said Fleur and Krum are on their way.
memories.source_text: "Got lost!" he mouthed, "Fleur and Krum’re coming now!"

memories.description: Cedric cut Cho free and pulled her up to the surface.
memories.source_text: "He pulled a knife out of his pocket and cut Cho free."

memories.description: I felt massive relief seeing Cedric and knowing help was coming. For once I wasn't panicking alone.
memories.source_text: "Feeling enormously relieved"

memories.description: Krum is coming too, though he looks terrifying down here, like a shark-headed swimmer.
memories.source_text: "It was Krum."

memories.description: We have very little time left. If we don't get out soon the hostages could be lost.
memories.source_text: "Time was getting short, and according to the song, the hostages would be lost after an hour."

memories.description: Those weeds are brutal and proper strong. I can't just yank them off, they're clinging like mad and will not come loose with a bit of pulling.
memories.source_text: The ropes of weed tying the hostages to the statue were thick, slimy, and very strong.

memories.description: There's a whole crowd here, singing and dragging attention to that statue. They're organized and not about to let me rush in without them noticing.
memories.source_text: A choir of merpeople was singing in the middle, calling the champions toward them, and behind them rose a crude sort of statue; a gigantic merperson hewn from a boulder.

memories.description: I should've had something on me. That knife would have helped but it's miles away and I'm stuck here without it. Great timing, right?
memories.source_text: For a fleeting second he thought of the knife Sirius had bought him for Christmas — locked in his trunk in the castle a quarter of a mile away, no use to him whatsoever.

memories.description: I thought they'd attack the moment I came near but they're holding back. That means they're watching, waiting for something else to happen. I need a different plan than brute force.
memories.source_text: He sped toward the hostages, half expecting the merpeople to lower their spears and charge at him, but they did nothing.

memories.description: Ron's right there, caught in the middle between Hermione and Cho. I have to get to him first.
memories.source_text: Ron was tied between Hermione and Cho Chang.

memories.description: Right, the egg actually sang that riddle. It’s pointing me to voices that can only be heard underwater and warning I have an hour to get back whatever they take.
memories.source_text: “Come seek us where our voices sound, We cannot sing above the ground, And while you’re searching, ponder this: We’ve taken what you’ll sorely miss, An hour long you’ll have to look, And to recover what we took, But past an hour — the prospect’s black, Too late, it’s gone, it won’t come back.”

memories.description: Myrtle told me to open the egg under water. I did and that’s how I heard the song, so the clue only works underwater.
memories.source_text: “I’d try putting it in the water, if I were you.”

memories.description: Of course! The voices belong to the merpeople in the lake. The second task is about the lake and the merpeople.
memories.source_text: “Myrtle, there aren’t merpeople in there, are there?” “Oooh, very good,”

memories.description: I had to put my head under the water to hear the egg properly. Whatever I need to do for the task will probably mean being underwater for a while.
memories.source_text: “You need to put your head under too,”

memories.description: I’m not a good swimmer and I don’t know how I’ll breathe underwater. This is a real problem for the task.
memories.source_text: “how am I supposed to breathe?”

memories.description: Filch found the egg and called it a Triwizard clue. If anyone thinks Peeves stole it or it was in someone’s office, this is going to cause trouble and draw attention to whoever has the egg.
memories.source_text: “Egg? My sweet! This is a Triwizard clue! This belongs to a school champion!”

memories.description: Snape is sure his office was tampered with and is taking this seriously. If Filch and Snape are searching the corridors, I could be caught even under the Invisibility Cloak if the map shows me.
memories.source_text: “I seal my office with a spell none but a wizard could break!”

memories.description: Moody turned up in the corridor just as Filch and Snape were arguing. His arrival makes things even more dangerous and unpredictable.
memories.source_text: Mad-Eye Moody limp into sight

memories.description: Myrtle spies from the pipes and likes to boss people around. She’s touchy about being dead and will blubber if you mention breathing near her.
memories.source_text: Harry thinking about Myrtle and her spying

memories.description: Right, Snape thinks I broke into his office and he is threatening to force me to tell the truth with Veritaserum. He will try to bully me into confessing even though I did not do it.
memories.source_text: "I haven't been anywhere near your office!" "Do you know what this is, Potter?" "It is Veritaserum"

memories.description: Sirius is here for me. He is acting like my godfather, sneaking around, stealing papers and even risking being seen because he wants to help. He is an Animagus and only a few people know that.
memories.source_text: "Fulfilling my duty as godfather," "You three and Dumbledore are the only ones around here who know I'm an Animagus"

memories.description: I've only got ten minutes. This is mad but I have to move, now.
memories.source_text: "Ten minutes?" Harry croaked. "Ten — ten minutes?" He looked down at his watch. Dobby was right. It was twenty past nine.

memories.description: Dobby has gone and sorted this out for me because I hadn't found the right book. He's trying to help, even if it's at the last minute.
memories.source_text: "Dobby will do the task for him!" and "Dobby knew Harry had not found the right book, so Dobby did it for him!"

memories.description: They've taken Ron. I have to go into the lake and get him back. That's what's been taken from me.
memories.source_text: "Harry Potter has to go into the lake and find his Wheezy" and "They've got . . . they've got Ron?"

memories.description: Gillyweed will let me breathe underwater. I need to eat it before I go in if I'm going to reach Ron.
memories.source_text: "You has to eat this, sir!" and Dobby drew out a ball of what looked like slimy, grayish-green rat tails. "Right before you go into the lake, sir — gillyweed!" "It will make Harry Potter breathe underwater, sir!"

memories.description: If Dobby overheard McGonagall and Moody, then this gillyweed plan actually comes from what staff were saying. I trust it enough to use it now.
memories.source_text: "Dobby hears things, sir, he is a house-elf, he goes all over the castle as he lights the fires and mops the floors. Dobby heard Professor McGonagall and Professor Moody in the staffroom, talking about the next task."

memories.description: We have exactly one hour to get back whatever they took. No messing about, that's the limit.
memories.source_text: "All our champions are ready for the second task... They have precisely an hour to recover what has been taken from them."

memories.description: I tried to shout a spell and nothing came out. My voice can fail me under pressure so I can't rely on shouting.
memories.source_text: "Relashio!" Harry shouted, except that no sound came out.

memories.description: They won't help us. They don't care about anyone but their own. I tried to get that spear and they just laughed and shook their heads.
memories.source_text: "We do not help," he said in a harsh, croaky voice.

memories.description: No way I'm leaving anyone. Even if they expect me to save only Ron, I won't just stand by and let Hermione or anyone else be left to die.
memories.source_text: "Your task is to retrieve your own friend,"

memories.description: Hermione is my friend as much as Ron is. I care about both of them and I'm going to try and get them free.
memories.source_text: "She's my friend too!"

memories.description: Right, they can see my wand and they're scared. They don't know much magic, just like the giant squid, so if I act fast I might bluff them.
memories.source_text: Their yellowish eyes were fixed upon Harry's wand, and they looked scared. There might be a lot more of them than there were of him, but Harry could tell, by the looks on their faces, that they knew no more magic than the giant squid did.

memories.description: Get out of the way! I shouted it and they stopped. Okay, shouting worked. If I sound certain they'll listen, at least for a bit.
memories.source_text: "Get out of the way!"

memories.description: You've got until three. Counting them down actually makes them back off for now. I can buy a little time if I make a stand.
memories.source_text: "You've got until three!"

memories.description: Right now I have to hold them off and hope Fleur turns up. I can't leave Ron and the little girl, but I can't help Hermione if I'm pulled under. I have to be ready to fight to the surface.
memories.source_text: He snatched up the stone, which Krum had dropped, but the mermen now closed in around Ron and the little girl, shaking their heads at him.

memories.description: I'm sending a letter. Plain and simple, that's what I'm doing.
memories.source_text: "Sending a letter," said Harry and George in unison.

memories.description: I had a sealed envelope with a name on it, and Fred made sure I couldn't show it. Something's up with who that letter is for.
memories.source_text: Harry glanced at it, but Fred, whether accidentally or on purpose, shifted his hand so that the name on it was covered.

memories.description: I dragged her up because Fleur wasn't there. I couldn't just leave her down there.
memories.source_text: “Fleur didn’t turn up, I couldn’t leave her,” Harry panted.

memories.description: I was dying for air, fighting like mad for the surface, and I nearly didn't make it. Getting to the light was everything.
memories.source_text: He could feel pain on the sides of his neck again  he was becoming very aware of how wet the water was in his mouth  yet the darkness was definitely thinning now  he could see daylight above him

memories.description: I thought everyone might assume the worst, but Ron and Gabrielle came round. We're not dead, and we made it.
memories.source_text: Harry had the impression they thought that Ron and the little girl might be dead, but they were wrong  both of them had opened their eyes

memories.description: Those merpeople looked dangerous as anything. Down there I didn't feel safe for a second.
memories.source_text: surrounded by spear-carrying merpeople who’d looked more than capable of murder

memories.description: Dumbledore pulled me up. I don't know what I'd have done without someone getting me out of that mess.
memories.source_text: Dumbledore and Bagman were pulling Harry upright

memories.description: Moody has been searching Snape's office. That makes me think someone is really watching Snape.
memories.source_text: "Snape said Moody's searched his office as well?"

memories.description: Even though Snape hates me and gives me grief, Dumbledore might have given him a second chance. I can't just assume he is all bad.
memories.source_text: "Moody said Dumbledore only lets Snape stay here because he’s giving him a second chance or something."

memories.description: Snape saved my life before, but he still loathes me. He treats me like he did James. I distrust him but I remember he has helped me.
memories.source_text: "it was true that Snape had saved his life once, but the odd thing was, Snape definitely loathed him"

memories.description: I'm trying to fine tune my plan about the egg clue. I need time and space to work it out.
memories.source_text: "I just need to — sort of fine-tune it, all right?"

memories.description: I've searched everywhere and there is no spell that will let me live underwater for an hour. I am running out of options and time.
memories.source_text: "they found nothing whatsoever that would enable Harry to spend an hour underwater and live to tell the tale."

memories.description: The deadline is getting closer. Time is slipping and I have to find a way to get to the lake soon.
memories.source_text: "There was a week to go before February the twenty-fourth"

memories.description: Karkaroff's watching me. I made a point of shouting so he knows I noticed him. He's not pleased.
memories.source_text: "Yeah, that’s right," said Harry, raising his voice slightly so that Karkaroff could hear him.

memories.description: Dumbledore can speak Mermish and he was talking with the merpeople. He had things under control down there.
memories.source_text: Dumbledore was crouching at the water’s edge, deep in conversation with what seemed to be the chief merperson

memories.description: Of course Dumbledore set strict safety measures. I don't need to beat myself up about not grabbing Ron immediately.
memories.source_text: Now he was out of the water, it seemed perfectly clear that Dumbledore’s safety precautions wouldn’t have permitted the death of a hostage just because their champion hadn’t turned up.

memories.description: Fleur's grateful and over the moon with me. That was awkward and flattering at the same time.
memories.source_text: Fleur bent down, kissed Harry twice on each cheek

memories.description: I feel stupid for a second, but it makes sense now that Dumbledore wouldn't let someone die. I shouldn't be beating myself up.
memories.source_text: Harry’s feeling of stupidity was growing. Now he was out of the water, it seemed perfectly clear that Dumbledore’s safety precautions wouldn’t have permitted the death of a hostage.

memories.description: He escaped and is desperate to warn Dumbledore. He's clearly frantic and thinks everything is his fault.
memories.source_text: "I . . . escaped . . . must warn . . . must tell . . . see Dumbledore . . . my fault . . . all my fault . . ."

memories.description: Krum was attacked from behind. Someone from the Triwizard entourage was hurt and blamed Crouch.
memories.source_text: "He attacked me!"

memories.description: Dumbledore needs Crouch found right away. This is urgent and everyone is looking for him.
memories.source_text: "I don’t know where Barty Crouch is," Dumbledore told Moody, "but it is essential that we find him."

memories.description: I thought I could run off and sort things out, but this is bigger than me. I have to follow orders and stay put when told.
memories.source_text: "You stay here with him!" "I’ll get Dumbledore if you let me go, Mr. Crouch!"

memories.description: Dumbledore is being protective and strict with me. He wants me kept safe and under watch.
memories.source_text: "You will take Harry back to school, Hagrid," Dumbledore repeated firmly. "Take him right up to Gryffindor Tower. And Harry — I want you to stay there."

memories.description: Hagrid defends Dumbledore fiercely. People who accuse Dumbledore get a straight answer from Hagrid.
memories.source_text: "How dare he accuse Dumbledore. Like Dumbledore’d do anythin’ like that."

memories.description: Hagrid thinks we should be wary of the foreign students. It's made me more aware that not everyone from other schools is automatically to be trusted.
memories.source_text: "The less you lot ’ave ter do with these foreigners, the happier yeh’ll be. Yeh can’ trust any of ’em."

memories.description: Karkaroff accuses Dumbledore of plotting and cheating. He is furious and paranoid right now.
memories.source_text: "Treachery!" he bellowed, pointing at Dumbledore. "It is a plot! You and your Ministry of Magic have lured me here under false pretenses, Dumbledore!"

memories.description: Moody is on the scene and ready to help. He arrives fast even with his leg and takes things seriously.
memories.source_text: "No need, Dumbledore," said a wheezy growl. "I’m here."

memories.description: I got that tiny letter from Sirius telling me to send the Hogsmeade date back, so I scribbled the weekend after next on the parchment and sent the owl straight away.
memories.source_text: Send date of next Hogsmeade weekend by return owl.

memories.description: I was going through every book I could find by the light of my wand, refusing to stop until I found something about surviving underwater. I kept telling myself next book, next book, because I had to find it.
memories.source_text: He carried them over to a table, then set to work, searching them by the narrow beam of his wand, occasionally checking his watch.

memories.description: I kept dreaming about being stuck underwater, the mermaid laughing and teasing me while I tried to get my broom back. It feels like I can't catch a break, even in my sleep.
memories.source_text: The mermaid in the painting in the prefects’ bathroom was laughing.

memories.description: They’re making it sound like he’s dying, but he can’t be that ill if he managed to get up here.
memories.source_text: “They’re making it sound like he’s dying,” said Harry slowly.

memories.description: My wand wasn’t in my pocket after the Top Box and before the forest. If the Dark Mark was conjured from the Top Box then someone could have taken my wand there.
memories.source_text: “I didn’t need to use it before we got in the forest. And then I put my hand in my pocket, and all that was in there were my Omnioculars.”

memories.description: Winky being found holding my wand makes me suspect something odd happened in the Top Box and that Crouch reacted by blaming his elf instead of looking properly.
memories.source_text: “Yeah, at the Quidditch World Cup,” said Harry, and he launched into the story of the Dark Mark’s appearance, and Winky being found with Harry’s wand clutched in her hand, and Mr. Crouch’s fury.

memories.description: Crouch's family fell apart after his son died and people turned against the father. That's why his reputation crashed.
memories.source_text: “Once the boy had died, people started feeling a bit more sympathetic toward the son and started asking how a nice young lad from a good family had gone so badly astray.”

memories.description: Crouch isn't just obsessed with justice. He might be chasing Death Eaters to win his reputation back, not only for duty.
memories.source_text: “If you ask me, he still thinks he can bring back the old popularity by catching one more Death Eater.”

memories.description: Karkaroff went to Snape and showed him something on his arm, and Snape looked worried and evasive. That smells dodgy.
memories.source_text: “Karkaroff wanted to talk to Snape, he says Snape’s been avoiding him. Karkaroff looked really worried. He showed Snape something on his arm, but I couldn’t see what it was.”

memories.description: Sirius wants us to call him Snuffles when we talk about him to each other.
memories.source_text: “And don’t forget, if you’re talking about me among yourselves, call me Snuffles, okay?”

memories.description: Sirius is serious about keeping me at Hogwarts. He wants notes, not midnight visits.
memories.source_text: “I don’t want you lot sneaking out of school to see me, all right? Just send notes to me here.”

memories.description: Moody said my name and told me to come in. He was the one doing the inviting.
memories.source_text: "Hello, Potter," said Moody. "Come in, then."

memories.description: I walked into Dumbledore's office again. It's a beautiful, round room full of sleeping portraits of former headteachers, their chests going up and down.
memories.source_text: Harry walked inside. He had been inside Dumbledore’s office once before; it was a very beautiful, circular room, lined with pictures of previous headmasters and headmistresses of Hogwarts, all of whom were fast asleep, their chests rising and falling gently.

memories.description: Maybe Rita's not using Muggle gadgets, but she's eavesdropping on people by magic. That explains how she's getting dirt on us.
memories.source_text: "Maybe she had you bugged," said Harry.

memories.description: I don't think Rita's just gossiping. I believe she's actively spying on people and inventing stories from what she hears.
memories.source_text: "I want to know how she heard me talking to Viktor!"

memories.description: Hermione and I are mates. People can stop reading into it. She's not my girlfriend.
memories.source_text: "We’re friends. She’s not my girlfriend and she never has been."

memories.description: The third task is a maze and touching the Cup gives full marks. It's straightforward but dangerous because of the obstacles Hagrid will supply.
memories.source_text: "The Triwizard Cup will be placed in the center of the maze. The first champion to touch it will receive full marks."

memories.description: Crouch is not all right. Seeing him muttering and falling apart made me think something really bad has happened to him.
memories.source_text: "He looked as though he had been traveling for days."

memories.description: Dobby saved me with that gillyweed. I owe him big time. He helped keep me alive, plain and simple.
memories.source_text: “You saved my life with that gillyweed, Dobby, you really did,” said Harry.

memories.description: Winky thinks Mr Crouch is still her master and she won’t accept Dumbledore as her master. She’s miserable and it’s making her drink herself into a stupor.
memories.source_text: “Winky still thinks Mr. Crouch is her master, sir, and nothing Dobby says will persuade her that Professor Dumbledore is her master now.”

memories.description: Butterbeer hits house-elves a lot harder than it does us. What seems weak to us can knock them sideways.
memories.source_text: “’Tis strong for a house-elf, sir,” he said.

memories.description: I didn’t even clock that Ron’s leprechaun gold had vanished at the time. I was so wrapped up in my wand and everything else that I missed it.
memories.source_text: “Oh . . .” he said, the memory coming back to him at last. “I dunno . . . I never noticed it had gone. I was more worried about my wand, wasn’t I?”

memories.description: Who is he to lecture me about being out of bounds? After everything he did at school, I can't exactly take lectures from him.
memories.source_text: "Who’s he, to lecture me about being out-of-bounds?" said Harry in mild indignation as he folded up Sirius’s letter and put it inside his robes.

memories.description: No one has attacked me this year. Honestly, nothing's happened to me at all, so I'm not convinced there's an immediate threat.
memories.source_text: "No one’s tried to attack me all year," said Harry. "No one’s done anything to me at all —"

memories.description: I saw George give Fred a quick look before he smiled at Ron and Fred's grin disappeared. Something was up between them.
memories.source_text: "Harry saw George half glance at Fred, before smiling at Ron."

memories.description: George just nicked the letter off Fred and sent it away on an owl. They were treating it like a joke, not something serious.
memories.source_text: "George walked over to Fred, pulled the letter out of his hands, and began attaching it to the leg of the nearest barn owl."

memories.description: I found Mr Crouch. I was the one who turned him up on the grounds.
memories.source_text: "It was you who found him, was it not?" "Yes," said Harry.

memories.description: I didn't see Madame Maxime anywhere. If she was here she'd have a job hiding, so she must not be around.
memories.source_text: "I didn't see Madame Maxime anywhere, though, and she'd have a job hiding, wouldn't she?"

memories.description: Dumbledore told me to wait while they checked the grounds and said it would not take long.
memories.source_text: "Wait here for me, Harry," he said. "Our examination of the grounds will not take long."

memories.description: Moody's left. I can hear his wooden leg getting fainter down the corridor so I'm on my own here.
memories.source_text: "the clunks of Moody’s wooden leg growing fainter in the corridor below."

memories.description: Hello, Fawkes. I'm talking to Fawkes now, we're alone together.
memories.source_text: "Hello, Fawkes," he said.

memories.description: If it were really serious, they'd tell Dumbledore. I'm sure of it. They wouldn't keep something that big to themselves.
memories.source_text: "No," said Harry. "If it was something that serious, they'd tell someone. They'd tell Dumbledore."

memories.description: Moody is the sort of man who'd react like a cannon if we woke him up early. I don't want to risk him thinking we're attacking him.
memories.source_text: "Yes," said Harry. "He'd probably blast us through the door if we wake him at the crack of dawn; he’ll think we’re trying to attack him while he’s asleep."

memories.description: Where's Hagrid? He's not at his door and the curtains are closed. Something's wrong and I want to know what.
memories.source_text: "Where's Hagrid?"

memories.description: Hagrid's indisposed. Someone's said he's too ill or otherwise unable to be out here.
memories.source_text: "He is indisposed," said Professor Grubbly-Plank

memories.description: Someone shoved a Daily Prophet at me and I read that they are saying awful things about Hagrid.
memories.source_text: "There you go," he said. "Hate to break it to you, Potter. . . ."

memories.description: The Prophet says Hagrid is part-giant, breeds dangerous creatures like Blast-Ended Skrewts, has maimed pupils, and that Dumbledore made a mistake hiring him.
memories.source_text: Article heading: "DUMBLEDORE'S GIANT MISTAKE" and text naming Hagrid as part-giant and dangerous

memories.description: I can't believe the paper's dug up stuff about Hagrid's mother and his blood. How did they find out about Fridwulfa and all this? It's shocking.
memories.source_text: "How did she find out?"

memories.description: I'm not their target. If they could wait until I was away to act, they were aiming at someone else, not me.
memories.source_text: "let's say Sirius is right, and someone Stunned Krum to kidnap Crouch. Well, they would’ve been in the trees near us, wouldn’t they? But they waited till I was out of the way until they acted, didn’t they? So it doesn’t look like I’m their target, does it?"

memories.description: Crouch looked too weak to have Disapparated. He couldn't have just vanished on his own because he was too ill.
memories.source_text: "I don't think so," said Harry, shaking his head. "He seemed really weak — I don't reckon he was up to Disapparating or anything."

memories.description: He was rambling and all over the place. He kept talking about warning Dumbledore, Bertha Jorkins, his guilt, and his son.
memories.source_text: "I’ve told you, he wasn’t making much sense," said Harry. "He said he wanted to warn Dumbledore about something. He definitely mentioned Bertha Jorkins, and he seemed to think she was dead. He kept saying stuff was his fault. . . . He mentioned his son."

memories.description: He said You-Know-Who is getting stronger. That stuck with me and it worries me.
memories.source_text: "I’ve told you," Harry repeated dully. "He said he’s getting stronger."

memories.description: Someone's ordering them to hurry. That voice is cold and urgent and they need this potion done fast.
memories.source_text: "Hurry!"

memories.description: The potion is heating up crazy quickly and looks dangerous. It's bubbling and throwing sparks like it's on fire.
memories.source_text: The liquid in the cauldron seemed to heat very fast. The surface began not only to bubble, but to send out fiery sparks, as though it were on fire.

memories.description: Wormtail's working the fire under the cauldron, and he's getting anxious. He's moving about like he's rushed and worried.
memories.source_text: Wormtail was busying himself at the bottom of the cauldron with a wand. Steam was thickening, blurring the outline of Wormtail tending the fire. The movements beneath the robes became more agitated.

memories.description: The snake bolted off into the dark. It's gone, leaving the potion to heat up without it.
memories.source_text: The large snake slithered away into the darkness.

memories.description: My wand blasted them with what looked like boiling water and it actually burned the grindylows where it hit them. I had to spray shots behind me to keep them off.
memories.source_text: A large bubble issued from his mouth, and his wand, instead of sending sparks at the grindylows, pelted them with what seemed to be a jet of boiling water, for where it struck them, angry red patches appeared on their green skin.

memories.description: Those grindylows latch onto ankles and keep coming back. I had to kick like mad and even rammed one with my foot to shake them off.
memories.source_text: Harry pulled his ankle out of the grindylow’s grip and swam, as fast as he could, occasionally sending more jets of hot water over his shoulder at random; every now and then he felt one of the grindylows snatch at his foot again, and he kicked out, hard; finally, he felt his foot connect with a horned skull, and looking back, saw the dazed grindylow floating away, cross-eyed, while its fellows shook their fists at Harry and sank back into the weed.

memories.description: Myrtle turned up and told me where to go but she won't come with me. She thinks the grindylows chase her and she's not coming anywhere near them.
memories.source_text: He whipped around and saw Moaning Myrtle floating hazily in front of him, gazing at him through her thick, pearly glasses. "Myrtle!" Harry tried to shout — but once again, nothing came out of his mouth but a very large bubble. Moaning Myrtle actually giggled. "You want to try over there!" she said, pointing. "I won’t come with you. . . . I don’t like them much, they always chase me when I get too close. . . ."

memories.description: The merpeople sing about the time limit. Their song made it clear I have an hour to find what they took, so I had to hurry toward that rock.
memories.source_text: Then, at long last, he heard a snatch of haunting mersong. "An hour long you’ll have to look, And to recover what we took . . ." Harry swam faster and soon saw a large rock emerge out of the muddy water ahead.

memories.description: The merpeople are nothing like the pretty mermaid in the bathroom. They look nasty and dangerous, with grayish skin, yellow eyes and teeth, and weird ropes of pebbles. This place is serious.
memories.source_text: ". . . your time’s half gone, so tarry not Lest what you seek stays here to rot. . . ." A cluster of crude stone dwellings stained with algae loomed suddenly out of the gloom on all sides. Here and there at the dark windows, Harry saw faces . . . faces that bore no resemblance at all to the painting of the mermaid in the prefects’ bathroom. . . . The merpeople had grayish skin and long, wild, dark green hair. Their eyes were yellow, as were their broken teeth, and they wore thick ropes of pebbles around their necks.

memories.description: I felt like I was alone down there, deeper than I expected, with the silence closing in on me. It made me panic for a second, like I was having a heart attack, but I forced myself to keep going.
memories.source_text: He turned full circle in the water, the silence pressing harder than ever against his eardrums. He knew he must be even deeper in the lake now, but nothing was moving but the rippling weed. "How are you getting on?" Harry thought he was having a heart attack.

memories.description: Percy's gone all puffed up about being promoted. He brags like he's the supreme ruler of the universe.
memories.source_text: "I've been promoted," Percy said before Harry could even ask

memories.description: Percy is standing in for Crouch because Crouch is not well. He's been knocked about since the World Cup and they think he's overworked.
memories.source_text: "I'm now Mr. Crouch's personal assistant, and I'm here representing him."

memories.description: Dumbledore speaks to his plate and orders pork chops. Of course he does.
memories.source_text: "Pork chops!"

memories.description: Hermione's teaching Krum to say her name and she caught my eye with a grin. She's messing about and enjoying it.
memories.source_text: "Her-my-oh-nee," she said slowly and clearly. "Herm-own-ninny." "Close enough," she said, catching Harry's eye and grinning.

memories.description: Moody noticed my socks and called them out. Dobby knitted them for me, and I told him so, because I thought it was funny.
memories.source_text: "Nice socks, Potter," Moody growled as he passed, his magical eye staring through Harry's robes.

memories.description: Parvati grabbed me to dance. I kept my head down, did the dancing, and she steered the whole time. Then she left mid-evening to dance with someone else.
memories.source_text: "Come on!" Parvati hissed. "We're supposed to dance!"

memories.description: Ron blew up about Krum being from Durmstrang and acting like Hermione is betraying Hogwarts by talking to him. Ron's made himself really obvious about being jealous and cross.
memories.source_text: "He's from Durmstrang!" spat Ron. "He's competing against Harry! Against Hogwarts!"

memories.description: I can't believe Krum did that. I thought he was all right, but seeing him use an Unforgivable Curse makes me question him. He must have been desperate or messed up in some way.
memories.source_text: "The use of an Unforgivable Curse on a fellow human being meant a life term in Azkaban, that was what Moody had told them. Krum surely couldn’t have wanted the Triwizard Cup that badly. . . ."

memories.description: Right, with that sphinx you only get one shot. I asked for the riddle and worked it out under pressure. Thinking fast actually mattered there.
memories.source_text: "Answer on your first guess — I let you pass. Answer wrongly — I attack. Remain silent — I will let you walk away from me unscathed."

memories.description: I figured the sphinx's riddle out. Spy, er, spy, er, spider. That felt good. I got lucky but I did it.
memories.source_text: "Spy . . . er . . . spy . . . er . . ." said Harry, pacing up and down. "A creature I wouldn’t want to kiss . . . a spider!" The sphinx smiled more broadly. She got up, stretched her front legs, and then moved aside for him to pass.

memories.description: Cedric's faster than me. I knew I probably couldn't beat him in a straight race to the cup.
memories.source_text: "Cedric was sprinting as fast as he could toward the cup, and Harry knew he would never catch up, Cedric was much taller, had much longer legs —"

memories.description: Cedric's decent. He wants me to have it after I helped him. He even tells me to take the cup. That shows he's honorable, which I did not expect in a competition like this.
memories.source_text: "Cedric looked around at Harry again, who was now holding onto the hedge to support himself. Cedric took a deep breath. 'You take it. You should win. That’s twice you’ve saved my neck in here.'"

memories.description: We decide to share the win. Cedric and I go for the cup together. We're partners in that moment, not opponents.
memories.source_text: "We’ll take it at the same time. It’s still a Hogwarts victory. We’ll tie for it."

memories.description: That spider hit me hard. My leg's busted and bleeding. Spells like Stupefy barely work on those things alone. Getting disarmed and dropped hurt like mad.
memories.source_text: "He was lifted into the air in its front legs; struggling madly, he tried to kick it; his leg connected with the pincers and next moment he was in excruciating pain."

memories.description: Expelliarmus actually saved me from worse, but I still came down badly. My ankle’s messed up and I can barely stand.
memories.source_text: "Harry raised his wand as the spider opened its pincers once more and shouted 'Expelliarmus!' It worked — the Disarming Spell made the spider drop him, but that meant that Harry fell twelve feet onto his already injured leg, which crumpled beneath him."

memories.description: When he talked about Voldemort he was the clearest. He kept trying to say he had to see Dumbledore. That part sounded real.
memories.source_text: "He was sanest when he was trying to talk about Voldemort," said Harry, and Ron winced at the sound of the name.

memories.description: If Snape hadn't delayed me we might have made it. I keep thinking he blocked us for a reason and I hate that.
memories.source_text: "If Snape hadn't held me up," Harry said bitterly, "we might've got there in time. 'The headmaster is busy, Potter, what's this rubbish, Potter?' Why couldn't he have just got out of the way?"

memories.description: If Crouch had the Marauder's Map it would have been simple to find him inside the grounds.
memories.source_text: "If he had the Marauder's Map on him, it would've been easy," said Harry.

memories.description: TOM RIDDLE is carved on the headstone. I saw his name in the wandlight.
memories.source_text: "TOM RIDDLE"

memories.description: What the hell? It's Wormtail under the hood. I can tell by the missing finger and his breathing.
memories.source_text: "You!"

memories.description: I'm tied to the headstone so tight I can't move an inch. He bound me from neck to ankles.
memories.source_text: the cloaked man was now conjuring tight cords around Harry, tying him from neck to ankles to the headstone

memories.description: Wormtail's not just creepy, he's actively attacking me. He's an enemy who just grabbed me and tied me up.
memories.source_text: he hit him — hit him with a hand that had a finger missing

memories.description: The Cup was a Portkey. Nobody told me it would send us somewhere.
memories.source_text: "Did anyone tell you the Cup was a Portkey?"

memories.description: We're not at Hogwarts anymore; we're miles away in a dark, overgrown graveyard. That's bad news.
memories.source_text: "Where are we?"

memories.description: This feels dangerous, so I grabbed my wand straight away and got ready for trouble.
memories.source_text: "Wands out, d'you reckon?"

memories.description: Blast-Ended Skrewts are huge and dangerous. I had to get away fast when Cedric warned me about them.
memories.source_text: “Hagrid’s Blast-Ended Skrewts!”

memories.description: A Patronus actually works on dementors. I summoned a silver stag and it drove the thing back and made it stumble.
memories.source_text: “Expecto Patronum!”

memories.description: Sometimes things in the maze can be illusions or shape-shifters. Calling it out and using a trick can make them explode into smoke.
memories.source_text: “You’re a boggart! Riddikulus!”

memories.description: Reducto only works on solid stuff. It went straight through that golden mist and did nothing.
memories.source_text: “Reducto!”

memories.description: Fleur screamed and then went silent. That scream told me she might be out of the task or in trouble.
memories.source_text: “Fleur?”

memories.description: Stupefy can stop another champion in their tracks. I used it on Krum and it brought him down.
memories.source_text: “Stupefy!”

memories.description: Impedimenta can freeze a creature if you hit the right spot. I managed to stop the skrewt by hitting its soft underside.
memories.source_text: “IMPEDIMENTA!”

memories.description: Krum will attack another champion without warning. I barged through the hedge and found Cedric under an Unforgivable Curse.
memories.source_text: “What are you doing?” yelled Cedric’s voice. “What the hell d’you think you’re doing?”

memories.description: Someone actually used the Cruciatus Curse in the maze. Cedric was writhing and twitching from it and I had to act fast.
memories.source_text: “Crucio!”

memories.description: I went straight to Cedric after stopping Krum. I grabbed him and checked he was breathing and okay.
memories.source_text: “Are you all right?”

memories.description: Someone's coming. I can feel we're being watched and there's a short hooded figure walking toward us between the graves. It's carrying something that looks like a baby or a bundle of robes and it stopped about six feet away.
memories.source_text: “Someone’s coming,”

memories.description: Cedric is dead. His body is about twenty feet away and I can see him lying there.
memories.source_text: Cedric’s body was lying some twenty feet away.

memories.description: The Triwizard Cup is nearby, glinting in the starlight not far past Cedric.
memories.source_text: Some way beyond him, glinting in the starlight, lay the Triwizard Cup.

memories.description: My wand is on the ground by Cedric’s feet. I do not have my wand.
memories.source_text: Harry’s wand was on the ground at Cedric’s feet.

memories.description: That bundle of robes I thought was a baby is at the foot of the grave and it is moving.
memories.source_text: The bundle of robes that Harry had thought was a baby was close by, at the foot of the grave.

memories.description: The thing in the robes is trying to get out. It is moving and struggling.
memories.source_text: It seemed to be stirring fretfully.

memories.description: My scar is burning with pain again. I feel it, and it tells me something awful is happening.
memories.source_text: Harry watched it, and his scar seared with pain again

memories.description: I am tied up and I cannot move my head or make a sound. I can only see what is right in front of me.
memories.source_text: He couldn’t make a sound, nor could he see where Wormtail had gone; he couldn’t turn his head to see beyond the headstone; he could see only what was right in front of him.

memories.description: There is a huge snake slithering around the headstone where I am tied. It is circling me.
memories.source_text: He looked down and saw a gigantic snake slithering through the grass, circling the headstone where he was tied.

memories.description: Wormtail is nearby, breathing wheezily, like he is dragging something heavy.
memories.source_text: Wormtail’s fast, wheezy breathing was growing louder again. It sounded as though he was forcing something heavy across the ground.

memories.description: Wormtail has pushed a huge stone cauldron to the grave. It is full of water and it is big enough for a grown man to sit in.
memories.source_text: Then he came back within Harry’s range of vision, and Harry saw him pushing a stone cauldron to the foot of the grave. It was full of what seemed to be water — Harry could hear it slopping around — and it was larger than any cauldron Harry had ever used; a great stone belly large enough for a full-grown man to sit in.

memories.description: It didn't work. The revival failed. Nothing came back.
memories.source_text: Nothing happened.

memories.description: I wanted it to have gone wrong. I actually hoped the whole thing had failed rather than what was happening now.
memories.source_text: Let it have drowned, Harry thought, let it have gone wrong.

memories.description: A blast of thick white steam filled my view. I couldn't see Wormtail or Cedric anymore, just vapor everywhere.
memories.source_text: A surge of white steam billowed thickly from the cauldron instead, obliterating everything in front of Harry, so that he couldn’t see Wormtail or Cedric or anything but vapor hanging in the air.

memories.description: Dumbledore thinks You-Know-Who is getting stronger again. Great. Just what we needed.
memories.source_text: "Dumbledore reckons You-Know-Who's getting stronger again as well?"

memories.description: Dumbledore trusts Snape even though Snape used to be a Death Eater. I can't just dismiss that. If Dumbledore trusts him, there's got to be more going on.
memories.source_text: "He really trusts Snape, even though he knows he was a Death Eater?"

memories.description: Rita Skeeter has run a story calling me disturbed and dangerous, saying I collapse from my scar and even implying I might be like You-Know-Who. That's rubbish and it's meant to turn people against me.
memories.source_text: "HARRY POTTER 'DISTURBED AND DANGEROUS'" headline and article

memories.description: They're making a big deal out of the fact I can speak Parseltongue. Malfoy and others are using it to link me to Dark stuff. It's nasty and it scares people.
memories.source_text: "Potter can speak Parseltongue," reveals Draco Malfoy

memories.description: If Rita got details like my scar hurting from outside my dorm, then someone must have been listening or spying. I can't assume everything is private anymore.
memories.source_text: "The window was open," said Harry.

memories.description: McGonagall and the professors are guarding the maze. If I get into trouble I can send red sparks and they'll come for me. That makes the whole thing slightly less terrifying.
memories.source_text: "We are going to be patrolling the outside of the maze," said Professor McGonagall

memories.description: I'm tied with Cedric going into the final task. It's down to me to keep my head and do the hexes I practiced.
memories.source_text: "Tied in first place, with eighty-five points each — Mr. Cedric Diggory and Mr. Harry Potter"

memories.description: The Weasleys turned up to watch me. That means more than I can say. It's good to have them here.
memories.source_text: "Surprise!" Mrs. Weasley said excitedly... "Thought we'd come and watch you, Harry!"

memories.description: What the hell is that? They had some creature, shaped like a crouched child but not a child at all, hairless and scaly with a flat, snakelike face and gleaming red eyes. They lowered it into the cauldron, it hissed and vanished below the surface.
memories.source_text: It is ready, Master.

memories.description: Wormtail looked sick and weak, not proud. He carried that thing with revulsion on his face, which makes him seem even more cowardly and miserable to me.
memories.source_text: It is ready, Master.

memories.description: I am not going to curl up and hide. If I die, I will stand up and fight like my father. I'm doing this on purpose and I refuse to go down on my knees.
memories.source_text: "he was not going to die crouching here like a child playing hide-and-seek; he was not going to die kneeling at Voldemort’s feet . . . he was going to die upright like his father, and he was going to die trying to defend himself, even if no defense was possible."

memories.description: My spell can meet his spell head on. When I shout Expelliarmus against Avada Kedavra they collide and something strange happens to both wands.
memories.source_text: "As Harry shouted, 'Expelliarmus!' Voldemort cried, 'Avada Kedavra!' A jet of green light issued from Voldemort’s wand just as a jet of red light blasted from Harry’s — they met in midair"

memories.description: When our spells connected a golden thread joined my wand to his. The wands can link in a way I have never seen before.
memories.source_text: "a narrow beam of light connected the two wands, neither red nor green, but bright, deep gold."

memories.description: That music is phoenix song. It fills me with hope and it feels like Dumbledore is right there with me. I can feel it inside me.
memories.source_text: "It was a sound Harry recognized, though he had heard it only once before in his life: phoenix song."

memories.description: The connection can push toward me. The light beads move along the thread and my wand gets unbearably hot when they come near. I can fight to shove them back though.
memories.source_text: "His wand began to vibrate more powerfully than ever . . . and now the beam between him and Voldemort changed too . . . it was as though large beads of light were sliding up and down the thread connecting the wands"

memories.description: If I hold on and focus hard enough I can force the magic back toward him. I can resist and even reverse whatever is coming at me.
memories.source_text: "He concentrated every last particle of his mind upon forcing the bead back toward Voldemort, his ears full of phoenix song, his eyes furious, fixed . . . and slowly, very slowly, the beads quivered to a halt, and then, just as slowly, they began to move the other way"

memories.description: They're using a piece of someone's bones to bring someone back. That's what that line meant. They're actually trying to renew him with a father's bone.
memories.source_text: Bone of the father, unknowingly given, you will renew your son!

memories.description: Wormtail is cutting himself and giving his own flesh to make this thing work. He is willing to hurt himself to bring his master back.
memories.source_text: Flesh of the servant willingly given you will revive your master

memories.description: They took my blood and poured it into that cauldron to revive him. My blood is part of the ritual and that's why they needed me tied up.
memories.source_text: B-blood of the enemy forcibly taken you will resurrect your foe

memories.description: I couldn't believe Wormtail would stab me to get my blood. I know now that I'm helpless in his hands and he'll hurt me to bring his master back.
memories.source_text: He felt its point penetrate the crook of his right arm and blood seeping down the sleeve of his torn robes

memories.description: Wormtail isn't just loyal, he's desperate and terrified. He's willing to do filthy things for his master even if it means hurting me. He's a coward who'll betray any decency to save his boss.
memories.source_text: He was whimpering... He pulled a long, thin, shining silver dagger from inside his cloak

memories.description: He can force people to obey with his wand and scares everyone into laughing at me when I'm on the receiving end.
memories.source_text: "I said, bow," Voldemort said, raising his wand — and Harry felt his spine curve as though a huge, invisible hand were bending him ruthlessly forward, and the Death Eaters laughed harder than ever.

memories.description: I can shout no and drag myself out of whatever his spells try to do to my mind. I refused the command and it snapped me back.
memories.source_text: "I WON'T!"

memories.description: Voldemort wants me to be obedient before he kills me. He's trying to break me and teach me to obey him.
memories.source_text: "You won't say no? Harry, obedience is a virtue I need to teach you before you die."

memories.description: My Quidditch reflexes actually save me in a fight. I can dodge when it counts.
memories.source_text: "with the reflexes born of his Quidditch training, he flung himself sideways onto the ground; he rolled behind the marble headstone of Voldemort’s father, and he heard it crack as the curse missed him."

memories.description: I won't play along or beg for my life just to make him happy. I'll stay proud even if it costs me.
memories.source_text: "he was not going to give him that satisfaction.\u0020.\u0020.\u0020he wasn't going to obey Voldemort\u0020.\u0020.\u0020he wasn't going to beg."

memories.description: My scar exploded with pain the moment that high cold voice said "Kill the spare" and I heard "Avada Kedavra". That voice and that curse hit me like nothing before and made my scar scream.
memories.source_text: "Kill the spare." "Avada Kedavra!"

memories.description: Cedric is dead. He's lying next to me with open gray eyes and his mouth half-open. I couldn't believe it!
memories.source_text: Cedric was lying spread-eagled on the ground beside him. He was dead.

memories.description: That short man in the cloak grabbed me, put me on my feet and dragged me toward the marble headstone. He's the one who shoved me into this, he's in control of what happens to me now.
memories.source_text: The short man in the cloak had put down his bundle, lit his wand, and was dragging Harry toward the marble headstone.

memories.description: He is back. Voldemort is back. I couldn't believe it when I saw him.
memories.source_text: "He’s back," Harry whispered. "He’s back. Voldemort."

memories.description: Cedric is dead. They killed Cedric and I held him and I tried to bring him back for his parents.
memories.source_text: "Dumbledore — he’s dead!"

memories.description: Voldemort used stuff from his father's grave, stuff from Wormtail, and my blood to get himself back. He used me against him.
memories.source_text: "He took stuff from his father’s grave, and from Wormtail, and me," said Harry.

memories.description: Loads of Death Eaters came back with him. He has allies again.
memories.source_text: "And the Death Eaters? They returned?" "Yes," said Harry. "Loads of them"

memories.description: I saw Mum and Dad come out of his wand. That was the weirdest thing, like they were real and then gone again.
memories.source_text: "I saw my mum and dad . . . they came out of his wand."

memories.description: There is a Death Eater at Hogwarts who rigged the Triwizard stuff to make me compete. Someone here betrayed me.
memories.source_text: "There’s a Death Eater at Hogwarts! There’s a Death Eater here — they put my name in the Goblet of Fire, they made sure I got through to the end —"

memories.description: I used to hope he was gone for good. Not anymore. He's back in a body and that changes everything.
memories.source_text: "The Dark Lord got his body back? He’s returned?"

memories.description: Professor McGonagall is staying here to keep watch while Dumbledore takes me upstairs. She's solid about it even if she looks a bit sick.
memories.source_text: "Minerva, could I ask you to stand guard here while I take Harry upstairs?" "Of course," said Professor McGonagall.

memories.description: Dumbledore wants Snape to fetch Madam Pomfrey so Moody can go to the hospital wing. Moody needs medical attention and Dumbledore's heading there.
memories.source_text: "Severus" — Dumbledore turned to Snape — "please tell Madam Pomfrey to come down here; we need to get Alastor Moody into the hospital wing."

memories.description: Dumbledore is sending Snape to bring Fudge up here because Fudge will want to question Crouch in person.
memories.source_text: "Then go down into the grounds, find Cornelius Fudge, and bring him up to this office. He will undoubtedly want to question Crouch himself."

memories.description: Dumbledore says he'll be in the hospital wing in half an hour if Fudge needs him. He's prioritizing the hospital wing right now.
memories.source_text: "Tell him I will be in the hospital wing in half an hour’s time if he needs me."

memories.description: Snape nodded and left without a word. He's following Dumbledore's orders straight away and doesn't hang about.
memories.source_text: "Snape nodded silently and swept out of the room."

memories.description: Dumbledore is still looking out for me. He speaks to me gently and is taking responsibility for what happens next.
memories.source_text: "Harry?" Dumbledore said gently.

memories.description: Cedric's parents are with Professor Sprout. She's looking after them because she was Head of his House.
memories.source_text: "They are with Professor Sprout," said Dumbledore.

memories.description: I saw Moody in a trunk, Wormtail wounded, Voldemort rising from a cauldron, and Cedric dead asking to be returned to his parents.
memories.source_text: "Mad-Eye Moody, inside the trunk. Wormtail, slumped on the ground, cradling his stump of an arm. Voldemort, rising from the steaming cauldron. Cedric . . . dead . . . Cedric, asking to be returned to his parents."

memories.description: I touched the Portkey in the maze and whatever happened after that matters. I can't just avoid it forever even though I want to.
memories.source_text: "I need to know what happened after you touched the Portkey in the maze, Harry," said Dumbledore.

memories.description: Sirius cares about me and wants me to rest. I felt grateful when he put a hand on my shoulder.
memories.source_text: "Let him have a sleep. Let him rest."

memories.description: Fawkes is comforting. His weight and presence calmed me when everything else was raw.
memories.source_text: There was a soft rush of wings. Fawkes the phoenix had left his perch, flown across the office, and landed on Harry's knee.

memories.description: Something can be forced out of Voldemort's wand, like a smoky hand or even people. I actually pushed a bead of light back into his wand and things started coming out of it.
memories.source_text: "The ghost of the hand he had made Wormtail"

memories.description: Cedric came out of Voldemort's wand as a solid looking shade and spoke to me. He trusted me enough to ask me to take his body back to his parents. I promised I would.
memories.source_text: "the torso of Cedric Diggory"

memories.description: My mum and dad showed up from the wand too. My mum told me to hold on for my dad and my dad told me to be ready to run and get to the Portkey that will return me to Hogwarts. I have to get to that Portkey when I can.
memories.source_text: "Your father's coming. Hold on for your father. It will be all right. Hold on."

memories.description: Voldemort's wand can suffer and be disrupted when something is forced back into it. That shook me. It made me realise he is not untouchable.
memories.source_text: "Voldemort's wand began to emit echoing screams of pain"

memories.description: The dead people that came out of the wand were trying to keep me alive by shielding me from Voldemort's gaze and shouting encouragement. They bought me the chance to run.
memories.source_text: "Don't let him get you, Harry don't let go!"

memories.description: When I yelled Accio at the Triwizard Cup I was trying to pull it toward me. I can summon the Cup under pressure even with curses flying everywhere.
memories.source_text: "Accio!"

memories.description: When the golden thread broke, the cage of light vanished but the shades stayed long enough to help. I had to run as fast as I could right then or lose the chance.
memories.source_text: "NOW!"

memories.description: Karkaroff ran away the night his Dark Mark burned. He betrayed people and now he is on the run because Voldemort can track his enemies.
memories.source_text: “Karkaroff fled tonight, when he felt the Dark Mark burn upon his arm. He betrayed too many faithful supporters of the Dark Lord to wish to meet them . . . but I doubt he will get far. The Dark Lord has ways of tracking his enemies.”

memories.description: Moody just told me he was the one who put my name into the Goblet of Fire.
memories.source_text: “No,” said Moody slowly. “No, he didn't. It was I who did that.”

memories.description: I couldn't believe Moody at first. I kept thinking he couldn't have done it.
memories.source_text: “No, you didn’t,” he said. “You didn’t do that . . . you can’t have done . . .”

memories.description: He admits he rigged the whole thing for me. He put my name in, scared off anyone who might stop me, pushed Hagrid to show me the dragons, and helped me figure out how to beat the dragon.
memories.source_text: “Who put your name in the Goblet of Fire, under the name of a different school? I did. Who frightened off every person I thought might try to hurt you or prevent you from winning the tournament? I did. Who nudged Hagrid into showing you the dragons? I did. Who helped you see the only way you could beat the dragon? I did.”

memories.description: Moody was spying on me the whole time. He says he saw I didn't get the egg clue and that he gave me another hint.
memories.source_text: “I was keeping watch on you, Potter. I knew you hadn’t worked out the egg’s clue, so I had to give you another hint —”

memories.description: He claims he told Cedric how to open the egg underwater, relying on Cedric to pass it to me. He thinks people like Cedric are easy to manipulate.
memories.source_text: “Who told Cedric to open it underwater? I did. I trusted that he would pass the information on to you. Decent people are so easy to manipulate, Potter. I was sure Cedric would want to repay you for telling him about the dragons, and so he did.”

memories.description: Moody says he planted the book I needed in my dormitory by giving it to Neville.
memories.source_text: “I planted it there early on, I gave it to the Longbottom boy, don’t you remember?”

memories.description: Moody just pointed his wand at me while telling me this. I feel betrayed and threatened by him now.
memories.source_text: At the same time, Moody drew out his wand and pointed it at Harry.

memories.description: He admits he planned everything so Dumbledore would not suspect him, and that he arranged for me to have the best chance in the maze by getting rid of the other champions.
memories.source_text: “I have had to use every ounce of cunning I possess, so that my hand would not be detectable in your success. Dumbledore would have been very suspicious if you had managed everything too easily. As long as you got into that maze, preferably with a decent head start — then, I knew, I would have a chance of getting rid of the other champions and leaving your way clear.”

memories.description: My leg started hurting again, proper pain this time, after all that listening. I was aching and weak.
memories.source_text: the pain in his leg, which he had not noticed all the time he had been listening to Crouch, now returned in full measure

memories.description: I was shaking. My hands felt useless and everything was a bit wobbly.
memories.source_text: He also realized that he was shaking

memories.description: Dumbledore grabbed my arm and helped me along. He's watching out for me right now.
memories.source_text: Dumbledore gripped his arm and helped him out into the dark corridor

memories.description: Dumbledore told me to go up to his office first and said Sirius is waiting there. Sirius is here.
memories.source_text: “I want you to come up to my office first, Harry,” he said quietly as they headed up the passageway. “Sirius is waiting for us there.”

memories.description: I felt numb and unreal, and strangely I didn't mind. I was almost glad to be detached from it all.
memories.source_text: A kind of numbness and a sense of complete unreality were upon him, but he did not care; he was even glad of it

memories.description: I know that voice. I recognised it straight away, even if I wasn't sure what to do next.
memories.source_text: “Lower your wand, boy, before you take someone’s eye out,” said a low, growling voice.

memories.description: I'm suspicious of him. I didn't lower my wand all the way and I kept my grip tight because I don't trust whatever Moody really is.
memories.source_text: “Professor Moody?” he said uncertainly. “I don’t know so much about ‘Professor,’” growled the voice, “never got round to much teaching, did I? Get down here, we want to see you properly.”

memories.description: I'm not messing about. If someone's trying to wind me up or threaten me I tell them to get out. I won't put up with it.
memories.source_text: "Get out," said Harry.

memories.description: Right, so there was blackmail involved and George was mixed up in it. I need to know who's behind things if it's going to affect any of us.
memories.source_text: "You going to tell us, then?" he said to George. "Who you were blackmailing?"

memories.description: Bagman was involved in the mess with the leprechaun gold and bets. That explains why he was hanging around helping me so much.
memories.source_text: "Bagman?" said Harry sharply. "Are you saying he was involved in —"

memories.description: I cast the Patronus Charm to drive the dementors away. It is the only thing that works against them.
memories.source_text: "I did the Patronus Charm to get rid of the dementors,"

memories.description: I think Voldemort must have sent the dementors. It feels like they were there for me on purpose.
memories.source_text: "He must have sent them," said Harry quietly, more to himself than to Uncle Vernon.

memories.description: Voldemort is back. I saw him a month ago and he's returned.
memories.source_text: "Lord Voldemort," said Harry.

memories.description: Aunt Petunia looked at me with real fear for the first time. Her whole attitude toward magic cracked open.
memories.source_text: "Back?" whispered Aunt Petunia. She was looking at Harry as she had never looked at him before.

memories.description: Dudley got hurt and the Ministry thinks I did magic there. I'm facing an expulsion case whether or not the dementors were involved.
memories.source_text: "If it was demenders who hurt Dudley, how come you've been expelled? You did you-know-what, you've admitted it!"

memories.description: I feel awful about winning. I shouldn't have had the Cup. Cedric should have won, not me.
memories.source_text: "I don't want that gold," said Harry in an expressionless voice. "You have it. Anyone can have it. I shouldn't have won it. It should've been Cedric's."

memories.description: I told Cedric to take the Cup with me. I said it out loud and I can't get rid of the thought that what I said mattered.
memories.source_text: "I told him to take the Cup with me," said Harry.

memories.description: Sirius promised he'll be back and I said I understood. I want to believe him and I'm clinging to that promise.
memories.source_text: "You’ll see me very soon, Harry," said Sirius, turning to him. "I promise you." "Yeah," said Harry. "Yeah . . . of course I do."

memories.description: They're trying to bury Cedric and the real story. The Prophet has barely mentioned any of it and I think Fudge is making them keep quiet. That's dodgy and wrong.
memories.source_text: There’s nothing in there. You can look for yourself, but there’s nothing at all. I’ve been checking every day. Just a small piece the day after the third task saying you won the tournament. They didn’t even mention Cedric. Nothing about any of it. If you ask me, Fudge is forcing them to keep quiet.

memories.description: Rita Skeeter has gone quiet on paper since the third task. She might still be a problem, but she hasn't printed anything new.
memories.source_text: Oh, Rita hasn’t written anything at all since the third task

memories.description: Rita Skeeter is an Animagus who turns into a beetle. She's been spying on people in bug form. I can't believe she was that brazen, but Hermione's right.
memories.source_text: That’s never — you’re kidding — No, I’m not ... I caught her on the windowsill in the hospital wing. Look very closely, and you’ll notice the markings around her antennae are exactly like those foul glasses she wears.

memories.description: Krum liked Cedric and thought he was polite. That tells me Cedric was respected even by other schools. It matters that people across schools thought well of him.
memories.source_text: I liked Diggory ... He vos alvays polite to me. Alvays. Even though I vos from Durmstrang — with Karkaroff

memories.description: I grabbed Cedric's gold and tried to give it away. I wanted to give it to his family because he deserved it, but they wouldn't take it. I felt like I should do something for him.
memories.source_text: "You take this," he muttered to her. "It should’ve been Cedric’s, he got there first, you take it —"

memories.description: Hagrid hugged me and made it clear I'm not all right. I'm shaken and he sees it, but he keeps saying we'll have to get on with it and fight.
memories.source_text: "You all righ’?" he said gruffly. "Yeah," said Harry. "No, yeh’re not," said Hagrid.

memories.description: I can't pretend anymore. Voldemort is back and people like Hagrid have been expecting this. It's not just some horrible dream. We have to face it.
memories.source_text: "Knew he was goin’ ter come back," said Hagrid, and Harry, Ron, and Hermione looked up at him, shocked.

memories.description: Hagrid told me I did as much as my dad would have. That mattered to me. It made me feel a bit like my parents were still with me.
memories.source_text: "Yeh did as much as yer father would’ve done, an’ I can’ give yeh no higher praise than that."

memories.description: Dumbledore told everyone to remember Cedric and to choose the right thing when it counts. That speech made it clear how serious this is and that people expect better of me.
memories.source_text: "Remember Cedric. Remember, if the time should come when you have to make a choice between what is right and what is easy, remember what happened to a boy who was good, and kind, and brave, because he strayed across the path of Lord Voldemort. Remember Cedric Diggory."

memories.description: My trunk is packed and Hedwig is with me. I'm leaving Hogwarts feeling empty and I'm dreading going back to Privet Drive.
memories.source_text: Harry’s trunk was packed; Hedwig was back in her cage on top of it.

memories.description: We're going by broomstick. That's how we're getting there.
memories.source_text: "Brooms," said Lupin.

memories.description: I can't Apparate, the Floo network is being watched, and a Portkey is off the table. Flying is the only safe option.
memories.source_text: "Only way. You're too young to Apparate, they'll be watching the Floo Network, and it's more than our life's worth to set up an unauthorized Portkey."

memories.description: Moody's making sure we can see everything on the way back. He's serious about keeping watch.
memories.source_text: "I want three-hundred-and-sixty degrees visibility on the return journey."

memories.description: Remus and Kingsley think I can handle a broom. Lupin says I'm excellent, so they expect me to fly well.
memories.source_text: "Remus says you're a good flier," said Kingsley Shacklebolt ... "He's excellent," said Lupin.

memories.description: I need to pack now and be ready to leave the moment they give the signal.
memories.source_text: "Anyway, you'd better go and get packed, Harry, we want to be ready to go when the signal comes."

memories.description: Tonks is coming to help me pack. She's cheerful about it.
memories.source_text: "I'll come and help you," said Tonks brightly.

memories.description: Dumbledore had me followed. I can't believe they'd shadow me, but Mrs Figg says they did so I need to expect more of that.
memories.source_text: Of course he has," said Mrs Figg impatiently.

memories.description: I did not cast the thing that made Dudley hear those horrors. I am not the one responsible for that.
memories.source_text: It wasn’t me!

memories.description: Mrs Figg is watching out for me. She is on my side and will try to keep me safe and give instructions when needed.
memories.source_text: I’ll take you to the door," said Mrs Figg

memories.description: I saw the potion that brought Voldemort back. The surface was sparkling and I know that's what woke him up.
memories.source_text: he saw the sparkling surface of the potion that had revived Voldemort;

memories.description: The Death Eaters apparated all around the graves. They turned up out of nowhere, right where we were.
memories.source_text: he saw the Death Eaters Apparating between the graves around them;
