memories.description: Cedric was lying dead by the cup. He was right there on the ground.
memories.source_text: he saw Cedric’s body, lying on the ground beside the cup.

memories.description: Wormtail stabbed me in the arm with a dagger. It hurt like mad and it was Voldemort's sidekick who did it.
memories.source_text: When Harry told of Wormtail piercing his arm with the dagger, however, Sirius let out a vehement exclamation

memories.description: Telling it all made me feel better. Saying it out loud pulled something poisonous out of me, like I could breathe again.
memories.source_text: It was even a relief; he felt almost as though something poisonous were being extracted from him.

memories.description: Sirius is desperate and protective, grabbing my shoulder like he wants to jump in. Dumbledore stopped him, which showed me Dumbledore wants control of how this is handled.
memories.source_text: Once or twice, Sirius made a noise as though about to say something, his hand still tight on Harry’s shoulder, but Dumbledore raised his hand to stop him

memories.description: Dumbledore's reaction when I said Wormtail stabbed me was instant. He sprang up so fast it made me start, so I know he takes this seriously and he's ready to act.
memories.source_text: Dumbledore stood up so quickly that Harry started.

memories.description: Mrs Figg knows Dumbledore and was acting on his orders to watch me. I can't believe she was spying on the Dursleys for Dumbledore all that time.
memories.source_text: "Of course I know Dumbledore, who doesn’t know Dumbledore?"

memories.description: Mrs Figg is a Squib. She can't perform magic to help against dementors, which is why she couldn't defend me.
memories.source_text: "I’m a Squib, as Mundungus knows full well, so how on earth was I supposed to help you fight off dementors?"

memories.description: Mundungus was supposed to be on watch and he left. He abandoned his duty while I was attacked by dementors.
memories.source_text: "MUNDUNGUS FLETCHER, I AM GOING TO KILL YOU!"

memories.description: Mundungus can Apparate and he has an Invisibility Cloak. He's dodgy and not exactly reliable.
memories.source_text: "There was a loud crack and a strong smell of mingled drink and stale tobacco filled the air as a squat, unshaven man in a tattered overcoat materialized right in front of them."

memories.description: The Ministry will probably detect that I used magic, and that could get me into real trouble even though I used it to save us from dementors.
memories.source_text: "The Ministry have their own ways of detecting underage magic, they’ll know already, you mark my words"

memories.description: I can use my owl to send word to Dumbledore or get help, so I have a way to contact people quickly.
memories.source_text: "I’ve got an owl, you can borrow her,"

memories.description: Dementors were actually in Wisteria Walk and they attacked me. That's why I had to use magic in front of Dudley.
memories.source_text: "Dementors attacking the boy on your watch!"

memories.description: Dudley was knocked out or in shock after the dementor attack and I had to drag him. He's helpless right now and I had to haul him along.
memories.source_text: "Get your fat bottom off the ground, quick!"

memories.description: This place looks like it belongs to a Dark wizard. What the hell is going on here?
memories.source_text: "What on earth were they doing in a house that looked as though it belonged to the Darkest of wizards?"

memories.description: Mrs Weasley's rushing off and says Ron and Hermione will explain things. Fine, I'll get the explanation from them.
memories.source_text: "Ron and Hermione will explain everything, dear, I’ve really got to dash,"

memories.description: So Tonks can change her appearance whenever she wants. She was born like that. That is mental
memories.source_text: “I’m a Metamorphmagus,” she said, looking back at her reflection and turning her head so that she could see her hair from all directions.

memories.description: Tonks is an Auror. Kingsley is higher up than her and she only qualified a year ago
memories.source_text: “You’re an Auror?” said Harry, impressed.

memories.description: You can’t learn to be a Metamorphmagus. You’re born one or you use wandwork and potions instead
memories.source_text: “Metamorphmagi are really rare, they’re born, not made.

memories.description: Tonks can do some cleaning spells but she’s not brilliant at household magic. Hedwig’s cage was getting smelly
memories.source_text: “Scourgify —” She pointed her wand at Hedwig’s cage; a few feathers and droppings vanished.

memories.description: My Firebolt is special. It’s my pride and joy and it actually matters to others. I still ride a proper broom and I care about that
memories.source_text: “Wow! A Firebolt?” Her eyes widened as they fell on the broomstick in Harry’s right hand.

memories.description: I don’t like people staring at my scar. I wish I could hide it sometimes
memories.source_text: “Bet you wouldn’t mind hiding that scar sometimes, eh?” Her eyes found the lightning-shaped scar on Harry’s forehead.

memories.description: Lupin left a letter for the Dursleys so they’ll think I’m safe and will see me next summer
memories.source_text: “I’ve left a letter telling your aunt and uncle not to worry —”

memories.description: Moody gave me a Disillusionment Charm because the Invisibility Cloak won’t stay on while we’re flying. It feels odd like something cold running down me
memories.source_text: “Come here, boy,” said Moody gruffly, beckoning Harry toward him with his wand. “I need to Disillusion you.”

memories.description: Moody has a Put-Outer that can snuff streetlamps. He borrowed it from Dumbledore
memories.source_text: He clicked the unlighter again; the next lamp went out. He kept clicking until every lamp in the square was extinguished

memories.description: I was a complete mess packing because I’d been stuck in my room and in a bad mood. My stuff was everywhere and I packed in a rush
memories.source_text: Harry started picking up books and throwing them hastily into his trunk.

memories.description: Moody was not the real Alastor Moody. I trusted him and he was an imposter posing as Moody.
memories.source_text: “This is not Alastor Moody,” said Dumbledore quietly.

memories.description: Someone staged things to trick Dobby and get me the gillyweed. I was being manipulated into thinking Dobby helped me when it was arranged to make me prepare for the task.
memories.source_text: “I called the elf to the staffroom to collect some robes for cleaning. I staged a loud conversation with Professor McGonagall about the hostages who had been taken, and whether Potter would think to use gillyweed. And your little elf friend ran straight to Snape’s office and then hurried to find you. . . .”

memories.description: They knew I was in the lake for ages and thought I might have died. I was closer to real danger than I knew.
memories.source_text: “You were so long in that lake, Potter, I thought you had drowned.”

memories.description: The imposter controlled the maze. He stunned Fleur and used the Imperius Curse on Krum to clear a path for me. My 'win' was rigged by him.
memories.source_text: “I was patrolling around it, able to see through the outer hedges, able to curse many obstacles out of your way. I Stunned Fleur Delacour as she passed. I put the Imperius Curse on Krum, so that he would finish Diggory and leave your path to the Cup clear.”

memories.description: I thought Voldemort's return and the maze were separate, but the imposter says he handed me to Voldemort and tried to help him. That means I was used as bait and almost killed to help Voldemort come back properly.
memories.source_text: “The Dark Lord didn’t manage to kill you, Potter, and he so wanted to,” whispered Moody. “Imagine how he will reward me when he finds I have done it for him. I gave you to him — the thing he needed above all to regenerate — and then I killed you for him.”

memories.description: The imposter wanted to join Voldemort and believed he would be rewarded. He betrayed everything and wanted to be on Voldemort's side.
memories.source_text: “We’ll see who’s mad, now that the Dark Lord has returned, with me at his side! He is back, Harry Potter, you did not conquer him — and now — I conquer you!”

memories.description: Dumbledore, Snape and McGonagall arrived to stop the imposter. I was found and pulled out of the situation by them.
memories.source_text: “Stupefy!” There was a blinding flash of red light, and with a great splintering and crashing, the door of Moody’s office was blasted apart — Moody was thrown backward onto the office floor. Harry, still staring at the place where Moody’s face had been, saw Albus Dumbledore, Professor Snape, and Professor McGonagall looking back at him out of the Foe-Glass.

memories.description: Dumbledore was furious and deadly serious about the imposter and what had been done. This was not a small matter to him.
memories.source_text: The look upon Dumbledore’s face as he stared down at the unconscious form of Mad-Eye Moody was more terrible than Harry could have ever imagined. There was no benign smile upon Dumbledore’s face, no twinkle in the eyes behind the spectacles. There was cold fury in every line of the ancient face.

memories.description: Dumbledore wanted a Truth Potion and Winky brought up. He was going to get the truth out of the imposter and sort this properly.
memories.source_text: “Severus, please fetch me the strongest Truth Potion you possess, and then go down to the kitchens and bring up the house-elf called Winky. Minerva, kindly go down to Hagrid’s house, where you will find a large black dog sitting in the pumpkin patch. Take the dog up to my office, tell him I will be with him shortly, then come back here.”

memories.description: Professor McGonagall was worried about me. Even though I needed to face what happened, she's clearly frightened and cares about my wellbeing.
memories.source_text: “Come along, Potter,” she whispered. The thin line of her mouth was twitching as though she was about to cry. “Come along . . . hospital wing . . .”

memories.description: Dumbledore has been keeping me out of the loop on purpose and I reckon he might not trust me as much as I thought
memories.source_text: "He could still’ve kept me informed if he’d wanted to," "Maybe he thinks I can’t be trusted"

memories.description: I did the dangerous stuff before and I saved people that mattered. I know I handled things no one expected me to
memories.source_text: "WHO SAVED THE SORCERER’S STONE? WHO GOT RID OF RIDDLE? WHO SAVED BOTH YOUR SKINS FROM THE DEMENTORS?"

memories.description: I feel shut out from my friends and angry that they get to be together at Hogwarts while I’m stuck with the Dursleys
memories.source_text: "How come I have to stay at the Dursleys’ while you two get to join in everything that’s going on here?"

memories.description: Tonks tricked the Dursleys and got them out of the house by sending a fake Muggle letter. Lucky for me, they are gone because of her trick.
memories.source_text: "It was me that lured them out of the way. Sent a letter by Muggle post telling them they'd been short-listed for the All-England Best-Kept Suburban Lawn Competition."

memories.description: We are leaving very soon. They are just waiting for a signal before we go.
memories.source_text: "Almost at once," said Lupin, "we're just waiting for the all-clear."

memories.description: We're not going to the Burrow because it's too risky. They have set up some hidden headquarters instead.
memories.source_text: "Not the Burrow, no," said Lupin, motioning Harry toward the kitchen; the little knot of wizards followed, all still eyeing Harry curiously. "Too risky. We've set up headquarters somewhere undetectable."

memories.description: There are a whole lot of people here to watch over me. They are acting as my guard.
memories.source_text: "We're your guard, Potter."

memories.description: She wants to be called Tonks, not Nymphadora. She hates that name.
memories.source_text: "Don't call me Nymphadora, Remus," said the young witch with a shudder. "It's Tonks."

memories.description: Moody is Alastor Moody. I already knew his face, but now I know who he really is.
memories.source_text: "This is Alastor Moody, Harry," Lupin continued, pointing toward Moody.

memories.description: Moody told me to fetch him a glass of water. He can be blunt and bossy even here.
memories.source_text: "Get me a glass of water, would you, Harry?" asked Moody.

memories.description: Moody's magical eye is unreliable and it irritates him. He actually pops it out when it sticks.
memories.source_text: "Damn it," he added angrily, putting a hand up to the magical eye, "it keeps sticking"

memories.description: More people than I expected turned up to collect me. I feel like I'm suddenly very important and everyone is watching me.
memories.source_text: "A surprising number of people volunteered to come and get you," said Lupin

memories.description: We only have about fifteen minutes before the all-clear or we have to move. There is no time to hang about.
memories.source_text: "We've got about fifteen minutes."

memories.description: Tonks was comparing Muggles to wizards and mentioning her Muggle-born dad. She notices things about Muggle houses and finds them interesting.
memories.source_text: "My dad's Muggle-born and he's a right old slob. I suppose it varies, just like with wizards?"

memories.description: They are not telling me much because it's too risky to talk. Everything is being kept quiet until it's safe.
memories.source_text: "We are just waiting for the signal to tell us it's safe to set off," said Lupin

memories.description: Moody can shut people down when it's risky to talk. He takes his job as guard seriously and is quick to silence anyone who might blabber.
memories.source_text: "Shut up!"

memories.description: My blood protects me because of Mum. Voldemort used my blood so he could touch me without hurting himself and try to steal that protection
memories.source_text: "He said my blood would make him stronger than if he’d used someone else’s"

memories.description: When wands that share the same core are forced to duel they can cause Priori Incantatem and force echoes of the spells the other wand has done to reappear
memories.source_text: "Priori Incantatem," he muttered.

memories.description: Those echoes can show the most recent victims first so Cedric and even my parents could appear as echoes coming out of Voldemort's wand
memories.source_text: "The last murders the wand performed," said Dumbledore, nodding.

memories.description: People like Fudge are listening to gossip and lying journalists instead of what actually happened to me and that stinks
memories.source_text: "You’ve been reading Rita Skeeter, Mr. Fudge," he said quietly.

memories.description: Sirius promised he’ll come back to me soon even though he has to go off and warn the others
memories.source_text: "You’ll see me very soon, Harry," said Sirius, turning to him. "I promise you."

memories.description: I don't care about the thousand Galleons. Winning means nothing when people I care about are dead and Voldemort is back
memories.source_text: "I don't want that gold," said Harry in an expressionless voice. "You have it."

memories.description: So you lot knew enough to get Dumbledore to make them swear secrecy and still didn't send me an owl. I trusted you to tell me. That's messed up.
memories.source_text: CAN’T’VE WANTED TO THAT MUCH, CAN YOU, OR YOU’D HAVE SENT ME AN OWL, BUT DUMBLEDORE MADE YOU SWEAR —

memories.description: This is the Order of the Phoenix's headquarters. Right here. So we're actually with the people fighting him.
memories.source_text: “Headquarters of the Order of the Phoenix,” said Ron at once.

memories.description: The Order is a secret society. Dumbledore founded it. They're the ones who fought You-Know-Who before.
memories.source_text: “It’s a secret society,” said Hermione quickly. “Dumbledore’s in charge, he founded it. It’s the people who fought against You-Know-Who last time.”

memories.description: Fred and George made something called Extendable Ears. Sounds useful if we want to know what people are saying.
memories.source_text: “Fred and George have invented Extendable Ears, see,” said Ron.

memories.description: You're here to take me away. Thank you. I can't believe they're here after four weeks of nothing.
memories.source_text: [“It’s all right, Harry. We’ve come to take you away.”]

memories.description: That's Lupin's voice. I know him. He's real and he came back for me.
memories.source_text: [“P-Professor Lupin?”]

memories.description: My Patronus is a stag. They already know that and that proves I'm me.
memories.source_text: [“Harry, what form does your Patronus take?” “A stag,” said Harry nervously.]

memories.description: Lupin is on my side. He shook my hand and looked at me like he meant it.
memories.source_text: [Lupin held out his hand and shook Harry’s.]

memories.description: I can't trust appearances. People I thought I knew can be impostors. I need real proof before I trust anyone.
memories.source_text: [He had recently spent nine months in what he had thought was Mad-Eye Moody’s company only to find out that it wasn’t Moody at all, but an impostor; an impostor, moreover, who had tried to kill Harry before being unmasked.]

memories.description: I remembered the name Twelve Grimmauld Place and as soon as I did a battered door appeared between numbers eleven and thirteen. That place was hiding in plain sight.
memories.source_text: "Think about what you’ve just memorized," said Lupin quietly.

memories.description: Moody burned the message right out of my hand. No way to keep that note now. He means business and is not messing about.
memories.source_text: "Not here, boy!" snarled Moody. "Wait till we’re inside!" He pulled the piece of parchment out of Harry’s hand and set fire to it with his wand-tip.

memories.description: I’m not allowed in the Order meeting. Ron and Hermione are waiting upstairs and I have to keep quiet in the hallway or Mrs Weasley warns it could wake something up.
memories.source_text: "No, Harry, the meeting’s only for members of the Order. Ron and Hermione are upstairs, you can wait with them until the meeting’s over and then we’ll have dinner. And keep your voice down in the hall," she added in an urgent whisper.

memories.description: There are shrunken house-elf heads mounted on the wall. That’s grim and weird even for a wizarding house.
memories.source_text: A closer look showed Harry that the heads belonged to house-elves.

memories.description: Mrs Weasley fusses over me like always. I might be treated like a kid but I know she’s on my side and I can count on her to look out for me.
memories.source_text: "Oh, Harry, it’s lovely to see you!" she whispered, pulling him into a rib-cracking hug before holding him at arm’s length and examining him critically. "You’re looking peaky; you need feeding up, but you’ll have to wait a bit for dinner, I’m afraid . . ."

memories.description: Could it have been me? I said that sarcastically because I felt accused, but I know I wasn't involved in whatever they were on about.
memories.source_text: "Couldn’t have been me, could it?"

memories.description: They tried to get Dumbledore on their side. I’m not surprised they did, and I can grudgingly admit they at least tried.
memories.source_text: "We knew you’d be angry, Harry, we really don’t blame you, but you’ve got to understand, we did try and persuade Dumbledore —"

memories.description: Seeing them so nervous made me feel guilty. I can’t just keep snapping at them; I feel bad when they’re scared of me.
memories.source_text: "Both of them were watching him apprehensively, as though they feared that he would start shouting again now that everyone else had gone."

memories.description: There were two dementors there. I saw them. I won't pretend otherwise.
memories.source_text: “De — men — tors,” said Harry slowly and clearly. “Two of them.”

memories.description: Dementors are the guards from Azkaban. They aren't random animals, they're tied to the wizarding world.
memories.source_text: “They guard the wizard prison, Azkaban,” said Aunt Petunia.

memories.description: Dementors drain all your happiness and can 'kiss' you, which is basically having your soul taken. That's not a metaphor. It's terrifying.
memories.source_text: “I told you — they suck all the happiness out of you,” said Harry, “and if they get the chance, they kiss you —”

memories.description: The Patronus Charm is the only thing that works against dementors. I used it to save Dudley.
memories.source_text: “Because I used the Patronus —”

memories.description: Sirius knows something happened because Arthur told him. He's worried and blunt about it. He didn't send the long explanation I wanted.
memories.source_text: Harry read Sirius’s message. "Arthur’s just told us what happened. Don’t leave the house again, whatever you do."

memories.description: The Ministry thinks I did something wrong and I've been expelled from school for it, even though I used the Patronus to fight dementors off.
memories.source_text: “If it was demenders who hurt Dudley, how come you’ve been expelled? You did you-know-what, you’ve admitted it!”

memories.description: The Dursleys blame me for attracting trouble. They already see me as the reason dementors showed up, and they won't hesitate to say I caused it.
memories.source_text: “It’s you,” said Uncle Vernon forcefully. “It’s got something to do with you, boy, I know it. Why else would they turn up here? Why else would they be down that alleyway? You’ve got to be the only — the only —”

memories.description: After everything, I just want to get away and tell someone I trust what happened. I need help and answers, not lectures.
memories.source_text: He was desperate to be alone, to think, perhaps to send a letter to Ron, Hermione, or Sirius.

memories.description: They were made to swear not to tell me what was going on. Dumbledore got them to keep things from me.
memories.source_text: "— swear not to tell me," said Harry.

memories.description: Everyone knew I'd been followed by the Order of the Phoenix this summer, except me. So people were watching my every move and I had no idea.
memories.source_text: "that’s why he’s had people from the Order of the Phoenix tailing you all the time,"

memories.description: I feel betrayed and furious that they all knew about the tailing and kept me in the dark. I looked after myself anyway, and they still treated me like I couldn't cope.
memories.source_text: "So everyone had known he was being followed except him."

memories.description: I wanted to be happy seeing Ron and Hermione, but finding out they hid this from me put distance between us. I don't feel like celebrating right now.
memories.source_text: "The warm glow that had flared inside him at the sight of his two best friends was extinguished as something icy flooded the pit of his stomach."

memories.description: Hedwig came straight to me and is glad to see me. She's been in a state because of everything, but she's mine and she trusts me.
memories.source_text: "Hedwig!" The snowy owl clicked her beak and nibbled his ear affectionately as Harry stroked her feathers.

memories.description: My wand is eleven inches with a phoenix-feather core and I've used it for four years.
memories.source_text: “Eleven inches, phoenix-feather core, been in use four years. That correct?”

memories.description: The wand-checking wizard keeps a record of my wand on a little slip of parchment but gives me the actual wand back.
memories.source_text: “I keep this,” said the wizard, impaling the slip of parchment on a small brass spike. “You get this back,” he added, thrusting the wand at Harry.

memories.description: Mr Weasley is looking out for me. He grabs my shoulder and steers me away from the desk like he's in charge and won't let anyone bother me.
memories.source_text: “Thank you, Eric,” said Mr Weasley firmly, and grasping Harry by the shoulder, he steered him away from the desk

memories.description: After the check we went through the golden gates into a smaller hall full of lifts behind golden grilles.
memories.source_text: Jostled slightly by the crowd, Harry followed Mr Weasley through the gates into the smaller hall beyond, where at least twenty lifts stood behind wrought golden grilles.

memories.description: I hung back a bit before shutting the door because I wanted to hear the commotion downstairs. I can’t stand being shut out of what’s happening.
memories.source_text: Harry took as much time as he dared to close the drawing room door; he wanted to listen to what was going on downstairs.

memories.description: Mum's worried for me and she cares a lot. She hugged me and said they're all keeping their fingers crossed for me.
memories.source_text: Mrs Weasley hugged him. "We’ve all got our fingers crossed," she said.

memories.description: Mr Weasley is Arthur Weasley from the Misuse of Muggle Artifacts Office and he's escorting me to some disciplinary hearing.
memories.source_text: "Arthur Weasley, Misuse of Muggle Artifacts Office, here to escort Harry Potter, who has been asked to attend a disciplinary hearing . . ."

memories.description: Mr Weasley doesn't use the visitor's entrance and gets confused by Muggle travel. He does not know all the Muggle ways.
memories.source_text: "As a matter of fact I’ve never even used the visitor’s entrance before."

memories.description: The Ministry entrance is hidden in a scruffy Muggle telephone box and it has that cold automated welcome that asks for your name and business.
memories.source_text: "Welcome to the Ministry of Magic. Please state your name and business."

memories.description: You get a visitor badge from a chute in the phone box that comes out where coins normally appear. That is how you check in at the Ministry.
memories.source_text: "Visitor, please take the badge and attach it to the front of your robes."

memories.description: I'm not on the Black family tree anymore. My name has been ripped off that tapestry, like I never belonged there.
memories.source_text: You’re not on here!

memories.description: Sirius is bitter about his family. He hates them and left because he couldn't stand their snobbish pure-blood rubbish.
memories.source_text: I used to be there, My sweet old mother blasted me off after I ran away from home

memories.description: Regulus was Sirius's brother and he ended up dead, and the family used Regulus as the 'good son' to shame Sirius.
memories.source_text: He was younger than me, and a much better son, as I was constantly reminded.

memories.description: Regulus didn’t just die by accident. He was killed because of his involvement with Voldemort, probably on Voldemort's orders.
memories.source_text: Oh no, No, he was murdered by Voldemort. Or on Voldemort’s orders, more likely

memories.description: Kreacher recognizes me by my scar. Even that filthy old elf knows who I am and what I did.
memories.source_text: Kreacher can see the scar, it must be true, that’s that boy who stopped the Dark Lord

memories.description: Tonks looks different this morning, all blonde and curly and sleepy. She's been up and out of sorts, so I shouldn't expect her to be sharp right now.
memories.source_text: "M-m-morning, Harry," yawned Tonks. Her hair was blonde and curly this morning.

memories.description: Tonks has been up all night. She's tired and jittery, so whatever she's said might be half of what she means.
memories.source_text: "I’ve b-b-been up all night," she said, with another shuddering yawn.

memories.description: Scrimgeour has been asking Kingsley and Tonks odd questions. They think we need to be more careful around him.
memories.source_text: "Oh . . . yeah . . . well, we need to be a bit more careful, he’s been asking Kingsley and me funny questions . . ."

memories.description: I just want something simple and quiet right now. I don't want to get pulled into a fuss.
memories.source_text: "Just — just toast, thanks," said Harry.

memories.description: I'm uneasy and squirming inside, glad I don't have to join the grown-ups talking about Scrimgeour.
memories.source_text: His insides were squirming.

memories.description: The hearing will be in Amelia Bones's office on Mr Weasley's floor. She's the one who is going to question me.
memories.source_text: "The hearing's on my floor, in Amelia Bones's office. She's Head of the Department of Magical Law Enforcement and she's the one who'll be questioning you."

memories.description: Lupin says the law lets underage wizards use magic if lives are at risk. That's my defence.
memories.source_text: "The law's on your side," said Lupin quietly. "Even underage wizards are allowed to use magic in life-threatening situations."

memories.description: Tonks thinks Amelia Bones will be fair. I can at least hope she'll listen to what happened.
memories.source_text: "Amelia Bones is okay, Harry," said Tonks earnestly. "She's fair, she'll hear you out."

memories.description: Sirius will stand up for me if it goes badly. He is ready to act on my behalf.
memories.source_text: "And if it's not," said Sirius grimly, "I'll see to Amelia Bones for you . . ."

memories.description: Sirius and the others think I need to keep calm, be polite and stick to the facts at the hearing.
memories.source_text: "Don't lose your temper," said Sirius abruptly. "Be polite and stick to the facts."

memories.description: Mrs Weasley fusses over me and tries to fix my hair even when I don't want her to. She cares and gets nervous.
memories.source_text: Mrs Weasley pressed hard on the top of his head. "Doesn't it ever lie flat?" she said desperately.

memories.description: I want answers about Voldemort. I asked Ron and Hermione but they said I’m not allowed in the Order, so I’ve been shut out. I saw Voldemort come back and that gives me every right to ask questions.
memories.source_text: "You know, I’m surprised at you. I thought the first thing you’d do when you got here would be to start asking questions about Voldemort."

memories.description: Molly hates Mundungus. Sirius says he’s useful and loyal to Dumbledore, but Mum thinks inviting him for dinner is too much. That’s awkward for me.
memories.source_text: "Molly doesn’t approve of Mundungus"

memories.description: Sirius thinks Mundungus is shady but valuable. He hears things we wouldn’t otherwise. That explains why Dung is around despite Mum’s disapproval.
memories.source_text: "He’s useful," Sirius muttered. "Knows all the crooks — well, he would, seeing as he’s one himself. But he’s also very loyal to Dumbledore, who helped him out of a tight spot once."

memories.description: People argue about whether I should be told things. I feel I’m not just a kid to be sheltered. I’m older than they treat me and I deserve a say.
memories.source_text: "He’s not a member of the Order of the Phoenix!" said Mrs Weasley. "He’s only fifteen and —" "— and he’s dealt with as much as most in the Order," said Sirius.

memories.description: Dumbledore deliberately kept stuff from me for reasons I may not like but that were supposed to protect me. Now I’m at headquarters and that position is shifting.
memories.source_text: "Dumbledore must have had his reasons for not wanting Harry to know too much," said Mrs Weasley.

memories.description: Kingsley just arrived and left a report for Dumbledore. Hestia has Moody's cloak now.
memories.source_text: "Hestia’s just relieved me, so she’s got Moody’s cloak now, thought I’d leave a report for Dumbledore . . ."

memories.description: Mrs Weasley warned that doxies bite and their teeth are poisonous and she has an antidote. We had to spray them and drop them in a bucket.
memories.source_text: "Right, you lot, you need to be careful, because doxies bite and their teeth are poisonous. I’ve got a bottle of antidote here, but I’d rather nobody needed it."

memories.description: Doxycide works fast. One good squirt will paralyze a doxy and you can pick it up.
memories.source_text: "When I say the word, start spraying immediately," she said. "They’ll come flying out at us, I expect, but it says on the sprays one good squirt will paralyze them."

memories.description: Fred and George are using doxy venom to test effects for their Skiving Snackboxes.
memories.source_text: "We want to experiment with doxy venom for our Skiving Snackboxes," George told Harry under his breath.

memories.description: Skiving Snackboxes are sweets designed to make you briefly ill so you can skip class, then recover with the other half of the sweet.
memories.source_text: "Range of sweets to make you ill," George whispered, "Not seriously ill, mind, just ill enough to get you out of a class when you feel like it."

memories.description: Their joke shop isn't open yet. They're running it by mail order and they put ads in the Daily Prophet.
memories.source_text: "Well, we haven’t had a chance to get premises yet," said Fred, "so we’re running it as a mail-order service at the moment. We put advertisements in the Daily Prophet last week."

memories.description: Mrs Weasley doesn't read the Daily Prophet now, so she won't know about the twins' ads or my part in funding them.
memories.source_text: "But don’t worry . . . Mum hasn’t got a clue. She won’t read the Daily Prophet anymore, ’cause of it telling lies about you and Dumbledore."

memories.description: I gave the twins my thousand Galleons to help them start their joke shop. They think it's brilliant and Mum does not know I helped.
memories.source_text: "He had forced the Weasley twins to take the thousand-Galleon prize money he had won in the Triwizard Tournament to help them realize their ambition to open a joke shop"

memories.description: Visitors have to be searched and hand over their wand at the security desk at the far end of the Atrium.
memories.source_text: "Visitor to the Ministry, you are required to submit to a search and present your wand for registration at the security desk, which is located at the far end of the Atrium."

memories.description: The security wizards physically scan you with a long golden rod and then demand your wand.
memories.source_text: "Step over here," said the wizard in a bored voice. Harry walked closer to him and the wizard held up a long golden rod, thin and flexible as a car aerial, and passed it up and down Harry's front and back. "Wand," grunted the security wizard at Harry, putting down the golden instrument and holding out his hand.

memories.description: Mr Weasley is escorting me through the Ministry. He is looking out for me right now.
memories.source_text: "I'm escorting a visitor," said Mr Weasley, gesturing toward Harry.

memories.description: If I manage to stay at Hogwarts, I want to put ten Galleons in the fountain for St. Mungo's.
memories.source_text: If I'm not expelled from Hogwarts, I'll put in ten Galleons, Harry found himself thinking desperately.

memories.description: The Order is trying to stop people joining Voldemort. I’m not surprised, that’s basically what they kept going on about.
memories.source_text: “I mean, all they’ve really said is that the Order’s trying to stop people joining Vol —”

memories.description: People should use his name. I want us to say Voldemort properly like Sirius and Lupin do, not skirt around it.
memories.source_text: “When are you going to start using his name? Sirius and Lupin do.”

memories.description: Sirius hinted at some kind of weapon. I’ve got to find out what he really meant.
memories.source_text: “The weapon Sirius mentioned?”

memories.description: Voldemort already has the Cruciatus for torture, so whatever this weapon is, it might be something different from just causing pain.
memories.source_text: “He’s got the Cruciatus Curse for causing pain,”

memories.description: They're trying to stop people joining Voldemort. Say his name. Sirius and Lupin do.
memories.source_text: "I mean, all they’ve really said is that the Order’s trying to stop people joining Vol —" "— demort ,"said Harry firmly.

memories.description: There’s some weapon out there that worries me. It could be something that kills loads of people at once or tortures them. I want to know what it is and who’s got it.
memories.source_text: "The weapon Sirius mentioned?"

memories.description: I’m thinking Voldemort already has ways to cause terrible pain. He doesn’t need anything more efficient than that, but whatever this weapon is, it’s bad news.
memories.source_text: "He’s got the Cruciatus Curse for causing pain," said Harry.

memories.description: They've moved my hearing. It starts at eight o'clock now and it's down in old Courtroom Ten. If we'd been five minutes later we'd have missed it.
memories.source_text: "they've changed the time and venue — it starts at eight o'clock now and it's down in old Courtroom Ten"

memories.description: We're already late. I felt sick and stupid, like I'd left all my insides back at Perkins's desk, and we had to race through the Ministry to get there.
memories.source_text: "Quick, Harry, we should have been there five minutes ago!"

memories.description: Using the old courtrooms is odd. It makes me uneasy, like something about the hearing is off or being hidden.
memories.source_text: "Those courtrooms haven't been used in years," said Mr Weasley angrily. "I can't think why they're doing it down there"

memories.description: The Department of Mysteries was named as where we were headed or involved. That name put me on edge and made the whole thing feel more serious.
memories.source_text: "Department of Mysteries"

memories.description: Sirius is everywhere in this office. His face is on every scrap of paper and it gave me a proper shock when I walked in.
memories.source_text: "Sirius’s face was blinking down at him from every direction."

memories.description: Kingsley still looks out for me. He’d wink and shove something my way because he thinks I’d want to see it.
memories.source_text: "Give him the magazine, he might find it interesting."

memories.description: Mr Weasley is rushed and a bit distracted here. He barely notices what’s going on and even ends up standing on my foot when I try to say hello.
memories.source_text: "They were talking to each other as though they hardly knew each other, and when Harry opened his mouth to say hello to Kingsley, Mr Weasley stood on his foot."

memories.description: So these windows are enchanted and Magical Maintenance chooses the weather for the Ministry. Weird, but it explains the sunlight even though we are underground.
memories.source_text: “aren’t we underground?” “Yes, we are,” said Mr Weasley, “those are enchanted windows; Magical Maintenance decide what weather we’re getting every day.”

memories.description: The memos flying around are actually Ministry interdepartmental memos. They replaced owls because of the mess. That explains all the fluttering bits.
memories.source_text: “Just Interdepartmental memos,” Mr Weasley muttered to him. “We used to use owls, but the mess was unbelievable . . . droppings all over the desks . . .”

memories.description: We're heading to the Department of Magical Law Enforcement and Mr Weasley works somewhere on that floor near Auror Headquarters. This is where he works.
memories.source_text:
“Level two, Department of Magical Law Enforcement, including the Improper Use of Magic Office, Auror Headquarters, and Wizengamot Administration Services.”

“This is us, Harry,” said Mr Weasley, and they followed the witch out of the lift into a corridor lined with doors. “My office is on the other side of the floor.”

memories.description: The place is full of cubicles and people; memos zoom everywhere and Auror Headquarters looks busy. It's loud and chaotic in a proper Ministry sort of way.
memories.source_text: Harry looked surreptitiously through the doorways as they passed.

memories.description: They sent an owl this morning. I missed it and that's why I'm being told I'm late.
memories.source_text: "An owl was sent to you this morning."

memories.description: They ordered me to sit down right away. There's no messing about.
memories.source_text: "Take your seat."

memories.description: That chair in the middle has chains on the arms. They're clearly planning to chain someone in it.
memories.source_text: Harry dropped his gaze to the chair in the center of the room, the arms of which were covered in chains

memories.description: They're blaming me for being late. I can feel the whole place watching me like I'm in trouble already.
memories.source_text: "That is not the Wizengamot's fault,"

memories.description: That box might not hold a normal animal. It actually breathed fire. That's mental and could be dangerous.
memories.source_text: "We thought it was a bog-standard chicken until it started breathing fire."

memories.description: I stuck close to Mr Weasley, trying not to draw attention. I was jammed against the back wall of the lift and trying to keep my head down.
memories.source_text: "All right, Arthur?" said the wizard, nodding at Mr Weasley.

memories.description: The Ministry has a floor for Quidditch and other odd departments. The lift announces every level so you know exactly where you're going.
memories.source_text: "Level seven, Department of Magical Games and Sports, incorporating the British and Irish Quidditch League Headquarters, Official Gobstones Club, and Ludicrous Patents Office."

memories.description: There are Quidditch posters everywhere and people carrying broomsticks. The place smells like it's full of sports and chaos.
memories.source_text: Harry glimpsed an untidy-looking corridor, with various posters of Quidditch teams tacked lopsidedly on the walls; one of the wizards in the lift, who was carrying an armful of broomsticks, extricated himself with difficulty and disappeared down the corridor.

memories.description: Another floor handles transport stuff like the Floo and Portkeys. The Ministry splits everything up into very specific departments.
memories.source_text: The doors closed, the lift juddered upward again, and the woman’s voice said, "Level six, Department of Magical Transport, incorporating the Floo Network Authority, Broom Regulatory Control, Portkey Office, and Apparation Test Center."

memories.description: People here act a bit chaotic. Paper airplanes flying into a lift? That's exactly the sort of thing that happens around the Ministry.
memories.source_text: Once again the lift doors opened and four or five witches and wizards got out; at the same time, several paper airplanes swooped into the lift.

memories.description: Two dementors attacked me and Dudley a week ago. If dementors only take orders from the Ministry, someone at the Ministry might have sent them. That possibility terrifies me.
memories.source_text: "If it is true that the dementors are taking orders only from the Ministry of Magic, and it is also true that two dementors attacked Harry and his cousin a week ago, then it follows logically that somebody at the Ministry might have ordered the attacks," said Dumbledore politely.

memories.description: Dumbledore is willing to stand up for me and bring evidence on my behalf. He actually offered to summon the house-elf to back me up, so I can trust he cares about proving the truth.
memories.source_text: "I can summon him here in an instant to give evidence if you wish."

memories.description: Cornelius Fudge is openly hostile and convinced I'm lying or dangerous. The Ministry, or at least Fudge, is out to punish me no matter what I say.
memories.source_text: "Have you ever bothered to tot up the number of cock-and-bull stories this boy has come out with, Dumbledore, while trying to cover up his flagrant misuse of magic out of school?" roared Fudge.

memories.description: Those chains moved and clinked at me, like they could have latched on, but they didn't. I sat there feeling sick because they looked ready to snap shut and then nothing happened.
memories.source_text: When he sat gingerly on the edge of the chair the chains clinked rather threateningly but did not bind him.

memories.description: There were dozens of them up on the bench in plum robes with that silver W. They were all looking at me like I was a curiosity or something to be judged.
memories.source_text: There were about fifty of them, all, as far as he could see, wearing plum-colored robes with an elaborately worked silver W on the left-hand side of the chest and all staring down their noses at him, some with very austere expressions, others looks of frank curiosity.

memories.description: That woman next to Fudge looks proper intimidating. I reckon whatever she thinks matters in here and she isn't someone to mess with.
memories.source_text: A broad, square-jawed witch with very short gray hair sat on Fudge’s left; she wore a monocle and looked forbidding.

memories.description: Percy didn't even look at me. He just stared at his parchment and took notes like I was nothing. That stung. I expected he might at least look my way.
memories.source_text: Harry looked at Percy, expecting some sign of recognition from him, but none came. Percy’s eyes, behind his horn-rimmed glasses, were fixed on his parchment, a quill poised in his hand.

memories.description: Dumbledore turned up and said he was the witness for my defense. He walked in calm as anything, and seeing him there felt like someone actually had my back.
memories.source_text: — Witness for the defense, Albus Percival Wulfric Brian Dumbledore,” said a quiet voice from behind Harry, who turned his head so fast he cricked his neck. Dumbledore was striding serenely across the room wearing long midnight-blue robes and a perfectly calm expression.

memories.description: My Patronus is a fully formed stag. It's not some faint wisp, it's a proper, corporeal Patronus and it's always taken that shape.
memories.source_text: "A corporeal Patronus?" "Yes," said Harry, "because —" "A — what?" said Harry. "Your Patronus had a clearly defined form? I mean to say, it was more than vapor or smoke?" "Yes," said Harry, feeling both impatient and slightly desperate, "it's a stag, it's always a stag."

memories.description: I was taught to produce a Patronus at school by Professor Lupin during my third year. That is where I learned how to do it.
memories.source_text: "I learned this at school?" "Yes, Professor Lupin taught me in my third year, because of the —"

memories.description: I already have an official Ministry warning for using magic when I was younger. They can bring that up against me now.
memories.source_text: "You received an official warning from the Ministry for using illegal magic three years ago, did you not?" "Yes, but —"

memories.description: I used the Patronus because there were dementors attacking me and Dudley in that alley. I did it to protect us, that's why I cast it there.
memories.source_text: "I did it because of the dementors!" "Dementors?" "I mean there were two dementors down that alleyway and they went for me and my cousin!"

memories.description: Dumbledore says there's a witness to the dementors and that she's just outside. That gives me hope that someone else saw what happened and I'm not just making it up.
memories.source_text: "We do, in fact, have a witness to the presence of dementors in that alleyway," he said, "other than Dudley Dursley, I mean." "I brought her with me," said Dumbledore. "She’s just outside the door."

memories.description: Seeing Dumbledore standing there actually calmed me. Even after being angry with him, when he greets everyone like that I feel like this is where I belong again.
memories.source_text: "To our newcomers," said Dumbledore in a ringing voice, his arms stretched wide and a beaming smile on his lips, "welcome! To our old hands — welcome back! There is a time for speech making, but this is not it. Tuck in!"

memories.description: So there haven’t been suspicious deaths yet. He’s being careful and keeping low for now.
memories.source_text: "That’s because there haven’t been any suspicious deaths yet," said Sirius, "not as far as we know, anyway. . . . And we know quite a lot."

memories.description: Voldemort’s holding back because his return went wrong. He doesn’t want to risk acting openly yet.
memories.source_text: "Because he doesn’t want to draw attention to himself at the moment," said Sirius. "It would be dangerous for him. His comeback didn’t come off quite the way he wanted it to, you see. He messed it up."

memories.description: Because I survived, people know he’s back. That made Dumbledore act straight away and dragged others into it.
memories.source_text: "You weren’t supposed to survive!" said Sirius. "Nobody apart from his Death Eaters was supposed to know he’d come back. But you survived to bear witness."

memories.description: Dumbledore is Voldemort’s real threat. That’s why the Ministry and Voldemort both fear him.
memories.source_text: "Dumbledore was the only one You-Know-Who was ever scared of!" said Bill.

memories.description: Dumbledore has plans about what Voldemort wants and his guesses are usually right.
memories.source_text: "Dumbledore’s got a shrewd idea," said Lupin, "and Dumbledore’s shrewd ideas normally turn out to be accurate."

memories.description: Voldemort is trying to rebuild his followers and dark forces. He won’t try to fight the Ministry with only a few people.
memories.source_text: "Well, firstly, he wants to build up his army again," said Sirius.

memories.description: The Ministry refuses to believe Voldemort’s back, and that makes warning people way harder.
memories.source_text: "It’s proving tricky, though." "Why?" "Because of the Ministry’s attitude," said Tonks.

memories.description: Fudge is more scared of Dumbledore than he is willing to admit. He thinks Dumbledore might try to take his job.
memories.source_text: "Fudge is frightened of him, you see," said Tonks sadly.

memories.description: Because the Ministry denies it, lots of wizards won’t believe Voldemort’s return, which makes people vulnerable.
memories.source_text: "While the Ministry insists there is nothing to fear from Voldemort, it’s hard to convince people he’s back," said Lupin.

memories.description: The Ministry is openly attacking Dumbledore and trying to discredit him to silence warnings about Voldemort.
memories.source_text: "They’ve demoted him from Chief Warlock on the Wizengamot ... and they’re talking about taking away his Order of Merlin, First Class, too."

memories.description: Voldemort recruits in secret, using tricks, jinxes, and blackmail. He works quietly and cleverly.
memories.source_text: "Voldemort doesn’t march up to people’s houses and bang on their front doors, Harry," said Sirius.

memories.description: He might be hunting for some secret weapon or tool this time, something worse or different than before.
memories.source_text: "Like a weapon. Something he didn’t have last time." "When he was powerful before?" "Yes."

memories.description: I wasn’t going to keep Ron in the dark. I’ll tell him and Hermione everything they need to know.
memories.source_text: "’Course I will," Harry said.

memories.description: This used to be my parents' house and Sirius owns it now. Of course it's his place, he offered it to Dumbledore for headquarters.
memories.source_text: "But what’s a portrait of your mother doing here?" "Hasn’t anyone told you? This was my parents’ house," said Sirius.

memories.description: Sirius is cross with Dumbledore right now. I can tell he's not happy with him, and I feel protective and close to Sirius because of it.
memories.source_text: "There was something about the slightly flattened tone of voice in which Sirius uttered Dumbledore’s name that told Harry that Sirius was not very happy with the headmaster either."

memories.description: Sirius can't move freely because the Ministry is after him and Wormtail probably exposed his Animagus status.
memories.source_text: "The Ministry of Magic’s still after me, and Voldemort will know all about me being an Animagus by now, Wormtail will have told him"

memories.description: Sirius hates being stuck inside. I get why he's fed up with the waiting around and reports. He wants to be doing something, not just sitting on his hands.
memories.source_text: "Personally, I’d have welcomed a dementor attack. A deadly struggle for my soul would have broken the monotony nicely. You think you’ve had it bad, at least you’ve been able to get out and about, stretch your legs, get into a few fights"

memories.description: I tried to catch Dumbledore's eye for reassurance and he looked like he couldn't care less. I started to doubt that he was backing me at all.
memories.source_text: "he was not at all sure that Dumbledore was right in telling the Wizengamot, in effect, that it was about time they made a decision. Again, however, Dumbledore seemed oblivious to Harry’s attempt to catch his eye."

memories.description: More than half the Wizengamot put up their hands to clear me. There were enough votes to wipe the whole thing.
memories.source_text: "Those in favor of clearing the accused of all charges?" ... "There were hands in the air, many of them ... more than half!"

memories.description: I kept thinking I messed it up. I barely spoke and kept wanting to explain the dementors properly and what happened with Dudley.
memories.source_text: "He had expected the hearing to last longer than this. He was not at all sure that he had made a good impression. He had not really said very much. He ought to have explained more fully about the dementors, about how he had fallen over, about how both he and Dudley had nearly been kissed."

memories.description: Fudge gave in and the verdict was 'cleared of all charges.' I was officially free.
memories.source_text: "Very well, very well ... cleared of all charges."

memories.description: I saw Ron lying there as if he were dead and it hit me like a punch to the stomach. I couldn't believe it and I felt sick.
memories.source_text: ["Sprawled on the dusty old carpet in a patch of moonlight, clearly dead, was Ron."]

memories.description: The boggart even turned into my own dead body. Seeing myself 'dead' on the floor was terrifying and wrong.
memories.source_text: ["Crack. Dead Harry . . ."]

memories.description: Lupin can banish the boggart's form quickly. He handled it calmly and made the apparition disappear.
memories.source_text: ["Pulling out his own wand he said, very firmly and clearly, 'Riddikulus!' Harry's body vanished."]

memories.description: Mum is terrified of losing us and it drives her to hysteria. Lupin tried to calm her down and called it 'just a boggart' to make her see sense.
memories.source_text: ["Molly, don't . . ." Next second she was sobbing her heart out on Lupin's shoulder. "Molly, it was just a boggart," he said soothingly, patting her on the head. "Just a stupid boggart . . ."]

memories.description: Mum begged not to tell Dad. She doesn't want Arthur finding out about these nightmares.
memories.source_text: ["D-d-don't tell Arthur," Mrs. Weasley was gulping now, mopping her eyes frantically with her cuffs. "I d-d-don't want him to know."]

memories.description: Moody's magical eye keeps an unsettling watch on me. I could feel it on me the whole time.
memories.source_text: ["Moody was looking at Harry, who avoided his gaze. He had a funny feeling Moody's magical eye had followed him all the way out of the kitchen."]

memories.description: She seems doddery and terrified. I wish she had acted a bit more sensible. Still, she saw something important.
memories.source_text: "She looked scared and more batty than ever. Harry wished she had thought to change out of her carpet slippers."

memories.description: There were dementors. Big, cloaked things heading toward two boys. That sinking feeling in my stomach tells me it was real.
memories.source_text: "They were big. Big and wearing cloaks."

memories.description: I get furious just thinking about Dumbledore. It makes me want to change the subject quick.
memories.source_text: the very thought of him made Harry’s insides burn with anger again.

memories.description: Snape is right there in the hall with the others. Of course he's snooping around whatever the Order is doing.
memories.source_text: In the very center of the group Harry saw the dark, greasy-haired head and prominent nose of his least favorite teacher at Hogwarts, Professor Snape.

memories.description: Fred and George are using an Extendable Ear to eavesdrop. If they fail, we'll miss what they're trying to hear.
memories.source_text: A thin piece of flesh-colored string descended in front of Harry’s eyes. Looking up he saw Fred and George on the landing above, cautiously lowering the Extendable Ear toward the dark knot of people below.

memories.description: Someone left through the front door. That could change whatever's happening in the hall below.
memories.source_text: They heard the front door open and then close.

memories.description: I was cleared of all charges. I got off at the Wizengamot and I am going back to Hogwarts. That relief hit me like a punch.
memories.source_text: "Cleared," Harry said, pulling the door closed behind him, "of all charges!"

memories.description: Malfoy is right here in the Ministry talking to Fudge. He sneers at me like he always does and I hate that he can just stare me down after what he did.
memories.source_text: "Well, well, well . . . Patronus Potter," said Lucius Malfoy coolly.

memories.description: If Fudge is meeting Malfoy privately then something is really wrong at the Ministry. I think Fudge might be being influenced or at least making dangerous choices.
memories.source_text: "Why wasn't he waiting outside Fudge's office if they've got business to do together?" Harry burst out furiously.

memories.description: Fudge has been talking about me with Malfoy. If the Minister is chatting with people like Lucius then the Ministry is full of people I cannot trust.
memories.source_text: "The Minister was just telling me about your lucky escape, Potter," drawled Mr Malfoy.

memories.description: My scar is burning more often now. It flares up and I can feel it sharply. It is a bad sign and it worries me.
memories.source_text: "Scar," Harry mumbled. "But it's nothing. . . . It happens all the time now . . ."

memories.description: Dumbledore's influence helped clear me. He backed me and that made the difference at the trial.
memories.source_text: "Yeah, he swung it for me," said Harry.

memories.description: People keep staring at me because of who I am. I wish they wouldn’t make such a fuss.
memories.source_text: "You’re Harry Potter," she added.

memories.description: I got a face full of Stinksap and it made me spit it out, but at least it won’t kill me.
memories.source_text: "Stinksap’s not poisonous,"

memories.description: Neville’s into Herbology in a big way, even if his plants look disgusting. He really cares about them.
memories.source_text: Harry stared at the thing. It was pulsating slightly

memories.description: He's not at the staff table. Hagrid is missing and I can see it straight away.
memories.source_text: "He’s not there."

memories.description: Maybe Hagrid's still away on that job for Dumbledore. That would explain him not being here.
memories.source_text: "Maybe he’s not back yet. You know — from his mission — the thing he was doing over the summer for Dumbledore."

memories.description: That woman sitting by Dumbledore is Umbridge. She's actually here at the staff table.
memories.source_text: "It’s that Umbridge woman!"

memories.description: People keep whispering about me and I'm fed up with it. I try to ignore it and act like I don't care.
memories.source_text: "Again Harry noticed people putting their heads together to whisper as he passed; he gritted his teeth and tried to act as though he neither noticed nor cared."

memories.description: That magazine is rubbish, full of daft claims. I can't take most of it seriously, it's just nonsense aimed to wind people up.
memories.source_text: "Anything good in there?" asked Ron as Harry closed the magazine.

memories.description: Even Hermione thinks the Quibbler is rubbish, which backs me up, but some of it still makes me uneasy.
memories.source_text: "Of course not," said Hermione scathingly, before Harry could answer, "The Quibbler's rubbish, everyone knows that."

memories.description: Seeing that stuff about Sirius in print made me uneasy. It might be a joke, but I can't shrug off the idea that people could be pointing fingers in the wrong direction.
memories.source_text: "Anything good in there?" asked Ron as Harry closed the magazine.

memories.description: I'm jumpy and I don't want prying eyes or mouths around right now. I pushed people away because I need to think and I don't trust how obvious I'm acting.
memories.source_text: "Yeah," said Harry, "but you, unlike me, are a git, so get out and leave us alone."

memories.description: Malfoy saying he'll be dogging my footsteps put me on edge. If he spots anything odd, like the black dog, it could blow everything for Sirius and the people helping him.
memories.source_text: "I seem to have touched a nerve," said Malfoy, smirking. "Well, just watch yourself, Potter, because I’ll be dogging your footsteps in case you step out of line."

memories.description: I can't talk openly with everyone here. I have to keep quiet and I trusted Hermione to know why I'm tense, but I won't risk saying anything in front of others.
memories.source_text: Harry could not talk freely in front of Neville and Luna. He exchanged another nervous look with Hermione and then stared out of the window.

memories.description: I thought it was funny for Sirius to come, but now I see that was stupid. He shouldn't have come; it could put him and everyone who knows at risk.
memories.source_text: He had thought Sirius coming with him to the station was a bit of a laugh, but suddenly it seemed reckless, if not downright dangerous.

memories.description: Yeah right. Like Gryffindor and Slytherin are suddenly going to be pals. Fat chance.
memories.source_text: "And it wants all the Houses to be friends?" "Fat chance."

memories.description: Everyone's staring at me because I came out of the maze holding Cedric and said Voldemort's back. Great. That's why no one wants to talk to me.
memories.source_text: Of course everyone was staring at him: He had emerged from the Triwizard maze two months ago clutching the dead body of a fellow student and claiming to have seen Lord Voldemort return to power.

memories.description: I didn't get a chance to explain any of it before the holidays, and I still feel wrecked at the idea of having to tell the whole school what happened.
memories.source_text: There had not been time last term to explain himself before everyone went home, even if he had felt up to giving the whole school a detailed account of the terrible events in that graveyard.

memories.description: I couldn't get in until someone remembered the new password. I wasn't in the mood for faffing about with that.
memories.source_text: No password, no entrance," she said loftily.

memories.description: Neville's around and trying to help, remembering the password and all that. At least someone was cheery enough to make it easier for me.
memories.source_text: "Guess what it is? I’m actually going to be able to remember it for once —" He waved the stunted little cactus he had shown them on the train. "Mimbulus mimbletonia!"

memories.description: I didn't want to talk. I just wanted to get away and be alone in the dormitory.
memories.source_text: Harry waved good night to them and headed straight for the door to the boys’ dormitories; he was not in much of a mood for talking at the moment.

memories.description: People are staring at me and it's horrible. I tried to grin but it vanished the second they looked terrified. I don't want that attention.
memories.source_text: "A blond boy next to Euan Abercrombie looked petrified, nudged Euan, and whispered something in his ear. Euan Abercrombie looked equally frightened and stole a horrified look at Harry, who felt the grin slide off his face like Stinksap."

memories.description: I left the hall on my own to get away from the whispering and pointing. Being alone was better than listening to that.
memories.source_text: "See you later," he said to Ron and Hermione and he made his way out of the Great Hall alone, doing everything he could to ignore more whispering, staring, and pointing as he passed."

memories.description: I know a few ways around the castle to dodge crowds and eyes. Quick shortcuts do the trick when you want to disappear.
memories.source_text: "He kept his eyes fixed ahead as he wove his way through the crowd in the entrance hall, then he hurried up the marble staircase, took a couple of concealed shortcuts, and had soon left most of the crowds behind."

memories.description: Hedwig has been sent back by my family so I need to take her cage with me and keep her safe.
memories.source_text: "Mum and Dad just sent Hedwig back"

memories.description: There will be a guard escorting us to King cross. That makes this trip more serious than usual.
memories.source_text: "We have to go to King’s Cross with a guard?"

memories.description: Sirius coming with us worried Hermione but I think he needed the fresh air. Still, I get why she was tense about it.
memories.source_text: "He shouldn't have come with us," said Hermione in a worried voice.

memories.description: I appreciate people like Lee giving a hand. I'm still glad to have friends around even when things get noisy and awkward.
memories.source_text: "Thanks, Lee," said Harry, grinning, as Sirius wagged his tail frantically.

memories.description: Ron and Hermione are off to the prefect carriage so this trip starts without Ron as my constant companion. That feels weird.
memories.source_text: "I might see you later, then."

memories.description: People are staring because of what the Prophet printed about me. I can't pretend I don't care. It's annoying and unfair.
memories.source_text: "After he had met this behavior in five consecutive carriages he remembered that the Daily Prophet had been telling its readers all summer what a lying show-off he was."

memories.description: It sounded like a load of waffle. I couldn't believe everyone made such a fuss about it.
memories.source_text: "Sounded like a load of waffle to me."

memories.description: So there were actually bits worth paying attention to. Fine, I admit it might've had some meaning hidden in the waffle.
memories.source_text: "Did it?"

memories.description: I reckon Seamus is avoiding me and it stinks. I don't like being pushed out like I'm the problem.
memories.source_text: Does he think he’ll turn into a nutter if he stays in a room with me too long?

memories.description: Talking to Cho is going to be awkward. Between Neville and Ron I can never get a moment with her that doesn’t go wrong.
memories.source_text: Is that a Tornados badge?

memories.description: Being an Auror would be brilliant and proper important. I want that kind of job too.
memories.source_text: Well, it’d be cool to be an Auror

memories.description: People jump on bandwagons. If someone suddenly starts supporting a team they might not be a real fan and that can make things messy in conversations.
memories.source_text: You don’t support them, do you?

memories.description: I messed up in Potions because I missed an instruction. Snape will gloat and of course I’ll get shouted at. I can't afford mistakes this year.
memories.source_text: Potter, what is this supposed to be?

memories.description: She didn't want me to come back to Hogwarts. My presence is the reason Seamus's mum tried to stop him coming.
memories.source_text: She didn't want me to come back to Hogwarts.

memories.description: She not only thinks I'm a liar, she blames Dumbledore as well. They're buying what the Daily Prophet prints.
memories.source_text: Well, she er well, it's not just you, it's Dumbledore too

memories.description: I can't pretend anymore. Some people genuinely believe I'm making everything up and Dumbledore's mad. That's how they see me now.
memories.source_text: She believes the Daily Prophet? She thinks I’m a liar and Dumbledore’s an old fool?

memories.description: I'm not going to let people call me a liar without fighting back. I'm done taking it lying down.
memories.source_text: I'll have a go at anyone who calls me a liar

memories.description: People around me are itching for the story about Cedric. They're asking in front of others and it's making everything worse.
memories.source_text: Look what did happen that night when you know when with Cedric Diggory and all?

memories.description: I'm fed up with being treated like some circus act. I feel angry and cornered and I won't be spoken to with that kind of disbelief.
memories.source_text: Don't talk to me like that!

memories.description: I was staring at the window trying to see Hogwarts and feeling fed up, then Hermione said we should get changed, so I knew it was time to move.
memories.source_text: "We'd better change," said Hermione at last.

memories.description: I was worried about Hagrid not being there and I said it out loud because it felt wrong he wasn't around.
memories.source_text: "Where's Hagrid?" he said out loud.

memories.description: Those creatures pulling the coaches were horrific, half-dragon, bone-showing, bat-winged things and I could see them clearly.
memories.source_text: "What are those horse things?"

memories.description: At first I thought everyone could see the beasts but when Ron couldn't, I started to suspect others might not be seeing what I see.
memories.source_text: "Can’t you see what’s pulling the carriages?"

memories.description: Luna sees weird things like I do, so I felt less alone and that I could trust her a bit more about strange stuff.
memories.source_text: "Oh yes," said Luna, "I’ve been able to see them ever since my first day here."

memories.description: She said hello all nervous and then ran off. I liked her, and that was embarrassing. I wanted to look cool and she caught me with Neville and Luna. Typical.
memories.source_text: Oh hello, Harry, Um bad time?

memories.description: Sirius Black is being smeared in The Quibbler, like they are calling him a mass murderer. This is the article Kingsley gave to my godfather.
memories.source_text: SIRIUS BLACK: Villain or Victim?

memories.description: They've got that stupid cartoon of Sirius standing on bones and are asking if he's guilty or some singing sensation. That's mental. People are deciding his entire life for him in a joke of a magazine.
memories.source_text: SIRIUS — Black As He’s Painted? Notorious Mass Murderer OR Innocent Singing Sensation?

memories.description: The Quibbler Kingsley gave Mr Weasley must be the same one Luna's reading. I grabbed it because I needed to see what they were saying about Black.
memories.source_text: Can I have a look at this?

memories.description: I told Ron he did well, even though I hated that I felt jealous. I can still be pleased for him and keep my mouth shut about the badge.
memories.source_text: "Cool," Harry said, and he was relieved to hear that his voice had stopped sounding hearty.

memories.description: Maybe Dumbledore didn't make me a prefect because of the trouble I get into, not because I'm not trusted. That actually makes sense and I can live with that.
memories.source_text: "Nah, I’ve caused too much trouble," Harry said, echoing Fred.

memories.description: I forgot prefects were chosen this year, so I wasn't expecting a badge. That explains why Ron got one and I didn't.
memories.source_text: He had forgotten completely about prefects being chosen in the fifth year.

memories.description: I keep telling myself I've done more dangerous things than Ron and Hermione, but that doesn't mean I'm the one who should be a prefect.
memories.source_text: "I’ve definitely done more, Harry thought indignantly. I’ve done more than either of them!"

memories.description: I gave the twins my Triwizard winnings to help them out and now I worry it might cause trouble with Mum. I don't want Mrs Weasley to think less of me for helping them.
memories.source_text: "We’d better get these upstairs . . ." Harry watched them go, feeling slightly uneasy.

memories.description: They're pretending there is no danger. The Ministry and Umbridge are denying that Voldemort's back and trying to make us act like nothing's happened.
memories.source_text: "There is nothing waiting out there, Mr. Potter."

memories.description: I know what I saw. Voldemort came back and I fought him. I'm not going to shut up about it.
memories.source_text: "It is NOT a lie! I saw him, I fought him!"

memories.description: Cedric was murdered by Voldemort. I can't let them dress it up as an accident.
memories.source_text: "Cedric Diggory's death was a tragic accident," she said coldly.

memories.description: Umbridge hates me and will use every bit of power she has to punish me. She means trouble for me personally.
memories.source_text: "Detention, Mr. Potter! Tomorrow evening. Five o'clock. My office."

memories.description: McGonagall sees how dangerous this is. I can't just storm about without thinking. I have to be careful because other people could get hurt or worse.
memories.source_text: "Potter, you need to be careful."

memories.description: We never get great DADA teachers. Hagrid said no one wants the job because it's jinxed. That's just how it is.
memories.source_text: "Well, we’ve never had great Defense Against the Dark Arts teachers, have we?" said Harry. "You know what it’s like, Hagrid told us, nobody wants the job, they say it’s jinxed."

memories.description: Let's get the homework done and stop arguing. I just want to get on with it and not make things worse.
memories.source_text: "Can’t we just . . . Let’s just do that homework, get it out of the way . . ."

memories.description: Fred and George are handing out sweets that make first years faint. That is dangerous messing about.
memories.source_text: "Fainting Fancies?" Harry suggested quietly. One by one, as though hit over the heads with invisible mallets, the first years were slumping unconscious in their seats

memories.description: I can feel everyone staring at me. I don't want more attention so I avoid the portrait hole.
memories.source_text: People were coming back from dinner now. Harry kept his face averted from the portrait hole, but could still sense the stares he was attracting.

memories.description: I asked if I could miss detention to attend the Quidditch keeper tryouts because it's important to me and my team.
memories.source_text: "I was supposed to be at the tryouts for the new Keeper at five o'clock on Friday and I was — was wondering whether I could skip detention that night"

memories.description: Umbridge sees my attempt to avoid detention as unacceptable and thinks I'm been spreading 'evil, nasty, attention-seeking stories'.
memories.source_text: "Oh no, no, no. This is your punishment for spreading evil, nasty, attention-seeking stories, Mr Potter"

memories.description: She insists I must attend detention at five every day she schedules, no exceptions for things I actually need to do.
memories.source_text: "No, you will come here at five o'clock tomorrow, and the next day, and on Friday too"

memories.description: She ordered me to write a phrase over and over as punishment: 'I must not tell lies.'
memories.source_text: "I want you to write 'I must not tell lies'"

memories.description: She gave me a special black quill that doesn't need ink and I had to use it instead of my own.
memories.source_text: "You won't need ink"

memories.description: When I wrote with that quill the words showed up on the paper in red and the same words were cut into the back of my hand, then the skin healed leaving redness.
memories.source_text: "He let out a gasp of pain. The words had appeared on the parchment in what appeared to be shining red ink. At the same time, the words had appeared on the back of Harry's right hand, cut into his skin"

memories.description: She's not just petty, she's enjoying having power over me and watching my reactions. She's deliberately cruel.
memories.source_text: "She was watching him with her head slightly to one side, still smiling widely, as though she knew exactly what he was thinking"

memories.description: She made me write 'I must not tell lies' in my own blood and the quill cuts my hand every time. It's meant to hurt and humiliate me, but I won't give her the satisfaction of seeing me break.
memories.source_text: He looked back at the parchment, placed the quill upon it once more, wrote I must not tell lies, and felt the searing pain on the back of his hand for a second time; once again the words had been cut into his skin, once again they healed over seconds later.

memories.description: She's watching for weakness. I won't show it. If I have to sit here all night and bleed, I will.
memories.source_text: He knew she was watching him for signs of weakness and he was not going to show any, not even if he had to sit here all night, cutting open his own hand with this quill.

memories.description: She inspects me like I'm some troublesome child and touches me in a way that makes me want to shudder. She's got this smug, poking kind of cruelty.
memories.source_text: “Hand,” she said. He extended it. She took it in her own. Harry repressed a shudder as she touched him with her thick, stubby fingers on which she wore a number of ugly old rings.

memories.description: I can't finish Snape's essay without Hermione. Plain and simple, I need her help.
memories.source_text: "There’s no point trying to finish this now, I can’t do it without Hermione, I haven’t got a clue what you’re supposed to do with moonstones, have you?"

memories.description: We're supposed to be sketching bowtruckles, and Hermione knows loads about them so I should stick with them.
memories.source_text: "He hurried back around the table to Ron and Hermione, who were squatting on the grass some distance away and attempting to persuade a bowtruckle to remain still long enough to draw it."

memories.description: If Malfoy is hinting Hagrid got hurt, I suddenly think Hagrid might be in real trouble and I’m worried about what Malfoy knows.
memories.source_text: "Maybe he’s been messing with stuff that’s too big for him, if you get my drift."

memories.description: My head's aching worse again. I feel sharp pain when I think about the essay on giant wars.
memories.source_text: "Harry shook his head, noticing as he did so that the ache in his right temple was getting worse."

memories.description: I was really pleased and surprised to get Ernie's support. It matters to me when people who aren't daft about this back me up.
memories.source_text: "Er — thanks very much, Ernie," said Harry, taken aback but pleased.

memories.description: I honestly think Umbridge is acting like a mad Quidditch coach right now. She's over the top and bossy and it's ridiculous.
memories.source_text: "I think we'd better check with Puddlemere United whether Oliver Wood's been killed during a training session, because she seems to be channeling his spirit."

memories.description: I've got loads to do tonight. If Umbridge keeps me ages in detention I'm screwed for all my homework and practice.
