memories.source_text: "I hope she doesn't keep me too long this evening. You realize we've got to write three essays, practice Vanishing Spells for McGonagall, work out a countercharm for Flitwick, finish the bowtruckle drawing, and start that stupid dream diary for Trelawney?"

memories.description: Umbridge's office is all sickly cosy and horrible. It's nothing like it used to be with Lockhart or Lupin or Moody. It's full of lace and kittens and dried flowers and it makes me feel on edge.
memories.source_text: "Come in," in a sugary voice. He entered cautiously, looking around.

memories.description: Right, Percy sent Ron a letter. It’s from him and it’s about Ron being made a prefect.
memories.source_text: Harry nodded.

memories.description: This feels like Percy showing off and lecturing Ron. I don’t like the smug tone he’s taking.
memories.source_text: Ron thrust the letter at Harry and Hermione, who leaned toward each other to read it together

memories.description: Malfoy’s still having a go at my scar. He’ll shout things to rile me up and try to make me look weak.
memories.source_text: "Hey, Potter, how’s your scar feeling?" called Malfoy.

memories.description: Angelina runs the plays and she tells me when to release the Snitch. I do what she says and I wait for her signal.
memories.source_text: "All right," called Angelina, "Fred, George, go and get your bats and a Bludger; Ron, get up to the goalposts, Harry, release the Snitch when I say so."

memories.description: Ron’s messing up because he’s nervous, not because he can’t play. He was fine in practice this morning.
memories.source_text: "He’s just nervous," said Harry.

memories.description: Fred and George carry stuff to patch people up quick. They’ll sort out Katie if something happens.
memories.source_text: "Here, take this," Fred told her, handing her something small and purple from out of his pocket.

memories.description: Fred and George back us up in games and their passing can catch me off guard, but I can still react under pressure.
memories.source_text: "Fred passed to Angelina; she reverse passed to Harry, who had not been expecting it, but caught it in the very tips of his fingers and passed it quickly to Ron, who lunged for it and missed by inches."

memories.description: My scar hurt when Umbridge touched me. It felt wrong and I know it means something is up.
memories.source_text: "I was just up in Umbridge's office and she touched my arm"

memories.description: She is twisted and dangerous. I don't trust her for a second.
memories.source_text: "She's evil," said Harry flatly

memories.description: I thought about writing to Sirius, but then I backed off because of how risky letters could be.
memories.source_text: "I think I'll write and tell Sirius about it, see what he thinks"

memories.description: I want to tell Sirius what's happening, but I won't if it's too dangerous. I won't put him or me at risk with an owl right now.
memories.source_text: "I think I'll write and tell Sirius about it, see what he thinks" and "All right, all right, I won't tell him, then!"

memories.description: I don't want to bother Dumbledore about this. My scar has been a pain on and off all summer and I don't want to make a fuss.
memories.source_text: "I'm not bothering him with this. Like you just said, it's not a big deal. It's been hurting on and off all summer"

memories.description: I asked Hermione to tell Ron for me because I didn't want to hang around arguing.
memories.source_text: "Tell Ron for me, will you?"

memories.description: Peeves is up to no good near the Paracelsus bust. I wouldn’t go past there if I can help it.
memories.source_text: "Peeves is planning an amusing joke on the next person to pass the bust of Paracelsus halfway down the corridor."

memories.description: If Peeves’s joke is what Nick thinks, someone’s going to get Paracelsus dropped on their head. Lovely.
memories.source_text: "Does it involve Paracelsus falling on top of the person’s head?"

memories.description: Angelina’s backing me and she likes the way I’m playing. That’s good to have from the captain.
memories.source_text: "Exactly the attitude I want, Harry," said Angelina approvingly

memories.description: Those Slytherin lot are going to try and wind Ron and me up. Fine. Ignore them and let our play do the talking.
memories.source_text: "What’s that Weasley’s riding?" Malfoy called in his sneering drawl.

memories.description: Snape will never be fair to me. I know it. Ever since I got here it's been like that and I can't pretend otherwise.
memories.source_text: since when has Snape ever been fair to me?

memories.description: My potion disappeared right in front of me. Great. I ended up standing there looking stupid next to an empty cauldron.
memories.source_text: Evanesco. The contents of Harry’s potion vanished; he was left standing foolishly beside an empty cauldron.

memories.description: Hermione thought Snape might be different because he's in the Order. I don't buy it. Being in the Order doesn't mean he stops being horrible to me.
memories.source_text: I did think he might be a bit better this year ... Now he's in the Order and everything.

memories.description: I don't want to share my dreams. My graveyard nightmare is mine and I don't need anyone telling me what it means.
memories.source_text: I never remember my dreams

memories.description: The Defense class is being treated like theory-only because of all the awful turnover. That worries me for O.W.L.s.
memories.source_text: The constant changing of teachers ... has unfortunately resulted in your being far below the standard we would expect to see in your O.W.L. year.

memories.description: Umbridge's rule is no wands in class. She's all about writing and talking and nothing about actually using defensive spells.
memories.source_text: Wands away and quills out, please.

memories.description: Umbridge's lessons are going to be dull and strict. She's going to make lessons pointless and boring, and that means trouble when you actually need to learn to defend yourself.
memories.source_text: There will be no need to talk.

memories.description: It's my job to catch the Snitch. That little golden thing is worth a hundred and fifty points and I have to be insanely fast and focused to get it.
memories.source_text: it was his job to recapture the tiny fluttering golden ball that was worth a hundred and fifty points to the Seeker’s team and doing so required enormous speed and skill.

memories.description: When the whistle goes, everything else blurs out. Once the Snitch is released I'm focused on it and nothing else matters.
memories.source_text: When Angelina blew her whistle, Harry released the Snitch and Fred and George let fly the Bludger; from that moment on, Harry was barely aware of what the others were doing.

memories.description: Angelina will shout at us if our positions slip. I get that if someone doesn't hold their post properly we suffer, and I can't afford to ignore it while I'm chasing the Snitch.
memories.source_text: “Stop — stop — STOP!” screamed Angelina. “Ron — you’re not covering your middle post!”

memories.description: I saw the Snitch and had to pull up because of the stoppage. It's maddening when I spot it and then we're told to stop.
memories.source_text: Harry, who had just sighted the Snitch circling the opposite goalpost, pulled up feeling distinctly aggrieved.

memories.description: I kept my mouth shut the whole time. I only said "Good evening" when I arrived and "Good night" when I left.
memories.source_text: "Good evening" and "Good night."

memories.description: Umbridge made me write "I must not tell lies" on my hand and it got cut into my skin, oozing blood. It's not fading anymore.
memories.source_text: "I must not tell lies"

memories.description: This is my fight with Umbridge. I do not want to give her the satisfaction of seeing them horrified, so I am keeping it to myself.
memories.source_text: He was not really sure why he was not telling Ron and Hermione exactly what was happening in Umbridge’s room

memories.description: After detention I had to work all night on Snape's essay and other homework. I finished at half past two and I know it is a poor job but I had no choice.
memories.source_text: It was half-past two by the time he had finished it.

memories.description: I was so exhausted that I collapsed fully clothed and slept straight away.
memories.source_text: he fell fully clothed on top of the bed covers and fell asleep immediately.

memories.description: She's wicked. I hate her more than Snape now. She's just plain evil, twisted and mad.
memories.source_text: "She’s evil, he thought, as he climbed a staircase to the seventh floor, she’s an evil, twisted, mad, old —"

memories.description: She's going to make me come back and go even further with those lines. She's not stopping after one night.
memories.source_text: "Oh yes," said Professor Umbridge, smiling widely as before. "Yes, I think we can etch the message a little deeper with another evening’s work."

memories.description: My hand's been carved. It's more than a cut. It hurts and it shows what she does to people.
memories.source_text: "It’s just a cut — it’s nothing — it’s —"

memories.description: I won't go running to Dumbledore. He hasn't even spoken to me since June, so I'm not asking him for this.
memories.source_text: "He’s got enough on his mind," said Harry, but that was not the true reason. He was not going to go to Dumbledore for help when Dumbledore had not spoken to him once since last June.

memories.description: I'm not going to let her see she's got to me. I refuse to give her that satisfaction.
memories.source_text: "No," said Harry at once. "I’m not giving her the satisfaction of knowing she’s got to me."

memories.description: That little bugger can swipe back. I held the bowtruckle and it sliced my hand with those sharp fingers. Careful handling matters, or you get cut.
memories.source_text: "OUCH!" Harry had gripped the bowtruckle so hard that it had almost snapped; it had just taken a great retaliatory swipe at his hand with its sharp fingers, leaving two long deep cuts there.

memories.description: I am dead set on Hagrid. Hearing people call him a moron winds me up so much I want to do something about it. I won't stand by while they rubbish him.
memories.source_text: "If he calls Hagrid a moron one more time . . ." snarled Harry.

memories.description: I want Hagrid back teaching Care of Magical Creatures. Nothing about Grubbly-Plank will be as good as him, and I want him back in charge.
memories.source_text: "I just wish Hagrid would hurry up and get back, that’s all," said Harry in a low voice, as they reached the greenhouses.

memories.description: I stick up for people who get laughed at, even if I don't get everything they say. I won't let Hermione mock someone out loud when it's obvious they're already getting enough grief.
memories.source_text: "D’you mind not offending the only people who believe me?" Harry asked Hermione as they made their way into class.

memories.description: Katie is hurt bad. Angelina stopped training and she needs the hospital wing. We can't carry on without Beaters and a Chaser.
memories.source_text: It was plain that Angelina had stopped training just in time; Katie was now chalk-white and covered in blood.

memories.description: I won't slag Ron off. He's not rubbish just because practice went badly. I'll stick up for him.
memories.source_text: “No,” said Harry loyally.

memories.description: Okay, he could've done better, but it's the first session. We need to give it time and not panic.
memories.source_text: “Well, I suppose he could’ve played better,” Harry muttered, “but it was only the first training session, like you said . . .”

memories.description: So Umbridge is the new High Inquisitor. Great. She means trouble for us and the school rules are about to get nastier.
memories.source_text: MINISTRY SEEKS EDUCATIONAL REFORM DOLORES UMBRIDGE APPOINTED FIRST-EVER “HIGH INQUISITOR”

memories.description: Trelawney might be a bit of a fraud, but I hate Umbridge enough that I was on Trelawney's side when Umbridge bullied her.
memories.source_text: The Inner Eye does not See upon command!

memories.description: Umbridge singled me out for punishment. She gave me detentions that made my cut bleed again and forced me to write lines. I will not give her the satisfaction of whining about it.
memories.source_text: I think another week’s detentions would do you some good, Mr. Potter

memories.description: I saw You-Know-Who. I'm not wasting time trying to convince anyone who won't believe Dumbledore or me.
memories.source_text: I saw him.

memories.description: People notice my scar. Even rough pub types clock it, so my presence changes how folks act around me.
memories.source_text: The barman's eyes traveled over Harry, resting for a fraction of a second on his scar.

memories.description: The Hog's Head is full of weird, shady types who hide their faces. It's the kind of place where people keep secrets and don't mind if you do the same.
memories.source_text: There was a man at the bar whose whole head was wrapped in dirty gray bandages

memories.description: Hermione's gone and organized this whole thing. Loads of people turned up expecting me to talk. She's the one who pulled everyone together, whether I wanted that or not.
memories.source_text: What have you been telling people? ... What are they expecting?

memories.description: If folks won't believe Dumbledore, they won't believe me either. I won't waste my time arguing with them.
memories.source_text: If you didn't believe him, you don't believe me

memories.description: This is unfair. I'm getting punished by Umbridge already and then McGonagall takes points off Gryffindor on top of that. How is that supposed to help?
memories.source_text: "I’m already being punished by her, why do you have to take points as well?"

memories.description: People think detentions don't work on me. They reckon I'm not learning my lesson from Umbridge's punishments.
memories.source_text: "Because detentions do not appear to have any effect on you whatsoever!" said Professor McGonagall

memories.description: Fine, I don't want to lose my temper with Umbridge. But I'm still mad about the points. I can see Hermione's point though.
memories.source_text: "I wish she hadn't taken points from you, but I think she's right to warn you not to lose your temper with Umbridge," said Hermione's voice

memories.description: McGonagall and I can be on the same side sometimes. I think she understands me more than she lets on.
memories.source_text: "Harry could not help giving her a faint smile and could have sworn he received one in return."

memories.description: Umbridge is trying to get info on Hagrid's leave. People are watching Hagrid closely and I should be careful because others might tattle.
memories.source_text: "I wonder — the headmaster seems strangely reluctant to give me any information on the matter — can you tell me what is causing Professor Hagrid’s very extended leave of absence?"

memories.description: I can't believe they treat me like I'm the troublemaker when I'm the one getting hurt. That's just not right.
memories.source_text: "She’s taken points off Gryffindor because I’m having my hand sliced open every night! How is that fair, how?"

memories.description: Okay, I kept thinking about it. Teaching Defense makes sense to me. I find myself planning lessons and thinking about the spells that actually worked for me.
memories.source_text: I thought it was a good idea from the start

memories.description: The first weekend in October is a Hogsmeade weekend. Hermione wants to use that to meet anyone who wants lessons.
memories.source_text: You know the first weekend in October's a Hogsmeade weekend?

memories.description: I still feel like a bit of a freak and worry people won't want me to teach, but I'm at least willing to try if Hermione and Ron want me to.
memories.source_text: Yeah, but I doubt anyone except you two would want to be taught by me. I'm a nutter, remember?

memories.description: Filch came barging in after I sent a letter to Sirius. Someone must have tipped him off about the letter or the dungbombs and he sniffed around my stuff.
memories.source_text: He said he was tipped off you were ordering Dungbombs? But who had tipped him off?

memories.description: I'm worrying about Sirius turning up in Hogsmeade when we meet. I keep picturing the big black dog bounding up the street and what might happen if Malfoy spots him.
memories.source_text: Don't worry, Harry

memories.description: I just saw Sirius's head in the fire. I know I saw him before in those flames so I can't just brush this off. That's why I went down to stare into it like an idiot.
memories.source_text: [Because I’ve just seen Sirius’s head in the fire]

memories.description: I wrote to Sirius and he answered. I keep thinking about him and apparently he keeps checking in on me. That matters to me more than I expected.
memories.source_text: [At the mention of Harry’s letter, Hermione and Ron had both turned to stare at him]

memories.description: My scar is bothering people. They don't think it's really dangerous right now but everyone is watching it and worried. I can feel that.
memories.source_text: [Well, I know it can’t be fun when it hurts, but we don’t think it’s anything to really worry about]

memories.description: Percy actually told Ron to sever ties with me and to rat me out to Umbridge. I can't believe my own brother thinks I'm dangerous.
memories.source_text: “Oh yeah — ‘sever ties’ with me, I swear I won’t get violent.”

memories.description: People at Hogwarts and in the Prophet are convinced I'm odd and a menace. That's real now, not just rumours.
memories.source_text: He knew that half the people inside Hogwarts thought him strange, even mad; he knew that the Daily Prophet had been making snide allusions to him for months

memories.description: Percy and I have a history — I lived with him, shared a tent, even got top marks from him once. That makes his betrayal sting even more.
memories.source_text: He had known Percy for four years, had stayed in his house during the summers, shared a tent with him during the Quidditch World Cup, had even been awarded full marks by him in the second task of the Triwizard Tournament last year

memories.description: Sirius would get how rotten this feels. He's been blamed and hated for years, so he knows what it's like to be on the wrong end of everyone.
memories.source_text: And with a surge of sympathy for his godfather, Harry thought that Sirius was probably the only person he knew who could really understand how he felt at the moment

memories.description: It's past midnight and we're the only ones up with Crookshanks. I'm exhausted and tense.
memories.source_text: It was now past midnight and the common room was deserted but for the three of them and Crookshanks.

memories.description: Umbridge has put Trelawney on probation. That's why Trelawney's making a fuss and crying in class.
memories.source_text: "She obviously reckons Trelawney’s an old fraud too. . . . Looks like she’s put her on probation."

memories.description: Umbridge's lessons are all about non-offensive responses. She wants us to learn theory, not actually defend ourselves properly.
memories.source_text: "Please turn to page thirty-four of Defensive Magical Theory and read the third chapter, entitled ‘The Case for Non-Offensive Responses to Magical Attack.'"

memories.description: The Ministry decree means no Quidditch practice for us. Umbridge is using rules to punish and control us.
memories.source_text: "No Quidditch practice," said Angelina in hollow tones

memories.description: Mundungus was spying on our meeting at the Hog's Head. People in the Order or shady followers are watching us.
memories.source_text: "He was the witch under the veil." "That was Mundungus?"

memories.description: Sirius makes me feel that learning real defense is urgent. I'm convinced we need to practice even if it's risky.
memories.source_text: "This year we know that there’s someone outside Hogwarts who’d like to kill us all, so I think learning to defend yourselves properly is a very good idea!"

memories.description: We suggested meeting places. The Shrieking Shack was proposed but might not work for twenty-eight people who are not Animagi.
memories.source_text: "How about the Shrieking Shack?"

memories.description: The Floo message was sealed when we got it. It looked genuine, so I keep telling myself nobody must have tampered with it.
memories.source_text: "But it was still sealed and everything," said Harry, trying to convince himself as much as her.

memories.description: If you don't know where we last spoke to him, that message wouldn't make sense to you. I can't see how someone could use it unless they already knew our meeting place.
memories.source_text: "And nobody would understand what it meant if they didn’t know where we’d spoken to him before, would they?"

memories.description: Neville matters to me. I stepped in because I won't watch him get bullied into a fight he can't win.
memories.source_text: "I had to stop you," Harry gasped, picking up his bag. "Crabbe and Goyle would’ve torn you apart."

memories.description: Snape's given me homework and it's going to eat into my night. Great, another sleepless one because of him.
memories.source_text: "You will write me an essay on the correct composition of this potion, indicating how and why you went wrong, to be handed in next lesson, do you understand?"

memories.description: Umbridge is out to interfere with teaching. If she can get the Ministry to remove lessons she doesn't like, she'll try.
memories.source_text: "She strode between two lines of desks toward Snape, who was bending over Dean Thomas’s cauldron."

memories.description: You did that? I can't believe Umbridge would attack Hedwig. I reckon she might be the one who did it and I'm furious about it.
memories.source_text: "You think Umbridge attacked Hedwig?" he said, outraged.

memories.description: Someone's been reading my letters. If Umbridge's involved, she could have seen anything sent to me.
memories.source_text: "Umbridge has been reading your mail, Harry. There’s no other explanation."

memories.description: Charms lessons are brilliant for talking privately because everyone and everything is noisy and moving about.
memories.source_text: "Charms was always one of the best lessons in which to enjoy a private chat: There was generally so much movement and activity that the danger of being overheard was very slight."

memories.description: Hermione thinks it was a near miss and that Umbridge might know how close she came to catching Sirius. Hermione's really worried about how dangerous this is.
memories.source_text: "It was a very, very close call last night," said Hermione. "I just wonder if Umbridge knows how close it was."

memories.description: Dumbledore said my scar hurts when Voldemort feels powerful emotions, so if it ached during that detention it was probably because he was really angry.
memories.source_text: "Dumbledore said it happened whenever Voldemort was feeling a powerful emotion,"

memories.description: Now that Voldemort's back I think the pain will happen more often and that means I'm going to be feeling it a lot.
memories.source_text: "So now he's back it's bound to hurt more often," said Sirius.

memories.description: Sirius seems colder with me now, like he's judging me against my dad and disappointed when I won't take risks.
memories.source_text: "You're less like your father than I thought," he said finally, a definite coolness in his voice.

memories.description: Umbridge won't let us practice magic in Defense class, we only read from the textbook.
memories.source_text: "She's not letting us use magic at all!"

memories.description: The Ministry, especially Fudge, actually thinks Dumbledore is building an army of us, which is why they're keeping us from learning proper defense.
memories.source_text: "That's exactly what he thinks you are doing," said Sirius, "or rather, that's exactly what he's afraid Dumbledore's doing - forming his own private army"

memories.description: Sirius wants to visit at Hogsmeade and thinks he could come up in his dog form, but that would be risky because people might recognise him.
memories.source_text: "When's your next Hogsmeade weekend anyway? I was thinking, we got away with the dog disguise at the station, didn't we? I thought I could —"

memories.description: I hate people who blame Hagrid for things. If someone gets hurt because they ignored instructions, that pisses me off.
memories.source_text: "Only because he was too stupid to listen to what Hagrid told him to do," said Harry angrily.

memories.description: Umbridge dishes out detentions for everything and she'll use them to shut people up. She is dangerous for students who speak up.
memories.source_text: "Another night's detention, I think," she said softly.

memories.description: Nobody who hasn't faced Voldemort can understand how terrifying it is. You don't just cast spells like a lesson when your life is on the line.
memories.source_text: "You don't know what it's like! You neither of you you’ve never had to face him, have you?"

memories.description: Hermione and Ron want me to teach them Defense because they trust me about facing Voldemort. I feel guilty but I agreed to try and help.
memories.source_text: "We need to know what it’s r-really like . . . facing him . . . facing V-Voldemort."

memories.description: I can fix things with magic even when I'm shaken. That might help when things go wrong.
memories.source_text: "Reparo," Harry muttered, pointing his wand at the broken pieces of china.

memories.description: Sirius backs what we're doing with this group. I trust him, plain and simple.
memories.source_text: "But he’s all for it!" said Harry.

memories.description: I can cast Impervius on my glasses to stop them fogging in the rain. It works and it's handy in storms.
memories.source_text: "Hermione did it," said Harry. He pulled out his wand, tapped his glasses and said, "Impervius!"

memories.description: I won't suddenly doubt Sirius. He gives good advice and I still listen to him.
memories.source_text: "Do you honestly trust his judgment?" "Yes, I do!" said Harry at once. "He’s always given us great advice!"

memories.description: Right, Hermione's completely on board now. Hundreds of books and she thinks this is the proper way to go.
memories.source_text: the presence of hundreds of books had finally convinced Hermione that what they were doing was right.

memories.description: Everyone showed up and we filled the place. It's going to be crowded but at least we'll all be here together.
memories.source_text: By the time eight o'clock arrived, every cushion was occupied.

memories.description: She knows about the meetings. This is not a coincidence. I am furious and I am sure Umbridge has been told.
memories.source_text: "This isn\'t a coincidence," he said, his hands forming fists. "She knows."

memories.description: Right, channels in and out of Hogwarts might be watched. We can no longer assume our messages are safe.
memories.source_text: "Bear in mind," she said quickly and quietly, her eyes on the scroll in his hand, "that channels of communication in and out of Hogwarts may be being watched, won\'t you?"

memories.description: Hedwig is injured. She arrived later than the other post and her wing is damaged. I need to get her to someone who can fix her.
memories.source_text: "She\'s hurt!" Harry whispered, bending his head low over her.

memories.description: Sirius sent a message. He wants to meet today at the same time and the same place. I am going anyway.
memories.source_text: "Today, same time, same place."

memories.description: Not everyone at that pub can be trusted. Someone from that gathering might have blabbed to Umbridge.
memories.source_text: "I don\'t think we\'re going to be as lucky, though, do you?" he asked Harry as the second years hurried away.

memories.description: That went alright but we can do better. We need to keep practising and tighten things up.
memories.source_text: "That wasn't bad," said Harry, "but there's definite room for improvement."

memories.description: I tried to spare Cho's feelings and back her up even when I thought she messed up. I'm not going to be cruel about it.
memories.source_text: "'Well, no, it was lousy, but I know you can do it properly, I was watching from over there . . .' She laughed."

memories.description: We're meeting next Wednesday night. We'll sort out extra sessions when we meet.
memories.source_text: "Let's say next Wednesday night, then," said Harry, "and we can decide on additional meetings then."

memories.description: I can control the meeting. A quick signal gets everyone to stop and listen.
memories.source_text: "He blew his whistle; everybody stopped shouting, 'Expelliarmus!' and the last couple of wands clattered to the floor."

memories.description: I used the Marauder's Map to keep watch for teachers. I'm making sure everyone gets back safely and avoids Filch.
memories.source_text: "He pulled out the Marauder's Map again and checked it carefully for signs of teachers on the seventh floor."

memories.description: So the Room of Requirement can hide someone and even has things like antidotes and a tiny bed. That could be brilliant for keeping people safe or hidden when we need to.
memories.source_text: "Dobby has used it, sir," said the elf, dropping his voice and looking guilty, "when Winky has been very drunk. He has hidden her in the Room of Requirement and he has found antidotes to butterbeer there, and a nice elf-sized bed to settle her on while she sleeps it off, sir."

memories.description: The room can produce supplies, like extra cleaning materials. It gives you what you need.
memories.source_text: "And Dobby knows Mr. Filch has found extra cleaning materials there when he has run short, sir, and —"

memories.description: It can probably create practical things on demand, even chamber pots. It truly adapts to what you need it to be.
memories.source_text: "and if you really needed a bathroom," said Harry, suddenly remembering something Dumbledore had said at the Yule Ball the previous Christmas, "would it fill itself with chamber pots?" "Dobby expects so, sir," said Dobby, nodding earnestly. "It is a most amazing room, sir."

memories.description: Very few people know about the Room. Most find it by chance and then can never find it again because you have to know how to call it.
memories.source_text: "Very few, sir. Mostly people stumbles across it when they needs it, sir, but often they never finds it again, for they do not know that it is always there waiting to be called into service, sir."

memories.description: This is perfect for our meetings. I used to be worried about security and space but now I know there is a place that appears exactly when needed and stays hidden otherwise.
memories.source_text: "It sounds brilliant," said Harry, his heart racing. "It sounds perfect, Dobby. When can you show me where it is?"

memories.description: The first D.A. meeting is set. Tonight at eight o'clock in the Room of Requirement on the seventh floor opposite the Barnabas the Barmy tapestry. We have a time and a place.
memories.source_text: "Good," said Harry quietly, when she told him, "because we’ve found somewhere to have our first Defense meeting. Tonight, eight o’clock, seventh floor opposite that tapestry of Barnabas the Barmy being clubbed by those trolls."

memories.description: Hedwig's back with me and she's been fixed by Professor Grubbly-Plank. She's all right now.
memories.source_text: Dobby volunteered to return Harry Potter’s owl! Professor Grubbly-Plank says she is all well now, sir!

memories.description: That dream with the door was really vivid and it's stuck in my head, even if it wasn't the worst thing I've had.
memories.source_text: Not really bad, said Harry, yawning and rubbing his eyes. I’ve had worse.

memories.description: Dobby is loyal to me and grateful because I set him free. He's happier now and wants to do things for me.
memories.source_text: Dobby wishes he could help Harry Potter, for Harry Potter set Dobby free and Dobby is much, much happier now

memories.description: I don't think Dobby can help with what I'm dealing with, but I appreciate him trying.
memories.source_text: You can’t help me, Dobby, but thanks for the offer

memories.description: Dark detectors show when Dark wizards or enemies are nearby but they can be fooled, so I won't trust them completely.
memories.source_text: "Dark Detectors," said Harry, stepping between the cushions to reach them. "Basically they all show when Dark wizards or enemies are around, but you don't want to rely on them too much, they can be fooled ."

memories.description: People are willing to back me as leader, even some who don't seem keen, so I know they've put their trust in me even if I'm nervous about it.
memories.source_text: "Everyone put up their hands, even Zacharias Smith, though he did it very halfheartedly."

memories.description: We should start training with Expelliarmus, the Disarming Charm, because it's practical and something everyone can learn first.
memories.source_text: "I was thinking, the first thing we should do is Expelliarmus, you know, the Disarming Charm."

memories.description: I've used Expelliarmus on You-Know-Who and it saved my life last June. It's not just a showy trick, it actually works when it matters.
memories.source_text: "I've used it against him," said Harry quietly. "It saved my life last June."

memories.description: If someone thinks a simple defensive spell is beneath them, they can sod off. We all need to learn the basics, no matter how clever we think we are.
memories.source_text: "But if you think it’s beneath you, you can leave," Harry said.

memories.description: I should get everyone practicing the basics in pairs so I can walk around and spot who's doing the spell wrong. It's the only way they'll actually learn.
memories.source_text: "Listen, Neville, can you take it in turns to practice with Ron and Hermione for a couple of minutes so I can walk around and see how the rest are doing?"

memories.description: Neville can do it if he gets the chance. He just needed someone to practice with and a bit of encouragement.
memories.source_text: "I DID IT!" said Neville gleefully. "I’ve never done it before — I DID IT!"

memories.description: Fred and George can't resist mucking about in the middle of practice. I can expect distractions from them and need to keep an eye out.
memories.source_text: "Sorry, Harry," said George hastily, when Harry caught his eye. "Couldn’t resist . . ."

memories.description: When things get out of hand I just need to shout and take control. A whistle would be handy to get everyone's attention quickly.
memories.source_text: "Okay, stop!" Harry shouted. "Stop! STOP!"

memories.description: I jumped at Flitwick's voice. Loud surprises throw me off, plain and simple.
memories.source_text: "Very good, Miss Granger!" said Professor Flitwick's squeaky little voice and Harry, Ron, and Hermione all jumped.

memories.description: Quidditch is back on. I'm glad. We need every edge we can get, so I'm in.
memories.source_text: "I’ve got permission! To re-form the Quidditch team!" "Excellent!" said Ron and Harry together.

memories.description: Hermione's distracted. I can't ignore it. Something's bothering her even now, and that matters.
memories.source_text: "Hope this clears up . . . What’s up with you, Hermione?"

memories.description: Hagrid’s been out looking for giants and he really found them. He said flat out he has.
memories.source_text: "Yeah, all righ’," he grunted, "I have."

memories.description: The giants are up in the mountains. That’s where they live.
memories.source_text: "Mountains," said Hagrid unhelpfully.

memories.description: They’re huge. About twenty feet tall, some even bigger. That’s not something you mess with.
memories.source_text: "'Bout twenty feet," said Hagrid casually.

memories.description: Hagrid’s badly hurt but he’s trying to play it down. He’s damaged and stubborn about getting help.
memories.source_text: "I’m tellin’ yeh, I’m fine," said Hagrid.

memories.description: Dumbledore sent Hagrid to find the giants. Hagrid trusts Dumbledore and went because Dumbledore told him to.
memories.source_text: "Dumbledore knew, an’ he told us," said Hagrid.

memories.description: The Ministry is watching Dumbledore and anyone thought to be with him. We can’t assume people aren’t being watched.
memories.source_text: "The Ministry’s keepin’ an eye on Dumbledore an’ anyone they reckon’s in league with him,"

memories.description: Dumbledore mentioned the Room to me in passing at the Yule Ball. If Dumbledore knows about it then it can't be some daft prank.
memories.source_text: "Just in passing," said Harry, shrugging.

memories.description: This bit of parchment is the Marauder's Map. Tap it with the words and the whole castle shows up on it.
memories.source_text: "I solemnly swear that I am up to no good."

memories.description: Hermione and Ron are with me on this. We spent the day rounding people up and we're all heading out together to use the Map and set things in motion.
memories.source_text: At half-past seven Harry, Ron, and Hermione left the Gryffindor common room, Harry clutching a certain piece of aged parchment in his hand.

memories.description: We actually got the word out — all twenty-five people who signed turned up. That's more than I expected.
memories.source_text: by the end of dinner he was confident that the news had been passed to every one of the twenty-five people who had turned up in the Hog's Head.

memories.description: I wanted to know what Hagrid had hidden in the Forest. I saw the black winged horses with my own eyes so they are real and Hagrid wasn't making them up.
memories.source_text: "What’s he keeping in there? Did he say?" asked Harry.

memories.description: I couldn't believe it at first but seeing the horses eat made me relieved. I know now the creatures are real and Hagrid knows about them too.
memories.source_text: "A great wave of relief broke over Harry. Here at last was proof that he had not imagined these creatures, that they were real"

memories.description: A door can just appear when you need a place to practise. I went straight for the handle and led us in.
memories.source_text: A highly polished door had appeared in the wall.

memories.description: The room inside is huge and dungeon-like with flickering torches, walls lined with bookcases, and big silk cushions instead of chairs. Perfect for training.
memories.source_text: Harry reached out, seized the brass handle, pulled open the door, and led the way into a spacious room lit with flickering torches like those that illuminated the dungeons eight floors below.

memories.description: That looked like a set-up to me, but I know I got in trouble for it. I did what I had to. Still, Minerva gave us detention and Umbridge is making things worse.
memories.source_text: "I have never seen such a disgraceful exhibition. Two onto one! Explain yourselves!"

memories.description: Umbridge has official power now. She can override other teachers and take away our privileges whenever she wants.
memories.source_text: "The High Inquisitor will henceforth have supreme authority over all punishments, sanctions, and removal of privileges pertaining to the students of Hogwarts"

memories.description: Umbridge wants to ban me from playing Quidditch for life. That is ridiculous and cruel, and it feels like she is trying to humiliate me.
memories.source_text: "I think a lifelong ban ought to do the trick"

memories.description: Ron is devastated and thinking about quitting the team. If he does, we will be in a real mess because we're already short of players.
memories.source_text: "I'm going to resign first thing tomorrow."

memories.description: I caught the Snitch. I grabbed it with everything I had and the whole stand went mental.
memories.source_text: It was over in two breathless, desperate, windswept seconds — Harry’s fingers closed around the tiny, struggling ball — Malfoy’s fingernails scrabbled the back of Harry’s hand hopelessly — Harry pulled his broom upward, holding the struggling ball in his hand and the Gryffindor spectators screamed their approval.

memories.description: I got clocked by a Bludger right after I caught it and landed flat on my back. I was winded and sore.
memories.source_text: WHAM! A Bludger hit Harry squarely in the small of the back and he flew forward off his broom; luckily he was only five or six feet above the ground, having dived so low to catch the Snitch, but he was winded all the same as he landed flat on his back on the frozen pitch.

memories.description: Malfoy slagged off Ron and my ties to the Weasleys. I don't like him one bit. If he insults Ron I will do something about it.
memories.source_text: “Saved Weasley’s neck, haven’t you?” he said to Harry. “I’ve never seen a worse Keeper . . . but then he was born in a bin. . . .”

memories.description: I lost it and went for Malfoy. I punched him in the gut out of pure anger because of what he said about Mum and the Weasleys.
memories.source_text: Harry grabbed hold of George; meanwhile it was taking the combined efforts of Angelina, Alicia, and Katie to stop Fred leaping on Malfoy, who was laughing openly.

memories.description: I got hit with an Impedimentia curse and was knocked over. That was the only thing that stopped me from decking Malfoy properly.
memories.source_text: He could hear girls’ voices screaming, Malfoy yelling, George swearing, a whistle blowing, and the bellowing of the crowd around him, but he did not care, not until somebody in the vicinity yelled “IMPEDIMENTA!” and only when he was knocked over backward by the force of the spell did he abandon the attempt to punch every inch of Malfoy he could reach.

memories.description: Madam Hooch sent me and George straight to McGonagall's office. We're in proper trouble and there's no point pretending otherwise.
memories.source_text: “I’ve never seen behavior like it — back up to the castle, both of you, and straight to your Head of House’s office! Go! Now!”

memories.description: I keep seeing things I can't explain and the worst part is thinking I was the one who attacked Mr Weasley. I feel sick about it and guilty as anything.
memories.source_text: "it was he who had attacked Mr. Weasley in the first place."

memories.description: I can get these urges — I don't just see things, I feel like I could act on them. That scares me more than the visions themselves.
memories.source_text: "I felt like I wanted to attack Dumbledore too."

memories.description: Mrs Weasley is on her way to St Mungo's and Dad is still alive. They're going to keep us waiting here until they send news.
memories.source_text: "Dad is still alive. I am setting out for St. Mungo's now. Stay where you are. I will send news as soon as I can. Mum."

memories.description: Everyone's here because I raised the alarm. I keep thinking it's my fault they're in this mess and I can't shake that.
memories.source_text: "We would not be here if it were not for him; they would all still be asleep in bed."

memories.description: I saw it happen. I had a vision of Mr Weasley being attacked by a giant snake and it felt real.
memories.source_text: I saw it happen

memories.description: I was inside the snake. I watched the whole attack from the snake's point of view.
memories.source_text: I was the snake

memories.description: This wasn't just some ordinary dream. It was real enough that I know Arthur Weasley has been badly hurt.
memories.source_text: It wasn’t an ordinary dream it was real

memories.description: Ron is terrified for his dad. He's pale and stunned and I can tell he's scared out of his mind.
memories.source_text: Ron looked from Harry to Dumbledore white-faced and shocked

memories.description: Fred, George and Ginny are looking at me like they might blame me for what I saw. I toned my story down and said I watched from the sidelines because I didn't want them accusing me of anything worse.
memories.source_text: Fred George and Ginny continued to stare at him for a moment

memories.description: Dumbledore is getting other portraits involved and trying to find out more. He thinks Everard and Dilys might help locate Mr Weasley.
memories.source_text: Please sit down all three of you Everard and Dilys may not be back for several minutes

memories.description: Dumbledore wants to send a warning out. He's already waking people and getting Fawkes involved to help.
memories.source_text: We will need a warning

memories.description: I get frustrated when people don't react as quickly as I think they should. I keep thinking about how badly someone could be hurt and want action now.
memories.source_text: why were they all so slow on the uptake did they not realize how much a person bled when fangs that long pierced their side

memories.description: You saw giants up close and watched what happened next. I wanted Hagrid to tell me exactly how they met them and what went wrong.
memories.source_text: "So," said Harry, "you saw them and then what?"

memories.description: They gave the giant a piece of everlasting fire as a gift. That was supposed to make the giants trust them.
memories.source_text: "A branch of — ?"

memories.description: Karkus didn't speak English, so they had to get other giants to translate. Not everything went smoothly at first.
memories.source_text: "You’re kidding!"

memories.description: Hagrid nearly got killed by Golgomath but Olympe used fast spellwork to save him. They escaped because of quick magic, not brute force.
memories.source_text: "How did you get out of that?"

memories.description: I can see thestrals because I have seen death. That explains why some people can't see them.
memories.source_text: "The only people who can see thestrals," she said, "are people who have seen death."

memories.description: Thestrals aren't evil omens. They're animals, not harbingers of doom, and they only bite if you really annoy them.
memories.source_text: "Thestrals aren' dangerous!" said Hagrid.

memories.description: Umbridge is just there to interfere and boss people around. She treats Hagrid like he's stupid and is trying to control the lesson.
memories.source_text: "Please continue teaching as usual. I am going to walk"

memories.description: Dumbledore told me to stay put. I don't like being kept out of the loop but apparently I'm meant to wait and do nothing for now.
memories.source_text: I have a message for you from Albus Dumbledore." "Stay where you are."

memories.description: Okay, so Dumbledore cleared things up with Umbridge enough for other people. That makes me think he's handling the grown-up stuff, even if he won't explain it to me.
memories.source_text: You lot disappeared right under her nose, even though Dumbledore told her Mr. Weasley was in St. Mungo's, and he'd given you all permission to visit.

memories.description: That dream about being inside the snake felt different and awful. It wasn't just a vision. It felt like I was the snake itself.
memories.source_text: It was like I was the snake.

memories.description: Ginny says possession leaves you with big gaps. I can remember everything, so maybe I wasn't possessed like she was. That actually takes a weight off me.
memories.source_text: When he did it to me, I couldn't remember what I'd been doing for hours at a time.

memories.description: I needed to apologise to Ginny properly. She called me out and I meant it when I said sorry.
memories.source_text: I forgot," he said. "Lucky you," said Ginny coolly. "I'm sorry," Harry said, and he meant it.

memories.description: I'm fed up with adults telling me to wait without explaining. I feel angry and boxed in, and I don't trust being left out of decisions about things that involve me.
memories.source_text: Stay where you are.' 'I haven't moved!' said Harry, his hand still upon the doorknob.

memories.description: They're not just random troublemakers. Death Eaters were visiting the giants, bringing them gifts. This is organized. Voldemort's lot are working with some of the giants.
memories.source_text: Couple of 'em were visitin' him every day, bringin' gifts to the Gurg

memories.description: Umbridge is actively spying and reporting. We have to expect the Ministry to be watching us and act like everything we do could be used against Dumbledore and his allies.
memories.source_text: She'll be informing the Minister of your late return

memories.description: Hermione and Ron are my people to rely on in a crisis. We stick together, hide together and trust each other when things get ugly.
memories.source_text: Get under here!

memories.description: I saw a vision of Mr Weasley being attacked and if I hadn't acted he might have died. I was there and I helped, and that is why Arthur is alive.
memories.source_text: I don’t know what would have happened if it hadn’t been for you, Harry

memories.description: I told Dumbledore about the vision but he didn't explain what it meant. He didn't give me answers.
memories.source_text: When he paused for breath, Sirius said, "Did you tell Dumbledore this?"

memories.description: I don't think it was just aftereffects. For a moment I actually felt like a snake and wanted to attack Dumbledore. Something inside me felt like a snake and that scares me.
memories.source_text: It must have been the aftermath of the vision, that’s all

memories.description: Sirius stuck up for me and calmed me down. I can rely on him to be steady and protective when I'm rattled.
memories.source_text: You’re in shock, Harry; you’re blaming yourself for something you only witnessed, and it’s lucky you did witness it or Arthur might have died. Just stop worrying

memories.description: She thinks I prefer talking to Hermione over her. She’s hurt and thinks I’m excluding her, and that made her lash out at me. I didn’t mean it that way.
memories.source_text: “Oh, you’ll talk to Hermione Granger!” she said shrilly, her face now shining with tears

memories.description: There was no time for Cedric to say anything before he died. He didn’t get to tell anyone anything, not even Cho.
memories.source_text: “There — there wasn’t time for him to say anything.”

memories.description: Hagrid and I are both outsiders and both orphans. He’s feeling battered and alone and I can see how much that family stuff still hurts him, so I can’t just write him off.
memories.source_text: “In the same boat, you an’ me, aren’ we, Harry? ... An’ both orphans. Yeah ... both orphans.”

memories.description: That Umbridge is completely unbearable. She plays nice but she sneers at you the whole time and I can't stand her face.
memories.source_text: She held up ten stubby little fingers, then, her smile wider and more toadlike than ever before beneath her green hat, she bustled from their midst

memories.description: The D A is real and it's working. We can actually teach people practical spells and they're getting better. I feel proud and responsible for it.
memories.source_text: I thought this evening we should just go over the things we've done so far, because it's the last meeting before the holidays and there's no point starting anything new right before a three-week break

memories.description: Cho still makes me feel sick in the stomach and I keep noticing her. I'm trying not to make a fool of myself but it bothers me more than I want to admit.
memories.source_text: When he passed Cho she beamed at him; he resisted the temptation to walk past her several more times

memories.description: I am rattled and not sure who to tell. Part of me wants to keep whatever happened to myself because it feels too heavy to say out loud.
memories.source_text: Half of him wanted to tell Ron and Hermione what had just happened, but the other half wanted to take the secret with him to the grave

memories.description: Malfoy and his lot are vile and petty. They'll mock anything to get under your skin, even the nastiest stuff, so I should expect them to try to wind people up.
memories.source_text: D'you reckon if you saw someone snuff it you'd be able to see the Quaffle better? He, Crabbe, and Goyle roared with laughter as they pushed past

memories.description: Yeah. I kissed Cho. It happened and I felt sick about how it went.
memories.source_text: "She — er —" "Did you kiss?" asked Hermione briskly.

memories.description: The kiss was awful. She was crying into my shoulder so it was just... wet. Not like anything I'd imagined.
memories.source_text: "How was it?" Harry considered for a moment. "Wet," he said truthfully.

memories.description: I can't avoid seeing her. We're going to have to meet at D.A., so I'll have to face this again whether I want to or not.
memories.source_text: "I'll have to, won't I?" said Harry. "We've got D.A. meetings, haven't we?"

memories.description: I tried to be nice. I patted her on the back because I didn't know what else to do when she started sobbing.
memories.source_text: "I sort of — patted her on the back a bit."

memories.description: I've liked Cho for ages, but I always imagined a happier version of her. Seeing her like that makes me question whether I even want to ask her out now.
memories.source_text: "Harry's liked her for ages, haven't you, Harry?"

memories.description: I want help. I wish Sirius were here to tell me what to do about girls because I have no idea.
memories.source_text: "wishing more than anything that Sirius's head would appear there and give him some advice about girls."

memories.description: Okay, so this is the long-term ward for permanent spell damage. People here are seriously hurt and some of them might not get better.
memories.source_text: "This is our long-term resident ward," she informed Harry, Ron, Hermione, and Ginny in a low voice. "For permanent spell damage, you know."

memories.description: Lockhart's wandering about and signing photos like a loon because his memory's shot. He's not dangerous to others but he's a danger to himself.
memories.source_text: "He does seem to be getting back some sense of himself," and the description of Gilderoy signing photographs feverishly.

memories.description: Neville's parents were Aurors and were tortured into this state by Voldemort's people. That's why they're here.
memories.source_text: "My son and his wife were tortured into insanity by You-Know-Who's followers."

memories.description: Neville looks terrified and ashamed, but Mrs Longbottom says he talks about me. That means he does trust me even if he won't meet my eye.
memories.source_text: "Yes, I know who you are, of course. Neville speaks most highly of you."

memories.description: Neville's mum is here and she's a shadow of the woman in that old Order photo. It's awful to see what they've done to her.
memories.source_text: "She no longer had the plump, happy-looking face Harry had seen in Moody's old photograph of the original Order of the Phoenix."

memories.description: Someone got me with a Trip Jinx. I went flying and skidded along the floor. Brilliant.
memories.source_text: "Trip Jinx, Potter!" he said.

memories.description: Umbridge is gleeful about catching me. She actually looks pleased to have hauled me in. That makes everything worse.
memories.source_text: "It’s him!" she said jubilantly at the sight of Harry on the floor.

memories.description: Umbridge is taking me straight to Dumbledore. She grabbed my arm like I was a criminal and expects me to come along. Malfoy helped her and got rewarded with points.
memories.source_text: "You can come with me to the headmaster’s office, Potter."

memories.description: That date was a complete fiasco. I told Cho the truth and it blew up in my face.
memories.source_text: "It was a complete fiasco, now you mention it."

memories.description: People need to know how dangerous Voldemort is. I have to tell them, even if they think I'm mad.
memories.source_text: "people have got to know what Voldemort's capable of, haven't they?"

memories.description: Cho and I are messed up right now. I do like her but whatever happened at that tea shop has put a wall between us.
memories.source_text: "I mean, what was all that about? What was going on?"

memories.description: My interview is out in The Quibbler and people are writing to me about it. It's public now and I can't take it back.
memories.source_text: "HARRY POTTER SPEAKS OUT AT LAST: THE TRUTH ABOUT HE-WHO-MUST-NOT-BE-NAMED AND THE NIGHT I SAW HIM RETURN"

memories.description: Umbridge is furious about the interview. She will use it as an excuse to punish me and restrict me at school.
memories.source_text: "There will be no more Hogsmeade trips for you, Mr. Potter,"

memories.description: Your dad has been attacked. I saw him get bitten and there was blood everywhere.
memories.source_text: [Your dad's . . . been attacked . . .]

memories.description: It wasn't just a dream. I was there and I did it. I actually saw it happen.
memories.source_text: [No! It wasn’t a dream . . . not an ordinary dream. . . . I was there, I saw it. . . . I did it . . .]

memories.description: This is serious. He was bitten and bleeding badly.
memories.source_text: [He’s been bitten, it’s serious, there was blood everywhere . . .]

memories.description: There was a huge snake involved. That’s what attacked him.
memories.source_text: [it was a huge snake . . .]

memories.description: I kept insisting I'm fine even though I’m sweating, shaking and my head hurts like mad.
memories.source_text: [I’m fine!]

memories.description: I had to tell Ron right away that his dad was the one in danger and we had to find him now.
memories.source_text: [There’s nothing wrong with me, it’s your dad you’ve got to worry about — we need to find out where he is — he’s bleeding like mad — I was — it was a huge snake . . .]

memories.description: Dumbledore's made me take Occlumency lessons with Snape to stop those dreams about You-Know-Who
memories.source_text: "Dumbledore wants to stop you having those dreams about Voldemort," said Hermione at once.

memories.description: Snape thinks if I can't control my emotions I'll be easy meat for Voldemort and he keeps pushing me to 'master myself'
memories.source_text: "You will find yourself easy prey for the Dark Lord!" said Snape savagely.

memories.description: That door I saw is the same one Arthur was guarding at the Ministry so whatever Voldemort wants is probably behind it
memories.source_text: "I saw that door when your dad took me down to the courtrooms for my hearing and it's definitely the same one he was guarding when the snake bit him."

memories.description: Of course the thing Voldemort's after is in the Department of Mysteries
memories.source_text: "In the Department of Mysteries, it's got to be," Harry whispered.

memories.description: Sirius trusts me enough to give me something to contact him if I need him but I will not be the one to lure him out of Grimmauld Place
memories.source_text: "I want you to take this," he said quietly, thrusting a badly wrapped package roughly the size of a paperback book into Harry's hands.

memories.description: Snape expects me to block him with my mind not my wand and thinks I keep handing him the memories I fear
memories.source_text: "You must remain focused. Repel me with your brain and you will not need to resort to your wand."

memories.description: I can't just switch off my feelings on command and Snape's methods are making me furious and shaky
memories.source_text: "I told you to empty yourself of emotion!"

memories.description: Right away I made the connection to those Death Eater scar things. It sounded horrible but Hermione's idea to use metal coins instead of people makes sense. I liked that better.
memories.source_text: "You know what these remind me of?" "No, what’s that?" "The Death Eaters’ scars. Voldemort touches one of them, and all their scars burn, and they know they’ve got to join him."

memories.description: Those fake Galleons are clever and quiet. I slipped mine in my pocket and felt safer knowing they change by charm when Hermione sets the date.
memories.source_text: "I suppose the only danger with these is that we might accidentally spend them." "Fat chance," said Ron, who was examining his own fake Galleon with a slightly mournful air. "I haven’t got any real Galleons to confuse it with."

memories.description: Hearing them sing that at Ron actually made me angry. I wanted to ignore it but I ended up diving straight for Ron to try and help. I will not stand by while they hound him.
memories.source_text: "Weasley cannot save a thing, He cannot block a single ring, That’s why Slytherins all sing: Weasley is our King."

memories.description: There it was. I spotted the Snitch. Game on. Find it and end this.
memories.source_text: "But Harry had seen it at last: The tiny fluttering Golden Snitch was hovering feet from the ground at the Slytherin end of the pitch."

memories.description: When I stick up for Ron with a jab like that it actually cracks the Slytherins up and makes Pansy shut up for a moment. I know I can get under their skin as well as they get under ours.
memories.source_text: "Warrington’s aim’s so pathetic I’d be more worried if he was aiming for the person next to me," he retorted, which made Ron and Hermione laugh and wiped the smirk off Pansy Parkinson’s face.

memories.description: I don’t want to go over how Cedric died. Don’t expect me to describe it. I’m done being paraded and poked about it.
memories.source_text: I don’t want to talk about Cedric Diggory, all right? So if that’s what you’re here for, you might as well clear out.

memories.description: Yes, I can conjure a Patronus, a stag. It’s real and it’s mine.
memories.source_text: Is it true that you can produce a Patronus? ... Yeah, ... A corporeal Patronus? ... She’s my auntie ... I’m Susan Bones. ... So — is it really true? You make a stag Patronus? ... Yes ...

memories.description: I did kill the basilisk with that sword in Dumbledore’s office. That happened, and it’s not something I brag about.
memories.source_text: And did you kill a basilisk with that sword in Dumbledore’s office? ... Er — yeah, I did, yeah

memories.description: Look, I had help with a lot of the dangerous stuff last year. Some of it I did on my own, but most of it involved others. I don’t want people thinking I did it all alone.
memories.source_text: I . . . I don’t want to sound like I’m trying to be modest or anything, but . . . I had a lot of help with all that stuff . . .

memories.description: Hermione’s gone and shown me off, and now everyone’s treating me like a curiosity. I’m angry about that.
memories.source_text: She had decided to display him like some sort of freak and of course they had all turned up to see just how wild his story was.

memories.description: I turned into You-Know-Who in that vision. I actually was him for a bit and then snapped back with my scar burning.
memories.source_text: “I was You-Know-Who,”

memories.description: Bode couldn’t have removed the thing because of something on the weapon or around it that stops people meddling with it.
memories.source_text: “Bode could never have taken it, Master. . . . Bode would have known he could not.”

memories.description: Rookwood is one of the Death Eaters and he’s involved in whatever went wrong with Bode and the weapon.
memories.source_text: “He was with Rookwood, he’s one of the Death Eaters who escaped from Azkaban, remember?”

memories.description: I’m not going to blurt this out. They want me to learn Occlumency to stop this, and if I tell everyone I’ll just prove their point.
memories.source_text: “I haven’t got to tell anyone,”

memories.description: If I could do Occlumency properly I wouldn’t be getting these visions shoved into my head.
memories.source_text: “I wouldn’t have seen it at all if I could do Occlumency.”

memories.description: When I’m confronting someone tied to Voldemort I get cold and dangerous; I can be cruel and commanding when I need answers.
memories.source_text: Harry's anger and cold voice toward Rookwood scene

memories.description: I shook Firenze's hand. He's not smiling, but he spoke to me like he expected we'd meet again.
memories.source_text: "Harry Potter," he said, holding out a hand when Harry entered.

memories.description: So he thinks our meeting was meant to happen. That's a bit creepy but I can't deny it's awkwardly true.
memories.source_text: "It was foretold that we would meet again."

memories.description: Firenze's got a hoof-shaped bruise on his chest. Someone's been rough with him.
memories.source_text: "Harry noticed that there was the shadow of a hoof-shaped bruise on Firenze's chest."

memories.description: I reckon Bane or one of the herd might've done it. It makes sense given how they treated Firenze before.
memories.source_text: "He wondered whether it had been Bane who had kicked Firenze in the chest."

memories.description: I lay back and a red star winked at me on the ceiling. Weird, but I'm watching what the stars say.
memories.source_text: "A twinkling red star winked at him from overhead."

memories.description: I asked how Trelawney was because I care if she's all right after being sacked.
memories.source_text: "How is she?" asked Harry.

memories.description: So I'm being told to learn Occlumency. Fine. I need to protect my mind so people cannot get into it.
memories.source_text: "Occlumency, Potter. The magical defense of the mind against external penetration."

memories.description: Snape is the one who will be teaching me. Great, extra lessons with him. Lovely.
memories.source_text: "I am in rather a hurry, Black . . . unlike you, I do not have unlimited leisure time . . ."

memories.description: Dumbledore wants this kept secret from Umbridge. I am not to tell anyone about the lessons.
memories.source_text: "You will receive private lessons once a week, but you will not tell anybody what you are doing, least of all Dolores Umbridge."

memories.description: Sirius and Lupin actually want me to learn this. They still back me, even if I hate that Snape will teach it.
memories.source_text: "And listen . . . Harry, I know you don’t like Snape, but he is a superb Occlumens and we all — Sirius included — want you to learn to protect yourself, so work hard, all right?"

memories.description: I thought Sirius would always just defend me without thinking. He does care, but he can be fierce about Snape too. I need to stay out of their fights.
memories.source_text: "I’ll get to the point, then," said Sirius, standing up.

memories.description: Once I'm inside Hogwarts grounds I should be safer. For now, I still feel exposed and nervous about the lessons to come.
memories.source_text: "You’ll be safe once you’re in the grounds," said Tonks, casting a careful eye around at the deserted road.

memories.description: Ten high-security prisoners have escaped from Azkaban and the Ministry is saying Sirius Black is the rallying point. That's why Fudge is making such a fuss.
memories.source_text: MASS BREAKOUT FROM AZKABAN MINISTRY FEARS BLACK IS RALLYING POINT FOR OLD DEATH EATERS

memories.description: Bellatrix Lestrange is one of the escapees and she was involved in torturing the Longbottoms. She's dangerous and tied to Black.
memories.source_text: Bellatrix Lestrange, convicted of the torture and permanent incapacitation of Frank and Alice Longbottom.

memories.description: Someone at the Ministry, Broderick Bode, was killed by a plant sent to St. Mungo's. That means Death Eaters or whoever's behind this are willing to use clever, hidden attacks.
memories.source_text: TRAGIC DEMISE OF MINISTRY OF MAGIC WORKER ... strangled by a potted-plant.

memories.description: I met Bode in the Department of Mysteries with Mr Weasley. This connects people I know to the attack and makes it real for me.
memories.source_text: “I met Bode,” he said slowly. “I saw him at the Ministry with your dad . . .”

memories.description: People at Hogwarts are starting to doubt the Prophet and some are thinking Dumbledore and I might have been right all along. The mood has shifted from pure hostility to curiosity.
memories.source_text: They sounded curious rather than hostile now, and once or twice he was sure he overheard snatches of conversation that suggested that the speakers were not satisfied with the Prophet’s version

memories.description: Heard every word I said in the Hog's Head and ran straight to Umbridge. So Willy Widdershins really did hear me and told on me.
memories.source_text: “He heard every word Potter said and hastened straight to the school to report to me —”

memories.description: Dumbledore says I wasn't breaking any rules at that first meeting. The ban came in two days later. That means the Hogsmeade meeting itself wasn't illegal.
memories.source_text: “If you remember, the Ministry decree banning all student societies was not put into effect until two days after Harry’s Hogsmeade meeting, so he was not breaking any rules in the Hog’s Head at all.”

memories.description: Umbridge tried to force Marietta to confirm the meetings by making her nod or shake her head. She was trying to make Marietta give evidence.
memories.source_text: “Just nod or shake your head, dear,” Umbridge said coaxingly to Marietta.

memories.description: Marietta handed Umbridge the list from the Room of Requirement. She betrayed us and gave them the names.
memories.source_text: “And to Harry’s horror, she withdrew from her pocket the list of names that had been pinned upon the Room of Requirement’s wall and handed it to Fudge.”

memories.description: They found the heading on the parchment. We've been named 'Dumbledore's Army' and they know it now. That's a proper disaster.
memories.source_text: “See what they’ve named themselves?” said Fudge quietly. “Dumbledore’s Army.”

memories.description: Marietta, who I thought was a friend or at least just a classmate, tipped off Umbridge. I feel betrayed and furious with her.
memories.source_text: “Miss Edgecombe tipped me off and I proceeded at once to the seventh floor, accompanied by certain trustworthy students, so as to catch those in the meeting red-handed.”

memories.description: Something unseen passed by Kingsley and I felt a brush like wings. I think there was some quiet magic or a protective thing going on that we couldn't see.
memories.source_text: “I could have sworn too that he felt something brush against his side, a gentle something like a draft or bird wings, but looking down he saw nothing there.”

memories.description: I have to study Occlumency properly. I need to do exactly what Snape says and practise every night so I can close my mind against bad dreams and whatever else tries to get in.
memories.source_text: "Listen to me, Harry, you must study Occlumency as hard as you can, do you understand me? Do everything Professor Snape tells you and practice it particularly every night before sleeping so that you can close your mind to bad dreams"

memories.description: Close my mind. That's the bit that matters in the moment. Shut it right up when I sleep and when people probe me.
memories.source_text: "Remember — close your mind —"

memories.description: Dumbledore isn't running away to hide me. He means to fight this in plain sight, and I can't expect to be quietly saved by him forever.
memories.source_text: "I am not leaving to go into hiding. Fudge will soon wish he�d never dislodged me from Hogwarts, I promise you"

memories.description: When Dumbledore touched me my scar screamed and I wanted to lash out at him. I hate that the scar can do that to me. It makes me dangerous and terrified at the same time.
memories.source_text: "As Dumbledore's fingers closed over Harry's skin, a pain shot through the scar on his forehead, and he felt again that terrible, snakelike longing to strike Dumbledore, to bite him, to hurt him"

memories.description: If someone ratted us out I could be finished at Hogwarts. Brilliant. That's exactly what I was terrified might happen.
memories.source_text: "If somebody had tipped off Umbridge about the D.A. then he, the leader, might as well be packing his trunk right now."

memories.description: Marietta betrayed us and got her face hexed to spell SNEAK. She told Umbridge and that's how they found out.
memories.source_text: "Marietta raised her head... her face was horribly disfigured by a series of close-set purple pustules that had spread across her nose and cheeks to form the word 'SNEAK.'"

memories.description: Willy Widdershins claims he heard me recruiting in the Hog's Head and reported it. That's the evidence they're using against me.
memories.source_text: "I have testimony from Willy Widdershins, Minerva, who happened to be in the bar at the time. He... heard every word Potter said and hastened straight to the school to report to me —"

memories.description: Dumbledore's backing me. He keeps signalling I'm not to panic. He's quietly protecting me here, and that's a huge relief.
memories.source_text: "There’s nothing like a good witness, is there, Dumbledore?" "Nothing at all, Cornelius," said Dumbledore gravely, inclining his head.

memories.description: Okay, so the first meeting wasn't illegal because the decree came later. That means I'm not automatically guilty for that Hogsmeade meeting.
memories.source_text: "I do not deny — and nor, I am sure, does Harry — that he was in the Hog’s Head that day... the Ministry decree banning all student societies was not put into effect until two days after Harry’s Hogsmeade meeting, so he was not breaking any rules in the Hog’s Head at all."

memories.description: Fudge is treating Marietta like a hero for snitching. The Minister's decided to use any witness to crush us, and he's delighted someone tattled.
memories.source_text: "Well, now," said Fudge... "It is very brave of you, my dear, coming to tell Professor Umbridge, you did exactly the right thing."

memories.description: They tried to trap me into admitting I knew I broke rules. I kept my head and denied knowing anything so they couldn't pin it on me.
memories.source_text: "You are not aware that you have broken any school rules?" "School rules?" said Harry. "No."

memories.description: Dumbledore is gone. He's dead. I can't believe it
memories.source_text: "I’m afraid this is the end of your friend Dumbledore."

memories.description: Fudge doesn't care about us. He's dismissive and bossy, more worried about appearances than what's happened here
memories.source_text: "You'd better get those two off to bed," said Fudge, looking back at Professor McGonagall with a dismissive nod toward Harry and Marietta.

memories.description: I keep having to tell people I will let them know about D.A. meetings because I can't do one tonight since I've got Remedial Potions.
memories.source_text: "I'll let you know when the next one is,"

memories.description: Cho asked me to go into Hogsmeade on Valentine's Day and I said yes, so that's actually a date now.
memories.source_text: "Er d'you want to come into Hogsmeade with me on Valentine's Day?"

memories.description: Dumbledore thinks I need to learn Occlumency so I can stop sharing thoughts and feelings with the Dark Lord.
memories.source_text: "And why does Professor Dumbledore think I need it, sir?"

memories.description: Legilimency is basically getting into someone else's head and pulling out their memories and feelings, like mind reading but worse.
memories.source_text: "It is the ability to extract feelings and memories from another person’s mind"

memories.description: That curse made some sort of link between me and Voldemort, which is why I can sometimes feel or see what he's feeling or seeing.
memories.source_text: "The curse that failed to kill you seems to have forged some kind of connection between you and the Dark Lord."

memories.description: If the Dark Lord can get into my head then he could try to make me do things, and that actually scares me.
memories.source_text: "And he might try and make me do things?"

memories.description: I'm Hagrid's friend. If Firenze says Hagrid's attempt isn't working, I have to warn him.
memories.source_text: "Harry Potter, you are a friend of Hagrid’s, are you not?"

memories.description: Firenze thinks whatever Hagrid's trying won't work and that Hagrid should give it up.
memories.source_text: "His attempt is not working. He would do better to abandon it."

memories.description: Centaurs read the sky very differently; they reckon war might be coming again and take ages to be sure.
memories.source_text: "Mars, bringer of battle, shines brightly above us, suggesting that the fight must break out again soon."

memories.description: Centaurs study the heavens for generations and think they can glimpse big changes from the stars.
memories.source_text: "Centaurs have unraveled the mysteries of these movements over centuries."

memories.description: Firenze thinks Trelawney is mostly blind to real patterns and wastes time on human fortune-telling, though he won't rule out a true Seeing.
memories.source_text: "Sybill Trelawney may have Seen, I do not know,"

memories.description: So it was never my 'army' at all. Dumbledore set this up and he even has a list of names. That's why they're calling it Dumbledore's Army.
memories.source_text: "Dumbledore's Army, Cornelius," said Dumbledore, still smiling as he waved the list of names before Fudge's face.

memories.description: McGonagall and Kingsley are clearly scared. If they've got fear on their faces in front of Dumbledore, things are serious and I'm not the only one worried.
memories.source_text: "There was fear in both faces."

memories.description: Dumbledore is openly admitting he organized opposition to Fudge. He's not hiding it and he isn't ashamed of it either.
memories.source_text: "You have been plotting against me!" he yelled. "That's right," said Dumbledore cheerfully.

memories.description: I tried to stop Dumbledore because I could see what he was about to do. I wasn't going to just let him hand this to Fudge without a fight.
memories.source_text: "NO!" shouted Harry. Kingsley flashed a look of warning at him, McGonagall widened her eyes threateningly, but it had suddenly dawned upon Harry what Dumbledore was about to do, and he could not let it happen.

memories.description: Percy is all over this. He's taken down Dumbledore's 'confession' and he's thrilled to be part of it. He'll run with it to the Ministry and the papers.
memories.source_text: "Weasley, have you written it all down, everything he's said, his confession, have you got it?" "Yes, sir, I think so, sir!" said Percy eagerly, whose nose was splattered with ink from the speed of his note-taking.

memories.description: Fudge is already planning to make a public show of this. He's going to feed it straight to the Prophet and celebrate having 'proof' against Dumbledore.
memories.source_text: "Duplicate your notes, Weasley, and send a copy to the Daily Prophet at once. If we send a fast owl we should make the morning edition!"

memories.description: Dobby warned me. Dobby risked everything to tell me Umbridge is involved and that she knows enough to be dangerous. I have to act now.
memories.source_text: Harry Potter, sir . . . Dobby has come to warn you . . .
