memories.description: We cannot hang about. If Dobby is terrified then whatever's coming is serious. I shouted for everyone to get out and stop arguing.
memories.source_text: WHAT ARE YOU WAITING FOR? RUN!

memories.description: I ordered Dobby to go back to the kitchen and to lie if Umbridge questions him. I will not let him hurt himself and I will protect the others by getting them away.
memories.source_text: get back down to the kitchen with the other elves, and if she asks you whether you warned me, lie and say no!

memories.description: Dobby trusts me. He risked everything to warn me and he is grateful. That means I have to look out for him.
memories.source_text: Thank you, Harry Potter!

memories.description: I saw Sturgis that day in the Department of Mysteries corridor. Your dad thought he was sneaking about my hearing
memories.source_text: "He was in the Department of Mysteries corridor that day! Your dad said he was probably trying to sneak down and find out what happened in my hearing"

memories.description: It makes sense that Sturgis might have been used to try to steal that weapon. If someone put the Imperius on him he could have been made to go after it
memories.source_text: "So when Sturgis next had an opportunity ... he tried to get into the department to steal the weapon for Voldemort"

memories.description: Rookwood knows the Department of Mysteries and could be used to get at the weapon
memories.source_text: "Rookwood used to work there. . . . Maybe Voldemort'll send Rookwood to do it?"

memories.description: I'm supposed to be learning Occlumency so I can close my mind to these visions
memories.source_text: "You do know why we are here, don't you, Potter?" "So I can learn Occlumency"

memories.description: I managed to use a Shield Charm against Snape's attack and it actually worked. The shield bought me a moment but I still broke into memories that weren't mine
memories.source_text: "Protego!" and the following scene where Snape staggered and memories flooded my head

memories.description: I snapped at Snape and he admitted it's his job to go into the Dark Lord's thoughts. That made things worse between us
memories.source_text: "No — that's your job, isn't it?"

memories.description: I asked Snape why he calls him the Dark Lord because I only heard Death Eaters use that name
memories.source_text: "Why do you call Voldemort the Dark Lord, I've only ever heard Death Eaters call him that"

memories.description: I watched my dad as a teenager in the Pensieve and he wasn't the hero I imagined at fifteen. He bullied Snape and showed off a lot.
memories.source_text: "I just wanted to talk . . . about my dad . . ."

memories.description: Okay, fine, he was young and stupid. I can't judge James only by that memory. People can grow out of being idiots.
memories.source_text: "I wouldn't like you to judge your father on what you saw there, Harry. He was only fifteen —"

memories.description: I feel a bit sorry for Snape now. Seeing how James and the others treated him changed how I see Snape and my dad.
memories.source_text: "I think James was everything Snape wanted to be — he was popular, he was good at Quidditch, good at pretty much everything."

memories.description: Snape has stopped my Occlumency lessons. That matters because I need to learn it and Dumbledore thinks it's vital.
memories.source_text: "He told me he'd never teach me Occlumency again"

memories.description: So there is an Inquisitorial Squad now and they have the power to dock points. Fine, more official nastiness to watch out for.
memories.source_text: "But members of the Inquisitorial Squad —"

memories.description: Malfoy will use that I badge to bully us and actually take points off Gryffindor. I can't just stand there and let him get away with it.
memories.source_text: "Malfoy just docked us all about fifty points," said Harry furiously

memories.description: Fred and George are planning something in the Great Hall at lunch. They're not scared of getting in trouble anymore, and they want us around as cover.
memories.source_text: "Phase one is about to begin. Id get in the Great Hall for lunch if I were you," said George.

memories.description: Umbridge is already watching me. Filch is being used to send me to her, which means I need to be ready for interrogation or worse.
memories.source_text: "The headmistress would like to see you, Potter," he leered.

memories.description: Filch has long been on Dumbledore for being soft and he hates us. He’s been primed to be vicious if given power.
memories.source_text: "I’ve been telling Dumbledore for years and years he’s too soft with you all," said Filch, chuckling nastily.

memories.description: Umbridge is pushing rules that let people like Filch brutalize students. Things at school are about to get a lot harsher.
memories.source_text: "But when Educational Decree Twenty-nine comes in, Potter, I’ll be allowed to do them things."

memories.description: Umbridge has already asked the Minister to get rid of Peeves. She’s working the system and making Hogwarts quieter for her own sake.
memories.source_text: "And she’s asked the Minister to sign an order for the expulsion of Peeves."

memories.description: Filch is clearly in Umbridge’s pocket and is being used to report on students. He’ll help her because he’s eager to prove himself.
memories.source_text: "Here we are," he said, leering down at Harry as he rapped three times upon Professor Umbridge’s door and pushed it open. "The Potter boy to see you, ma’am."

memories.description: Umbridge pretends to be sweet but everything she does is a performance to unsettle me. She used a drink to try and make me relax and talk.
memories.source_text: "What would you like to drink?" "To drink, Mr. Potter," she said, smiling still more widely. "Tea? Coffee? Pumpkin juice?"

memories.description: Umbridge is directly accusing me of knowing where Dumbledore is and trying to force me to tell her. She’s not above threatening tactics.
memories.source_text: "Where is Albus Dumbledore?"

memories.description: She thinks I’m meeting Sirius and is trying to bully me into giving him up. She’ll use whatever she can to find out.
memories.source_text: "In that case, you will kindly tell me the whereabouts of Sirius Black."

memories.description: Umbridge has the Floo Network monitored and is watching all communication into and out of Hogwarts. There are almost no private ways to contact people anymore.
memories.source_text: "All channels of communication in and out of this school are being monitored. A Floo Network Regulator is keeping watch over every fire in Hogwarts — except my own, of course."

memories.description: Seeing that painted kitten with a magical eye made me think straight away that drinking anything offered by an enemy is dangerous. I won’t be gullible about traps like that.
memories.source_text: "One of the horrible painted kittens behind Umbridge had great round blue eyes just like Mad-Eye Moody’s magical one,"

memories.description: I'm not the weapon after all. I'm actually human and not just some tool for Voldemort.
memories.source_text: "I’m not the weapon after all, thought Harry."

memories.description: You can’t Apparate or Disapparate inside Hogwarts. Even Voldemort couldn't just teleport me out of my dormitory.
memories.source_text: "Even Voldemort couldn’t just make you fly out of your dormitory, Harry."

memories.description: House-elves can leave if given clothes or in extreme situations. Dobby left the Malfoys to warn me once.
memories.source_text: "Dobby did, he left the Malfoys’ to give me warnings three years ago."

memories.description: House-elves are supposed to be bound to a house, but they can defy that if they choose, as Dobby did.
memories.source_text: "They can leave the house if they really want to," Harry contradicted him. "Dobby did, he left the Malfoys’ to give me warnings three years ago. He had to punish himself afterward, but he still managed it."

memories.description: Practical Defensive Magic is exactly the sort of book I need for the D.A. It's got useful counterjinxes and proper illustrations.
memories.source_text: "Sirius and Lupin had given Harry a set of excellent books entitled Practical Defensive Magic and Its Use Against the Dark Arts"

memories.description: I felt close to Sirius and the others. When they comfort me, I actually want to join in and be part of it.
memories.source_text: "He felt like joining in as they heard Sirius tramping past their door toward Buckbeak’s room, singing 'God Rest Ye Merry, Hippogriffs' at the top of his voice."

memories.description: Kreacher really favors Bellatrix Lestrange. He keeps her photograph front and center among the family pictures.
memories.source_text: "By the looks of it, hers was Kreacher’s favorite photograph; he had placed it to the fore of all the others and had mended the glass clumsily with Spellotape."

memories.description: Kreacher saved bits and pieces from the house when Sirius tried to purge it. He’s magpie-like about things he can salvage.
memories.source_text: "He had also managed to retrieve the silver-framed family photographs that Sirius had thrown away over the summer."

memories.description: Fred and George can Apparate into the house. They popped into my room with a crack and a grin.
memories.source_text: "Fred and George Apparated at the foot of his bed."

memories.description: Kreacher went into hiding after being shouted at. He might be somewhere upstairs, avoiding people.
memories.source_text: "You were ordering him out of the kitchen." "Yeah . . . You know, I think that’s the last time I saw him, too. . . . He must be hiding upstairs somewhere . . ."

memories.description: Mrs. Weasley absolutely loses it when she thinks someone has been sewing their own wounds. Dad trying Muggle remedies is a bad idea in her book.
memories.source_text: "Mrs. Weasley shriek, 'WHAT DO YOU MEAN, THAT’S THE GENERAL IDEA?'"

memories.description: Mr. Weasley loved practical Muggle things like fuse-wire and screwdrivers. Give him tools and he's thrilled.
memories.source_text: "Because he had just opened Harry’s gift of fuse-wire and screwdrivers."

memories.description: Lockhart's memory is a mess. He doesn't seem to remember teaching us properly anymore.
memories.source_text: "Professor Lockhart!" ... "Haven't we met?" "Er . . . yeah, we have," said Harry. "You used to teach us at Hogwarts, remember?" "Teach?" repeated Lockhart, looking faintly unsettled."

memories.description: Snape says I can keep doing Occlumency on my own now that I've got the basics, so I stopped the lessons.
memories.source_text: "I’ve told you, Snape reckons I can carry on by myself now I’ve got the basics . . ."

memories.description: I used to be sure my parents were wonderful, but the Pensieve memories have made me doubt James. I can see things Snape said might have been true, and that messes me up.
memories.source_text: "He had been so sure that his parents had been wonderful people that he never had the slightest difficulty in disbelieving Snape’s aspersions on his father’s character."

memories.description: I want to talk to Sirius desperately, but with Umbridge watching the fires and reading mail I think I can't reach him.
memories.source_text: "I wish I could talk to Sirius," he muttered. "But I know I can’t."

memories.description: I got an Easter egg from Mum in a package that had been inspected by Umbridge's lot, which made me feel strangely upset for some reason.
memories.source_text: "It’s Easter eggs from Mum," said Ginny. "There’s one for you. . . ."

memories.description: I'm thinking about becoming an Auror, but McGonagall made it clear they want top grades and I’m only averaging Acceptable right now.
memories.source_text: "Well, I thought of, maybe, being an Auror," Harry mumbled.

memories.description: If I want to be an Auror I should take Defense Against the Dark Arts, Transfiguration, Charms and Potions for N.E.W.T.s and work hard to raise my marks.
memories.source_text: "I would also advise Transfiguration ... then you ought to do Charms, always useful, and Potions."

memories.description: What the hell. Umbridge is telling everyone I have a criminal record. That is not going to help my chances with the Ministry.
memories.source_text: "Potter has a criminal record," said Umbridge loudly.

memories.description: Minerva stands up for me. She actually promises to help me become an Auror if she has to coach me every night. I can count on her to fight for me.
memories.source_text: "Potter has been cleared of all charges," said Professor McGonagall, even more loudly.

memories.description: If the Ministry is set against me then I have to decide for myself what I want. I cannot rely on them to make it easy.
memories.source_text: "The Minister of Magic will never employ Harry Potter!" said Umbridge, her voice rising furiously.

memories.description: Minerva will train me hard. I need to get my grades up and be ready for more exams after Hogwarts.
memories.source_text: "I will assist you to become an Auror if it is the last thing I do! If I have to coach you nightly I will make sure you achieve the required results!"

memories.description: My Defense scores are good when someone competent teaches me. That matters.
memories.source_text: "He has achieved high marks in all Defense Against the Dark Arts tests set by a competent teacher."

memories.description: I took Sirius's knife, put the Invisibility Cloak on and nicked Umbridge's Floo powder. I will go where I need to go to find out what is happening.
memories.source_text: He pulled off his Cloak and, striding over to the fireplace, found what he was looking for within seconds: a small box containing glittering Floo powder.

memories.description: Hermione is terrified I'm doing something reckless. I feel guilty about worrying her but I'm going anyway. I have to see what's going on.
memories.source_text: "Harry, don’t do it, please don’t do it!" Hermione said in anguished tones as the bell rang at the end of the class.

memories.description: Grawp is massive. He is huge, clumsy and unpredictable, and getting close to him makes the ground shake.
memories.source_text: "He was, as Hagrid had said, at least sixteen feet tall."

memories.description: Grawp can lash out suddenly. He nearly grabbed Hermione and Hagrid got hurt when he swung at him.
memories.source_text: "BAD BOY, GRAWPY!"

memories.description: The centaurs don’t want humans in the forest. They’re hostile and quick to assert control over who comes in.
memories.source_text: "I thought that we told you, Hagrid," said a deep male voice, "that you are no longer welcome here?"

memories.description: I’m clearer now that things have gone wrong between Firenze and the centaurs. They see him as a traitor and that changes how the centaurs treat anyone associated with him.
memories.source_text: "Firenze has entered into servitude to humans," said a gray centaur with a hard, deeply lined face.

memories.description: My presence in the forest isn’t safe. The centaurs don’t recognize me and make it plain they don’t welcome humans here.
memories.source_text: "We agreed, I think, what we would do if this human showed his face in the forest again?"

memories.description: Voldemort has Sirius and I saw it. He's torturing him and says he'll kill him.
memories.source_text: "Voldemort's got Sirius."

memories.description: McGonagall is out of Hogwarts and in St. Mungo's, so there is no one left here from the Order to tell.
memories.source_text: "They've taken McGonagall to St. Mungo's this morning."

memories.description: The Department of Mysteries has that room with glass spheres and I know exactly where Voldemort is trying to get to.
memories.source_text: "There's a room in the Department of Mysteries full of shelves covered in these little glass balls, and they're at the end of row ninety-seven."

memories.description: I expect Ron and Hermione to come with me or I'm going regardless. I'm desperate and I'm going to try to save Sirius.
memories.source_text: "If you don't want to do it, fine, but I'm going, understand?"

memories.description: Hagrid is hurt and looking terrible. I can tell he has been attacked and he needs help right now.
memories.source_text: “Hagrid’s nose was gently dripping blood. His eyes were both blackened.”

memories.description: Umbridge is out to get Hagrid and she is looking for any excuse to get him fired.
memories.source_text: “Umbridge reckons it was me that put tha’ niffler in her office.”

memories.description: Hagrid thinks he is going to be sacked soon and he is worried about what will happen to Grawp if he is forced to leave.
memories.source_text: “Well, there’s a good chance I’m goin’ ter be gettin’ the sack any day now.”

memories.description: Grawp has been injuring Hagrid because he does not know his own strength. He is dangerous sometimes but not malicious.
memories.source_text: “He’s been hurting you all this time, hasn’t he?” and “He don’ know his own strength!”

memories.description: Grawp is Hagrid’s half brother. That explains why Hagrid is determined to bring him back and keep him safe.
memories.source_text: “He’s my brother!” and “Well — half-brother.”

memories.description: I promised Hagrid we would try to help Grawp. I had no idea exactly what that would mean, but I promised and I mean to keep it.
memories.source_text: “If yeh could jus’ nip down here in yer Invisibility Cloak maybe once a week an’ have a little chat with him.”

memories.description: Grawp is kept tied up with huge ropes. He is not free to wander because he could be a danger if he gets angry.
memories.source_text: “There’s ropes thick as saplings stretching from around the trunks of the largest nearby trees toward the place where Grawp lay curled on the ground.”

memories.description: Snape's lessons are making my scar worse and I'm getting more sensitive to Voldemort because of them. It's making me feel sick and wired all the time.
memories.source_text: "It's lessons with Snape that are making it worse," said Harry flatly.

memories.description: I'm putting in the hours at Occlumency but it's not getting better. I can't just switch it off even when I'm trying.
memories.source_text: "I am working!" said Harry, nettled.

memories.description: Hagrid thinks Umbridge catching us with him would ruin everything for him and for us. So visiting him after dark is too dangerous.
memories.source_text: "If she catches yeh, it’ll be all of our necks on the line," he told them flatly.

memories.description: I'm fed up with the dreams about the Department of Mysteries and the constant pain in my scar. It's like being tuned to Voldemort and I hate it.
memories.source_text: "I'm getting sick of my scar hurting, and I'm getting bored walking down that corridor every night."

memories.description: I really miss Quidditch. Watching Ron and Ginny on the stands reminded me how much being kept out of it hurts.
memories.source_text: "Yeah, I do," sighed Harry. "I do."

memories.description: She thinks she's untouchable because of her Ministry job. I know she will act like she's important and dangerous, and I don't trust her for a second.
memories.source_text: "The Ministry places a rather higher value on my life than yours, I'm afraid."

memories.description: My scar throbs when Voldemort is near. If it went white-hot I'd know he's about to strike. Right now it's warning me and making me tense.
memories.source_text: "His scar was throbbing in the soft evening air but it had not yet burned white-hot, as he knew it would if Voldemort had moved in for the kill."

memories.description: Going into the forest without wands is stupid and risky. Umbridge refuses to give hers, which makes being unarmed even worse.
memories.source_text: "Can we have your wand, then, if we're going first?" "No, I don't think so, Mr. Potter," said Umbridge sweetly, poking him in the back with it.

memories.description: When Umbridge loses her wand and it gets broken I wanted to grab it and stop her causing more trouble. I felt helpless and furious watching the centaurs handle her.
memories.source_text: "Her wand fell from her hand to the ground and Harry's heart leapt, if he could just reach it — But as he stretched out a hand toward it, a centaur's hoof descended upon the wand and it broke cleanly in half."

memories.description: The centaurs don't just attack randomly. They can seize us and drag us around. I need to be ready for them to act fast and violently.
memories.source_text: "'Now!' roared a voice in Harry's ear and a thick hairy arm descended from thin air and dragged him upright; Hermione too had been pulled to her feet."

memories.description: I saw Hagrid watching from his window and gave him a quick thumbs-up. I care about him and I wanted him to know I'm behind him.
memories.source_text: [Harry could see Hagrid watching anxiously out of his cabin window.]

memories.description: Divination is hopeless for me. I messed up the crystal ball, I got tea leaves wrong, and I even mixed up palm lines. I'm done pretending I care about it.
memories.source_text: [Even by Harry’s low standards in Divination, the exam went very badly.]

memories.description: Professor McGonagall was carried back to the castle and looked badly hurt. People expect Madam Pomfrey to patch her up.
memories.source_text: ["I just hope Professor McGonagall’s all right," said Lavender tearfully. "They carried her back up to the castle, we watched through the dormitory window," said Colin Creevey. "She didn’t look very well..." "Madam Pomfrey will sort her out," said Alicia Spinnet firmly.]

memories.description: Umbridge hates part-humans, and that's probably why she's trying to get Hagrid sacked.
memories.source_text: ["Umbridge hates part-humans," said Hermione bitterly, flopping down into an armchair.]

memories.description: Something forced my body to say things and to cast a curse. I suddenly spoke with this cold voice and the Cruciatus hit the man on the floor. That was terrifying and not under my control.
memories.source_text: [A voice issued from his own mouth, a high, cold voice empty of any human kindness, "Take it for me. Lift it down, now. I cannot touch it but you can." ... heard the high, cold voice say, "Crucio!" The man on the floor let out a scream of pain...]

memories.description: Sirius is here, he's hurt and defiant, and he begged me that he'd have to be killed rather than give in. I trusted him and this hurts like mad.
memories.source_text: [Very slowly, his arms trembling, the man on the ground raised his shoulders a few inches and lifted his head. His face was bloodstained and gaunt, twisted in pain yet rigid with defiance. "You’ll have to kill me," whispered Sirius.]

memories.description: There was a voice saying Voldemort is waiting. Whatever's happening involves Voldemort being close by or involved in what's going on.
memories.source_text: ["Lord Voldemort is waiting ..."]

memories.description: No way is Sirius safe at the Department of Mysteries. If Kreacher is right then Padfoot will not come back from there
memories.source_text: “Master will not come back from the Department of Mysteries!”

memories.description: I know someone has got Padfoot and it is urgent. I shouted that because I had one last chance to tell someone at Hogwarts
memories.source_text: “He’s got Padfoot!”

memories.description: It was Umbridge who sent the dementors after me. She lied to cover it up and is willing to do dirty things to silence me
memories.source_text: “They were all bleating about silencing you somehow — discrediting you — but I was the one who actually did something about it”

memories.description: Snape is still cold and unreadable. I pinned my hopes on him and he walked away without helping, so I can no longer rely on him to save Sirius
memories.source_text: “You wanted to see me, Headmistress?”

memories.description: Sirius should be here where I saw him. If he is not, something is very wrong. I feel sick about it and I have to find him.
memories.source_text: I don’t think Sirius is here.

memories.description: There's a dusty glass sphere with my name on the label. My name is literally on one of these things. That has to mean something.
memories.source_text: It’s — it’s got your name on

memories.description: When I pick up the orb it is warm like it has been in the sun. Touching it feels like it matters somehow, even though at first nothing happened.
memories.source_text: It’s got my name on

memories.description: I gave Fred and George my Triwizard winnings last June. They used that money to set up whatever they have now.
memories.source_text: "Because they got the gold from me. I gave them my Triwizard winnings last June."

memories.description: I don't regret giving them the money. It was the right thing to do and I back them setting up their joke shop.
memories.source_text: "And I don't regret it either — I didn't need the gold, and they'll be great at a joke shop . . ."

memories.description: Umbridge's lessons are a nightmare for students. Her own measures are getting laughed at and students are deliberately making her look ridiculous.
memories.source_text: "After putting four successive classes in detention and failing to discover their secret she was forced to give up and allow the bleeding, swooning, sweating, and vomiting students to leave her classes in droves."

memories.description: Peeves is making Umbridge's life hell and nobody else is doing much to stop him.
memories.source_text: "Peeves...spent hours at a time floating along after Umbridge and blowing loud raspberries every time she spoke."

memories.description: I'm trying to let those dreams lead me on. I actually want to get back to that corridor in the Department of Mysteries even if it's dangerous.
memories.source_text: "You are trying to block your mind, aren't you?"

memories.description: If Montague stays out of it, Slytherin will be weaker and Gryffindor might have a shot at the Cup.
memories.source_text: "If Montague doesn't recover before Slytherin play Hufflepuff, we might be in with a chance of winning the Cup."

memories.description: Hermione won't let me drop the Occlumency subject. She's pushy about it and keeps bringing it up.
memories.source_text: "He'd been regretting this ever since; Hermione would not let the subject drop and kept reverting to it when Harry least expected it."

memories.description: Watching Cho play just makes everything confusing for me. I can't handle more arguments or petty rubbish right now.
memories.source_text: "He was not sure what he wanted to happen anymore, except that he could not stand any more rows."

memories.description: Sirius is alive and being held by You-Know-Who, but I have no idea how we're supposed to reach him to help.
memories.source_text: "Yes," said Harry, as his scar gave another painful prickle, "and I'm sure Sirius is still alive, but I can't see how we're going to get there to help him."

memories.description: Grawp caused the centaurs to scatter and I feel furious and helpless about what just happened.
memories.source_text: "I`m not that fussed, to be honest," said Harry bitterly.

memories.description: I've lost my wand and we're stranded in the Forbidden Forest with no way to get to London or to rescue Sirius quickly.
memories.source_text: "Not only had Harry managed to lose his wand but they were stuck in the middle of the Forbidden Forest with no means of transport whatsoever."

memories.description: Thestrals are not ugly to me anymore. They can help us and I want to use them to fly where we need to go.
memories.source_text: "How could he ever have thought them ugly?" (Harry pats the thestral)

memories.description: We need more thestrals to carry everyone. Time is slipping and every delay could cost Sirius his life.
memories.source_text: "Okay, fine, it's your choice," he said curtly. "But unless we can find more thestrals you're not going to be able —"

memories.description: I can't believe I forgot Snape's still at Hogwarts. Of course there's someone from the Order here
memories.source_text: There was still a member of the Order of the Phoenix at Hogwarts — Snape.

memories.description: Voldemort has Padfoot and he's in the Department of Mysteries. I saw him there in the vision and I know it's real
memories.source_text: Voldemort's got Sirius in the Department of Mysteries, he thought desperately. Voldemort's got Sirius —

memories.description: Umbridge is onto me and she'll try to stop anything I do. She's a problem I have to work around
memories.source_text: You are on probation!

memories.description: Snape isn't going to play along with Umbridge's craziness, and I can't count on him to help me out in front of her
memories.source_text: I wish to interrogate him! ... I have no idea, said Snape coldly. "Potter, when I want nonsense shouted at me I shall give you a Babbling Beverage.

memories.description: Grimmauld Place is empty right now. Sirius isn't at home where he should be
memories.source_text: He knelt down quickly, thrust his head into the dancing fire, and cried, 'Number twelve, Grimmauld Place!' ... There was nobody there.

memories.description: Voldemort goes after people he knows I care about. He set Ginny up to draw me in because he expects me to try to save Sirius.
memories.source_text: “Voldemort knows you, Harry! He took Ginny down into the Chamber of Secrets to lure you there, it’s the kind of thing he does, he knows you’re the — the sort of person who’d go to Sirius’s aid!”

memories.description: I've seen Sirius. He is trapped and no one else knows, so it falls to us to act.
memories.source_text: “Sirius is trapped — I’ve seen him — Voldemort’s got him, and no one else knows, and that means we’re the only ones who can save him,”

memories.description: Those visions aren't just dreams. Occlumency was to stop me seeing real things. I know the visions are real.
memories.source_text: “I’m not having nightmares, I’m not just dreaming! What d’you think all the Occlumency was for, why d’you think Dumbledore wanted me prevented from seeing these things? Because they’re REAL,”

memories.description: Kreacher said Sirius will not come back from the Department of Mysteries.
memories.source_text: “Master will not come back from the Department of Mysteries!”

memories.description: My friends have supported me when I acted to save them before. I expect loyalty from them now when I say Sirius needs saving.
memories.source_text: “If I remember rightly, you didn’t have a problem with my saving-people-thing when it was you I was saving from the dementors, or” — he rounded on Ron — “when it was your sister I was saving from the basilisk —”

memories.description: Umbridge set traps and Stealth Sensoring Spells. She was waiting and she seized our wands when she found us.
memories.source_text: “Take his wand,” she barked at someone he could not see, and he felt a hand grope inside the chest pocket of his robes and remove the wand.

memories.description: Umbridge is cunning and paranoid about security. I can't assume her office is easy to sneak into again.
memories.source_text: “You think that after two nifflers I was going to let one more foul, scavenging little creature enter my office without my knowledge? I had Stealth Sensoring Spells placed all around my doorway after the last one got in, you foolish boy.”

memories.description: We are not going to let them pretend we made them do it. I shouted that because I know we didn\'t ask them to help and we won\'t let them claim otherwise.
memories.source_text: "We\'re not going to say anything like that!"

memories.description: I saw Hermione try to explain and mess it up. I feared her words would make things worse and they did. I expected talking might help but it didn\'t.
memories.source_text: "Please," said Hermione breathlessly, "please, don\'t attack us, we don\'t think like her, we aren\'t Ministry of Magic employees! We only came in here because we hoped you\'d drive her off for us —"

memories.description: Grawp thinks Hagrid is his and he wants him. I watched Grawp reach for us and knew he meant Hagrid, not trouble for us at first, though it turned violent when the centaurs shot at him.
memories.source_text: "GRAWP WANT HAGGER!"

memories.description: Hermione clings to me when things get dangerous. I felt responsible and ready to fight or do whatever it takes to keep her safe.
memories.source_text: "Harry!" she whispered.

memories.description: I know they're not bluffing. If I give Dolohov the prophecy he'll just kill us straight away. I won't make that choice.
memories.source_text: "Like you won't kill us all the moment I hand it over anyway!"

memories.description: I can stop someone fast when I need to. When it mattered I froze Dolohov and the other Death Eater solid and bought us time.
memories.source_text: "PETRIFICUS TOTALUS!"

memories.description: Hermione's life matters above everything right now. I panicked at the thought she might be dead and everything else narrowed down to getting her safe.
memories.source_text: "Hermione," Harry said at once, shaking her as the baby-headed Death Eater blundered out of sight again.

memories.description: I feel protective of Ron and Ginny and the others. When I heard them I dropped everything to get to them. They're my responsibility in the moment.
memories.source_text: "RON?" Harry yelled, turning quickly from the monstrous transformation taking place before them.

memories.description: Those things in the tanks are real and disgusting. I could see them clearly now and they were like slimy cauliflowers floating in green water.
memories.source_text: Glimmering eerily they drifted in and out of sight in the depths of the green water, looking something like slimy cauliflowers.

memories.description: If we went the way I dreamed, we might get somewhere. We have to try the route from the dark room again.
memories.source_text: I think we should go back and try from there.

memories.description: This place is enormous and full of doors. We can’t assume one entrance leads everywhere.
memories.source_text: There are doors here too

memories.description: That veil is active. It’s moving like someone just went through it so something’s on the other side.
memories.source_text: There was no answering voice, but the veil continued to flutter and sway.

memories.description: When I saw that archway and the veil, I couldn’t shake the idea that Sirius might be trapped on the other side. I kept thinking he could be there.
memories.source_text: Sirius?

memories.description: Everything we’re doing is about saving Sirius. I’m convinced that’s what this is for and I won’t let that go.
memories.source_text: Harry, we are supposed to be here for Sirius!

memories.description: Hermione and I worked out the row numbers. Row ninety-seven is where we think he should be so we have to check it thoroughly.
memories.source_text: ‘Ninety-seven!’ whispered Hermione.

memories.description: The exit opened right behind me and led straight to the lifts. If I can get to the Atrium I can take a lift out.
memories.source_text: The door right behind him flew open, and the corridor toward the lifts stretched ahead of him, torch-lit and empty.

memories.description: Bellatrix is gloating and taunting me. She mocks me and provokes me, so this is personal and dangerous.
memories.source_text: “Come out, come out, little Harry!” she called in her mock-baby voice, which echoed off the polished wooden floors. “What did you come after me for, then? I thought you were here to avenge my dear cousin!”

memories.description: I felt a new kind of hatred, so strong I actually used Crucio on her. I never thought I'd do something like that, but I did it because I couldn't stand her.
memories.source_text: Hatred rose in Harry such as he had never known before. He flung himself out from behind the fountain and bellowed “Crucio!”

memories.description: So Umbridge is spying on everyone's mail and Filch is watching the secret passages. They're watching us from all sides.
memories.source_text: "My Inquisitorial Squad is opening and reading all owl post entering and leaving the castle. And Mr. Filch is observing all secret passages in and out of the castle."

memories.description: Umbridge tries to boss me around and kick me out whenever she can. I won't do what she wants easily.
memories.source_text: "Back to lunch with you, Potter!"

memories.description: I can't trust everyone in the D.A. anymore. People I thought were friends can betray us and that's dangerous.
memories.source_text: "She sold us all out, including you!"

memories.description: I feel let down by Cho. She defended Marietta and it made me angrier at her. We're not on the same page right now.
memories.source_text: "Are you okay? Umbridge hasn't been asking you about the D.A., has she?"

memories.description: Snape is volatile about what he doesn't want known. He panics and lashes out when something touches a private memory.
memories.source_text: "You will not tell anybody what you saw!"

memories.description: We won. I’m glad about that, plain and simple.
memories.source_text: "I’m just glad we won, that’s all."

memories.description: I made a couple of good saves in the match, and yeah, I remembered the moves in the moment.
memories.source_text: "And then, when Chambers came at me about five minutes later — what?"

memories.description: Hagrid has been dealing with giants stuff and he wanted us involved, which ties me closer into whatever trouble he drags in.
memories.source_text: "He decided to tell us why he’s been covered in injuries ever since he got back from the giants."

memories.description: Hagrid brought a giant back and hid him in the forest. That thing, Grawp, is real and huge.
memories.source_text: "He brought one back and hid it in the forest?" "Yep."

memories.description: Hagrid made us promise to help teach Grawp English. We actually promised and that matters.
memories.source_text: "Teach him English, yeah."

memories.description: Our O.W.L.s are coming up, theory in the mornings, practicals in the afternoons, and Astronomy at night. Exams are stacked and serious.
memories.source_text: "As you can see, your O.W.L.s are spread over two successive weeks."

memories.description: Professor McGonagall warned that the exams are heavily protected against cheating. No easy shortcuts.
memories.source_text: "I must warn you that the most stringent Anti-Cheating Charms have been applied to your examination papers."

memories.description: I can ride thestrals to get places even if others cannot see them. I have to hold on tight because they launch and fly dead fast.
memories.source_text: “Oh it’s easy,” said Luna, sliding obligingly from her thestral and marching over to him, Hermione, and Ginny. “Come here . . .” She pulled them over to the other thestrals standing around and one by one managed to help them onto the backs of their mounts.

memories.description: That flight was terrifyingly fast. Once they take off you better grip on or you'll go flying off.
memories.source_text: Then, with a sweeping movement that nearly unseated him, the wings on either side extended, the horse crouched slowly and then rocketed upward so fast and so steeply that Harry had to clench his arms and legs tightly around the horse to avoid sliding backward over its bony rump.

memories.description: Something's wrong at the Ministry. No security people where they should be means we are walking into trouble.
memories.source_text: Harry felt sure that there ought to be a security person there, sure that their absence was an ominous sign, and his feeling of foreboding increased as they passed through the golden gates to the lifts.

memories.description: We're being treated as a rescue party at the Ministry. My name is literally stamped on a badge for a rescue mission.
memories.source_text: “Visitors, please take the badges and attach them to the front of your robes.” Half a dozen badges slid out of the metal chute where returned coins usually appeared. Hermione scooped them up and handed them mutely to Harry over Ginny’s head; he glanced at the topmost one. HARRY POTTER RESCUE MISSION

memories.description: He turned up in the middle of the hall, pale and snake-faced, and he was looking straight at me like I was the problem. He thinks the prophecy matters and that I ruined it.
memories.source_text: "So you smashed my prophecy?" said Voldemort softly, staring at Harry with those pitiless red eyes.

memories.description: He tried to kill me outright with Avada Kedavra and I could not move. That Killing Curse came for me and I was helpless.
memories.source_text: "AVADA KEDAVRA!"

memories.description: Bella was on her knees, all desperate and sniveling, blaming the Animagus for screwing things up. She was terrified of him.
memories.source_text: "Master, I am sorry, I knew not, I was fighting the Animagus Black!" sobbed Bellatrix, flinging herself down at Voldemort's feet

memories.description: Dumbledore showed up and everything changed. He arrived like he always does, calm and dangerous, and got stuck into Voldemort straight away.
memories.source_text: "Dumbledore!"

memories.description: The statues actually came to life to protect me. The headless golden statue threw itself between Voldemort and me and took a hit for me. I was shoved out of the way and kept safe by stone.
memories.source_text: The headless golden statue of the wizard in the fountain had sprung alive, leaping from its plinth, and landed on the floor with a crash between Harry and Voldemort.

memories.description: More statues jumped in. One pinned Bella to the floor and her spells bounced off it. The place turned into a proper fight with stone on our side.
memories.source_text: the other statues sprang to life too. The statue of the witch ran at Bellatrix, who screamed and sent spells streaming uselessly off its chest

memories.description: Dumbledore taunted him and said the Aurors were coming. Voldemort claimed he would be gone before then, but Dumbledore was holding him off and stalling for help.
memories.source_text: "It was foolish to come here tonight, Tom," said Dumbledore calmly. "The Aurors are on their way -"

memories.description: The Death Eaters are back and the whole wizarding world is on alert. That leaflet spells it out plain.
memories.source_text: [The Wizarding community is currently under threat from an organization calling itself the Death Eaters.]

memories.description: Don't go out on your own. Seriously, travelling alone is a bad idea right now.
memories.source_text: [You are advised not to leave the house alone.]

memories.description: They're even using Inferi. That is creepy and dangerous. If you see one you report it straight away.
memories.source_text: [Unconfirmed sightings suggest that the Death Eaters may now be using Inferi (see page 10). Any sighting of an Inferius, or encounter with same, should be reported to the Ministry IMMEDIATELY.]

memories.description: People can be disguised with Polyjuice. We need security questions so mates can tell if someone is an imposter.
memories.source_text: [Agree on security questions with close friends and family so as to detect Death Eaters masquerading as others by use of the Polyjuice Potion (see page 2).]

memories.description: If the Dark Mark shows up over a place, do not go in. Call the Aurors. That is not the time to be brave.
memories.source_text: [Should the Dark Mark appear over any dwelling place or other building, DO NOT ENTER, but contact the Auror office immediately.]

memories.description: The prophecy is gone. It smashed when I tried to get Neville up those steps so there is nothing left to fetch.
memories.source_text: "The prophecy smashed when I was trying to get Neville up the steps!"

memories.description: My scar burns when Voldemort finds out something. The pain hit me hard and I knew Voldemort would know the prophecy was destroyed.
memories.source_text: "And he knows!" said Harry with a mad laugh to match Bellatrix’s own. "Your dear old mate Voldemort knows it’s gone!"

memories.description: Bellatrix is fanatically loyal to Voldemort and believes she has power I can't match. Hearing her made me even more sure she will do anything for him.
memories.source_text: "I was and am the Dark Lord’s most loyal servant, I learned the Dark Arts from him, and I know spells of such power that you, pathetic little boy, can never hope to compete —"

memories.description: She tried to summon the prophecy right there in the room. She shouted a direct summoning and expected it to appear.
memories.source_text: "Accio Prophecy! ACCIO PROPHECY!"

memories.description: Bellatrix sounded scared for the first time when I said the prophecy was smashed. That fear showed me she is terrified of Voldemort's reaction.
memories.source_text: "What? What do you mean?" she cried, and for the first time there was fear in her voice.

memories.description: I was ready to die rather than give the prophecy up because it no longer existed to hand over anyway. The scar pain hit me as I said it, proving how connected I am to what Voldemort feels.
memories.source_text: "Well, you’re going to have to kill me, because it’s gone!" Harry roared — and as he shouted it, pain seared across his forehead.

memories.description: I'll put Kreacher in the Hogwarts kitchens with the other house-elves so they can keep an eye on him.
memories.source_text: "Er — Kreacher — I want you to go to Hogwarts and work in the kitchens there with the other house-elves."

memories.description: Buckbeak is mine but I'm leaving him with Hagrid because that's where he'd be happiest.
memories.source_text: "No," said Harry at once, "he can stay with Hagrid. I think Buckbeak would prefer that."

memories.description: They've renamed Buckbeak 'Witherwings' for his safety, at least for now.
memories.source_text: "Incidentally, we have decided, in the interests of Buckbeak's safety, to rechristen him 'Witherwings' for the time being,"

memories.description: Dumbledore thinks I might not show up somewhere important, like my trunk might not even be packed.
memories.source_text: "Doubtful that I would turn up?" Dumbledore suggested shrewdly.

memories.description: Dumbledore's coming on Friday at eleven P.M. to take me to the Burrow. It's that simple. He invited me to spend the rest of the holidays there.
memories.source_text: If it is convenient to you, I shall call at number four, Privet Drive this coming Friday at eleven P.M. to escort you to the Burrow, where you have been invited to spend the remainder of your school holidays.

memories.description: He wants my help with something on the way to the Burrow. No idea what yet, but he expects me to come along and help.
memories.source_text: If you are agreeable, I should also be glad of your assistance in a matter to which I hope to attend on the way to the Burrow.

memories.description: Dumbledore told me to send my answer back by owl. I already sent a 'yes' as he asked.
memories.source_text: Kindly send your answer by return of this owl.

memories.description: I've been staring at this letter non-stop for three days. I know every word by heart and I keep checking the window to see if he turns up.
memories.source_text: Harry had read this letter so often since its arrival three days ago that although it had been delivered in a tightly furled scroll, it now lay quite flat.

memories.description: I can't do anything about it now; either he shows up or he doesn't. Waiting is pointless, but I can't stop watching for him.
memories.source_text: Either Dumbledore was going to come, or he was not.

memories.description: I've still got that alarm clock I fixed years ago. It's ticking away and it's nearly eleven, which makes me even more on edge.
memories.source_text: An alarm clock, repaired by Harry several years ago, ticked loudly on the sill, showing one minute to eleven.

memories.description: I haven't packed a thing. I kept thinking I'd panic and get ready, but I just sat by the window instead.
memories.source_text: But Harry had not packed.

memories.description: Sirius left me everything he owned. I have his money at Gringotts and whatever personal things he had.
memories.source_text: "Sirius’s will was discovered a week ago and that he left you everything he owned."

memories.description: Sirius left me number twelve, Grimmauld Place. I own the house now whether I like it or not.
memories.source_text: "Sirius also left you number twelve, Grimmauld Place."

memories.description: Kreacher is tied up in the Black family and Bellatrix thinks he should belong to her. He is hostile and refuses to come to me.
memories.source_text: "Kreacher belongs to Miss Bellatrix, oh yes, Kreacher belongs to the Blacks, Kreacher wants his new mistress, Kreacher won’t go to the Potter brat, Kreacher won’t, won’t, won’t -"

memories.description: I am the rightful owner of Grimmauld Place and of Kreacher. I hate the idea of owning Kreacher. I don't want him after what he did, but legally he belongs to me.
memories.source_text: "Well, that simplifies matters," said Dumbledore cheerfully. "It seems that Sirius knew what he was doing. You are the rightful owner of number twelve, Grimmauld Place and of Kreacher."

memories.description: If the house is enchanted to stay in the Black line then Bellatrix could try to claim it. That's dangerous and I do not want her getting hold of Grimmauld Place.
memories.source_text: "It might be that Bellatrix will arrive on the doorstep at any moment."

memories.description: Tonks looks drawn and ill. She tried to act normal but I can tell something's off with her.
memories.source_text: "Hello, Professor," she said. "Wotcher, Harry." "Hi, Tonks." Harry thought she looked drawn, even ill, and there was something forced in her smile.

memories.description: Arthur is running a new office that busts dodgy so-called protective products. He's dealing with fake protections and cursed junk.
memories.source_text: "Yes, Rufus Scrimgeour has set up several new offices in response to the present situation, and Arthur’s heading the Office for the Detection and Confiscation of Counterfeit Defensive Spells and Protective Objects."

memories.description: People are selling dangerous fake items like Metamorph-Medals that don't work and can make you orange or give you horrible warts.
memories.source_text: "Some idiot’s started selling Metamorph-Medals. Just sling them around your neck and you’ll be able to change your appearance at will. A hundred thousand disguises, all for ten Galleons!" "Mostly you just turn a fairly unpleasant orange color, but a couple of people have also sprouted tentaclelike warts all over their bodies."

memories.description: The Weasley clock shows people in mortal peril and it just told us Dad was traveling, so he's on his way back.
memories.source_text: She pointed at the clock’s face. Mr Weasley’s hand had switched to "traveling." "He’s coming!"

memories.description: Dumbledore brought me to the Burrow late at night. He still looks out for me and comes when needed.
memories.source_text: "It is I, Dumbledore, bringing Harry."

memories.description: Everyone is more at risk now that You-Know-Who is back. The danger isn't just rumor, it feels real and constant.
memories.source_text: "Every single one of its nine hands was now pointing at 'mortal peril.' ... 'It’s been like that for a while now,' said Mrs Weasley, in an unconvincingly casual voice, 'ever since You-Know-Who came back into the open.'"

memories.description: I will do anything to protect the others. If giving up something matters to keep them alive, I will try to do it.
memories.source_text: "Let — let the others go, and I’ll give it to you!" said Harry desperately.

memories.description: The prophecy is real and it's physically hot in my hand. It's important and dangerous in more ways than one.
memories.source_text: "The prophecy was hot with the heat from his clutching hand as he held it out."

memories.description: When Sirius went through that veil I believed I could pull him back. I lunged for him because I refused to accept he was gone.
memories.source_text: "SIRIUS!" Harry yelled, "SIRIUS!"

memories.description: I trusted Lupin to be honest with me. When he held me back and told me Sirius was gone I had to face the terrible truth. I feel helpless and furious.
memories.source_text: "There’s nothing you can do, Harry . . ." "He’s gone."

memories.description: Sirius was brave and reckless to the end. I used to think he'd always get away with it. That is no longer something I can rely on.
memories.source_text: "He was laughing at her. 'Come on, you can do better than that!' he yelled... The second jet of light hit him squarely on the chest."

memories.description: I can summon a Patronus in front of examiners. I did it on purpose to put Umbridge in her place and it worked, the stag came out and everyone noticed.
memories.source_text: "Expecto Patronum!"

memories.description: So the O.W.L. results arrive by owl in July. At least I'll have one piece of mail to expect at Privet Drive next summer.
memories.source_text: "An owl will be sent to you some time in July," said Professor McGonagall.

memories.description: Hermione's panic about the exam answers is getting on my nerves. I told her to stop fussing and just do it herself because I don't want to be nagged while we're trying to revise.
memories.source_text: "Why don’t you just do it yourself?"

memories.description: I'm being possessed right now. Something with red eyes has me locked in its coils and it can make me speak with my own mouth. The pain is insane and I cannot separate myself from it.
memories.source_text: If death is nothing, Dumbledore, kill the boy

memories.description: Dumbledore can sound afraid. I thought he was unshakable but when he shouted at me he actually sounded frightened.
memories.source_text: Stay where you are, Harry!

memories.description: Fawkes will throw himself between Dumbledore and a killing curse. He took that blast to save Dumbledore and was reduced to a tiny, burned form.
memories.source_text: Fawkes swooped down in front of Dumbledore, opened his beak wide, and swallowed the jet of green light whole. He burst into flame and fell to the floor, small, wrinkled, and flightless

memories.description: When the pain becomes too much I want it to end. If death would stop this, I would beg for it without thinking. I don't want to keep being used like this.
memories.source_text: Kill me now, Dumbledore

memories.description: They want that prophecy more than anything. I am holding something they will do anything to get.
memories.source_text: “Now give me the prophecy, Potter.”

memories.description: There is a prophecy about me and Voldemort. That could be why my parents died and why I have this scar.
memories.source_text: “About both of you, Potter, about both of you . . .”

memories.description: I believed Sirius might be here with them. I led my friends into this because I thought I had him nearby.
memories.source_text: “I know Sirius is here!”

memories.description: I will protect my friends no matter what. If anyone wants to hurt them they will have to get past me first.
memories.source_text: “You’ll have to smash this if you want to attack any of us,”

memories.description: If I make a move at the right moment we can create a chance to get out. I can lead them to run and smash the shelves to cover our escape.
memories.source_text: “When I say go —”

memories.description: I thought about death and then I thought about Sirius and I kept telling myself I will see him again. I wanted that more than anything.
memories.source_text: Death is nothing compared to this. . . . And I’ll see Sirius again. . . .

memories.description: I saw him with my own eyes. Voldemort was here, he grabbed someone and Disapparated. He is back.
memories.source_text: He was there! ... it was You-Know-Who, he grabbed a woman and Disapparated!

memories.description: There are Death Eaters trapped downstairs in the Death Chamber and they are being held by an Anti-Disapparation Jinx.
memories.source_text: you will find several escaped Death Eaters contained in the Death Chamber, bound by an Anti-Disapparation Jinx

memories.description: Dumbledore is taking responsibility for explaining what happened and wants me back at Hogwarts before anyone else gets the full story.
memories.source_text: I shall explain everything, when Harry is back at school.

memories.description: Dumbledore told Fudge to get Umbridge removed from Hogwarts. That means things might change at school.
memories.source_text: You will give the order to remove Dolores Umbridge from Hogwarts

memories.description: Dumbledore gave me a Portkey to get me back to Hogwarts fast. I just had to touch it and go.
memories.source_text: Take this Portkey, Harry.

memories.description: My scar should hurt when Voldemort gets stronger, but it is not burning now and that worries me.
memories.source_text: "I thought it would be burning all the time now Voldemort’s getting so powerful again."

memories.description: So Voldemort is using Occlumency to block my access to his thoughts. That explains why I am not getting constant flashes.
memories.source_text: "It appears that he is now employing Occlumency against you."

memories.description: Dumbledore brought me along to try to persuade a retired teacher to come back to Hogwarts. I am supposed to be useful for that.
memories.source_text: "We are here to persuade an old colleague of mine to come out of retirement and return to Hogwarts."

memories.description: Dumbledore thinks checking jam preference is a clever way to tell if someone is an impostor. His favorite jam is raspberry.
memories.source_text: "You have not asked me, for instance, what is my favorite flavor of jam, to check that I am indeed Professor Dumbledore and not an impostor."

memories.description: Inferi are bewitched corpses used by Dark wizards. That is terrifying.
memories.source_text: "They are corpses," said Dumbledore calmly. "Dead bodies that have been bewitched to do a Dark wizard’s bidding."

memories.description: I expected the house to contain a corpse or someone dead, but Horace was hiding by pretending to be an armchair. I couldn't believe it.
memories.source_text: "There was no need to stick the wand in that hard," he said gruffly, clambering to his feet. "It hurt."

memories.description: Dumbledore introduced me to Horace Slughorn. Horace is an old colleague of Dumbledore and he noticed my scar right away.
memories.source_text: "This, said Dumbledore, moving forward to make the introduction, is Harry Potter. Harry, this is an old friend and colleague of mine, Horace Slughorn."

memories.description: I felt sorry for Luna. She gets picked on, but she says things like they will sort themselves out and I didn't mind her talking about Sirius.
memories.source_text: "Some people call me ‘Loony’ Lovegood, actually."

memories.description: Sirius is dead. He was my godfather. It still hits me and everything I wanted before feels like it belongs to another life.
memories.source_text: "That man the Death Eaters killed was your godfather, wasn’t he? Ginny told me."

memories.description: Luna believes she heard voices behind the veil and because I thought I heard something too, I can't dismiss her as completely mad.
memories.source_text: "Oh, come on. You heard them, just behind the veil, didn’t you?"

memories.description: I bought a massive pile of Cauldron Cakes and Pumpkin Pasties on the train. Sweet stuff helps pass the time.
memories.source_text: "The food trolley’s just stopped if you want anything"

memories.description: Cho and Marietta were on the corridor and Cho and I caught each other's eye. It felt like that part of my life is fading away.
memories.source_text: "Hey, Harry," said Ron, nodding toward the glass window onto the corridor."

memories.description: Moody, Tonks, Lupin and the Weasleys were waiting at King’s Cross to meet the Dursleys. They plan to have words with my aunt and uncle before I go with them.
memories.source_text: "we thought we might have a little chat with your aunt and uncle before letting them take you home."

memories.description: I thought leaving the train would be miserable, but seeing everyone there made me feel better. I even toyed with the idea of never getting off, but that was nonsense.
memories.source_text: "When the ticket inspector signaled to him, Ron, and Hermione that it was safe to walk through the magical barrier between platforms nine and ten, however, he found a surprise awaiting him on the other side"

memories.description: The whole wizarding world is under threat from the Death Eaters. That's the situation and we can't ignore it.
memories.source_text: The Wizarding community is currently under threat from an organization calling itself the Death Eaters.

memories.description: Don't go out alone. I need to be careful and not wander off by myself.
memories.source_text: You are advised not to leave the house alone.

memories.description: Night is when it's worst. I should try to get anywhere important done before dark.
memories.source_text: Particular care should be taken during the hours of darkness. Wherever possible, arrange to complete journeys before night has fallen.

memories.description: I need to check the protective spells around where I stay. Shield and Disillusionment Charms matter, and underage folks might need Side Along Apparition if things go wrong.
memories.source_text: Review the security arrangements around your house, making sure that all family members are aware of emergency measures such as Shield and Disillusionment Charms, and, in the case of underage family members, Side-Along-Apparition.

memories.description: People could be using Polyjuice to pretend to be someone else. We should set up security questions so we can tell who's who.
memories.source_text: Agree on security questions with close friends and family so as to detect Death Eaters masquerading as others by use of the Polyjuice Potion (see page 2).

memories.description: If someone is acting weird, they might be under the Imperius Curse. I should get the Magical Law Enforcement Squad involved straight away.
memories.source_text: Should you feel that a family member, colleague, friend, or neighbor is acting in a strange manner, contact the Magical Law Enforcement Squad at once. They may have been put under the Imperius Curse (see page 4).

memories.description: If I see the Dark Mark over a place, I am not going in. Contact the Aurors and stay away.
memories.source_text: Should the Dark Mark appear over any dwelling place or other building, DO NOT ENTER, but contact the Auror office immediately.

memories.description: There are reports the Death Eaters might be using Inferi. That is seriously dangerous and changes how we deal with attacks.
memories.source_text: Unconfirmed sightings suggest that the Death Eaters may now be using Inferi (see page 10).

memories.description: The trunk's mostly empty apart from rubbish and old things. There's nothing important packed up there right now.
memories.source_text: A large trunk stood in the very middle of the room. Its lid was open; it looked expectant; yet it was almost empty but for a residue of old underwear, sweets, empty ink bottles, and broken quills that coated the very bottom.

memories.description: Owls are on alert for me even when I'm out cold. I can rely on them to keep watch a bit.
memories.source_text: Her amber eyes surveyed the room imperiously, her head swiveling occasionally to gaze at her snoring master.

memories.description: They\'re calling me the Boy Who Lived again. Great, more attention I did not ask for.
memories.source_text: 'He\'s \u2018the Boy Who Lived\u2019 again now, though, isn\'t he?'

memories.description: The dementors have abandoned Azkaban. That means a lot of Death Eaters, including my dad\'s lot, could be out soon.
memories.source_text: 'The dementors have left Azkaban,' said Malfoy quietly.

memories.description: Malfoy hates me more than ever and is out for revenge. He threatened me and I don\'t trust him a bit.
memories.source_text: 'You\'re dead, Potter.'

memories.description: Hagrid thinks Sirius died fighting. I can hear how badly that hurts him, but I am not ready to accept that without knowing for certain.
memories.source_text: 'I knew Sirius longer 'n you did. . . . He died in battle, an' tha's the way he'd've wanted ter go.'

memories.description: The Ministry has finally admitted Voldemort is back. That changes everything. We are not safe and people must be on guard.
memories.source_text: 'It is with great regret that I must confirm that the wizard styling himself Lord ... is alive and among us again,' said Fudge.

memories.description: Dumbledore's wearing a big clumsy gold ring with a cracked black stone. He's slower now and his fingers are burned, but he still carries himself like he knows what he's doing.
memories.source_text: "I am undoubtedly slower than I was. But on the other hand . . ." He shrugged and spread his hands wide, as though to say that age had its compensations, and Harry noticed a ring on his uninjured hand that he had never seen Dumbledore wear before: It was large, rather clumsily made of what looked like gold, and was set with a heavy black stone that had cracked down the middle.

memories.description: Slughorn's been hiding for about a year, living in Muggle houses, using tricks like Freezing Charms on alarm systems so he won't get caught. He's trying to stay off the Death Eaters' radar.
memories.source_text: "I haven’t given them the chance. I’ve been on the move for a year. Never stay in one place more than a week. Move from Muggle house to Muggle house — the owners of this place are on holiday in the Canary Islands — it’s been very pleasant, I’ll be sorry to leave. It’s quite easy once you know how, one simple Freezing Charm on these absurd burglar alarms they use instead of Sneakoscopes and make sure the neighbors don’t spot you bringing in the piano."

memories.description: Dumbledore thinks the Death Eaters would try to recruit Slughorn for nasty work, and Slughorn's clearly worried enough to keep moving instead of staying put.
memories.source_text: "What would the Death Eaters want with a poor broken-down old buffer like me?" demanded Slughorn. "I imagine that they would want you to turn your considerable talents to coercion, torture, and murder," said Dumbledore.

memories.description: Slughorn remembers my mother, Lily, and he liked her a lot. He still talks about her as one of his favorites, so I know he has a soft spot for her and for me because of her.
memories.source_text: "You look very like your father." ... "Except for your eyes. You’ve got —" "My mother’s eyes, yeah." ... "Yes, well. You shouldn’t have favorites as a teacher, of course, but she was one of mine. Your mother," Slughorn added, in answer to Harry’s questioning look. "Lily Evans. One of the brightest I ever taught. Vivacious, you know. Charming girl. I used to tell her she ought to have been in my House."

memories.description: Slughorn used to be Head of Slytherin. He collects ex-students and tries to keep ties with powerful people.
memories.source_text: "I was Head of Slytherin," said Slughorn.

memories.description: I still hate Umbridge, but hearing Dumbledore say she walked into trouble with the centaurs makes me feel she deserved the mess she got herself into.
memories.source_text: "If that’s how you treat teachers these days —" "Professor Umbridge ran afoul of our centaur herd," said Dumbledore. "I think you, Horace, would have known better than to stride into the forest and call a horde of angry centaurs ‘filthy half-breeds.’"

memories.description: He says he's been out of touch for a year so I can't assume everyone knows where he is.
memories.source_text: [Of course not, I have been out of touch with everybody for a year.]

memories.description: Slughorn will try to collect me. I am a prize to him because of what people call me.
memories.source_text: [He will undoubtedly try to collect you, Harry. You would be the jewel of his collection; 'the Boy Who Lived' . . . or, as they call you these days, 'the Chosen One.']

memories.description: Dumbledore wants to give me private lessons this year.
memories.source_text: [I think it is time that I took a greater hand in your education.]

memories.description: Dumbledore thinks I'm coping and is proud of me. That matters.
memories.source_text: [I hope you will forgive me for mentioning it, Harry, but I am pleased and a little proud at how well you seem to be coping after everything that happened at the Ministry.]

memories.description: I do not have to do Occlumency with Snape now.
memories.source_text: [Professor Snape, Harry — and no, you will not.]

memories.description: Dumbledore told me to keep my Invisibility Cloak on me at all times, even at Hogwarts.
memories.source_text: [I wish you to keep your Invisibility Cloak with you at all times from this moment onward. Even within Hogwarts itself. Just in case, you understand me?]

memories.description: The Ministry has given the Burrow top security while I'm staying there so they are watching my post and protecting the place.
memories.source_text: [the Burrow has been given the highest security the Ministry of Magic can provide.]

memories.description: Losing Sirius made me determined. If I die, I will take as many Death Eaters down with me as I can.
memories.source_text: [If it is, I’ll make sure I take as many Death Eaters with me as I can, and Voldemort too if I can manage it.]

memories.description: He wants something fixed and he wants to put something aside in the shop. I couldn't see what he meant because he was behind that cabinet.
memories.source_text: "Dunno," said Harry, thinking hard. "He wants something mended . . . and he wants to reserve something in there. . . . Could you see what he pointed at when he said 'that one'?"

memories.description: I've got a two way mirror from Sirius. If I say his name into it he should be able to talk to me through it. I have to try now.
memories.source_text: "This is a two-way mirror. I’ve got the other. If you need to speak to me, just say my name into it; you’ll appear in my mirror and I’ll be able to talk in yours."

memories.description: Sirius wouldn't have just stayed at home and let others fight. He would go help if he could.
memories.source_text: "He was never one ter sit around at home an’ let other people do the fightin’."

memories.description: Nick says Sirius will not come back as a ghost. I don't want to accept that, but I have to face that he might really be gone.
memories.source_text: "He will not come back,"

memories.description: I need to go see Ron and Hermione in the hospital wing. They're injured and I have to look after them.
memories.source_text: "I’ve got to go and visit Ron and Hermione in the hospital wing,"

memories.description: Slughorn might be the new teacher. He looks a bit like a walrus and used to be Head of Slytherin. Can't be worse than Umbridge, surely.
memories.source_text: "He looks a bit like a walrus, and he used to be Head of Slytherin," said Harry.

memories.description: Bill and Fleur are engaged. Right now Mrs Weasley and everyone are skirting around the subject so I only just found out.
memories.source_text: "Bill and I are going to be married!"

memories.description: Being at the Dursleys is unsurprising. I still get treated like a Muggle oddity and honestly I prefer it when they keep their distance.
memories.source_text: "Same as usual," said Harry, "they didn’t talk to me much, but I like it better that way."

memories.description: Fleur is being very forward and friendly with the family. She kissed me on both cheeks and seems keen to impress.
memories.source_text: "Eet was no trouble," said Fleur Delacour, setting the tray across Harry’s knees and then swooping to kiss him on each cheek.

memories.description: I was woken by a racket and Ron bursting in. He always makes an entrance like that and I should expect no less.
memories.source_text: "Wuzzgoinon?"

memories.description: I got made Quidditch Captain. Right now that just means more responsibility and people expect me to pull the team together.
memories.source_text: "He had been made Quidditch Captain."

memories.description: Dementors are attacking again. That's awful and it makes everything feel ten times worse.
memories.source_text: “There have been another couple of dementor attacks,” he announced

memories.description: Karkaroff is dead and the Dark Mark was over him. People who turn on the Death Eaters get killed fast.
memories.source_text: “And they’ve found Igor Karkaroff’s body in a shack up north. The Dark Mark had been set over it — well, frankly, I’m surprised he stayed alive for even a year after deserting the Death Eaters; Sirius’s brother, Regulus, only managed a few days as far as I can remember.”

memories.description: Florean Fortescue has been dragged off from his ice-cream shop. He used to give me free ice creams. That's awful and I want to know who did it.
memories.source_text: “Did you hear about Florean Fortescue, Remus?” asked Bill... “Dragged off, by the look of his place.”

memories.description: Ollivander's wand shop is empty. If the wandmaker's gone, that's terrifying for everyone who relies on wands and for Diagon Alley.
memories.source_text: “Talking of Diagon Alley,” said Mr Weasley, “looks like Ollivander’s gone too.”

memories.description: Malfoy did it. He was the one who got me.
memories.source_text: "Draco Malfoy," said Harry bitterly.

memories.description: She fixed my nose with a quick spell. It went hot then cold and now it's mended.
memories.source_text: "Episkey," said Tonks.

memories.description: Tonks helped me get off the train, handed my cloak back and healed me without fuss. I owe her one; she's useful and calm when it matters.
memories.source_text: "Wotcher, Harry." "No problem," said Tonks.

memories.description: Malfoy wasn't out bullying first years. He's sitting with the other Slytherins instead. That looks like he's got something else on his mind.
memories.source_text: Malfoy’s not doing prefect duty. He’s just sitting in his compartment with the other Slytherins, we saw him when we passed.

memories.description: Maybe Malfoy thinks being in the Inquisitorial Squad is more important than being a prefect. That would explain why he skipped duty.
memories.source_text: Maybe he preferred the Inquisitorial Squad

memories.description: I'm going to follow Zabini and slip into the Slytherin compartment under the Invisibility Cloak. I want to find out what Malfoy is up to.
memories.source_text: I’ll see you two later

memories.description: Ginny got noticed by Slughorn because she hexed Zacharias. I respect her for standing up to idiots like him.
memories.source_text: He saw me hex Zacharias Smith

memories.description: If I'm hiding, the Cloak has to do. Dumbledore trusts this thing, so I'm trusting it too. Ministry or not, the Cloak will have to be enough.
memories.source_text: "I’m to wait for you, any idea how long you’ll be?"

memories.description: When it matters I take charge. Pull the Cloak out and move now, no faffing around.
memories.source_text: "Get under here, quick,"

memories.description: Malfoy slipped off toward Knockturn Alley. We have to follow him, now, before he vanishes.
memories.source_text: "He was going in that direction,"

memories.description: I can't hang about. If I want to catch him I have to push everyone, hurry up and keep going.
memories.source_text: "Quick, or we’ll lose him,"

memories.description: He's in Borgin and Burkes. Malfoy is actually in there, right where I used to hide.
memories.source_text: There in the midst of the cases full of skulls and old bottles stood Draco Malfoy with his back to them, just visible beyond the very same large black cabinet in which Harry had once hidden to avoid Malfoy and his father.

memories.description: Buying Dark artifacts is something people try to hide now. If you're seen around places like this, it's a giveaway.
memories.source_text: They peered into windows as they passed, but none of the shops seemed to have any customers at all.

memories.description: I'm not stepping back just because Dumbledore's not here. If they want to try anything, fine. I'm ready to stand up to them.
memories.source_text: "Wow . . . look at that . . . he’s not here now! So why not have a go? They might be able to find you a double cell in Azkaban with your loser of a husband!"

memories.description: I keep my wand up. I won't let them intimidate me into doing nothing, even if people tell me I'll get in trouble.
memories.source_text: Harry did not lower his wand. "Harry, no!" moaned Hermione, grabbing his arm and attempting to push it down by his side.

memories.description: They've put me on top-grade security. Fine. I'm being watched and protected now.
memories.source_text: "He’s been given top-grade security status."

memories.description: I choked on my cereal and Ron smacked me on the back. He's a prat but he'll bash me if I choke and he'd do the same for me.
memories.source_text: Harry choked over his cornflakes, and Ron thumped him on the back.

memories.description: That was a Patronus. Someone just sent a Patronus message to the castle.
memories.source_text: "Was that a Patronus?" asked Harry, who had seen Dumbledore send messages like this.

memories.description: Tonks is posted in Hogsmeade to help protect Hogwarts.
memories.source_text: "I’m stationed in Hogsmeade now, to give the school extra protection," said Tonks.

memories.description: She’s not alone. Proudfoot, Savage, and Dawlish are also stationed up there.
memories.source_text: "No, Proudfoot, Savage, and Dawlish are here too."

memories.description: Dawlish is the Auror Dumbledore attacked last year. He’s one of the ones on duty at Hogsmeade.
memories.source_text: "Dawlish, that Auror Dumbledore attacked last year?" "That’s right."

memories.description: Tonks used to be flippant and jokey, but she’s different now. She looks older and much more serious since the Ministry business.
memories.source_text: Last year she had been inquisitive (to the point of being a little annoying at times), she had laughed easily, she had made jokes. Now she seemed older and much more serious and purposeful.

memories.description: I know Hermione would tell me to comfort Tonks about Sirius, and that it wasn't her fault, but I just can't bring myself to talk about Sirius right now.
memories.source_text: He reflected uncomfortably that Hermione would have suggested he say something consoling about Sirius to her, that it hadn’t been her fault at all, but he couldn’t bring himself to do it.

memories.description: I thanked her for everything and said good night as I walked up to the school with Snape.
memories.source_text: "Thanks for . . . everything."

memories.description: My face was covered in blood. I grabbed a spoon, scrubbed at it and felt gross until Hermione cleaned it off.
memories.source_text: "You’re covered in blood!"

memories.description: I shut down the questions and decided to keep quiet for now because I wanted to deal with it myself.
memories.source_text: "I’ll tell you later,"

memories.description: I reckon Malfoy might've taken his father's place among the Death Eaters and that means whatever he's after at Borgin could be proper Dark and dangerous. We should look into it.
memories.source_text: ["I think he’s replaced his father as a Death Eater."]
