memories.description: The main door was open for me when I got back in, so I didn't have to break in or anything.
memories.source_text: "The front door had remained unlocked for him"

memories.description: Peeves nearly caught me on the third floor. I had to use a shortcut and dive out of sight to get past him.
memories.source_text: "on the third floor he met Peeves and only narrowly avoided detection by diving sideways through one of his shortcuts."

memories.description: The Fat Lady's password changed at midnight. I couldn't get into Gryffindor Tower so I was stuck outside.
memories.source_text: "Well, the password changed at midnight, so you'll just have to sleep in the corridor, won't you?"

memories.description: Dumbledore tightened security and changed things so I couldn't just get in whenever I wanted.
memories.source_text: "If you're angry, go and take it up with the headmaster, he's the one who's tightened security."

memories.description: Dumbledore came back an hour ago. He's at Hogwarts now.
memories.source_text: "Professor Dumbledore returned to the school an hour ago."

memories.description: Apparently Dumbledore seemed in good spirits but a bit tired when he arrived.
memories.source_text: "He appeared, according to the Baron, to be in good spirits, though a little tired, of course."

memories.description: At first I thought Dumbledore might be up on the Astronomy Tower but then Nick said he's in his office, so I'm convinced I can go find him there.
memories.source_text: "Oh, groaning and clanking up on the Astronomy Tower, it's a favorite pastime of his -" "Oh - in his office,"

memories.description: I'm desperate to tell Dumbledore I got the memory. I trust him with this and need to get it to him straight away.
memories.source_text: "Yeah, he has," said Harry, excitement blazing in his chest at the prospect of telling Dumbledore he had secured the memory.

memories.description: A Horcrux is when someone hides part of their soul in an object so they can survive even if their body is destroyed.
memories.source_text: "A Horcrux is the word used for an object in which a person has concealed part of their soul."

memories.description: Making a Horcrux requires murdering someone. Killing tears the soul and that torn piece can be hidden.
memories.source_text: "By committing murder. Killing rips the soul apart."

memories.description: If part of your soul is stored away, you can’t fully die because that piece keeps you anchored to life.
memories.source_text: "Then, even if one’s body is attacked or destroyed, one cannot die, for part of the soul remains earthbound and undamaged."

memories.description: Voldemort was trying to learn whether you could split your soul into more than one Horcrux so you could become even harder to kill.
memories.source_text: "What he particularly wanted from Horace was an opinion on what would happen to the wizard who created more than one Horcrux"

memories.description: Nobody, as far as anyone knew, had ever split their soul into lots of pieces before, so Voldemort was experimenting with something unheard of.
memories.source_text: "As far as I know ... no wizard had ever done more than tear his soul in two."

memories.description: The diary I destroyed was actually one of Voldemort's Horcruxes. That explains why the memory inside could act and hurt Ginny.
memories.source_text: "You handed it to me, Harry. The diary, Riddle’s diary, the one giving instructions on how to reopen the Chamber of Secrets."

memories.description: I can’t believe a memory could become that dangerous. The diary wasn’t just a book, it held a piece of him that could act on its own.
memories.source_text: "A mere memory starting to act and think for itself? A mere memory, sapping the life out of the girl into whose hands it had fallen?"

memories.description: Voldemort was obsessed and dangerous from a young age. He wasn’t just clever, he was willing to ruin his own soul to avoid death.
memories.source_text: "You heard Voldemort: What he particularly wanted from Horace was an opinion ..."

memories.description: Slughorn reacted like splitting a soul into seven pieces is monstrous. The idea of multiple Horcruxes is horrifying and unnatural.
memories.source_text: "Merlin’s beard, Tom! Seven! Isn’t it bad enough to think of killing one person? And in any case ... bad enough to divide the soul ... but to rip it into seven pieces ..."

memories.description: Hearing that existence with a split soul is worse than death makes me even more certain Voldemort’s path was monstrous.
memories.source_text: "Death would be preferable."

memories.description: It's Ron's birthday. I handed him a present and he already has a pile of gifts on his bed.
memories.source_text: "Happy birthday, Ron," said Harry, when they were woken on the first of March by Seamus and Dean leaving noisily for breakfast. "Have a present." He threw the package across onto Ron's bed

memories.description: I use the Marauder's Map and hide it after every use. I tapped it and said the charm to open it quietly.
memories.source_text: "I solemnly swear that I am up to no good," so that Neville, who was passing the foot of his bed at the time, would not hear.

memories.description: Malfoy is missing from all the obvious places in the school. He's not at the Slytherin table, not near Snape, and not in any of the bathrooms or the hospital wing.
memories.source_text: "I don't think he's in his bed. . . ." "He did not seem to be at the Slytherin table in the Great Hall, eating breakfast. . . . He was nowhere near Snape, who was sitting in his study. . . . He wasn't in any of the bathrooms or in the hospital wing."

memories.description: Malfoy's disappearances are not random. There must be an explanation, but I don't know what it is yet and tailing him all day is impossible with my schedule.
memories.source_text: "There had to be an explanation for Malfoy's periodic disappearances, but he simply could not think what it could be."

memories.description: I lied to myself with the map and closed it even though I hadn't solved anything.
memories.source_text: "Harry tapped the map with his wand, muttered, 'Mischief managed,' though it hadn't been, and got dressed, thinking hard."

memories.description: Ron is a complete mess over some girl. I know he's distracted and not himself this morning.
memories.source_text: "'Harry!' said Ron suddenly. 'What?' 'Harry, I can't stand it!' 'You can't stand what?' 'I can’t stop thinking about her!' said Ron hoarsely."

memories.description: Romilda Vane is the girl Ron can't stop thinking about.
memories.source_text: "'Romilda Vane,' said Ron softly,"

memories.description: Ron suddenly gets violent and just hit me. He's furious and about to hit me again.
memories.source_text: "He turned to leave; he had got two steps toward the door when a crashing blow hit him on the right ear. Staggering, he looked around. Ron's fist was drawn right back; his face was contorted with rage; he was about to strike again."

memories.description: Right now I didn't get what I wanted from Slughorn. Plain and simple.
memories.source_text: “No joy,” said Harry, as Ron joined them.

memories.description: I'm on a roll thanks to the Felix Felicis. Everything feels like it's pointing me the right way.
memories.source_text: He did not have to creep along, for he met nobody on his way, but this did not surprise him in the slightest: This evening, he was the luckiest person at Hogwarts.

memories.description: Filch left the front door unlocked. That's how I got out.
memories.source_text: When he reached the entrance hall he saw that Filch had forgotten to lock the front door.

memories.description: Going to the vegetable patch paid off. Slughorn was there when I showed up.
memories.source_text: It was not strictly on the way, but it seemed clear to Harry that this was a whim on which he should act, so he directed his feet immediately toward the vegetable patch, where he was pleased, but not altogether surprised, to find Professor Slughorn in conversation with Professor Sprout.

memories.description: Aragog has died. Hagrid is crushed and wants a proper burial.
memories.source_text: “It’s not ev’ryone appreciates how beau’iful they are,” said Hagrid to Slughorn’s back.

memories.description: Slughorn's interest in Aragog is not sentimental. He sees the spider's venom as something valuable to obtain.
memories.source_text: “But acromantula venom is very valuable . . . If the beast only just died it might not yet have dried out. . . . Of course, I wouldn’t want to do anything insensitive if Hagrid is upset . . . but if there was any way to procure some . . . I mean, it’s almost impossible to get venom from an acromantula while it’s alive. . . .”

memories.description: I got Slughorn to come to Hagrid's and pretend to pay respects. He agreed quick enough when there was something in it for him.
memories.source_text: “Well, if you wanted to come, Professor, Hagrid would probably be really pleased. . . . Give Aragog a better send-off, you know . . .” “Yes, of course,” said Slughorn, his eyes now gleaming with enthusiasm. “I tell you what, Harry, I’ll meet you down there with a bottle or two.”

memories.description: He did it. Snape listened at the door and told Voldemort, and because of him my mum and dad were hunted. I am furious and I want answers.
memories.source_text: "It was Snape who had overheard the prophecy. It was Snape who had carried the news of the prophecy to Voldemort."

memories.description: Dumbledore thinks a Horcrux is hidden in a seaside cave that Tom Riddle haunted. We're going after it.
memories.source_text: "I believe it to be hidden in a cave on the coast many miles from here"

memories.description: Dumbledore is still trusting me enough to bring me along. I feel needed and I refuse to be left out, no matter how angry I am.
memories.source_text: "Harry, I promised that you could come with me."

memories.description: Of course they were Crabbe and Goyle in disguise. I keep walking past Malfoy and his lot and not twigging he's right under our noses.
memories.source_text: "Those two girls I saw him with when he missed Quidditch — ha! Crabbe and Goyle!" "Do you mean to say," said Hermione in a hushed voice, "that that little girl whose scales I repaired — ?" "Yeah, of course!" said Harry loudly, staring at her.

memories.description: If Malfoy has shown them the Dark Mark then that explains why they put up with him. That changes how dangerous this lot might be.
memories.source_text: "Well, they wouldn’t, would they, if he’s shown them his Dark Mark?" said Harry.

memories.description: I know I need that memory from Slughorn. As much as I want to chase Malfoy, getting Slughorn's memory is what matters most right now.
memories.source_text: "But, Harry, before you get all excited, I still don’t think you’ll be able to get into the Room of Requirement without knowing what’s there first. And I don’t think you should forget" — she heaved her bag onto her shoulder and gave him a very serious look — "that what you’re supposed to be concentrating on is getting that memory from Slughorn. Good night."

memories.description: Snape still hates me and is happy to punish me for any slip up. I can't let him wind me up but it still gets to me.
memories.source_text: "Late again, Potter," said Snape coldly, as Harry hurried into the candlelit classroom. "Ten points from Gryffindor."

memories.description: I have no idea how to get Slughorn's memory out of him yet. While I try to work that out, it makes sense to find out what Malfoy is up to.
memories.source_text: "I haven’t forgotten about Slughorn, but I haven’t got a clue how to get that memory off him, and until I get a brain wave why shouldn’t I find out what Malfoy’s doing?"

memories.description: I lied because I was annoyed you woke me up, and the password is still 'tapeworm'.
memories.source_text: All right, I lied! I was annoyed you woke me up! The password’s still 'tapeworm'!

memories.description: I said 'toffee éclairs' to the gargoyle so it would let me in.
memories.source_text: toffee éclairs

memories.description: I've got the memory from Slughorn in this tiny bottle. This is what we've been after.
memories.source_text: Sir, I’ve got it. I’ve got the memory from Slughorn.

memories.description: Of course I've got it now. I actually have the memory and I can show it to Dumbledore.
memories.source_text: Sir, I’ve got it. I’ve got the memory from Slughorn.

memories.description: He doesn’t want to talk to me. He can tell I’ve been trying to get him on his own and he won’t let it happen.
memories.source_text: He doesn’t want to talk to me, Hermione!

memories.description: I use the Marauder’s Map and the Invisibility Cloak to get around and see what’s going on without being seen.
memories.source_text: I pulled the Marauder’s Map and his Invisibility Cloak from his bag.

memories.description: If Goyle’s standing outside that wall, someone is inside and they’re guarding the room.
memories.source_text: There, alone in the seventh-floor corridor, was Gregory Goyle.

memories.description: I scared Goyle off by talking to him quietly. Making him panic confirms people like him are easily rattled.
memories.source_text: Hello . . . you’re very pretty, aren’t you?

memories.description: Tonks looked awful and off her normal self. She’s not her usual confident self.
memories.source_text: I thought she looked terrible: thinner than usual, her mouse-colored hair lank.

memories.description: Dumbledore’s not in his office. He’s gone away again and people don’t seem to know where he is.
memories.source_text: He’s not there. Apparently he’s gone away again.

memories.description: I miss Sirius. Saying it out loud made it clear I’m still grieving and that other people notice when his name is mentioned.
memories.source_text: I’m sorry. I mean . . . I miss him, as well.

memories.description: When Tonks nearly cried at Sirius’s name and her Patronus changed, I started wondering if her Patronus might have become him. Maybe she’s attached to Sirius in some way.
memories.source_text: I wondered whether it hadn’t become . . . you know . . . him.

memories.description: I don’t get letters from the Order anymore since Sirius died. I’m out of the loop.
memories.source_text: No one from the Order writes to me anymore, said Harry, not since Sirius —

memories.description: I get furious when I can’t find answers. I’ll keep pushing until I get something.
memories.source_text: Losing his patience completely, Harry ran at the wall and kicked it.

memories.description: He's hurt. Albus is injured and I have to get him help.
memories.source_text: “He’s hurt,” said Harry.

memories.description: I need to move him inside the pub so I can run up to Hogwarts and fetch help.
memories.source_text: “Madam Rosmerta, can he come into the Three Broomsticks while I go up to the school and get help for him?”

memories.description: The Dark Mark is hovering over Hogwarts. Something terrible is happening there right now.
memories.source_text: “The — the Dark Mark, Albus.” And she pointed into the sky, in the direction of Hogwarts.

memories.description: If someone helps me carry him we can get Albus into the Three Broomsticks immediately.
memories.source_text: “If you help me support him,” said Harry, not listening to her, “I think we can get him inside —”

memories.description: Magic does leave traces. Things like a hidden boat or a chain can be tracked by someone who knows the maker's style.
memories.source_text: Magic always leaves traces

memories.description: Voldemort did not expect someone my age to get this far. I'm not supposed to 'register' the same way as a powerful adult wizard.
memories.source_text: Voldemort would never have expected a sixteen-year-old to reach this place: I think it unlikely that your powers will register compared to mine

memories.description: The creatures in the lake will probably react once they figure out we are not Voldemort. They're dangerous and we can't assume they'll stay calm.
memories.source_text: I think we must resign ourselves to the fact that they will, at some point, realize we are not Lord Voldemort

memories.description: There are dead bodies floating under the water. They look eerie and they can lunge out when disturbed.
memories.source_text: There are bodies in here!

memories.description: That green potion has been set up so you have to drink it to reach whatever is at the bottom. You can't scoop it out or charm it away.
memories.source_text: I can only conclude that this potion is supposed to be drunk

memories.description: I was brought along so I would force Dumbledore to keep drinking even if it hurts him. I promised to follow his orders even when it scares me.
memories.source_text: Once and for all, Harry, do I have your word that you will do all in your power to make me keep drinking?

memories.description: Dumbledore literally cannot get close to the potion because of his burned hand. He needs me to do the difficult part if things go wrong.
memories.source_text: I cannot touch

memories.description: We did it. We actually got the Horcrux.
memories.source_text: "We did it, Professor!" "We did it! We got the Horcrux!"

memories.description: That potion was not a health drink. It messed him up and knocked him right down.
memories.source_text: "That potion . . . was no health drink."

memories.description: I have to get him to the hospital wing. I can't leave him here; I need to help him now.
memories.source_text: "Sir — it’s okay, sir, you’re going to be all right, don’t worry —"

memories.description: Dumbledore is going to take me with him if he finds another Horcrux. I'm actually going to go with Dumbledore and try to destroy them.
memories.source_text: "positively awed when he told them about Voldemort’s Horcruxes and Dumbledore’s promise to take Harry along, should he find another one."

memories.description: I silenced the people near us with Muffliato so I could tell Ron and Hermione everything without being overheard.
memories.source_text: "having first cast the Muffliato spell upon those nearest them"

memories.description: Ginny and Dean have split up. That could affect the Quidditch team if they're not speaking.
memories.source_text: "Ginny and Dean split up too, Harry."

memories.description: My Charms worked; my vinegar turned to ice during the lesson.
memories.source_text: "Harry’s vinegar turned to ice; Ron’s flask exploded."

memories.description: Katie’s back and she’s fine. They let her out of St. Mungo’s and she even went home for a few days.
memories.source_text: “I’m really well!” she said happily. “They let me out of St. Mungo’s on Monday, I had a couple of days at home with Mum and Dad and then came back here this morning.”

memories.description: Someone gave Katie the necklace in the girls' bathroom at the Three Broomsticks and she has no memory of who did it.
memories.source_text: “No,” said Katie, shaking her head ruefully. “Everyone’s been asking me, but I haven’t got a clue. The last thing I remember was walking into the ladies’ in the Three Broomsticks.”

memories.description: It might not have been actually a woman. With Polyjuice around, any bloke could have been made to look like a girl. That makes the whole thing more dangerous.
memories.source_text: “Or someone who looked like a girl or a woman,” said Harry. “Don’t forget, there was a cauldron full of Polyjuice Potion at Hogwarts. We know some of it got stolen.”

memories.description: I want another hit of Felix and I’m going back to the Room of Requirement to try again. I’m not giving up on finding what we need.
memories.source_text: “I think I’m going to take another swig of Felix,” said Harry, “and have a go at the Room of Requirement again.”

memories.description: Felix is really complicated and takes six months to brew. I can’t just make a quick stash of it.
memories.source_text: Harry pulled his copy of Advanced Potion-Making out of his bag and looked up Felix Felicis. “Blimey, it’s seriously complicated,” he said, running an eye down the list of ingredients. “And it takes six months.”

memories.description: The Dark Mark is over Hogwarts. That green skull with the serpent tongue is hanging above the school and it means Death Eaters have been there.
memories.source_text: "There it was, hanging in the sky above the school: the blazing green skull with a serpent tongue, the mark Death Eaters left behind whenever they had entered a building . . . wherever they had murdered."

memories.description: I felt dread the second I saw the Mark. This is serious, that feeling was instant and cold.
memories.source_text: "Dread flooded Harry at the sound of the words."

memories.description: Dumbledore wants Severus woken and brought to him, and he ordered me to say nothing to anyone and not to take off the Invisibility Cloak.
memories.source_text: "Go and wake Severus," said Dumbledore faintly but clearly. "Tell him what has happened and bring him to me. Do nothing else, speak to nobody else, and do not remove your Cloak."

memories.description: Dumbledore wants Rosmerta to contact the Ministry right away in case nobody at Hogwarts knows yet.
memories.source_text: "Rosmerta, please send a message to the Ministry," said Dumbledore.

memories.description: There are brooms behind the bar in the pub and I can summon them with Accio. Two brooms came racing out and stopped by me.
memories.source_text: "I've got a couple behind the bar," she said, looking very frightened. "Shall I run and fetch — ?" "No, Harry can do it." Harry raised his wand at once. "Accio Rosmerta's Brooms!"

memories.description: I was frozen with horror, not a spell. It wasn't magic stopping me, it was shock. Once they moved I could move.
memories.source_text: "As they vanished through the door, Harry realized he could move again. What was now holding him paralyzed against the wall was not magic, but horror and shock."

memories.description: Snape shoved Malfoy out and barked at everyone to get out. He wasn't hanging about, he grabbed Malfoy and forced him through the door.
memories.source_text: "Out of here, quickly," said Snape. He seized Malfoy by the scruff of the neck and forced him through the door ahead of the rest;

memories.description: I blasted the Death Eater with Petrificus Totalus and he went rigid. That let me clamber over him and get down the stairs.
memories.source_text: "Petrificus Totalus!"

memories.description: There was Polyjuice involved at Hogwarts and people could look like girls or women if they wanted. That could explain a lot about who was sneaking around.
memories.source_text: "Or someone who looked like a girl or a woman," said Harry.

memories.description: I kept thinking more Felix would fix things, especially to get time alone with Ginny or to slip into the Room of Requirement, but Hermione was right that luck only goes so far.
memories.source_text: "I think I\'m going to take another swig of Felix," said Harry, "and have a go at the Room of Requirement again."

memories.description: I had Sectumsempra marked in Advanced Potion-Making and I really did not know what it did. I was tempted to try it on McLaggen if I ever got the chance.
memories.source_text: "He had still not found out what it did, mainly because he did not want to test it around Hermione, but he was considering trying it out on McLaggen"

memories.description: I'm stuck between wanting Ginny and not wanting to betray Ron. I keep talking to Ginny and looking for chances to be alone with her, but I'm worried about Ron's reaction.
memories.source_text: "The battle still raged inside his head: Ginny or Ron?"

memories.description: Malfoy was in a bathroom with Moaning Myrtle, and when I found him he was actually crying and terrified about something he had to do.
memories.source_text: "he saw Malfoy\'s tiny, labeled dot standing in a boys\' bathroom on the floor below, accompanied, not by Crabbe or Goyle, but by Moaning Myrtle."

memories.description: I cast Sectumsempra without knowing what it would do and it seriously injured Malfoy. I feel sick about it and I did not mean for him to get hurt like that.
memories.source_text: "SECTUMSEMPRA! bellowed Harry from the floor, waving his wand wildly."

memories.description: Snape thinks I know Dark Magic because I used Sectumsempra. He suspects I learned it from somewhere suspicious and he is furious.
memories.source_text: "Apparently I underestimated you, Potter," he said quietly. "Who would have thought you knew such Dark Magic? Who taught you that spell?"

memories.description: I was frozen by pure horror, not by a spell. I couldn't move because I was terrified, not because someone had me under a jinx.
memories.source_text: "What was now holding him paralyzed against the wall was not magic, but horror and shock."

memories.description: I cast or someone cast Petrificus Totalus on that Death Eater and he went rigid. That gave me a way past him.
memories.source_text: "'Petrificus Totalus!' The Death Eater buckled as though hit in the back with something solid and fell to the ground, rigid as a waxwork"

memories.description: Dumbledore and Snape are connected in whatever just happened. If I can get them both together I can undo this.
memories.source_text: "He had to get to Dumbledore and he had to catch Snape. Somehow the two things were linked."

memories.description: Dumbledore is not dead. I refuse to accept that. There has to be some way to fix this.
memories.source_text: "Dumbledore could not have died."

memories.description: Snape shouted it's over and ran off with Malfoy. They got through the fight without a scratch. They're the ones who left when everything exploded.
memories.source_text: "he heard the hated voice shout, 'It's over, time to go!' and saw Snape disappearing around the corner at the far end of the corridor; he and Malfoy seemed to have forced their way through the fight unscathed."

memories.description: I protested, but he reminded me I swore to obey him, so I have to do as he says even if I don't want to.
memories.source_text: "But -"

memories.description: He's ordering me to leave and expects me to follow that promise right away.
memories.source_text: "You swore to obey me, Harry - go!"

memories.description: He's staying behind and waiting, so I'm the one who has to move on.
memories.source_text: "I shall wait here."

memories.description: This place is impossible for ordinary people to get to. Voldemort or his kind had to use magic to bring victims here.
memories.source_text: "No Muggle could reach this rock unless they were uncommonly good mountaineers, and boats cannot approach the cliffs, the waters around them are too dangerous."

memories.description: The cave is saturated with magic. I could feel it as soon as we got in.
memories.source_text: "It has known magic,"

memories.description: To get through the entrance the door wants blood as payment. It is crude and ugly but it is the lock.
memories.source_text: "I rather think that we are required to make payment to pass."

memories.description: Dumbledore was willing to use his own blood but he thought my blood mattered more for the protection on the door. He treats me like I matter in this fight.
memories.source_text: "But your blood is worth more than mine."

memories.description: The Horcrux is not at the bottom or on the shore. It sits in the middle of that black lake.
memories.source_text: "I think the Horcrux is in the middle."

memories.description: The lake is defended by things that will react if we try to grab the Horcrux. Trying an obvious trick told us that.
memories.source_text: "Something, I think, that is ready to respond should we attempt to seize the Horcrux."

memories.description: Dumbledore can heal himself fast. I stopped thinking of him as just frail with one bad hand. He can still do real, serious magic when it counts.
memories.source_text: "You are very kind, Harry," said Dumbledore, now passing the tip of his wand over the deep cut he had made in his own arm, so that it healed instantly, just as Snape had healed Malfoy’s wounds.

memories.description: Dumbledore's light showed us the fissure and the path. Small spells like that can change everything in a dangerous place.
memories.source_text: "Lumos,"

memories.description: He needs to keep drinking that potion even if it tortures him. I had to force him to keep going to get to the Horcrux.
memories.source_text: "You\'ve got to keep drinking, remember? You told me you had to keep drinking."

memories.description: When he came back to himself he needed water badly. I tried every spell and even plunged the goblet into the lake to get him any I could.
memories.source_text: "Water," croaked Dumbledore.

memories.description: Dumbledore is fallible and exhausted. He can still work magic, but he can also be wiped out and need me to help him. I can actually support him when he cannot go on alone.
memories.source_text: "I am weak," he said.

memories.description: The locket was down there in the basin and he took it. That thing is one of the pieces we are after and he made sure it was safe.
memories.source_text: "Dumbledore scooped the locket from the bottom of the stone basin and stowed it inside his robes."

memories.description: He relied on me and praised me for it. I did not just follow orders, I saved us both from the Inferi and helped him when he was weak.
memories.source_text: "You did well, very well, Harry."

memories.description: Fire stops Inferi. Dumbledore made that ring and it kept them safe long enough to leave. Fire is the one thing they will not cross.
memories.source_text: "Through the darkness, fire erupted: crimson and gold, a ring of fire that surrounded the rock so that the Inferi... did not dare pass through the flames."

memories.description: Right now I think the Prince was brilliant at Potions and his tricks saved people. I still want that book back because it helps, even if I know Snape might be after it.
memories.source_text: "He was a genius, the Prince. Anyway . . . without his bezoar tip . . . I wouldn’t be here to discuss it, would I?"

memories.description: Dumbledore wants to see me straight away. I need to go, maybe he found something about the book or he has important news.
memories.source_text: "He wants me to go to his office as quick as I can!"

memories.description: Snape is piling on detentions to keep me away from everything I want to be doing, and it feels deliberate. He is definitely making my life harder.
memories.source_text: "He’s hinting now that if I don’t get all the boxes done by the end of term, we’ll carry on next year."

memories.description: Ginny teases people about the tattoo nonsense and she sits close to me. I like having her around and I don’t want Snape’s detentions to steal my time with her.
memories.source_text: "I told her it’s a Hungarian Horntail," said Ginny

memories.description: Trelawney says someone was in the Room of Requirement and there was a whooping voice in there. If someone else is using it then my book might be at risk.
memories.source_text: "I walked into the room and I heard a voice, which has never happened before in all my years of hiding — of using the room, I mean."

memories.description: Snape is going to take my books and he knows about that Potions book. I have to get it back if I can.
memories.source_text: "Bring me your schoolbag," said Snape softly, "and all of your schoolbooks. All of them. Bring them to me here. Now!"

memories.description: Snape thinks I cheated and he has me down for detention every Saturday until the end of term. Great timing with the match.
memories.source_text: "Do you know what I think, Potter?" said Snape, very quietly. "I think that you are a liar and a cheat and that you deserve detention with me every Saturday until the end of term."

memories.description: I still defend the book because I believe the Prince just copied spells for his own notes, not to encourage anyone to use them.
memories.source_text: "The Prince only copied it out! It’s not like he was advising anyone to use it!"

memories.description: Someone has my Potions book under a fake name in it. That name in the front cover has landed me in even more trouble.
memories.source_text: "This is the copy of Advanced Potion-Making that you purchased from Flourish and Blotts?" "Yes," said Harry firmly. "Then why," asked Snape, "does it have the name ‘Roonil Wazlib’ written inside the front cover?"

memories.description: I told Ginny she would play Seeker and I hoped it would fix things between her and Dean. I want to protect her and make things right if I can.
memories.source_text: "I had just told her that she would be playing Seeker on Saturday and that Dean would be rejoining the team as Chaser in her place."

memories.description: My Saturday detentions are pointless, boring copy work and I am not allowed to use magic. Snape is enjoying making me do it.
memories.source_text: "They are the records of other Hogwarts wrongdoers and their punishments. Where the ink has grown faint, or the cards have suffered damage from mice, we would like you to copy out the crimes and punishments afresh and, making sure that they are in alphabetical order, replace them in the boxes. You will not use magic."

memories.description: Voldemort killed my dad first and then went for my mum. She could have run but she chose to protect me.
memories.source_text: "Voldemort murdered him and then stepped over his body toward my mum,"

memories.description: I accept that I'm the Chosen One and that means I have to stop him. I need information that will help me do it.
memories.source_text: "I am the Chosen One."

memories.description: Slughorn just gave me the memory I needed. He helped me even though he was ashamed. I owe him for this.
memories.source_text: "Thank you very much, Professor."

memories.description: Hagrid raised Aragog from an egg. He was very attached to him.
memories.source_text: "I had him from an egg, yeh know," said Hagrid morosely.

memories.description: Snape hated my dad and Sirius. People Snape hates often end up dead. That makes me suspicious as hell of him.
memories.source_text: "He hated my dad like he hated Sirius! Haven’t you noticed, Professor, how the people Snape hates tend to end up dead?"

memories.description: Dumbledore trusts Snape, but I do not. I think Snape is up to something with Malfoy and I am not convinced by anyone who tells me otherwise.
memories.source_text: "I trust Severus Snape completely."

memories.description: If I go with Dumbledore I must follow orders instantly, even if he tells me to run or hide or leave him. I promised I would.
memories.source_text: "I take you with me on one condition: that you obey any command I might give you at once, and without question."

memories.description: Dumbledore wants me to come along tonight and told me to grab the Invisibility Cloak and meet him fast.
memories.source_text: "Very good. Then I wish you to go and fetch your Invisibility Cloak and meet me in the entrance hall in five minutes’ time."

memories.description: I took the Marauder’s Map and Felix Felicis and shoved the map at Hermione and the potion at Ron because I need them to watch Malfoy and Snape while I go with Dumbledore.
memories.source_text: "I’ve got to be quick,"

memories.description: Dumbledore put extra protections in the school for tonight, but if Snape is involved he might know how to get around them. That is why I want my friends watching.
memories.source_text: "Dumbledore says he’s put extra protection in the school,"

memories.description: I trust Ron and Hermione to keep an eye on things while I go with Dumbledore. I left them tools to help: the map and some Felix Felicis.
memories.source_text: "You need what’s wrapped in them, it’s the Felix Felicis."

memories.description: Hagrid's hut is burning and Fang is trapped inside. I heard Hagrid yelling about Fang and we had to put the flames out with Aguamenti.
memories.source_text: "Hagrid’s house was on fire."

memories.description: Snape kept blocking my spells and taunting me, saying I can't use Unforgivable Curses and that I lack the nerve and skill.
memories.source_text: "You haven’t got the nerve or the ability" and "No Unforgivable Curses from you, Potter!"

memories.description: Snape was the one who invented those spells in my old Potions book. He calls himself the Half-Blood Prince and is furious that I used them.
memories.source_text: "You dare use my own spells against me, Potter? It was I who invented them... I, the Half-Blood Prince!"

memories.description: The Death Eaters were told to leave me for Voldemort, and Snape ordered the others to go even while he stayed fighting me.
memories.source_text: "Have you forgotten our orders? Potter belongs to the Dark Lord — we are to leave him! Go! Go!"

memories.description: Dumbledore is dead and I saw Snape kill him. I couldn't believe it when I told Hagrid and he didn't want to accept it.
memories.source_text: "He’s dead. Snape killed him."

memories.description: Buckbeak attacked Snape and that gave Snape a chance to escape. The hippogriff circled the gates while Snape Disapparated.
memories.source_text: "Buckbeak had flown at Snape..."

memories.description: Fang survived the fire and was alive and howling when we put the flames out. He's okay, which felt like the only good thing in that moment.
memories.source_text: "Fang’s in there, yer evil — !"

memories.description: I hate Snape more than I thought possible. After everything I saw and after Dumbledore, my anger at Snape is as strong as my hatred for Voldemort.
memories.source_text: "You dare use my own spells against me, Potter?... I, the Half-Blood Prince!" and Harry's internal: "he now hated as much as he hated Voldemort himself"

memories.description: They want us to go into hiding and the Order is offering real protection, the best they can give.
memories.source_text: You’ve got to go into hiding and the Order wants to help. You’re being offered serious protection, the best there is.

memories.description: The Ministry can’t be trusted anymore. I believe people inside it have been turned against us.
memories.source_text: You heard what Mr. Weasley and Kingsley said. We think the Ministry has been infiltrated.

memories.description: My uncle keeps wanting someone official like Kingsley to take charge. He still looks to the establishment for protection even when he hates and mistrusts the magical world.
memories.source_text: I still don’t see why we can’t have that Kingsley bloke.

memories.description: I should have shown that book to Dumbledore. I kept thinking I had proof Snape was like Voldemort at school, and I blamed myself for not telling Dumbledore.
memories.source_text: I should've shown the book to Dumbledore," said Harry.

memories.description: Dumbledore probably knew the Prince bit about Snape's family. That makes me think Dumbledore might have known more than he let on.
memories.source_text: I’ll bet Dumbledore knew his mother was called ‘Prince.’

memories.description: I can't be with Ginny anymore. I have to do things on my own and I won't put her in danger just because we're together.
memories.source_text: "I can't be involved with you anymore. We can't be together."

memories.description: They used the Room of Requirement and those Vanishing Cabinets to get Death Eaters into the castle. That's how they walked straight in.
memories.source_text: So they got in through the Room of Requirement.

memories.description: Snape wasn't trying to stop the Death Eaters. He came back to help them, not to save us. I can't stand it.
memories.source_text: He was, but to help them, not to stop them

memories.description: Snape shouted 'It's over' after he came through the dust with Malfoy. He meant it. He did what he'd planned.
memories.source_text: He shouted, 'It's over,'

memories.description: At first I thought Snape might not have known, but everything fits together now and he still helped them. That makes him just as guilty.
memories.source_text: I don't think he knew they were coming before Filius told him

memories.description: After they came through the Room of Requirement, the Death Eaters were heading straight for the Astronomy Tower. That's where it all built up.
memories.source_text: We found the Death Eaters minutes later, heading in the direction of the Astronomy Tower.

memories.description: So Scrimgeour thinks I was Dumbledore's favorite and expects me to be devastated. He is using how close we were as leverage.
memories.source_text: "You are, of course, devastated," he said. "I know that you were very close to Dumbledore. I think you may have been his favorite pupil ever. The bond between the two of you —"

memories.description: They are saying I was with Dumbledore the night he left and want people to believe I know more than I will tell.
memories.source_text: "The word is that you were with him when he left the school the night that he died."

memories.description: I don't buy their protection. Voldemort wants to kill me himself, and Aurors will not stop him. I will not trade silence or loyalty for a couple of guards.
memories.source_text: "The Ministry can offer you all sorts of protection, you know, Harry. I would be delighted to place a couple of my Aurors at your service —"

memories.description: He wanted me to publicly praise the Ministry to boost morale in return for favors. I see how they try to use me as a propaganda tool instead of actually helping.
memories.source_text: "the request I made of you at Christmas —" "What request? Oh yeah . . . the one where I tell the world what a great job you’re doing in exchange for —" "— for raising everyone’s morale!"

memories.description: I'm not going to be their mouthpiece. They think I'm Dumbledore's man and they hate that. That loyalty is mine and I will not sell it.
memories.source_text: "Released Stan Shunpike yet?" "I see you are —" "Dumbledore’s man through and through," said Harry. "That’s right."

memories.description: The ring that was a Horcrux is gone. It was hidden in the Gaunts' ruin and Dumbledore destroyed it.
memories.source_text: "The ring is no longer a Horcrux."

memories.description: There are more Horcruxes out there. We took out two, but there are still at least four left.
memories.source_text: "You destroyed the diary and I the ring, but if we are right in our theory of a seven-part soul, four Horcruxes remain."

memories.description: Dumbledore thinks the locket and Hufflepuff's cup are definitely Horcruxes.
memories.source_text: "The locket!" "Hufflepuff’s cup!"

memories.description: Voldemort probably wanted items from the four founders. He definitely has Slytherin and maybe Hufflepuff. He might have something from Ravenclaw or Gryffindor.
memories.source_text: "The remaining two, assuming again that he created a total of six, are more of a problem... I will hazard a guess that, having secured objects from Hufflepuff and Slytherin, he set out to track down objects owned by Gryffindor or Ravenclaw."

memories.description: Dumbledore guesses Nagini, the snake, might be a Horcrux. Voldemort could have turned her into one after she killed someone.
memories.source_text: "I think I know what the sixth Horcrux is. I wonder what you will say when I confess that I have been curious for a while about the behavior of the snake, Nagini?"

memories.description: Summary: diary and ring destroyed. Cup, locket, and Nagini still exist. There may also be a founder's item left.
memories.source_text: "So, the diary's gone, the ring's gone. The cup, the locket, and the snake are still intact..."

memories.description: Dumbledore trusts me enough to let me help look for and destroy Horcruxes. I can join him on the mission.
memories.source_text: "And if you do," said Harry quickly, "can I come with you and help get rid of it?" Dumbledore looked at Harry very intently for a moment before saying, "Yes, I think so."

memories.description: Voldemort probably does not instantly know when a Horcrux is destroyed. He might feel it only at death or later, not immediately.
memories.source_text: "Does Voldemort know when a Horcrux is destroyed, sir? Can he feel it?" "A very interesting question, Harry. I believe not."

memories.description: If all the Horcruxes are destroyed, Voldemort can be killed. He will still be dangerous, but mortal.
memories.source_text: "Without his Horcruxes, Voldemort will be a mortal man with a maimed and diminished soul."

memories.description: My ability to love is a real power against Voldemort. It's not flashy, but it's what protects me and makes me dangerous to him.
memories.source_text: "You have a power that Voldemort has never had. You can —" "I know!" said Harry impatiently. "I can love!"

memories.description: The prophecy only mattered because Voldemort acted on it. He made me his enemy by choosing to try to kill me.
memories.source_text: "If Voldemort had never heard of the prophecy, would it have been fulfilled? Would it have meant anything? Of course not!"

memories.description: Even without the prophecy, I would still want to finish Voldemort. I wouldn't rest until I tried to stop him.
memories.source_text: "Imagine, please, just for a moment, that you had never heard that prophecy! How would you feel about Voldemort now? Think!"

memories.description: Dumbledore and I agree that it's likely one of us will end up killing the other. It's grim but real.
memories.source_text: "That one of us is going to end up killing the other," said Harry. "Yes."

memories.description: Fenrir lunged at me and I hit him with Petrificus Totalus. He collapsed on top of me and I shoved him off so I could get away.
memories.source_text: Petrificus Totalus!

memories.description: I dropped in on Ginny and Amycus and fired Impedimenta to help her. I will jump into fights if it helps my friends.
memories.source_text: Impedimenta!

memories.description: Snape cannot get away. I have to chase him down even if everything else is chaos around me.
memories.source_text: Snape must not escape, he must catch up with Snape

memories.description: Ginny saw me appear out of nowhere. I pop up where I'm needed and I move fast, even when I'm muddy and bleeding.
memories.source_text: Harry, where did you come from?

memories.description: McGonagall attacked and distracted enemies so I could close in. The teachers are fighting too and I have to press on.
memories.source_text: Take that!

memories.description: Neville is down but conscious. He told me Snape and Malfoy ran past, so they are ahead and I have to catch them.
memories.source_text: M'all right

memories.description: Even though I sprinted, Snape is already far ahead. I need to push myself harder if I'm going to catch him.
memories.source_text: Snape had an immense head start.

memories.description: The Room of Requirement might be blocked off so they cannot escape through the cabinet, or one of them's already gone in and I'm too late
memories.source_text: Was it possible that he had already entered the cabinet in the Room of Requirement, or had the Order made steps to secure it, to prevent the Death Eaters retreating that way?

memories.description: Someone left a bloody footprint leading to the front doors so at least one of them is heading that way
memories.source_text: he spotted a bloody footprint that showed at least one of the fleeing Death Eaters was heading toward the front doors

memories.description: There are three of them running for the gates to Disapparate: the huge blond Death Eater, and Snape and Malfoy
memories.source_text: He could just make out three figures racing across the lawn, heading for the gates beyond which they could Disapparate

memories.description: I pushed past everyone without waiting because I had to catch them now
memories.source_text: “Out of the way!” yelled Harry, knocking two boys aside as he sprinted toward the landing and down the remainder of the marble staircase.

memories.description: The front entrance is wrecked and people are terrified; whatever happened inside spilled out onto the grounds
memories.source_text: The oak front doors had been blasted open, there were smears of blood on the flagstones, and several terrified students stood huddled against the walls

memories.description: He's calling me like he always does. Sixteen years of that exact yell means I'm the one he wants again. Great.
memories.source_text: ["Oi! You!"]

memories.description: For a moment I actually thought I saw Dumbledore's eye in the mirror shard. I couldn't believe it!
memories.source_text: ["in which, for a split second, he had thought he saw Dumbledore’s eye"]

memories.description: I saw myself holding a pair of thick woolen socks when I looked in the mirror. Not some grand family or glory, just socks. Weird and a bit sharp, but that's what I saw.
memories.source_text: “I? I see myself holding a pair of thick, woolen socks.”

memories.description: I tore the obituary out of the Prophet, folded it and shoved it inside my Practical Defensive Magic book. I don't want it lying around or anyone else looking at it. I need to keep it to myself for now.
memories.source_text: After several minutes’ thought, Harry tore the obituary out of the Prophet, folded it carefully, and tucked it inside the first volume of Practical Defensive Magic and Its Use Against the Dark Arts.

memories.description: He pretended to be something he was not to fit in with the pure-blood lot. That is exactly what I hate about him. He used his background to get power and respect.
memories.source_text: "He’d play up the pure-blood side so he could get in with Lucius Malfoy and the rest of them. . . . He’s just like Voldemort. Pure-blood mother, Muggle father . . . ashamed of his parentage, trying to make himself feared using the Dark Arts, gave himself an impressive new name — Lord Voldemort — the Half-Blood Prince — how could Dumbledore have missed — ?"

memories.description: I can't believe I was fooled. I trusted him because he helped me, and now I think he knew what I was doing and still let it go on.
memories.source_text: "He knew when I used Sectumsempra. He didn’t really need Legilimency. . . . He might even have known before then, with Slughorn talking about how brilliant I was at Potions. . . . Shouldn’t have left his old book in the bottom of that cupboard, should he?"

memories.description: I see Snape very differently now. I used to respect him more. Now I feel betrayed and angry. I don't trust him anymore.
memories.source_text: "— murderer," spat Harry.

memories.description: I care about Ginny. If anything happened to her because of me I would never forgive myself
memories.source_text: "I care," said Harry. "How do you think I’d feel if this was your funeral . . . and it was my fault. . . ."

memories.description: Ginny never stopped hoping for me and she still likes me. I wish I'd asked her out sooner because we could have had time together
memories.source_text: "I never really gave up on you," she said. "Not really. I always hoped. . . ."

memories.description: I need to get moving and start hunting Horcruxes right away. Staying here with everyone would break me and stop me from doing what must be done
memories.source_text: Moving felt much more bearable than sitting still, just as setting out as soon as possible to track down the Horcruxes and kill Voldemort would feel better than waiting to do it.

memories.description: I can't stand listening to how she feels right now. It hurts too much and I don't think I could stick to my plan if I stayed
memories.source_text: Harry could not bear to hear these things, nor did he think his resolution would hold if he remained sitting beside her.

memories.description: The Prophet is covering up Voldemort. The Ministry must be squeezing them to keep anything important about him out of the paper.
memories.source_text: He was sure that the Ministry was leaning on the Prophet to suppress news about Voldemort.

memories.description: Rita's running a smear piece on Dumbledore. She's digging up everything she can, saying he had a troubled childhood, a reckless youth and all these secrets.
memories.source_text: Rita Skeeter reveals the disturbed childhood, the lawless youth, the lifelong feuds, and the guilty secrets that Dumbledore carried to his grave.

memories.description: There's a full biography coming out next week called The Life and Lies of Albus Dumbledore by Rita Skeeter. It's meant to blow the lid off everything.
memories.source_text: The Life and Lies of Albus Dumbledore, by Rita Skeeter, exclusively interviewed by Betty Braithwaite, page 13, inside.

memories.description: People are going to start asking what the Order was really up to. If this gets out, everyone will question why Dumbledore kept it secret.
memories.source_text: WHAT was the real purpose of the secret organization known as the Order of the Phoenix?

memories.description: They're even promising to explain how Dumbledore died. They're turning his death into another scandalous story.
memories.source_text: HOW did Dumbledore really meet his end? The answers to these and many more questions are explored in the explosive new biography

memories.description: Well, I suppose I can live with her if Mum can. I don’t like saying it, but I don’t hate Fleur outright.
memories.source_text: "She\'s not that bad," said Harry. "Ugly, though," he added hastily, as Ginny raised her eyebrows, and she let out a reluctant giggle.

memories.description: They won\'t find Snape until they find Voldemort. They never have, so they won\'t now. That just makes me furious.
memories.source_text: "Of course there isn\'t," said Harry, who became angry every time this subject cropped up.

memories.description: There are Horcruxes out there and I have to find them. The locket, the cup, the snake, something from Gryffindor or Ravenclaw. I have to get them before Voldemort can be killed.
memories.source_text: He kept reciting their names to himself, as though by listing them he could bring them within reach: the locket . . . the cup . . . the snake . . . something of Gryffindor\'s or Ravenclaw\'s . . .

memories.description: If R.A.B. is involved with the locket, that changes things. Whoever R.A.B. is, they matter to this hunt.
memories.source_text: "R.A.B.?" said Harry, sitting up straight.

memories.description: That's mental. Seeing six of me stripping and stuffing my things away like it was nothing made my skin crawl.
memories.source_text: "The real Harry thought that this might just be the most bizarre thing he had ever seen, and he had seen some extremely odd things."

memories.description: I hate how casual everyone is with my stuff and my image. I want people to treat my privacy like it's worth something.
memories.source_text: "He felt like asking them to show a little more respect for his privacy as they all began stripping off with impunity, clearly much more at ease with displaying his body than they would have been with their own."

memories.description: Right now I'm going with Hagrid on the motorbike in the sidecar. Not thrilled about the attention but that is the plan.
memories.source_text: "An’ you’re with me, Harry. That all righ’?"

memories.description: Moody thinks the Death Eaters will look for the Potters on brooms. So they're setting things up so the broom-riding Potters look most like the real deal.
memories.source_text: "We think the Death Eaters will expect you to be on a broom,"

memories.description: They're coming in about five minutes. I need to be ready.
memories.source_text: "They'll be here in about five minutes,"

memories.description: The plan is that my relatives will drive away first, go ten miles, then Disapparate to safety so no magic in the house gets traced back to me.
memories.source_text: "We shall be leaving before Harry does. Due to the danger of using magic in your house — Harry being still underage, it could provide the Ministry with an excuse to arrest him — we shall be driving, say, ten miles or so, before Disapparating to the safe location we have picked out for you."

memories.description: Mad-Eye can't take me by Side-Along-Apparition. Something about it being impossible right now.
memories.source_text: "Can't do it," said Hestia tersely. "Mad-Eye will explain."

memories.description: They're timing my departure so the protective charm will break exactly when my family gets to safety.
memories.source_text: "We are attempting to time your departure from the house with your family's Disapparition, Harry; thus, the charm breaks at the moment you all head for safety."

memories.description: Dudley actually agreed to go with the Order. If Dudley will go, his parents will too. That means I won't be left behind alone against their stubbornness.
memories.source_text: "Dad,— I'm going with these Order people." (Dudley) and "For the first time in your life, you're talking sense." (Harry)

memories.description: Dudley said I saved his life and thanked me, which is ridiculous but it matters. He admitted I wasn't a waste of space and that shifted things between us, even a bit.
memories.source_text: "You saved my life." (Dudley) and "Not really," said Harry. "It was your soul the dementor would have taken."

memories.description: My relatives really do think I'm worthless. I'm used to it, but the people coming to help actually care about the danger I'm in and the part I play in this fight.
memories.source_text: "They think I’m a waste of space, actually, but I’m used to —" and Hestia: "Don’t these people realize what you’ve been through?"

memories.description: Dedalus and Hestia are actually polite and painfully cheerful about the whole operation. They're trying to keep things moving and get my family out fast.
memories.source_text: "Good day to you, Harry Potter's relatives!" said Dedalus happily, striding into the living room. ... "We shall be leaving before Harry does."

memories.description: Kingsley is the one protecting the Prime Minister. The Dursleys like him because he looks and sounds proper, but that doesn't change anything about what's happening.
memories.source_text: Kingsley is protecting the Mug I mean, your Prime Minister.

memories.description: Those crashes and explosions and derailments are not random. They are attacks, not simple accidents.
memories.source_text: These accidents aren't accidents

memories.description: Voldemort is behind this and he is killing Muggles on purpose. He does it for pleasure, plain and simple.
memories.source_text: he kills Muggles for fun

memories.description: The fogs are caused by dementors. They feed off fear and despair and that's why everything feels worse.
memories.source_text: Even the fogs they're caused by dementors

memories.description: There are far more dementors than the two that attacked us. There could be hundreds or even thousands now because they multiply whenever there's fear.
memories.source_text: More? laughed Harry There are hundreds, maybe thousands by this time

memories.description: I trust people like Hestia Jones and Dedalus Diggle to handle things if needed. They're capable and ready.
memories.source_text: But Hestia Jones and Dedalus Diggle are more than up to the job

memories.description: He's dead. I saw Snape cast Avada Kedavra and kill Dumbledore.
memories.source_text: "Snape killed him," said Harry. "I was there, I saw it. ... and then Snape ... did it. The Avada Kedavra."

memories.description: Snape gave Voldemort the info that led him to my mum and dad. He lied about being sorry to get Dumbledore to trust him.
memories.source_text: "Snape passed Voldemort the information that made Voldemort hunt down my mum and dad. Then Snape told Dumbledore he hadn't realized what he was doing, he was really sorry he'd done it, sorry that they were dead."

memories.description: Bill's alive but he's been horrifically mauled by Greyback. He probably won't become a full werewolf but those wounds are cursed and he could have wolfish traits for ever.
memories.source_text: "He stepped over Bill, but it's all right, he's alive." "Greyback attacked him." "No charm will work on these," said Madam Pomfrey. "I've tried everything I know, but there is no cure for werewolf bites." "No, I don't think that Bill will be a true werewolf," said Lupin, "but that does not mean that there won't be some contamination. Those are cursed wounds. They are unlikely ever to heal fully, and and Bill might have some wolfish characteristics from now on."

memories.description: The Felix potion saved us. If we'd not had it, we might all have been killed.
memories.source_text: "Harry, if we hadn't had your Felix potion, I think we'd all have been killed, but everything seemed to just miss us —"

memories.description: People are looking to me and I'm at the center of this. I was with Dumbledore when he died and everyone expects answers from me.
memories.source_text: "We’re going to the hospital wing," said Ginny. "I’m not hurt," said Harry. "It’s McGonagall’s orders," said Ginny.

memories.description: All right, Kingsley thinks I'm more important than the Muggle Prime Minister for tonight. Fine, I get it, I'm needed here.
memories.source_text: "He can get along without me for one night," said Kingsley. "You’re more important."

memories.description: Okay, Tonks got married. I couldn't be there and it was quiet. That's brilliant for her, even if I missed it.
memories.source_text: "Harry, guess what?" said Tonks ... and she wiggled her left hand at him; a ring glittered there.

memories.description: Moody just said Plan A was abandoned. Plans changed. We need to move on and work out the next step.
memories.source_text: "As Dedalus probably told you, we had to abandon Plan A."

memories.description: Dumbledore is dead. I can't believe he's gone. That's it, the man who kept everything together is gone.
memories.source_text: "Dumbledore — dead?" "Yes," said Harry.

memories.description: Someone stole the Horcrux we went for and left a fake locket. We didn't get it.
memories.source_text: "It wasn't there?" "No," said Harry. "Someone had already taken it and left a fake in its place."

memories.description: The stolen locket had the initials R.A.B. written on it. R.A.B. is connected to whoever took the Horcrux.
memories.source_text: "R.A.B.," whispered Ron, "but who was that?"

memories.description: People are discussing closing Hogwarts because of what's happened tonight. Everything we knew feels like it's falling apart.
memories.source_text: "They’re talking about closing the school," said Harry.

memories.description: McGonagall is acting as head now. She wants to talk to me alone, so I'm expected to answer questions and help with what's next.
memories.source_text: "See you in a bit" to Ron, Hermione, and Ginny, and followed Professor McGonagall back down the ward.

memories.description: They want me to help with Bill and Fleur's wedding. There's loads to do and I'm expected to stick around and lend a hand.
memories.source_text: Well, Harry, while we’ve still got you here, you won’t mind helping with the preparations for Bill and Fleur’s wedding, will you? There’s still so much to do.

memories.description: Molly treats me like family. She asks me to help and is pleased when I agree, even if it catches me off guard.
memories.source_text: No - I - of course not,

memories.description: Dumbledore left me something important to do. He told me about it and I can't just ignore it.
memories.source_text: "Well, Dumbledore left me . . . stuff to do," mumbled Harry.

memories.description: Ron and Hermione know what Dumbledore told me and they want to come along. They're choosing to stick by me.
memories.source_text: "Ron and Hermione know about it, and they want to come too."

memories.description: I know it's got to be me who does this. I don't think I misunderstood Dumbledore. This is my responsibility.
memories.source_text: "I didn't misunderstand," said Harry flatly. "It's got to be me."

memories.description: Hedwig's gone. I couldn't believe it when she lay motionless in her cage. I feel sick thinking about it.
memories.source_text: "Hedwig — Hedwig —"

memories.description: Sirius's bike is massive and Hagrid loves it. Sitting in the sidecar makes me feel tiny and exposed.
memories.source_text: "An' the last time yeh was on it, Harry, I could fit yeh in one hand!"

memories.description: The bike has crazy built-in tricks and buttons. Hagrid and Arthur have been tinkering with it, and some of those tricks are dangerous.
memories.source_text: "It's got a few tricks up its handlebars now. Tha' one was my idea."

memories.description: I can hold my own in a fight from a sidecar. Stunning spells work even when I'm terrified and half falling apart.
memories.source_text: "Stupefy!"

memories.description: One of the hooded Death Eaters was Stan Shunpike. I hit him with Expelliarmus and that moment made someone shout it's the real one. That makes everything worse and more confusing.
memories.source_text: "That's him, it's him, it's the real one!"

memories.description: Voldemort can fly without a broom. I saw him up close and my scar burned like mad. He is real and he's hunting me directly.
memories.source_text: "Voldemort was flying like smoke on the wind"

memories.description: My wand reacts when my scar hurts. When my scar screamed, my wand moved and fired on its own. I can't ignore that anymore.
memories.source_text: "As the pain from Harry's scar forced his eyes shut, his wand acted of its own accord."

memories.description: In a panic I can still act. I hit the dragon-fire button to try and save us even when everything was falling apart.
memories.source_text: "I punched it with his wand-free hand and the bike shot more flames into the air"

memories.description: I trust all of you. Even if something went wrong, I don't believe anyone here would betray me to Voldemort.
memories.source_text: "I don't think anyone in this room would ever sell me to Voldemort."

memories.description: I need to go with them to recover Mad-Eye's body. I can't just sit here while people are in danger because I'm here.
memories.source_text: "I’ve got to go too," said Harry.

memories.description: My wand did something on its own and hit Voldemort. I didn't mean to do that magic.
memories.source_text: "It wasn’t me," said Harry flatly. "It was my wand. My wand acted of its own accord."

memories.description: If Voldemort discovers where I am it puts everyone here at risk. That's why me staying is dangerous for them.
memories.source_text: "If Voldemort finds out I’m here —"

memories.description: My scar burning tells me something serious is happening and it scares me to think people expect me to have Voldemort-level power.
memories.source_text: "My scar was burning: He felt angry and frustrated; he hated the idea that they were all imagining him to have power to match Voldemort’s."

memories.description: Thank God George is alive. I was desperate when I thought he might be dead.
memories.source_text: "Thank God."

memories.description: Hermione and Kingsley made it back. At least some of us are accounted for.
memories.source_text: "Hermione and Kingsley," said Harry.

memories.description: Mad-Eye Moody is dead. That hit me like a punch. If Moody is gone then things are worse than I wanted to believe.
memories.source_text: "Mad-Eye's dead."

memories.description: George still knows me after everything, even joking about it. That small bit of normality matters to me.
memories.source_text: "Hi, Harry — you are Harry, right?"

memories.description: Hedwig's gone. My owl got hit and she's dead. I can't believe she's gone.
memories.source_text: "She . . . she got hit," said Harry.

memories.description: Hagrid's alive and being looked after. Thank Merlin — he's all right.
memories.source_text: "Hagrid's fine, son," said the man, "the wife's seeing to him now."

memories.description: Me, Hagrid, George and Hermione are back. The others aren't here with us.
memories.source_text: "Only Harry, Hagrid, George, and me."

memories.description: The Death Eaters ambushed us as soon as we left. They knew it was tonight and set a trap.
memories.source_text: "The Death Eaters were waiting for us," Harry told her. "We were surrounded the moment we took off — they knew it was tonight —"

memories.description: Voldemort caught up with us during the chase. He showed up, hunted us, then disappeared again.
memories.source_text: "he joined the chase halfway through but vanished pretty quickly."

memories.description: Because I was kind to Stan Shunpike, Voldemort changed his target to go after me. Great.
memories.source_text: "Harry behaved a little too kindly to Stan Shunpike," said Lupin.

memories.description: George lost an ear. That's awful and I can't bloody believe it.
memories.source_text: "He lost an ear," said Lupin.

memories.description: Someone used Sectumsempra on George during the chase. Lupin thinks it was Snape's doing.
memories.source_text: "Snape's work," said Lupin. "Snape?" shouted Harry. "He lost his hood during the chase. Sectumsempra was always a speciality of Snape's."

memories.description: I saw Lupin fly after us during the chase. He left to follow when Voldemort diverted his attention.
memories.source_text: "I saw him too, he came after Hagrid and me."

memories.description: He can fly on his own. Voldemort does not need a broom or a thestral to get around.
memories.source_text: "then Harry saw him. Voldemort was flying like smoke on the wind, without broomstick or thestral to hold him"

memories.description: He is focused on me. When I saw his face and the wand go up I knew he was after me and not just anyone.
memories.source_text: "His snakelike face gleaming out of the blackness, his white fingers raising his wand again"

memories.description: He wants me. Voldemort actually screamed that I belong to him.
memories.source_text: "Barely gripping the plummeting bike with his knees, Harry heard Voldemort scream, 'Mine!'"

memories.description: My wand moved like it had a mind of its own. When my scar burned the wand dragged my hand like a magnet.
memories.source_text: "As the pain from Harry’s scar forced his eyes shut, his wand acted of its own accord"

memories.description: My wand fired when my scar screamed. I caused that golden blast without meaning to and it hit someone.
memories.source_text: "He felt it drag his hand around like some great magnet, saw a spurt of golden fire through his half-closed eyelids, heard a crack and a scream of fury"

memories.description: I can trigger the bike's dragon-fire in a panic. I hit the button and sprayed flames even while falling.
memories.source_text: "Somehow, Harry found his nose an inch from the dragon-fire button. He punched it with his wand-free hand and the bike shot more flames into the air"

memories.description: I can try to summon Hagrid even in chaos. I yelled for him and shouted Accio Hagrid to pull him back.
memories.source_text: "'Hagrid!' Harry called, holding on to the bike for dear life. 'Hagrid - Accio Hagrid!'"

memories.description: Hagrid fell. He and that Death Eater went down together because the broom couldn't carry both.
memories.source_text: "to his horror, Harry saw both Hagrid and the Death Eater falling out of sight, their combined weight too much for the broomstick"

memories.description: Voldemort orders other wizards to hand over their wands. He told Selwyn to give him his wand.
memories.source_text: "Behind him came another scream, 'Your wand, Selwyn, give me your wand!'"

memories.description: This plan has a glaring problem. If fourteen people all head for the same place it will give us away. I can see that straight away and I don’t like it.
memories.source_text: "Maybe they won’t know which of the twelve secure houses I’m heading for at first, but won’t it be sort of obvious once" — he performed a quick headcount — "fourteen of us fly off toward Tonks’s parents’?"

memories.description: I refuse to let people risk being turned into me unless there is really no other option. I will not agree to this lightly.
memories.source_text: "No!" he said loudly, his voice ringing through the kitchen. "No way!"

memories.description: They need a lock of my hair to make the Polyjuice Potion and create the decoys. If I don't give it, they can't do it.
memories.source_text: "So, Potter — some of your hair, if you please."

memories.description: The Order has arranged safe houses and Portkeys. People I care about are being used to protect me and I have to decide how far I'm willing to cooperate.
memories.source_text: "You’ll be going to Tonks’s parents. Once you’re within the boundaries of the protective enchantments we’ve put on their house, you’ll be able to use a Portkey to the Burrow. Any questions?"

memories.description: They're keeping Moody's death quiet. The papers and the Ministry are hiding things and that feels wrong.
memories.source_text: The Daily Prophet hasn’t said a word about him dying or about finding the body,” Bill went on. “But that doesn’t mean much. It’s keeping a lot quiet these days.

memories.description: They won't call a hearing about my underage magic. It's because they'd rather cover up that Voldemort attacked me than face the truth.
memories.source_text: And they still haven’t called a hearing about all the underage magic I used escaping the Death Eaters?”

memories.description: Either they know I had no choice, or they're keeping me quiet so the public doesn't find out how bad things really are. I won't be brushed off.
memories.source_text: Because they know I had no choice or because they don’t want me to tell the world Voldemort attacked me?”

memories.description: Once I'm seventeen the charm breaks. That's it. We're all exposed if Voldemort comes back full force.
memories.source_text: Once I’m seventeen, the protective charm that keeps me safe will break, and that exposes you as well as me.

memories.description: The Order told me Voldemort won't just go after me, he'll go after the people around me to get to me or to punish them.
memories.source_text: The Order is sure Voldemort will target you, whether to torture you to try and find out where I am, or because he

memories.description: I already have a house left by my godfather, so I wouldn't want the Dursleys' place. It's not about their house for me.
memories.source_text: I’ve already got a house, my godfather left me one.

memories.description: The Dursleys are scared and panicking about supposed danger to them because of me, especially Vernon who can't stop changing his mind.
memories.source_text: “According to you,” Vernon Dursley said now, resuming his pacing up and down the living room, “we — Petunia, Dudley, and I — are in danger. From — from —”

memories.description: Vernon keeps flipping between decisions all the time. He's packed and unpacked the car so many times I can't take him seriously when he warns me.
memories.source_text: “I’ve changed my mind,” he said.

memories.description: Vernon genuinely thinks there's a plot to grab their house and that I'm somehow involved, which is absurd.
memories.source_text: “I was awake half the night thinking it all over, and I believe it’s a plot to get the house.”

memories.description: I've had to correct Vernon about who Voldemort is more times than I can count. He still refuses to accept what's been explained to him by others.
memories.source_text:
“You claim,” said Uncle Vernon, starting to pace yet again, “that this Lord Thing —”

“— Voldemort,” said Harry impatiently, “and we’ve been through this about a hundred times already.

memories.description: When did you do it? I mean, I can't believe you took those books right after Dumbledore's funeral. That's risky but clever.
memories.source_text: But when did you do this? Harry asked, regarding Hermione with a mixture of admiration and incredulity.

memories.description: I want to trust Hermione's judgement here. If she thinks we won't use the info to make a Horcrux, then maybe she's right, but we still need to be careful.
memories.source_text: She said imploringly, "I can’t believe Dumbledore would have been angry, it’s not as though we’re going to use the information to make a Horcrux, is it?"

memories.description: Dumbledore reckoned Riddle already knew how to make a Horcrux. Slughorn was only asked about what happens if you split your soul into seven.
memories.source_text: "He only approached Slughorn to find out what would happen if you split your soul into seven," said Harry.

memories.description: Right then I started thinking Dumbledore was probably correct and that Riddle could well have learned the basic Horcrux stuff from the library before he ever went to Slughorn.
memories.source_text: "Dumbledore was sure Riddle already knew how to make a Horcrux by the time he asked Slughorn about them. I think you’re right, Hermione, that could easily have been where he got the information."

memories.description: Phoenix tears are the only antidote to basilisk venom. Of course they are.
memories.source_text: "— phoenix tears," said Harry, nodding.

memories.description: Stabbing a Horcrux with basilisk venom will destroy it. That's one of the few foolproof ways.
memories.source_text: "What, stabbing it with a basilisk fang?" asked Harry.

memories.description: So Thicknesse has just made it illegal to use the Floo, Portkeys, or Apparition from here. Basically they have sealed this place off and made it punishable if anyone tries to help me get out that way.
memories.source_text: Pius Thicknesse has gone over, which gives us a big problem. He’s made it an imprisonable offense to connect this house to the Floo Network, place a Portkey here, or Apparate in or out.

memories.description: I've still got the Trace on me because I'm under seventeen. Any magic cast around me will alert the Ministry and the Death Eaters. That makes any obvious escape spell a huge risk.
memories.source_text: You’re underage, which means you’ve still got the Trace on you.

memories.description: Waiting until I turn seventeen isn't an option. The moment I do, my mum's protection drops and Voldemort will be able to grab me, so we have to move before then.
memories.source_text: We can’t wait for the Trace to break, because the moment you turn seventeen you’ll lose all the protection your mother gave you.

memories.description: We're forced to use things the Trace can't pick up like brooms, thestrals, or Hagrid's bike. No spells, no Floo, no Portkey, no Apparition. It's risky but it's the only way.
memories.source_text: We’re going to use the only means of transport left to us, the only ones the Trace can’t detect, because we don’t need to cast spells to use them: brooms, thestrals, and Hagrid’s motorbike.

memories.description: I get it now. Mum's protective charm only ends when I turn seventeen or when I stop calling this place home. Leaving tonight means breaking it early but staying isn't safe either.
memories.source_text: Now, your mother’s charm will only break under two conditions: when you come of age, or you no longer call this place home.

memories.description: They don't know we're moving tonight. We've fed them a fake trail so the Ministry expects me to leave on the thirtieth. That gives us a cover for tonight if we act fast.
memories.source_text: The one thing we’ve got on our side is that You-Know-Who doesn’t know we’re moving you tonight. We’ve leaked a fake trail to the Ministry: They think you’re not leaving until the thirtieth.

memories.description: I'm leaving the Dursleys tonight for good. There's no going back to living with them, so this is the end of that life.
