memories.source_text: You and your aunt and uncle are going your separate ways tonight, in the full understanding that you’re never going to live together again, correct?

memories.description: I know the diary actually died when I stabbed it. Ink poured like blood and that bit of Voldemort's soul screamed and vanished.
memories.source_text: "That diary sort of died when I stabbed it,"

memories.description: It's fine, I understand. I don't blame him for being careful about his being here.
memories.source_text: "It's fine, I understand," said Harry, speaking more to Lupin than Tonks.

memories.description: He looked all right for a second, then he went back to being miserable. I can't fix that right now.
memories.source_text: Lupin gave him a swift smile, but as they turned away, Harry saw Lupin's face fall again into lines of misery.

memories.description: Hagrid's a walking disaster sometimes. He sat in the wrong place and smashed a load of seats to bits. Of course he did.
memories.source_text: Hagrid was causing a certain amount of disruption. Having misunderstood Fred's directions he had sat himself ... on five seats that now resembled a large pile of golden matchsticks.

memories.description: I ended up with a deaf old couple to look after. Great. Talk about being stuck on duty.
memories.source_text: a rather deaf old couple fell to Harry's lot.

memories.description: They are coming with me and they know how dangerous this is. I can't find words for what that means to me but it's real and it's terrifying.
memories.source_text: The measures they had taken to protect their families made him realize, more than anything else could have done, that they really were going to come with him and that they knew exactly how dangerous that would be.

memories.description: I want to go to Godric's Hollow first. There's something about the place that pulls me there. Maybe it holds answers because that is where I survived Voldemort's curse.
memories.source_text: I know you said you wanted to go to Godric’s Hollow first, Harry, and I understand why, but . . . well . . . shouldn’t we make the Horcruxes our priority?

memories.description: R.A.B.'s note says the real locket was stolen and he meant to destroy it. If he actually destroyed it that's one less Horcrux we might have to deal with, but we still have to find the real locket to be sure.
memories.source_text: 'I have stolen the real Horcrux and intend to destroy it as soon as I can,'

memories.description: So Ron has a ghoul in his attic and he expects me to meet it. I can see it now and I can barely believe it looks like someone in pajamas.
memories.source_text: "That’s your ghoul, isn’t it?" asked Harry

memories.description: They plan to leave the ghoul in Ron's bed so anyone who comes snooping will think Ron is seriously ill and contagious.
memories.source_text: "Once we’ve left, the ghoul’s going to come and live down here in my room," said Ron.

memories.description: Ron’s dad and Fred and George helped turn the ghoul into the spattergroit disguise. The Weasleys are involved in this ruse.
memories.source_text: "Dad is. He helped Fred and George transform the ghoul."

memories.description: Bill said he saw Moody hit by the Killing Curse, so I can't just pretend he's alive without good reason. If Bill saw it, that counts for something.
memories.source_text: "But Bill saw him hit by the Killing Curse," said Harry.

memories.description: Fleur saw Moody's wand blasted out of his hand. If that's true, Moody was disarmed before he fell.
memories.source_text: "Fleur said his wand was blasted out of his hand," said Harry.

memories.description: I'm determined they're coming with me. I know they said they'd follow me before, and I'm not backing down on wanting them at my side now.
memories.source_text: "Listen," said Harry.

memories.description: I pictured Moody dead, like Dumbledore, and it made my stomach flip. I couldn't help it, but I saw him broken and it felt sickening.
memories.source_text: For the first time, Harry imagined Mad-Eye’s body, broken as Dumbledore’s had been, yet with that one eye still whizzing in its socket.

memories.description: Mad-Eye's body hasn't been found and there's no news about him. They couldn't hold a funeral because they couldn't recover him.
memories.source_text: "No news about Mad-Eye?" Harry asked Bill. "Nothing," replied Bill.

memories.description: The papers and the Ministry are keeping things quiet on purpose. They're hiding information instead of telling the truth.
memories.source_text: "The Daily Prophet hasn’t said a word about him dying or about finding the body," Bill went on. "But that doesn’t mean much. It’s keeping a lot quiet these days."

memories.description: The Ministry still hasn't called me in for a hearing about the underage magic I used when the Death Eaters attacked.
memories.source_text: "And they still haven’t called a hearing about all the underage magic I used escaping the Death Eaters?" Harry called across the table to Mr Weasley, who shook his head.

memories.description: It's not about me getting in trouble. It's because Scrimgeour and the Ministry don't want people to know Voldemort is back and how bad things are.
memories.source_text: "Because they know I had no choice or because they don’t want me to tell the world Voldemort attacked me?" "The latter, I think. Scrimgeour doesn’t want to admit that You-Know-Who is as powerful as he is, nor that Azkaban’s seen a mass breakout."

memories.description: I'm still angry and tense about all this. I want to tell the truth and I'm frustrated that no one is willing to admit what's happening.
memories.source_text: Harry clenched his knife so tightly that the faint scars on the back of his right hand stood out, white against his skin: I must not tell lies.

memories.description: Luna thinks I look smart and her dad has odd ideas about wedding luck. I just went along with it.
memories.source_text: "You look smart. I told Daddy most people would probably wear dress robes, but he believes you ought to wear sun colors to a wedding, for luck, you know."

memories.description: Krum spotted the Weasley connection and noticed Ron's reaction. I tried to move him away from Ron by showing him to his seat.
memories.source_text: "Your friend is not pleased to see me," said Krum... "Or is he a relative?" he added with a glance at Harry's red curly hair.

memories.description: Krum thinks Xenophilius is wearing Grindelwald's sign and said he'd duel him if he wasn't Fleur's guest. That's serious enough to make me keep an eye on things.
memories.source_text: "Because," said Krum, "if he vos not a guest of Fleur's, I vould duel him, here and now, for vearing that filthy sign upon his chest."

memories.description: Krum says he was invited by Fleur. He's friendly enough with the wedding crowd, so I shook his hand and offered to show him his seat.
memories.source_text: "Fleur invited me," said Krum, eyebrows raised.

memories.description: The diary Horcrux actually died when I destroyed it. I remember the ink and the screams. Once it's properly destroyed the bit of soul trapped in it can no longer exist.
memories.source_text: "The diary sort of died when I stabbed it," said Harry, remembering ink pouring like blood from the punctured pages, and the screams of the piece of Voldemort’s soul as it vanished.

memories.description: Ginny tried to get rid of the diary by flushing it, but the Horcrux came back like nothing had happened. It's not enough to just get rid of the object casually.
memories.source_text: "Ginny tried to get rid of the diary before you did, flushing it away, but obviously it came back good as new."

memories.description: I should've asked Dumbledore how he destroyed the ring. I keep thinking I should've known more about destroying Horcruxes.
memories.source_text: "I wonder how Dumbledore destroyed the ring?" said Harry. "Why didn’t I ask him? I never really . . ."

memories.description: I'm not leaving. I'm going to be right here with Hermione and Ron, and we won't be split up for this.
memories.source_text: "We're not going anywhere," said Harry

memories.description: Dumbledore left me that Snitch as a keepsake about perseverance and skill. It's supposed to remind me what you can get if you stick at something.
memories.source_text: "'To Harry James Potter,'" he read, "I leave the Snitch he caught in his first Quidditch match at Hogwarts, as a reminder of the rewards of perseverance and skill.'"

memories.description: That Snitch has flesh memory. It can identify the first person to touch it and might be enchanted to open only for me.
memories.source_text: "This Snitch will remember your touch, Potter."

memories.description: When the Minister told me to take it I had to. I couldn't refuse him in that moment even though I was worried about what might be inside.
memories.source_text: "Take it," said Scrimgeour quietly. Harry met the Minister's yellow eyes and knew he had no option but to obey."

memories.description: I half expected something dramatic to happen when I touched the Snitch, but it didn't. That was a bit of an anticlimax.
memories.source_text: "Nothing happened. As Harry's fingers closed around the Snitch, its tired wings fluttered and were still."

memories.description: I should have kept the Cloak on me. What the hell, I left it behind and that was stupid.
memories.source_text: "Why didn’t I make sure I had the Invisibility Cloak with me?"

memories.description: If I fire a Stunning Spell fast and hard I can take a Death Eater out, even when things are chaos.
memories.source_text: "Stupefy!"

memories.description: Hermione's right, they're after me. I can't let my guilt make us go back and risk everyone else.
memories.source_text: "We can’t worry about that now," whispered Hermione. "It’s you they’re after, Harry, and we’ll just put everyone in even more danger by going back."

memories.description: Even unseen, I still have to agree and keep moving. Arguing won't help when people are in danger.
memories.source_text: "Yeah."

memories.description: Grimmauld Place is the best chance we've got. It's where we should go if we need somewhere to hide.
memories.source_text: "Grimmauld Place," said Harry.

memories.description: I felt rotten thinking the Death Eaters might have tracked us because of a Trace on me. I felt contaminated and worried that maybe they found a way to put it back on a seventeen-year-old.
memories.source_text: "You — you don’t think you’ve still got your Trace on you, do you, Harry?"

memories.description: If I can't use magic and they can't use magic near me without giving us away, we're in real trouble. We can't go around using magic or we'll draw them straight to us.
memories.source_text: "If I can’t use magic, and you can’t use magic near me, without us giving away our position —" he began.

memories.description: Seeing that horror-figure made me think some of this stuff is just meant to scare Snape or any intruder. It wasn't the real thing, it was a trick to frighten whoever shows up.
memories.source_text: "No! It wasn’t us! We didn’t kill you —"

memories.description: Gregorovitch keeps popping into my head in my sleep. I keep saying his name in dreams and my scar prickles when it happens.
memories.source_text: You were muttering in your sleep. 'Gregorovitch.' You kept saying 'Gregorovitch.'

memories.description: I reckon Voldemort is hunting Gregorovitch. I can feel it, like I saw him somewhere abroad looking for someone.
memories.source_text: I think Voldemort’s looking for him.

memories.description: There’s some link between Gregorovitch and Quidditch. I kept seeing it, even if I can't quite pull the rest together right now.
memories.source_text: I think he's got something to do with Quidditch. There’s some connection, but I can’t — I can’t think what it is.

memories.description: I’m seventeen now. Once I'm seventeen the protective charm will break and everything changes. That's it. We're all exposed.
memories.source_text: I’m seventeen!

memories.description: Ginny and I kissed. It was amazing and real and I wanted it to be private, but Ron walked in and it all fell flat. That was rubbish timing.
memories.source_text: She was kissing him as she had never kissed him before, and Harry was kissing her back

memories.description: I don't want Hermione knowing about everything I see in my sleep. I want her not to worry me about it right now.
memories.source_text: Do me a favor and don’t tell Hermione

memories.description: Scrimgeour wants to speak to me alone. That makes me nervous. If the Minister is hovering around my seventeenth birthday then nothing good is simple.
memories.source_text: I require a private word with you

memories.description: I can use magic freely now that the Trace is gone. It feels good to do little things for myself, even if they end up being a bit messy.
memories.source_text: Accio Glasses!

memories.description: Dumbledore left me things in his will. He wanted me to have stuff even after he was gone.
memories.source_text: "Dumbledore left you a second bequest, Potter."

memories.description: People argue the sword is not mine to keep. The Ministry think it belongs to history, not to me.
memories.source_text: "The sword of Godric Gryffindor"

memories.description: Maybe Dumbledore thought the sword was important against Voldemort. If he wanted me to have it, he must have had a reason tied up with the Horcrux business.
memories.source_text: "Was it because Dumbledore believed that only the sword of Godric Gryffindor could defeat the Heir of Slytherin?"

memories.description: The Snitch I caught has writing that appears and vanishes that says I open at the close. I tried to make sense of it and it meant nothing in the moment, but it clearly matters.
memories.source_text: "I open at the close."

memories.description: I held back in front of Scrimgeour. I won’t always show everything when it’s dangerous or the wrong people are watching.
memories.source_text: "I wasn’t going to try too hard in front of Scrimgeour, was I?"

memories.description: I can’t trust the Minister. He’s controlling and quick to intimidate. The Ministry is not on the side I want right now.
memories.source_text: "You may wear that scar like a crown, Potter, but it is not up to a seventeen-year-old boy to tell me how to do my job!"

memories.description: He might have picked that symbol up somewhere and think it means something harmless, not that Xenophilius is a supporter of the Dark Arts.
memories.source_text: "There’s a chance that Xenophilius doesn’t actually know what the symbol means. The Lovegoods are quite . . . unusual."

memories.description: Luna is behaving like she has Wrackspurts in her ears or head, that’s why she’s waving her arms around.
memories.source_text: "Probably trying to get rid of a Wrackspurt,"

memories.description: Gregorovitch is a famous wandmaker and his name popped back into my head when I saw Krum’s wand; wandmakers leave marks in people’s memories.
memories.source_text: "Gregorovitch!" and the memory of Ollivander examining Krum’s wand

memories.description: Elphias Doge defends Dumbledore fiercely and expects me to dismiss Rita Skeeter’s claims, but I can’t just decide not to know the truth because someone asks me to.
memories.source_text: "Don’t believe a word of it! Not a word, Harry! Let nothing tarnish your memories of Albus Dumbledore!"

memories.description: I found Regulus's sign on the door. R.A.B. is real and linked to Regulus Arcturus Black.
memories.source_text: Do Not Enter Without the Express Permission of Regulus Arcturus Black

memories.description: Regulus was a Death Eater who turned against them and paid for it. He had access to Voldemort and then tried to get away.
memories.source_text: Sirius told me about him, he joined up when he was really young and then got cold feet and tried to leave — so they killed him.

memories.description: If R.A.B. is Regulus, then someone in the Blacks tried to fight Voldemort from the inside.
memories.source_text: R.A.B. I think I’ve found him.

memories.description: We couldn't Summon the locket. It might be under counter-enchantments like the one in the cave.
memories.source_text: Accio Locket!

memories.description: Kreacher stole a bunch of our old junk and keeps a stash in his cupboard in the kitchen. The locket could be there.
memories.source_text: Kreacher nicked loads of things back from us,

memories.description: This is happening right now. Muggle-borns are being rounded up, and the Ministry is onto them.
memories.source_text: 'Muggle-borns are being rounded up as we speak.'

memories.description: They're forcing every kid to go to Hogwarts so Voldemort can keep an eye on them and weed out anyone without the right blood.
memories.source_text: 'Attendance is now compulsory for every young witch and wizard.'

memories.description: If someone in the Order is going to abandon their family, I can't respect them. Parents shouldn't leave their kids unless they've got to.
memories.source_text: 'I’m pretty sure my father would have wanted to know why you aren’t sticking with your own kid, actually.'

memories.description: Lupin's hiding his shame and thinking of running rather than standing by his wife and child. I feel betrayed and furious at him for it.
memories.source_text: 'Don’t you understand what I’ve done to my wife and my unborn child? I should never have married her, I’ve made her an outcast!'

memories.description: I had to check him out. I drew my wand and made sure it was Remus before I lowered it. I trust him, but I checked anyway.
memories.source_text: "Show yourself!" he called back. Lupin moved forward into the lamplight, hands still held high in a gesture of surrender. "I am Remus John Lupin, werewolf, sometimes known as Moony, one of the four creators of the Marauder's Map, married to Nymphadora, usually known as Tonks, and I taught you how to produce a Patronus, Harry, which takes the form of a stag."

memories.description: They've put my face all over the Prophet. I'm wanted for questioning about Dumbledore's death. That's how they're turning people against me.
memories.source_text: "Here," he said, pushing it across the table to Harry, "you'll know sooner or later anyway. That's their pretext for going after you." Harry smoothed out the paper. A huge photograph of his own face filled the front page. He read the headline over it: WANTED FOR QUESTIONING ABOUT THE DEATH OF ALBUS DUMBLEDORE"

memories.description: The Ministry is basically working with the Death Eaters now. They have the power to act without fear. We are being hunted and no one is safe.
memories.source_text: "What you've got to realize, Harry, is that the Death Eaters have got the full might of the Ministry on their side now," said Lupin.

memories.description: The Daily Prophet is compromised. The people who might have protected me are being silenced or turned. I can't count on the paper or the Ministry to help.
memories.source_text: "So Death Eaters have taken over the Daily Prophet too?" asked Hermione furiously. Lupin nodded.

memories.description: Regulus ordered Kreacher to come home from the cave.
memories.source_text: "Master Regulus told Kreacher to come back,"

memories.description: Kreacher got away from the Inferi by using elf magic to Apparate or Disapparate, not the same as wizard magic.
memories.source_text: "He Disapparated!"

memories.description: Regulus stole a locket Horcrux from Voldemort and brought it back.
memories.source_text: "Master Regulus took from his pocket a locket like the one the Dark Lord had,"

memories.description: Regulus told Kreacher to leave him and to go home, to never tell the family what happened, and to destroy the locket after switching it.
memories.source_text: "And he ordered — Kreacher to leave — without him. And he told Kreacher — to go home — and never to tell my Mistress — what he had done — but to destroy — the first locket."

memories.description: Regulus drank the potion meant to protect the Horcrux and was dragged under by the Inferi and died.
memories.source_text: "And he drank — all the potion — and Kreacher swapped the lockets — and watched . . . as Master Regulus . . . was dragged beneath the water . . . and . . ."

memories.description: The locket Horcrux cannot be destroyed by the usual things Kreacher tried, so it's much harder to get rid of than we thought.
memories.source_text: "Nothing Kreacher did made any mark upon it,"

memories.description: Kreacher feels guilty and terrified because he couldn't obey Regulus's final order and that made the whole Black household miserable.
memories.source_text: "Kreacher failed to obey orders, Kreacher could not destroy the locket! And his Mistress was mad with grief,"

memories.description: I asked Kreacher to find Mundungus so we can track down Regulus's locket and finish what Regulus started.
memories.source_text: "Kreacher, I want you, please, to go and find Mundungus Fletcher."

memories.description: She lied to boost her pedigree. I saw the locket she took from a petty criminal being used so she could pretend she was pure-blood. That made my blood boil.
memories.source_text: "The S stands for Selwyn. . . . I am related to the Selwyns. . . . Indeed, there are few pure-blood families to whom I am not related."

memories.description: I wasn't going to sit there and let her pretend. I blasted Umbridge and Yaxley because enough was enough.
memories.source_text: "Stupefy!"

memories.description: My Patronus is a stag. It overwhelms the dementors and lights up a whole place. It works better than the cat.
memories.source_text: "EXPECTO PATRONUM!" The silver stag soared from the tip of Harry's wand and leaped toward the dementors

memories.description: The locket is a Horcrux. Getting it is the priority. Everything else comes after that.
memories.source_text: "Get the Horcrux," Harry told Hermione.

memories.description: People need to get out now. I told the Muggle-borns to leave the country if they can and hide with their families so they do not get shipped off.
memories.source_text: "It’s been decided that you should all go home and go into hiding with your families," Harry told the waiting Muggle-borns

memories.description: This place might not be safe anymore; Death Eaters could Apparate in at any time and we could be walking into a trap.
memories.source_text: [Even now, he could be bringing other Death Eaters in there by Apparition. Gloomy and oppressive though the house was, it had been their one safe refuge]

memories.description: Kreacher's changed; he's happier and friendlier now, and I feel guilty that he was making a home for us that we won't even use.
memories.source_text: [even, now that Kreacher was so much happier and friendlier, a kind of home. With a twinge of regret that had nothing to do with food, Harry imagined the house-elf busying himself over the steak-and-kidney pie that Harry, Ron, and Hermione would never eat. "Harry, I'm sorry, I'm so sorry!" "Don't be stupid, it wasn't your fault! If anything, it was mine."]

memories.description: I've got Mad-Eye's magical eye on me now; it's something real I can use or check, and it matters.
memories.source_text: [Harry put his hand in his pocket and drew out Mad-Eye’s eye.]

memories.description: Kreacher knows things and I can order him to speak. I called him and he appeared, so I can get answers from him when I press him.
memories.source_text: "Kreacher!"

memories.description: I will not let him abuse people in my house. I had to step in and stop Kreacher insulting the Weasleys and Hermione.
memories.source_text: "I forbid you to call anyone 'blood traitor' or 'Mudblood'"

memories.description: The locket we got rid of was taken back by Kreacher, so it's linked to something important in this house.
memories.source_text: "Two years ago... there was a big gold locket in the drawing room upstairs. We threw it out. Did you steal it back?" / "Yes."

memories.description: Mundungus Fletcher nicked the locket and other Black family things. He is the one who ran off with them.
memories.source_text: "Mundungus Fletcher stole it all"

memories.description: That locket belonged to Regulus Black. It's not just junk. It has a direct tie to the Black family and to Regulus himself.
memories.source_text: "the locket, Master Regulus's locket"

memories.description: Voldemort used Kreacher to test something awful in a cave. The elf was forced to drink a potion and saw terrible things, which matches what I know happened at a Horcrux site.
memories.source_text: "The Dark Lord made Kreacher drink it. Kreacher drank, and as he drank, he saw terrible things"

memories.description: Regulus was proud enough and involved enough with Voldemort to have done something drastic. He might have been trying to help or to make amends in his own way.
memories.source_text: "Master Regulus had proper pride; he knew what was due to the name of Black"

memories.description: I am in charge here and I will control Kreacher. He is contemptuous and foul, but I can force him to obey and make him tell the truth when it matters.
memories.source_text: Harry wrenched open Kreacher's cupboard, grabbed blankets and called Kreacher; he also flattened Kreacher to stop him from hurting himself

memories.description: Magic is being celebrated as superior here. They mean it. This place thinks wizards are above everyone else.
memories.source_text: Engraved in foot-high letters at the base of the statue were the words MAGIC IS MIGHT.

memories.description: They turned Muggles into decoration and support. I couldn't believe how grotesque that is.
memories.source_text: what he had thought were decoratively carved thrones were actually mounds of carved humans: hundreds and hundreds of naked bodies, men, women, and children, all with rather stupid, ugly faces, twisted and pressed together to support the weight of the handsomely robed wizards.

memories.description: People here expect me to go along with their cruelty. They see me as someone who should approve of punishing others.
memories.source_text: With a nod and unpleasant smile to Harry, who was evidently expected to appreciate this treatment of Cattermole, Yaxley swept away toward another lift.

memories.description: Yaxley is dangerous and important. He's intimidating and has power at the Ministry.
memories.source_text: The man’s scowling, slightly brutish face was somehow at odds with his magnificent, sweeping robes, which were embroidered with much gold thread.

memories.description: We're not getting any safer by waiting around. If we hang about, that locket could get tossed or moved. We have to act now.
memories.source_text: "I think we should do it tomorrow," said Harry.

memories.description: Apparition to and from the Ministry is blocked. That affects how we get in and out.
memories.source_text: "We know they've stopped Apparition in and out of the Ministry."

memories.description: Only top Ministry people can use the Floo from home now. That narrows our options.
memories.source_text: "We know only the most senior Ministry members are allowed to connect their homes to the Floo Network now, because Ron heard those two Unspeakables complaining about it."

memories.description: Dolores is on level one. We know where to start looking.
memories.source_text: "And we know roughly where Umbridge's office is, because of what you heard that bearded bloke saying to his mate - 'I'll be up on level one, Dolores wants to see me'"

memories.description: I used the loo entrance, pulled the chain and flooed straight into the Ministry. It works, so that's our route in.
memories.source_text: "He reached up, pulled the chain, and next moment had zoomed down a short chute, emerging out of a fireplace into the Ministry of Magic."

memories.description: Mafalda's tokens will give us access if everything goes to plan. We can steal our way in with them.
memories.source_text: "If the plan works, we will have," Harry continued calmly.

memories.description: We can't go back to Grimmauld Place. I thought we were headed back but that's not possible now.
memories.source_text: "Harry, I don’t think we’re going to be able to go back there."

memories.description: Yaxley might know the secret to Grimmauld Place and could get inside. That's a huge problem.
memories.source_text: "Since Dumbledore died, we’re Secret-Keepers, so I’ve given him the secret, haven’t I?"

memories.description: Hermione is too frightened to try risky healing magic on whoever's hurt, and she's shaken up.
memories.source_text: "It’s all I feel safe doing," said Hermione shakily.

memories.description: We should stay put for now. Moving him is asking for trouble.
memories.source_text: "Let’s stay here for now," Harry said.

memories.description: Of course the tent's in the bag. I can summon it instead of rummaging around.
memories.source_text: "You could get out the tent, Harry."

memories.description: That's the World Cup tent. The smell of cats gives it away.
memories.source_text: Harry recognized it, partly because of the smell of cats, as the same tent in which they had slept on the night of the Quidditch World Cup.

memories.description: My scar is opening again when he loses control. It burns and slams anger into me like a shock, and I can feel when he's raging.
memories.source_text: I — I think it’s started opening again whenever he loses control, that’s how it used to —

memories.description: It closed for a while, but it is not shut anymore. I have to deal with this or it will keep dragging me into his head.
memories.source_text: It did, for a while,

memories.description: I can only pick up raw emotion from him sometimes, mostly anger. I don't always get clear images or words, just that burning fury.
memories.source_text: No, I just felt anger — he’s really angry —

memories.description: I know Dumbledore wanted Occlumency so Voldemort could not use our connection. I do not need Hermione to tell me what that cost before.
memories.source_text: Yeah, I do remember, thanks,

memories.description: I acted clueless and said "Sorry?" because pretending to be daft was my best shot at keeping people off my back.
memories.source_text: “Sorry?”

memories.description: I slipped in behind her and whispered "I'm behind you," because I would do whatever it took to protect Hermione from those Dementors and that awful hearing.
memories.source_text: “I’m behind you,”

memories.description: Seeing Mrs. Cattermole shudder as she passed the Dementors told me exactly how terrified ordinary people are in that place. It made me want to stop it, now.
memories.source_text: As she passed the dementors, Harry saw her shudder.

memories.description: There was a Patronus cat keeping the prosecutors comfortable while the accused froze. That showed me who Umbridge protects and who she wants to break.
memories.source_text: The moment he had passed the place where the Patronus cat patrolled, he felt the change in temperature: It was warm and comfortable here.

memories.description: Splinching is not a joke. That was brutal, a chunk of Ron's arm gone like someone had taken a knife to him. I had to act fast.
memories.source_text: "Splinched," said Hermione, her fingers already busy at Ron's sleeve, where the blood was wettest and darkest.

memories.description: Hermione's bag holds whatever you need. I reached in, found things by feel, and went for what would help.
memories.source_text: "Bag — right —" Harry sped to the place where Hermione had landed, seized the tiny beaded bag, and thrust his hand inside it.

memories.description: When it matters, I can get a spell out under pressure. Accio Dittany pulled the potion right into my hand.
memories.source_text: "Accio Dittany!" A small brown bottle zoomed out of the bag; he caught it and hastened back to Hermione and Ron

memories.description: Ron passed out. I had to be quick because he was unconscious and bleeding badly.
memories.source_text: "He’s fainted," said Hermione, who was also rather pale; she no longer looked like Mafalda, though her hair was still gray in places.

memories.description: Follow the Patronuses and they'll lead us out through the Atrium. That's the route out, plain and simple.
memories.source_text: "Now, if you’ll just follow the Patronuses, you’ll be able to leave from the Atrium."

memories.description: People are being told to go into hiding, get away from the Ministry. Get families out, go abroad if you can.
memories.source_text: "It’s been decided that you should all go home and go into hiding with your families,"

memories.description: They know there are intruders and there's not much time. We have maybe five minutes before they react properly.
memories.source_text: "Harry, they know there are intruders inside the Ministry, something about a hole in Umbridge’s office door, I reckon we’ve got five minutes if that —"

memories.description: I can bluff authority and use threats about family trees to cow them. If I sound convincing they'll do as I say.
memories.source_text: "Would you like me to have your family tree examined, like I had Dirk Cresswell’s?"

memories.description: Some of the Ministry lot are helping Muggle-borns escape, or at least pretending to. People can be forced into doing awful things.
memories.source_text: "He’s been helping Muggle-borns escape, Yaxley!"

memories.description: Reg Cattermole is mixed up in this mess. There are two Regs now and it's confusing as hell for everyone concerned.
memories.source_text: "Reg!" screamed Mrs. Cattermole, and she threw herself into Ron’s arms.

memories.description: I checked it and I know that symbol from what Krum told me — it's Grindelwald's mark. That's what it is.
memories.source_text: "Isn’t it the same symbol Luna’s dad was wearing round his neck?" "Then it’s Grindelwald’s mark."

memories.description: Scrimgeour should've spotted this if it was Dark stuff. If he missed it, something's off.
memories.source_text: "And you’d think Scrimgeour would have recognized it. He was Minister, he ought to have been expert on Dark stuff."

memories.description: I lashed out at Lupin and I know I was wrong to call him a coward, but I still feel he was acting like one.
memories.source_text: "I know I shouldn’t have called him a coward."

memories.description: If upsetting Lupin gets him back with Tonks, then whatever I said was worth it. I want that more than I want to be right.
memories.source_text: "But if it makes him go back to Tonks, it’ll be worth it, won’t it?"

memories.description: There was a photograph of the Dumbledore family with Percival, Kendra, Ariana and Aberforth. They looked ordinary and happy in the picture.
memories.source_text: "The Dumbledore family, left to right: Albus; Percival, holding newborn Ariana; Kendra; and Aberforth."

memories.description: Rita Skeeter's piece says Kendra moved the family to Godric's Hollow after Percival was sent to Azkaban and that she kept to herself, which adds context to the Dumbledores' past.
memories.source_text: "EXCLUSIVE EXTRACT FROM THE UPCOMING BIOGRAPHY OF ALBUS DUMBLEDORE by Rita Skeeter" (paragraphs describing Kendra and Percival)

memories.description: Kreacher brought Mundungus to me. Kreacher tracked him down and is loyal to the people from this house.
memories.source_text: "Kreacher has returned with the thief Mundungus Fletcher, Master."

memories.description: Mundungus admits he panicked and ran when You-Know-Who appeared; he is unreliable and cowardly when things get dangerous.
memories.source_text: "I panicked, okay? I never wanted to come along, no offense, mate, but I never volunteered to die for you, an’ that was bleedin’ You-Know-Who come flying at me..."

memories.description: Mundungus sold or gave the locket to a little woman in Diagon Alley with a bow on her head who looked like a toad. The locket left his possession that way.
memories.source_text: "I was selling in Diagon Alley and she come up to me and asks if I’ve got a license for trading in magical artifacts... She was gonna fine me, but she took a fancy to the locket an’ told me she’d take it and let me off that time..."

memories.description: I want to go to Godric's Hollow. We need to go there.
memories.source_text: "I — I want to go to Godric’s Hollow."

memories.description: Hermione hears me and agrees with what I said. She's on the same page about going.
memories.source_text: "Did you hear me right?"

memories.description: People have been leaving messages for me. They're backing me and wishing me luck. That actually makes me smile.
memories.source_text: "Good luck, Harry, wherever you are. If you read this, Harry, we’re all behind you! Long live Harry Potter."

memories.description: There's someone coming up the lane. I think it's a woman and she's hobbling, but I can't be sure yet.
memories.source_text: "A heavily muffled figure was hobbling up the lane toward them, silhouetted by the bright lights in the distant square."

memories.description: I can feel something from that locket against my chest, like a tiny metal heart or my blood thudding along with it.
memories.source_text: "Can you feel it, though?"

memories.description: We have to keep the locket safe until we figure out how to destroy it, so I'm going to wear it under my robes.
memories.source_text: "Keep it safe till we work out how to destroy it,"

memories.description: We need to take turns keeping watch and sort out food — someone has to stay on guard.
memories.source_text: "I think we should take it in turns to keep watch outside the tent,"

memories.description: Voldemort had Gregorovitch tied up and was torturing him.
memories.source_text: "He found Gregorovitch. He had him tied up, he was torturing him."

memories.description: Voldemort wanted something from Gregorovitch that Gregorovitch said had been stolen.
memories.source_text: "He asked him to hand it over, but Gregorovitch said it had been stolen from him"

memories.description: Voldemort read Gregorovitch's mind and I saw a young bloke on a windowsill who fired a curse, stole whatever Voldemort wanted, and then vanished.
memories.source_text: "He read Gregorovitch’s mind, and I saw this young bloke perched on a windowsill, and he fired a curse at Gregorovitch and jumped out of sight."

memories.description: It feels odd because Voldemort didn't mention my wand or those twin cores, so something about what he wanted doesn't add up to me.
memories.source_text: "He said nothing about the twin cores"

memories.description: It was probably something small the thief had. I reckon whatever it was, you couldn't tell much from a distance.
memories.source_text: "No it must've been something small."

memories.description: Maybe Voldemort could try to make another Horcrux, but that would be risky for him. Hermione warned he's already pushed his soul too far, so it should be dangerous for him to do it again.
memories.source_text: "I don't know," said Harry slowly. "Maybe. But wouldn't it be dangerous for him to make another one? Didn't Hermione say he had pushed his soul to the limit already?"

memories.description: I wasn't as calm as I pretended to be when I told Hermione everything would be all right. I was glad to get out of there and onto safer ground.
memories.source_text: "Harry, who did not feel as sanguine as he had pretended when reassuring Hermione, was glad to reach the gate and the slippery pavement."

memories.description: The pub's got people in it and they're singing that carol we heard near the church. It's crowded and loud enough that it might hide us if we needed it.
memories.source_text: "The pub was fuller than before: Many voices inside it were now singing the carol that they had heard as they approached the church."

memories.description: There's something dark and large at the end of the row of houses. That's where I'm looking now and it looks important.
memories.source_text: "He was looking toward the dark mass that stood at the very end of this row of houses."

memories.description: I thought about ducking into the pub for shelter, but Hermione pulled me the other way. I didn't argue because she was sure about where to go.
memories.source_text: "For a moment Harry considered suggesting they take refuge inside it, but before he could say anything Hermione murmured, 'Let’s go this way,' and pulled him down the dark street leading out of the village in the opposite direction from which they had entered."

memories.description: She's not a Muggle. That's nearly certain.
memories.source_text: There was next to no chance that this woman was a Muggle

memories.description: She can see us even though she shouldn't be able to. That's wrong and worrying.
memories.source_text: By all the rules of normal magic, meanwhile, she ought not to be able to see Hermione and him at all

memories.description: She knows we're here and she probably knows who we are. That feels personal.
memories.source_text: he had the strangest feeling that she knew that they were there, and also who they were

memories.description: Snape's actually been made headmaster. Snape is running Hogwarts now.
memories.source_text: SEVERUS SNAPE CONFIRMED AS HOGWARTS HEADMASTER

memories.description: If the Ministry and Voldemort back Snape, the teachers won't have a real choice. They'll probably stay and teach to try to protect the students rather than end up in Azkaban.
memories.source_text: 'If the Ministry and Voldemort are behind Snape it’ll be a choice between staying and teaching, or a nice few years in Azkaban'

memories.description: There are more Death Eaters than usual around the house. They're waiting like they want us to leave for the Hogwarts Express.
memories.source_text: 'There are still a load of Death Eaters watching the house'

memories.description: The Invisibility Cloak slipped when I landed, so we almost got seen coming back in.
memories.source_text: 'I landed badly on the top step, and the Cloak slipped.'

memories.description: Kreacher's cooking has actually got better since he has Regulus's locket. His French onion soup is proper good.
memories.source_text: The quality of Kreacher’s cooking had improved dramatically ever since he had been given Regulus’s locket

memories.description: Ghosts can't move snow, so whatever kicked up that snow in the bush wasn't a ghost.
memories.source_text: ["Ghosts could not move snow."]

memories.description: If it was a Death Eater we'd be dead by now, so it's probably just a cat or a bird and not someone dangerous.
memories.source_text: ["It's a cat," said Harry, after a second or two, "or a bird. If it was a Death Eater we'd be dead by now."]

memories.description: The graveyard is supposed to be haunted, but that doesn't fit the snow-moving thing.
memories.source_text: ["Harry thought of A History of Magic; the graveyard was supposed to be haunted: what if — ?"]

memories.description: She's right here and I had to ask her point blank. I confronted her straight off because something about her felt wrong.
memories.source_text: "Are you Bathilda?"

memories.description: Could she have been waiting for me this whole time? I can't just write that off anymore. It looks like she might have been expecting me.
memories.source_text: "Was it possible that she had been waiting for them all these long months?"

memories.description: She can sense us. That's not ordinary. It feels like some Dumbledore-level kind of thing, which makes her way more dangerous and mysterious than a normal old witch.
memories.source_text: "Even her ability to sense them suggested some Dumbledore-ish power that he had never encountered before."

memories.description: I'm starting to think she followed us. She might have been in the shadows in the graveyard and trailed us here.
memories.source_text: "Was it not likely that it was she who had moved in the shadows in the graveyard and had followed them to this spot?"

memories.description: My scar screams when he's near. When that pain hits, Voldemort is coming.
memories.source_text: "He’s coming! Hermione, he’s coming!"

memories.description: At first I was focussing on the snake, but then I knew something worse was nearer. The snake isn't the worst thing to worry about.
memories.source_text: He thought "worse than the snake was coming" and his head felt like it would split with pain from his scar

memories.description: I saw the face in the broken photograph. That's the thief I'm after.
memories.source_text: He stooped down and picked up the smashed photograph. There he was, the unknown thief, the thief he was seeking.

memories.description: Hermione thinks I'm okay because I told her I was. I lied about being all right.
memories.source_text: "Yes," he lied.

memories.description: Dumbledore said fear of a name matters, but I'm not sure saying his name helps us any. Calling him by his name didn't save Dumbledore.
memories.source_text: "Dumbledore said fear of a name —"

memories.description: Kreacher was right about the locket being important. This thing is a Horcrux and we've actually got it.
memories.source_text: "I reckon Kreacher's right"

memories.description: We have to figure out how to open the locket first. If we cannot open it we cannot destroy it.
memories.source_text: "We're going to have to work out how to open this thing before we can destroy it."

memories.description: Holding the locket feels wrong to me. There's something inside it that makes me want to get rid of it straight away.
memories.source_text: "Even after all their efforts to find it, he felt a violent urge to fling the locket from him."

memories.description: My attempts to pry the locket open by hand and with the charm failed. It won't open easily.
memories.source_text: "Neither worked."

memories.description: The Fidelius Charm died with Mum and Dad. The house is visible now.
memories.source_text: "Look. . . . Look at it, Hermione. . . ."

memories.description: The cottage is mostly standing but the right side of the top floor was blown apart. That must be where the curse backfired.
memories.source_text: "I don’t . . . oh!"

memories.description: A sign grew up in front of the house and it calls me the only wizard to survive the Killing Curse.
memories.source_text: "You’re not going to go inside? It looks unsafe, it might — oh, Harry, look!"

memories.description: The house has been left as a ruined monument to my parents and to the violence that destroyed our family.
memories.source_text: "On this spot, on the night of 31 October 1981, Lily and James Potter lost their lives. Their son, Harry, remains the only wizard ever to have survived the Killing Curse. This house, invisible to Muggles, has been left in its ruined state as a monument to the Potters and as a reminder of the violence that tore apart their family."

memories.description: Maybe the damage from Dark Magic is like an injury you cannot fix. That could be why nobody has rebuilt the place.
memories.source_text: "Maybe you can’t rebuild it?"

memories.description: The gate is old, snowy and thickly rusted. I didn't want to open the gate. I just wanted to touch something that belonged to my family.
memories.source_text: "He slipped a hand from beneath the Cloak and grasped the snowy and thickly rusted gate, not wishing to open it, but simply to hold some part of the house."

memories.description: I saw a statue of my parents and me as a baby. It was surreal to see myself in stone, happy and without my scar.
memories.source_text: "As they had passed it, it had transformed. Instead of an obelisk covered in names, there was a statue of three people: a man with untidy hair and glasses, a woman with long hair and a kind, pretty face, and a baby boy sitting in his mother’s arms."

memories.description: Dumbledore's family is buried here. His mother Kendra and his sister Ariana are in the graveyard at Godric's Hollow.
memories.source_text: "KENDRA DUMBLEDORE and, a short way below her dates of birth and death, AND HER DAUGHTER ARIANA."

memories.description: I feel a bit thrown. Dumbledore and I share this place and he never told me. I wish he had; it would have mattered to me.
memories.source_text: "Harry could not help thinking that he and Dumbledore both had deep roots in this graveyard, and that Dumbledore ought to have told him so, yet he had never thought to share the connection."

memories.description: My parents' graves are here in Godric's Hollow. Their names and dates are on the marble stone.
memories.source_text: "It was made of white marble, just like Dumbledore’s tomb, and this made it easy to read, as it seemed to shine in the dark. ... JAMES POTTER LILY POTTER BORN 27 MARCH 1960 DIED 31 OCTOBER 1981 BORN 30 JANUARY 1960 DIED 31 OCTOBER 1981"

memories.description: Seeing that inscription freaked me out at first. It sounded like something a Death Eater would like, so I panicked and wondered what it meant on my parents' grave.
memories.source_text: "'The last enemy that shall be destroyed is death' . . . 'Isn’t that a Death Eater idea? Why is that there?'"

memories.description: Being that close to my parents' graves hit me like a weight. I felt grief the same way I did after Dumbledore died.
memories.source_text: "He moved toward her, feeling as if something heavy were pressing on his chest, the same sensation he had had right after Dumbledore had died, a grief that had actually weighed on his heart and lungs."

memories.description: I'm determined to find my parents' graves and see them no matter what. I need to.
memories.source_text: "I’m going to keep looking for my parents, all right?"

memories.description: The locket burned me. I've got a scar over my heart and half-healed puncture marks on my arm.
memories.source_text: There was a scarlet oval over his heart where the locket had burned him. He could also see the half-healed puncture marks to his forearm.

memories.description: I've got the Horcrux in my bag. We should keep it switched off and away for a while.
memories.source_text: Where’ve you put the Horcrux? "In my bag. I think we should keep it off for a while."

memories.description: We shouldn't have gone to Godric's Hollow. I feel responsible and I'm sorry about what happened there.
memories.source_text: “We shouldn’t have gone to Godric’s Hollow. It’s my fault, it’s all my fault, Hermione, I’m sorry.”

memories.description: I thought Dumbledore might have left the sword there and I was counting on that. We got it wrong and that stings.
memories.source_text: “It’s not your fault. I wanted to go too; I really thought Dumbledore might have left the sword there for you.” “Yeah, well . . . we got that wrong, didn’t we?”

memories.description: We got away. We're out of whatever that was.
memories.source_text: "We got away."

memories.description: I've been really ill. I mean proper sick, not just a bit off.
memories.source_text: "You’ve been ill," she finished. "Quite ill."

memories.description: I was shouting and moaning while I was... out of it. I must have been awful to listen to.
memories.source_text: "You’ve been shouting and moaning and . . . things,"

memories.description: There was a Horcrux stuck to my chest. It wouldn't come off until Hermione did something to separate it.
memories.source_text: "I couldn’t get the Horcrux off you," Hermione said, and he knew she wanted to change the subject. "It was stuck, stuck to your chest."

memories.description: I've got a mark where the Horcrux was. Hermione used a Severing Charm to tear it off me.
memories.source_text: "You’ve got a mark; I’m sorry, I had to use a Severing Charm to get it away."

memories.description: A snake bit me too. Hermione cleaned it and put dittany on the bite.
memories.source_text: "The snake bit you too, but I’ve cleaned the wound and put some dittany on it."

memories.description: I was too weak to move, so Hermione used a Hover Charm to get me into the bunk because she couldn't lift me herself.
memories.source_text: "I had to use a Hover Charm to get you into your bunk, I couldn’t lift you."

memories.description: They're goblins. I heard them say their names plain as day, so this isn't ordinary smugglers or Muggles, it's goblins right there on the riverbank.
memories.source_text: Here, Griphook, Gornuk.

memories.description: The sword at Gringotts is a copy. The real Gryffindor sword isn't in that vault, it's gone. Of course it is, why would it be left where anyone could get at it?
memories.source_text: It’s a fake," rasped Griphook. "The sword of Gryffindor!

memories.description: Ginny and the others who tried to take the sword were caught and punished, though not seriously injured. That's not good enough, but at least they're alive.
memories.source_text: Oh, they were punished, and cruelly," said Griphook indifferently.

memories.description: People think I'm vanished and hiding. They expect me to be leading the fight. I shouldn't be surprised they're talking like that, but it stings. If they think I'm run off, I have to be more careful and smarter about where I go.
memories.source_text: Hard to help a boy who’s vanished off the face of the earth," said Dirk.

memories.description: Some of them still believe in me. That's something I can use. Not everyone has given up on me or thinks I'm a fraud.
memories.source_text: I know Harry Potter," said Dean. "And I reckon he’s the real thing — the Chosen One, or whatever you want to call it.

memories.description: I listen hard and I act fast. I made them be quiet, had Hermione set up protections, and used the Extendable Ears so we could hear everything without being seen.
memories.source_text: You cast the Muffliato charm over us, right?" he whispered to Hermione.

memories.description: My wand just split into two while I tried to disarm Hermione. I couldn't believe it!
memories.source_text: "Expelliarmus!"

memories.description: Okay, it was an accident. She didn't mean to. I know that even if it feels awful.
memories.source_text: "It was an accident," said Harry mechanically.

memories.description: I'll borrow Hermione's wand for now and keep watch. I'll rely on her wand until I can sort this out.
memories.source_text: "Well, I'll just borrow yours for now, then. While I keep watch."

memories.description: I couldn't make a Patronus when the dementors came. I tried and it just wouldn't come. I felt useless and ashamed.
memories.source_text: "I couldn’t . . . make one," he panted, clutching the stitch in his side. "Wouldn’t . . . come."

memories.description: The locket weighs on me. The moment Hermione took it off me I felt lighter and less clammy. That thing affects how I feel and probably how I act.
memories.source_text: "Of course!" cried Hermione, clapping a hand to her forehead and startling both of them into silence. "Harry, give me the locket! Come on," she said impatiently, clicking her fingers at him when he did not react, "the Horcrux, Harry, you’re still wearing it!"

memories.description: Hogwarts keeps coming back to me as the most likely place for a Horcrux. It was his home, what made him special. Even if others doubt it, I still think it's important.
memories.source_text: "Dumbledore said in front of me that he never assumed he knew all of Hogwarts’s secrets. I’m telling you, if there was one place Vol —" "OI!" "YOU-KNOW-WHO, then!" Harry shouted, goaded past endurance. "If there was one place that was really important to You-Know-Who, it was Hogwarts!"

memories.description: When my scar burns I see the same blond kid, the thief who stole from Gregorovitch. I can't tune into other things, only what Voldemort is thinking at that moment.
memories.source_text: "A face," muttered Harry, every time. "The same face. The thief who stole from Gregorovitch."

memories.description: I'm starting to feel left out. Ron and Hermione have been whispering together and going quiet when I come near. I worry they expect me to have a secret plan I don't actually have.
memories.source_text: As the days stretched into weeks, Harry began to suspect that Ron and Hermione were having conversations without, and about, him.

memories.description: Where's my wand? My holly and phoenix wand is nearly snapped in two, hanging on by a single feather strand and splintered right through.
memories.source_text: Where’s my wand, Hermione?

memories.description: I couldn't just stand by I had to try to get it fixed but it's not going to be simple or clean. Reparo might not bring it back properly.
memories.source_text: Mend it. Please.

memories.description: Even after Hermione mended it the light was weak. The wand's not functioning like it should.
memories.source_text: Lumos!

memories.description: Hermione cares enough to try even when she's unsure. She gave it everything she had and she was upset about it.
memories.source_text: Harry took it into his hands as though it was a living thing that had suffered a terrible injury.

memories.description: Nagini almost strangled me. She had the Horcrux pressed into my chest and I could not breathe. I had to fight her off and then she let go.
memories.source_text: Nagini had released him

memories.description: The Horcrux is dangerous to touch and it feels like ice against your heart. It nearly stopped me from thinking or breathing.
memories.source_text: the snake coiled itself around his torso, squeezing the air from him, pressing the Horcrux hard into his chest

memories.description: I know how close I came to losing it in there. I have to stay sharp and get that Horcrux out of play before it kills me.
memories.source_text: He was abruptly awake in the sour smelling darkness

memories.description: Snape's running into trouble. His crackdown is real and harsh. Ginny is banned from Hogsmeade and any student groups are outlawed. They're trying to squash Dumbledore's Army.
memories.source_text: Snape seemed to be facing a constant, low level of mutiny from a hard core of students. Ginny had been banned from going into Hogsmeade. Snape had reinstated Umbridge’s old decree forbidding gatherings of three or more students or any unofficial student societies.

memories.description: Ginny and probably Neville and Luna are keeping the DA going even now. They're resisting. That means the fight at Hogwarts is still on.
memories.source_text: From all of these things, Harry deduced that Ginny, and probably Neville and Luna along with her, had been doing their best to continue Dumbledore’s Army.

memories.description: I miss Ginny like mad. Hearing she's in danger makes me desperate to see her.
memories.source_text: This scant news made Harry want to see Ginny so badly it felt like a stomachache;

memories.description: The idea of going back to Hogwarts is ridiculously tempting. Food, a proper bed, other people in charge would be a relief.
memories.source_text: He imagined simply going back to school to join the destabilization of Snape’s regime: Being fed, and having a soft bed, and other people being in charge, seemed the most wonderful prospect in the world at that moment.

memories.description: I can't just stroll back to Hogwarts. I'm Undesirable Number One and there's a huge bounty on me. Returning would be suicidal.
memories.source_text: But then he remembered that he was Undesirable Number One, that there was a ten-thousand-Galleon price on his head, and that to walk into Hogwarts these days was just as dangerous as walking into the Ministry of Magic.

memories.description: Phineas Nigellus is nosy and asks where we are. Hermione shuts him away when he pushes. He sulks and doesn't show up for days.
memories.source_text: Phineas Nigellus inadvertently emphasized this fact by slipping in leading questions about Harry and Hermione’s whereabouts. Hermione shoved him back inside the beaded bag every time he did this, and Phineas Nigellus invariably refused to reappear for several days after these unceremonious good-byes.

memories.description: We're moving constantly to avoid being found. We've been through mountains, marshes and a snowed under island. It's miserable and cold.
memories.source_text: They did not dare remain in any one area too long, so rather than staying in the south of England, where a hard ground frost was the worst of their worries, they continued to meander up and down the country, braving a mountainside, where sleet pounded the tent; a wide, flat marsh, where the tent was flooded with chill water; and a tiny island in the middle of a Scottish loch, where snow half buried the tent in the night.

memories.description: I suggested we take a break from wearing the Horcrux. Even a few hours off feels necessary and smart.
memories.source_text: He had also had the foresight to suggest that they take a few hours’ break from wearing the Horcrux, which was hanging over the end of the bunk beside him.

memories.description: I was about to suggest going back to Hogwarts again. I keep thinking that's the only unexplored option, even though it's dangerous.
memories.source_text: “Hermione, I’ve been thinking, and —”

memories.description: My wand is broken. I shoved the pieces away and there is nothing I can do with them now.
memories.source_text: He pulled the pieces of the broken wand out of his pocket and, without looking at them, tucked them away in Hagrid’s pouch around his neck.

memories.description: Dumbledore left us to flail about with no plan. I'm furious with him for leaving us in the dark.
memories.source_text: Impenetrable, unhelpful, useless, like everything else Dumbledore had left behind — And his fury at Dumbledore broke over him now like lava, scorching him inside, wiping out every other feeling.

memories.description: I dropped the photograph. If Voldemort gets that, he has everything he needs to track us down.
memories.source_text: And he had dropped the photograph of the thief, and it would surely be easy now for Voldemort to find out who he was.

memories.description: Dumbledore used to be friends with Grindelwald. That's a name I did not expect to see next to Dumbledore's.
memories.source_text: Albus Dumbledore, shortly after his mother’s death, with his friend Gellert Grindelwald.

memories.description: Seeing Dumbledore and Grindelwald together changes how I see Dumbledore. He had ties I never knew about.
memories.source_text: Grindelwald.

memories.description: Dumbledore had a brilliant youth and was celebrated for loads of achievements before all this mess.
memories.source_text: Now approaching his eighteenth birthday, Dumbledore left Hogwarts in a blaze of glory — Head Boy, Prefect, Winner of the Barnabus Finkley Prize for Exceptional Spell-Casting, British Youth Representative to the Wizengamot, Gold Medal-Winner for Ground-Breaking Contribution to the International Alchemical Conference in Cairo.

memories.description: Dumbledore might have been involved in keeping his sister locked away. That makes me question a lot about him.
memories.source_text: The answer, it seems, is ensuring the continued imprisonment of his sister.

memories.description: I told Hermione I wasn't angry with her. She saved us, and I owe her my life.
memories.source_text: “No,” he said quietly. “No, Hermione, I know it was an accident. You were trying to get us out of there alive, and you were incredible. I’d be dead if you hadn’t been there to help me.”

memories.description: I can open that locket by speaking Parseltongue. It comes straight to me, like I always knew how to do it.
memories.source_text: "I’m going to ask it to open, using Parseltongue," said Harry.

memories.description: After being near Nagini I get how deep this is. It clicked for me, like something I already had inside.
memories.source_text: "Perhaps it had taken his recent encounter with Nagini to make him realize it."

memories.description: We have to get rid of that locket now. I want it gone, no more putting up with it.
memories.source_text: "Let’s get rid of the damn thing, it’s been months —"

memories.description: I believe Ron is the one who should destroy the locket with the sword. He can do this, so come on, do it.
memories.source_text: "You can do it," said Harry, "you can! You’ve just got the sword, I know it’s supposed to be you who uses it. Please, just get rid of it, Ron."

memories.description: I trusted Dumbledore completely and now that trust is smashed to bits. I feel like I have nothing left to hang on to.
memories.source_text: "All was ashes: How much more could he lose? Ron, Dumbledore, the phoenix wand . . ."

memories.description: Dumbledore kept way more of himself for Grindelwald than for me. That cuts harder than anything else.
memories.source_text: "He shared a damn sight more of what he was really thinking with Gellert Grindelwald than he ever shared with me."

memories.description: That phrase helped Grindelwald justify horrible things. If Dumbledore fed him ideas back then, that explains how it got started.
memories.source_text: "'For the Greater Good' became Grindelwald’s slogan, his justification for all the atrocities he committed later."

memories.description: I used to think Dumbledore loved and protected me. Now I don't believe he ever loved me the way I needed.
memories.source_text: "I don't know who he loved, Hermione, but it was never me."

memories.description: He expected blind trust and kept me in the dark. Asking me to risk my life without full explanations feels like a betrayal.
memories.source_text: "Look what he asked from me, Hermione! Risk your life, Harry! And again! And again! And don't expect me to explain everything, just trust me blindly, trust that I know what I'm doing, trust me even though I don't trust you! Never the whole truth! Never!"

memories.description: I still look after my mates. Even when I'm furious, I take responsibility and keep going. I'll finish the watch.
memories.source_text: "Thanks for the tea. I’ll finish the watch. You get back in the warm."

memories.description: Bathilda was dead and the snake was inside her. Voldemort put it there in Godric's Hollow to wait for me.
memories.source_text: She was the snake or the snake was her all along

memories.description: I could understand Parseltongue; the snake sent a message to Voldemort in my head, he got excited, and Bathilda turned into the snake and attacked me.
memories.source_text: Once we were up in the room the snake sent a message to You Know Who I heard it happen inside my head I felt him get excited he said to keep me there and then she changed changed into the snake and attacked

memories.description: It wasn't meant to kill me, only to hold me until Voldemort showed up. If I'd managed to kill the snake, it would have been worth it.
memories.source_text: It wasn't supposed to kill me just keep me there till You Know Who came

memories.description: I'm tired but I'm okay. I can handle it; she's the one who looks like she needs sleep.
memories.source_text: You're the one who needs sleep No offense but you look terrible I'm fine

memories.description: I saw a silver doe leading us to the sword in the pool. It took me straight to it and I jumped in to get it.
memories.source_text: Well, I saw the doe first, obviously.

memories.description: The locket opened and Ron drove the sword into it. He did the killing blow on the Horcrux.
memories.source_text: and Ron stabbed it with the sword.

memories.description: He's back. Ron turned up, soaked through, holding the sword and the Horcrux. I couldn't believe it at first.
memories.source_text: "There before him stood Ron, fully dressed but drenched to the skin, his hair plastered to his face, the sword of Gryffindor in one hand and the Horcrux dangling from its broken chain in the other."

memories.description: He dived in after me and saved me. He risked himself to pull me out.
memories.source_text: "That’s why you jumped in, right?" "Yeah," said Harry.

memories.description: He actually pulled the Horcrux out. The locket is gone from around my neck because of him.
memories.source_text: "Oh yeah, I got it out," he said, rather unnecessarily, holding up the sword for Harry’s inspection.

memories.description: That doe Patronus wasn't Ron's. I thought it might be him, but no. My Patronus is a stag so the doe was someone else.
memories.source_text: "My Patronus is a stag." "Oh yeah. I thought it looked different. No antlers."

memories.description: He's back and he wants to come with us again. He made that offer, awkward as it was, and he risked his life to help me.
memories.source_text: "I’ve — you know — I’ve come back. If —" He cleared his throat. "You know. You still want me."

memories.description: It's the best I could hope for. That's about as good as it gets.
memories.source_text: About the best you could hope for, I think,

memories.description: You're the one who pulled the sword from the pool. It has to be you. I'm certain you must do it.
memories.source_text: Because you got the sword out of the pool. I think it’s supposed to be you.

memories.description: I'll open the locket and you stab it straightaway. Whatever's inside will fight back, so be ready and strike hard.
memories.source_text: I'm going to open it, and you stab it. Straightaway, okay? Because whatever's in there will put up a fight.

memories.description: I've found the spot by the sycamore and cleared the rock. This is where we'll do it.
memories.source_text: Come here,

memories.description: So Dumbledore used the sword to break a ring. That means he took it out before Ginny did.
memories.source_text: "I believe that the last time I saw the sword of Gryffindor leave its case was when Professor Dumbledore used it to break open a ring."

memories.description: The sword is goblin made, so it only soaks up what strengthens it. If it touched basilisk venom it would hold that poison.
memories.source_text: "Goblin-made armor does not require cleaning, simple girl. Goblins' silver repels mundane dirt, imbibing only that which strengthens it."

memories.description: Dumbledore kept the real sword because he needed it to destroy Horcruxes. He must have left a fake at Hogwarts.
memories.source_text: "And Dumbledore didn't give it to me because he still needed it, he wanted to use it on the locket -"

memories.description: Something between Ron and me has broken. He stormed off and Disapparated. I feel betrayed and furious.
memories.source_text: "Go home then," said Harry. "Yeah, maybe I will!" shouted Ron, and he took several steps toward Harry"

memories.description: Snape punished Ginny, Neville and Luna by sending them into the Forbidden Forest with Hagrid.
memories.source_text: "Professor Snape sent them into the Forbidden Forest, to do some work for the oaf, Hagrid."

memories.description: We stayed there two nights and I kept thinking someone was moving and calling out in the dark. I was sure someone was nearby.
memories.source_text: “We were there,” said Harry. “We spent two nights there, and the second night I kept thinking I could hear someone moving around in the dark and calling out!”

memories.description: Ron trusts our protective spells. They really hid us from him, even though he suspected we were close.
memories.source_text: “Yeah, well, that would’ve been me,” said Ron. “Your protective spells work, anyway, because I couldn’t see you and I couldn’t hear you."

memories.description: We were on that hill for two nights. I kept hearing someone moving and calling in the dark and I thought someone was nearby.
memories.source_text: "We were there," said Harry. "We spent two nights there, and the second night I kept thinking I could hear someone moving around in the dark and calling out!"

memories.description: Right away I agreed with Hermione about the light looking like a Portkey. It made sense to me straight away.
memories.source_text: "Yeah," said Harry and Hermione together automatically.

memories.description: I had to override everything I felt and shout orders. You don't argue with a Horcrux. Stab it now, Ron.
memories.source_text: "Don't listen to it!" "Stab it!"

memories.description: The Horcrux can torture someone to the edge and then die when it's destroyed. Breaking it makes the pain stop.
memories.source_text: "The thing that had lived in the Horcrux had vanished; torturing Ron had been its final act."

memories.description: Ron saved us and paid for it. I put the locket away and stayed with him instead of walking off. He's still my mate whether he thinks he is or not.
memories.source_text: "He was shaking, but not, Harry realized, from cold. Harry crammed the broken locket into his pocket, knelt down beside Ron, and placed a hand cautiously on his shoulder."

memories.description: The Horcrux attacks by twisting the worst things into your head. It dug at Ron with all that 'second best' rubbish.
memories.source_text: "Least loved, always, by the mother who craved a daughter . . . Least loved, now, by the girl who prefers your friend . . . Second best, always, eternally overshadowed . . ."

memories.description: She's terrified and furious, totally losing control, and I can't calm her down.
memories.source_text: "Give me back my wand! Give it back to me!"

memories.description: Ron saved me. Plain and simple. He risked himself to get back to us.
memories.source_text: "Ron just saved my life."

memories.description: That silver thing Ron has is the Deluminator and it does more than switch lights on and off.
memories.source_text: "The Deluminator?"

memories.description: I'm trying to keep things calm and focused. I told them everything was fine because I didn't want panic, and I'm the one who brought Ron back into the tent.
memories.source_text: “It’s okay, everything’s fine. More than fine. I’m great. There’s someone here.”

memories.description: I hang back and try to stay out of the way when things get heated between Ron and Hermione. I'm the mediator here and I'm ready to step in when needed.
memories.source_text: Harry backed into a shadowy corner, slipped off Ron’s rucksack, and attempted to blend in with the canvas.

memories.description: I cast Protego to stop Hermione from attacking Ron. I act fast and decisively to prevent things getting worse.
memories.source_text: “Protego!”

memories.description: I believe I need to try to calm Hermione down even if she won't listen. I'm determined to stop the argument before it destroys everything.
memories.source_text: “Hermione!” said Harry. “Calm —”

memories.description: I saw Dumbledore's handwriting with that tiny triangular mark used as his A. I can't pretend I don't now think Dumbledore had some link to that mark.
memories.source_text: "The signature," said Hermione. "Look at the signature, Harry!"

memories.description: That symbol has shown up in places older than Grindelwald. It isn't just Grindelwald's thing, and it keeps turning up where it matters.
memories.source_text: "It keeps cropping up, doesn’t it?" said Hermione. "I know Viktor said it was Grindelwald’s mark, but it was definitely on that old grave in Godric’s Hollow..."

memories.description: I'm worried about Hermione dragging us into more danger. I don't want us repeating a trip to Godric's Hollow that puts us at risk.
memories.source_text: "Hermione, we don’t need another Godric’s Hollow. We talked ourselves into going there, and —"

memories.description: He's probably worried about what'll happen to them if the Death Eaters find out I was here.
memories.source_text: "He’s probably worried about what’ll happen to them if the Death Eaters find out I was here," said Harry.

memories.description: Dumbledore's dead. I saw it happen and I saw the body, he's definitely gone.
memories.source_text: "Dumbledore's dead," he said. "I saw it happen, I saw the body. He's definitely gone."

memories.description: I want him to be alive, but that's not true. He's gone, and I can't pretend otherwise.
memories.source_text: "Dumbledore's dead," he said. "I saw it happen, I saw the body. He's definitely gone."

memories.description: Death's actually got an Invisibility Cloak. So Death can hide himself. That sounds wrong and worrying.
memories.source_text: "Death’s got an Invisibility Cloak?"

memories.description: Someone is helping us. That doe was sent for a reason. One Horcrux is gone and things can turn in our favour.
memories.source_text: "Someone helped us," he kept saying. "Someone sent that doe. Someone's on our side. One Horcrux down, mate!"

memories.description: Destroying the locket matters. If we can get one, we can get more. I'm feeling hopeful we can find the rest.
memories.source_text: Bolstered by the destruction of the locket, they set to debating the possible locations of the other Horcruxes

memories.description: Ron being back changes everything. I'm actually that happy to have him with us again.
memories.source_text: above all, Ron’s return, made Harry so happy that it was quite difficult to maintain a straight face

memories.description: I've told Ron everything about what Hermione and I went through and what happened at Godric's Hollow. There's nothing more to hide from him.
memories.source_text: Harry had finally managed to tell Ron the whole story of his and Hermione’s various wanderings, right up to the full story of what had happened at Godric’s Hollow

memories.description: I've fallen into saying 'You-Know-Who' but I don't mind saying V. It's a bad habit, but it's mine.
memories.source_text: "The what?" "You and Hermione have stopped saying You-Know-Who’s name!"

memories.description: She's like a sister to me. I love her like family and I think she feels the same. It's always been that way.
memories.source_text: "She’s like my sister," he went on. "I love her like a sister and I reckon she feels the same way about me. It’s always been like that. I thought you knew."

memories.description: With Ron gone, things fell apart between us. Now he's back I can see how much it cost us and how important he is.
memories.source_text: "With you gone . . ." He could not finish; it was only now that Ron was here again that Harry fully realized how much his absence had cost them.

memories.description: What Ron did tonight mattered. He got the sword, helped finish the Horcrux, and saved my life. That counts for a lot.
memories.source_text: "You’ve sort of made up for it tonight," said Harry. "Getting the sword. Finishing off the Horcrux. Saving my life."

memories.description: The tent was warm and lit by those bluebell flames when we came back. I couldn't wait to wake Hermione.
memories.source_text: It was gloriously warm after the pool and the forest, the only illumination the bluebell flames still shimmering in a

memories.description: I still don't get what the Deathly Hallows are. Plain and simple, it makes no sense to me yet.
memories.source_text: "I'm sorry," said Harry. "I still don't really understand."

memories.description: I sipped that Gurdyroot infusion to be polite and nearly choked on it. That stuff is disgusting.
memories.source_text: To be polite, he took a sip from his cup too, and almost gagged: The stuff was quite disgusting

memories.description: I introduced myself straight away and offered my hand. I make things simple and direct.
memories.source_text: "Hello, Mr Lovegood," said Harry, holding out his hand. "I’m Harry, Harry Potter."

memories.description: He stared at my scar the moment I showed myself. People still spot it and it makes them uneasy.
memories.source_text: "Xenophilius did not take Harry’s hand, although the eye that was not pointing inward at his nose slid straight to the scar on Harry’s forehead."

memories.description: That was awkward. I felt a bit let down by his coldness, but I kept patient and pushed to come in anyway.
memories.source_text: "It won’t take long," said Harry, slightly disappointed by this less-than-warm welcome.
