memories.description: All right. Godric's Hollow is where we need to go. I can't think of anywhere else it could be. It's dangerous but it really does seem the most likely place.
memories.source_text: "You want to go to Godric’s Hollow. I agree, I think we should. I mean, I can’t think of anywhere else it could be either. It’ll be dangerous, but the more I think of it, the more likely it seems it’s there."

memories.description: Bathilda Bagshot might still be living in Godric's Hollow. Muriel said that and it stuck with me.
memories.source_text: "Bathilda Bagshot still lives in Godric’s Hollow."

memories.description: I can't rule it out. If Dumbledore wanted someone to hide the sword, maybe he trusted Bathilda with it. That would explain why I didn't think about the sword at first.
memories.source_text: "Harry, what if Bathilda’s got the sword? What if Dumbledore entrusted it to her?"

memories.description: Part of why I want to go is to see my parents' graves and the house where I almost died. Bathilda being there makes it feel more important.
memories.source_text: "Remember what Muriel said?" ... "Bathilda Bagshot still lives in Godric’s Hollow."

memories.description: We need a plan. We have to practice Disapparating under the Cloak and learn Disillusionment Charms. If disguises must be thicker we might even use Polyjuice, and then we would have to collect hair.
memories.source_text: "We’ll need to practice Disapparating together under the Invisibility Cloak for a start, and perhaps Disillusionment Charms would be sensible too, unless you think we should go the whole hog and use Polyjuice Potion?"

memories.description: The snow is a problem. We'll leave footprints. If we go in I'll lead and Hermione will follow to cover the prints. We have to be careful about obvious tracks.
memories.source_text: "All this snow!" Hermione whispered beneath the cloak. "Why didn’t we think of snow? After all our precautions, we’ll leave prints! We’ll just have to get rid of them — you go in front, I’ll do it —"

memories.description: I'm sick of convincing myself Dumbledore left secret signs for us. Enough guessing. We need to focus on finding Horcruxes, not chasing every possible clue.
memories.source_text: “We keep trying to convince ourselves Dumbledore left us secret signs and clues —”

memories.description: Fine, we'll go see the Lovegoods, but straight after that I want us hunting Horcruxes again. No distractions.
memories.source_text: “Only, once we’ve seen Lovegood, let’s try and look for some more Horcruxes, shall we? Where do the Lovegoods live, anyway? Do either of you know?”

memories.description: Skeeter's written something about Dumbledore being pals with Grindelwald. That's what people are talking about.
memories.source_text: "Speaking of Dumbledore, have you heard what Skeeter wrote about him?"

memories.description: He was our age then. That matters to me. It doesn't make Dumbledore some monster overnight.
memories.source_text: "Our age," said Harry

memories.description: I'm still practicing with the blackthorn wand. I need to keep getting better, plain and simple.
memories.source_text: Harry continued to practice with the blackthorn wand.

memories.description: So they reckon they lured people here to kill them and snatch her back. That's ruthless and desperate, and it means they're playing dirty to get what they want.
memories.source_text: "Thought you’d lure us here to kill us, did you? And you think you’ll get your girl back like this?"

memories.description: Someone just shouted that I'm upstairs. Brilliant, they've blown my cover and given away where I am.
memories.source_text: "I swear . . . I swear . . . Potter’s upstairs!"

memories.description: They used a Homenum revelio at the stairs. They're trying to detect people, so hiding won't work for long.
memories.source_text: "Homenum revelio," said the voice at the foot of the stairs.

memories.description: Dumbledore's Patronus was a phoenix, not a doe.
memories.source_text: "Anyway, his Patronus was a phoenix, not a doe."

memories.description: Dumbledore didn't expect Ron to abandon me for good. He left things because he knew Ron would come back to us.
memories.source_text: "No," Harry corrected him. "He must've known you'd always want to come back."

memories.description: You reckon the Elder Wand might be real? If it is, its history of changing hands by force could explain why people end up dead trying to get it.
memories.source_text: "So the Elder Wand," said Harry quickly, before Hermione could retort, "you think that exists too?"

memories.description: Hermione and I are both baffled and annoyed by this. I look to her when something sounds daft because we think alike on this sort of thing.
memories.source_text: Harry glanced at Hermione.

memories.description: The sword wasn’t sitting there by chance. Whoever sent that Patronus put the sword in the pool.
memories.source_text: [“So how did the sword get in that pool?” “Whoever cast the Patronus must have put it there.”]

memories.description: The locket is a Horcrux and whatever’s inside it reacts violently to the sword. It tried to get at me when it sensed the sword.
memories.source_text: [“The Horcrux was still swinging from Ron’s hand. The locket was twitching slightly. Harry knew that the thing inside it was agitated again. It had sensed the presence of the sword and had tried to kill Harry rather than let him possess it.”]

memories.description: We can test whether that’s the real sword and we can’t dither. This is the moment to destroy the locket straight away.
memories.source_text: [“You reckon this is the real one?” asked Ron. “One way to find out, isn’t there?” said Harry. ... Now was not the time for long discussions; now was the moment to destroy the locket once and for all.”]

memories.description: I worked out that machine was a printing press because it was spitting out Quibblers. That was obvious once I looked properly.
memories.source_text: "It looked like the bizarre offspring of a workbench and a set of old shelves, but after a moment Harry deduced that it was an old-fashioned printing press, due to the fact that it was churning out Quibblers."

memories.description: We need help now. I said it straight because there was no time to faff about.
memories.source_text: "We need some help,"

memories.description: Xenophilius stared at my scar like it meant something huge to him. I can tell he sees me as more than just another person with problems.
memories.source_text: "His good eye moved again to Harry’s scar. He seemed simultaneously terrified and mesmerized."

memories.description: Wait, so in the story Death actually talks to the brothers. That's bizarre, but yes, Death speaks like a character.
memories.source_text: 'And Death spoke to them. He was angry that he had been cheated out of three new victims, for travelers usually drowned in the river.'

memories.description: Right, the oldest asked Death for an unbeatable wand. That means someone in the tale wanted power to beat Death itself.
memories.source_text: 'So the oldest brother, who was a combative man, asked for a wand more powerful than any in existence: a wand that must always win duels for its owner.'

memories.description: They're sure it's me up there. I need to be careful and get out now.
memories.source_text: "There’s someone up there all right, Selwyn," said the second man sharply. "It’s Potter, I tell you, it’s Potter!" sobbed Xenophilius.

memories.description: They're using Luna to force Xenophilius to hand me over. He's terrified for her, so I have to move fast.
memories.source_text: "You can have your little girl, Lovegood," said Selwyn, "if you get up those stairs and bring me down Harry Potter."

memories.description: We have to get out now. No hanging about, start digging and get Ron free.
memories.source_text: "Come on," Harry whispered, "we’ve got to get out of here."

memories.description: I trust Hermione enough to follow her plan and hold on. We're a team and I will do what she says.
memories.source_text: "Please, Ron! Harry, hold on tight to my hand, Ron, grab my shoulder." Harry held out his left hand.

memories.description: He's trying to hover the printing press to clear the stairs. He's mucking about with a Hover Charm.
memories.source_text: Xenophilius was trying to shift it using a Hover Charm.

memories.description: I couldn't work out what Hermione was hanging on for, but I trusted her to do something about it.
memories.source_text: Harry did not know what Hermione was waiting for.

memories.description: Hermione's the one who actually fixed it — she slapped an Obliviate at Xenophilius and then used a lowering charm to shift the press. Smart, fast, and direct.
memories.source_text: “Obliviate!” cried Hermione, pointing her wand first into his face, then at the floor beneath them. “Deprimo!”

memories.description: Something in my memory shifted when I heard Peverell. That name means something important.
memories.source_text: Peverell . . . he had heard that name before. . . .

memories.description: They're here and they know I'm involved. They think Lovegood brought me to them and they're torturing him for answers.
memories.source_text: It really is Potter! Really!

memories.description: Hermione is absolutely crucial to us. I don't know what we'd do without her, she's the one keeping us going.
memories.source_text: "Yeah, you are, Hermione," agreed Harry fervently. "I don’t know what we’d do without you."

memories.description: Luna will survive Azkaban. She's tougher than people think and she'll cope, even in that place.
memories.source_text: "She will," said Harry. He could not bear to contemplate the alternative. "She’s tough, Luna, much tougher than you’d think. She’s probably teaching all the inmates about Wrackspurts and Nargles."

memories.description: Get everyone out first. I am not risking more lives when Voldemort is closing in.
memories.source_text: "Go! We'll follow, just go!"

memories.description: If people notice prisoners gone, everything is finished. We had to stop anyone coming down.
memories.source_text: "The moment anyone entered the room and saw the absence of three prisoners, they were lost."

memories.description: Voldemort will react with instant, terrifying violence when summoned. His return will hurt me through the scar and make everything collapse fast.
memories.source_text: "You will not win, you cannot win! That wand will never, ever be yours"

memories.description: When there is a chance to get someone out, I have to grab it and run. Get people to safety is top priority.
memories.source_text: "Ron, catch — and GO!"

memories.description: Dobby risked everything for us. He is fiercely loyal and will do something nobody expected. I owe him.
memories.source_text: "Dobby has no master! Dobby is a free elf, and Dobby has come to save Harry Potter and his friends!"

memories.description: Even when we escape, terrible things can happen. I could not save Dobby in time and that hit me like a knife.
memories.source_text: "Dobby — no — HELP!"

memories.description: Lupin left early. He got up, wrapped his traveling cloak around himself and went off. He's not staying for long.
memories.source_text: "No . . . no . . . I really must get back," said Lupin at last, declining yet another goblet of wine.

memories.description: Bill's congratulating tone reminded me that people are still celebrating and that I'm meant to be part of this family moment, even if things are tense.
memories.source_text: "Godfather, Harry!" said Bill as they walked into the kitchen together, helping clear the table.

memories.description: Bill knows about my plan with Griphook. He spelled it out to me as if it were obvious.
memories.source_text: "Harry, you're planning something with Griphook."

memories.description: Bill knows goblins. He worked at Gringotts and he's warning me because he understands them and what they might do.
memories.source_text: "I know goblins," said Bill. "I've worked for Gringotts ever since I left Hogwarts."

memories.description: This is serious. Bill wanted privacy to warn me, so I can't treat his words lightly. He's worried enough to pull me aside.
memories.source_text: "I wanted a private word, actually, Harry. It hasn't been easy to get an opportunity with the cottage this full of people."

memories.description: Don't let anyone touch my scar. It hurts like mad and if they probe it I can't keep my head clear.
memories.source_text: "Don't touch it!"

memories.description: People will treat me like a prize to be paraded. They think catching me and my wand is worth everything, but I have to stay focused, not let them use my fear against me.
memories.source_text: "I thought you wore glasses, Potter?"

memories.description: Greyback won't summon Voldemort himself. He's useful but not trusted enough to call in the big boss. That means they plan to take me to the Malfoys.
memories.source_text: "I haven't got — they say he's using the Malfoys' place as a base. We’ll take the boy there."

memories.description: I can't rely on magical messages to save us easily. I begged and got nothing. I have to act with what we've actually got in the room.
memories.source_text: "Help us! We're in the cellar of Malfoy Manor, help us!"

memories.description: Dobby cares enough to risk himself for me. He will help get some of us out and I can ask him to fetch people to safety.
memories.source_text: "Dobby has come to rescue you."

memories.description: Three things together would make someone master of Death. If I had them, I'd be the one in control.
memories.source_text: Three objects, or Hallows, which, if united, will make the possessor master of Death . . .

memories.description: Maybe the Hallows are the answer against Horcruxes. If I owned the Hallows, maybe I could beat Voldemort and stay alive.
memories.source_text: Hallows versus Horcruxes? Was there a way, after all, to ensure that he was the one who triumphed? If he were the master of the Deathly Hallows, would he be safe?

memories.description: My Invisibility Cloak is astonishingly light and smooth. I can feel it, almost like it's part of me when I touch it.
memories.source_text: He had pulled out his Invisibility Cloak and was running it through his fingers, the cloth supple as water, light as air.

memories.description: Right. I heard him. Thanks. I'll bear that in mind and actually remember it.
memories.source_text: “Right,” said Harry as Bill opened the door, “yeah. Thanks. I’ll bear that in mind.”

memories.description: So goblins think anything they make belongs to them no matter what. Even if a wizard buys something they'd see it as only rented and expect it back eventually.
memories.source_text: All goblin-made objects are, in goblin eyes, rightfully theirs.

memories.description: They reckon our way of handing goblin stuff down from wizard to wizard is basically stealing. That's mental.
memories.source_text: They consider our habit of keeping goblin-made objects, passing them from wizard to wizard without further payment, little more than theft.

memories.description: I can't promise goblins anything lightly. If I go back on my word to one of them it could be worse than breaking into Gringotts. I need to be careful.
memories.source_text: All I am saying is to be very careful what you promise goblins, Harry. It would be less dangerous to break into Gringotts than to renege on a promise to a goblin.

memories.description: I won't be lying, honest. I'm doing what has to be done, even if it feels wrong. I'm defiant about it but ashamed at the same time.
memories.source_text: "I won’t be lying . . . really."

memories.description: That whole 'for the greater good' stuff makes me uneasy. I shove the idea out of my head because we've no choice, but it still sits wrong with me.
memories.source_text: He remembered the words that had been engraved over the gateway to Nurmengard: FOR THE GREATER GOOD. He pushed the idea away.

memories.description: I gave Griphook my word that I'll hand over the Sword of Gryffindor if he helps us. I meant it, even if I'm worried about it.
memories.source_text: "I have your word, Harry Potter, that you will give me the sword of Gryffindor if I help you?" "Yes," said Harry.

memories.description: Lupin still believes I'm alive and sees me as a symbol. If he thinks that, maybe he forgives me. That hits me hard, and I feel both grateful and ashamed.
memories.source_text: "I do," said Lupin firmly. "There is no doubt at all in my mind that his death would be proclaimed as widely as possible by the Death Eaters if it had happened... 'The Boy Who Lived' remains a symbol of everything for which we are fighting"

memories.description: Hagrid got away. He's on the run after supposedly hosting a Support Harry Potter party at Hogwarts. That means he's still out there and dangerous times don't stop him from being reckless.
memories.source_text: "Rubeus Hagrid... has narrowly escaped arrest within the grounds of Hogwarts... Hagrid was not taken into custody, and is, we believe, on the run."

memories.description: Lupin telling me to follow my instincts makes me trust my gut more. If he says my instincts are nearly always right, I should listen to them.
memories.source_text: "And I'd tell him to follow his instincts, which are good and nearly always right."

memories.description: Potterwatch will use 'Mad-Eye' as the next password. That gives us a lead to find their next broadcast.
memories.source_text: "Keep twiddling those dials: The next password will be 'Mad-Eye.'"

memories.description: Maybe the goblin story isn't true. I can't just accept their version of history without question.
memories.source_text: "Maybe he’s lying," Harry said, opening his eyes again. "Griphook. Maybe Gryffindor didn’t take the sword. How do we know the goblin version of history’s right?"

memories.description: I'll tell Griphook he can have the sword after he helps us, but I'm going to be careful about the timing so we can use it first.
memories.source_text: "We’ll tell him he can have the sword after he’s helped us get into that vault — but we’ll be careful to avoid telling him exactly when he can have it."

memories.description: I want Griphook's help and I intend to keep my word about giving the sword back after we've used it on the Horcruxes.
memories.source_text: "He can have it," Harry went on, "after we’ve used it on all of the Horcruxes. I’ll make sure he gets it then. I’ll keep my word."

memories.description: He's agreed to help us but he expects payment. That's clear. I can't just assume he'll do it for free.
memories.source_text: I have reached my decision, Harry Potter. I have decided to help you

memories.description: He wants the sword, not gold. That sword is exactly what he's after.
memories.source_text: I want the sword. The sword of Godric Gryffindor.

memories.description: So goblins don't see the sword as simply ours. They reckon it belonged to goblin ancestors before Gryffindor took it. That changes how I think about who has a claim to it.
memories.source_text: It was Ragnuk the First's, taken from him by Godric Gryffindor

memories.description: I felt relieved when he seemed willing to help. But that relief turned to worry once I realised what he wanted in return.
memories.source_text: That's great! Griphook, thank you, we're really

memories.description: I'm the godfather. I couldn't believe it at first when Remus asked me, but I'm overwhelmed and honoured. I feel stunned and really happy about it.
memories.source_text: ["You—you'll be godfather?" "M-me?" "You, yes, of course — Dora quite agrees, no one better —"]

memories.description: I'm amazed and delighted. Everything feels lighter, like the blast in Grimmauld Place never happened.
memories.source_text: ["I — yeah — blimey —" (Harry felt overwhelmed, astonished, delighted)]

memories.description: Bill warned me to be careful if I've made a deal with Griphook. Goblins think about ownership differently to wizards and I need to watch my back.
memories.source_text: "If you have struck any kind of bargain with Griphook, and most particularly if that bargain involves treasure, you must be exceptionally careful. Goblin notions of ownership, payment, and repayment are not the same as human ones."

memories.description: Goblins believe the maker is the true owner of an object, not the person who bought it. That could make any treasure-related bargain dangerous.
memories.source_text: "To a goblin, the rightful and true master of any object is the maker, not the purchaser."

memories.description: I won't tell Bill what I promised Griphook. I kept my mouth shut and I'm sticking to it.
memories.source_text: "I can’t tell you that," said Harry. "Sorry, Bill."

memories.description: The Lestrange vault is ancient. The oldest wizarding families keep their valuables down in the deepest, biggest, most protected level.
memories.source_text: "It is one of the most ancient chambers. The oldest Wizarding families store their treasures at the deepest level, where the vaults are largest and best protected."

memories.description: Griphook put the false sword in the Lestrange vault once. He knows how that vault works and has been inside it.
memories.source_text: "I have visited the Lestranges' vault only once...on the occasion I was told to place inside it the false sword."

memories.description: Remus Lupin is a werewolf and he's married to Nymphadora Tonks. Someone at Shell Cottage gave him the address and asked him to come in an emergency.
memories.source_text: "I am a werewolf, married to Nymphadora Tonks, and you, the Secret-Keeper of Shell Cottage, told me the address and bade me come in an emergency!"

memories.description: Lupin shouted that it's a boy, so whatever's happened involves a baby boy.
memories.source_text: "It's a boy!"

memories.description: Lupin turned up suddenly and straightaway made himself known. I couldn't believe he was here and that he'd come to help.
memories.source_text: "It is I, Remus John Lupin!"

memories.description: The Cloak is the real deal. It makes you truly invisible and it lasts forever. It's not just a trick.
memories.source_text: "The Cloak was exactly what Xenophilius had described: A cloak that really and truly renders the wearer completely invisible"

memories.description: I'm descended from Ignotus Peverell. That makes the Cloak part of my family inheritance. That's mine by right.
memories.source_text: "He’s my ancestor! I’m descended from the third brother!"

memories.description: Dumbledore left me something hidden inside the Snitch. I think it's my mum's ring, which must be the Resurrection Stone.
memories.source_text: "IT’S IN HERE! He left me the ring — it’s in the Snitch!"

memories.description: Voldemort isn't looking for a new wand. He's hunting the Elder Wand, an old wand with a bloody history, and he doesn't see the whole picture about the Hallows.
memories.source_text: "That’s what he’s after." "You-Know-Who’s after the Elder Wand."

memories.description: The Hallows are real. I already have at least one Hallow and maybe two. If I get them all I'm master of death, or at least that's what it looks like to me now.
memories.source_text: "The Deathly Hallows are real, and I’ve got one — maybe two —"

memories.description: I trust that Dumbledore left this for me to discover. He wanted me to learn and to face things on my own.
memories.source_text: "Dumbledore usually let me find out stuff for myself. He let me try my strength, take risks. This feels like the kind of thing he’d do."

memories.description: Voldemort used part of what he found as a Horcrux. That shows he didn't know everything about the Hallows or he'd have done something different.
memories.source_text: "He took a Hallow, and turned it into a Horcrux"

memories.description: That message on the Snitch matters. The Snitch will open at some specific time or event, not straight away, and I have to wait until the right moment.
memories.source_text: "I open at the close."

memories.description: If Voldemort had known the Hallows made someone master of death, he would have chased them instead of relying solely on Horcruxes. So he didn't know the full truth.
memories.source_text: "If Voldemort had known about the Deathly Hallows, surely he would have sought them"

memories.description: Griphook knows who I am and holds me in a kind of wary respect. That can help or hinder us depending on how I play it.
memories.source_text: "I remember, Harry Potter. Even amongst goblins, you are very famous."

memories.description: Griphook remembers I brought him here and that I saved him. That debt affects how he reacts to me.
memories.source_text: "You also rescued a goblin."

memories.description: There is something in the Lestrange vault that terrified Bellatrix. I am sure now it is a Horcrux. We have to get in.
memories.source_text: "What do you seek within the Lestranges' vault?"

memories.description: The sword Griphook touched is the real Gryffindor sword and the one in Bellatrix's vault is a fake. That changes what we can trust about the vault's contents.
memories.source_text: "The sword that lies inside it is a fake. This is the real one."

memories.description: Goblins take vault secrets very seriously. If we want into Gringotts we need a goblin's cooperation, not just brute force.
memories.source_text: "It is against our code to speak of the secrets of Gringotts. We are the guardians of fabulous treasures."

memories.description: Voldemort would have hidden a Horcrux where he thought it would seem like a private treasure. The Lestrange vault fits that exactly.
memories.source_text: "He probably told her it was a treasured possession and asked her to place it in her vault."

memories.description: Goblins resent wand-carriers and feel their craft is stolen from them. Any deal with Griphook will be tangled up with that grievance.
memories.source_text: "The right to carry a wand has long been contested between wizards and goblins."

memories.description: Voldemort would have seen a Gringotts vault as a symbol of belonging and power. That explains why he trusted the Lestranges with something important.
memories.source_text: "I think he would have envied anyone who had a key to a Gringotts vault."

memories.description: Griphook is not agreeing yet. He is keeping us hanging. I have to be careful and persuasive if I want his help.
memories.source_text: "I shall think about it," said Griphook maddeningly.

memories.description: Ollivander and others were rescued because of me. People who suffered under Voldemort's followers are grateful and weakened. Time is short and I need to act fast.
memories.source_text: "Mr. Ollivander, I’m sorry to disturb you," "You rescued us. I thought we would die in that place."

memories.description: Hermione needed help and Ron had taken her inside. I felt responsible and needed to know she was safe.
memories.source_text: Hermione? Where is she?

memories.description: Dobby deserved respect, not a quick wand-fix. I wanted to do things properly for him, even if it meant getting my hands dirty.
memories.source_text: I want to do it properly. Not by magic. Have you got a spade?

memories.description: I have to talk to the goblin and Ollivander right now. Nothing can wait; there's something important I must sort out with them.
memories.source_text: I need to speak to Griphook and Ollivander

memories.description: This mission is secret. I can't explain our plans even to allies. It's on us to carry it out without spreading details.
memories.source_text: We can't tell you what we're doing

memories.description: Dobby's death hit me hard. I owe him everything he did for us, and losing him makes me more determined and angrier at whoever's responsible.
memories.source_text: Good-bye, Dobby

memories.description: The Summoning Charm didn't work on the cloak. I grabbed it and it stayed put.
memories.source_text: "The Summoning Charm had not worked on it."

memories.description: They set a trap for us. Of course they knew we were coming.
memories.source_text: "They were ready for us," whispered Harry.

memories.description: They're searching the streets and ready to split up to find us. We're being hunted.
memories.source_text: "Spread out. He’s here."

memories.description: I don't know what it's after. My hands are numb with cold but I am not letting go no matter what.
memories.source_text: "No idea," Harry bellowed back. His hands were numb with cold but he did not dare attempt to shift his grip.

memories.description: If that dragon heads for the sea and we see the coast disappear, we're in real trouble. I'm freezing, starving and parched, and I keep thinking when that thing last had a meal.
memories.source_text: He had been wondering for some time what they would do if they saw the coast sail beneath them, if the dragon headed for open sea; he was cold and numb, not to mention desperately hungry and thirsty.

memories.description: My wand is gone for good. I can't fix it and I can't pretend otherwise. That's that.
memories.source_text: "No," whispered Ollivander. "I am sorry, very sorry, but a wand that has suffered this degree of damage cannot be repaired by any means that I know of."

memories.description: If you take a wand from someone, the wand will usually switch its loyalty to you. Taking it matters.
memories.source_text: "In general, however, where a wand has been won, its allegiance will change."

memories.description: Wands pick witches and wizards, not the other way round. That's how wandlore works.
memories.source_text: "The wand chooses the wizard," said Ollivander.

memories.description: My wand did something nobody expected because of its twin core link. It's weird and rare and it explains why my wand beat another that night.
memories.source_text: "I had . . . never heard of such a thing. Your wand performed something unique that night. The connection of the twin cores is incredibly rare,"

memories.description: Voldemort was asking about the Elder Wand. He wants it and he thinks it could beat whatever protects me.
memories.source_text: "He wanted to know everything I could tell him about the wand variously known as the Deathstick, the Wand of Destiny, or the Elder Wand."

memories.description: If Voldemort gets the Elder Wand he could become terrifyingly powerful. That's plain as day.
memories.source_text: "The Dark Lord in possession of the Deathstick is, I must admit . . . formidable."

memories.description: The Elder Wand has a history. Gregorovitch had it, Grindelwald stole it from him, then Dumbledore beat Grindelwald and took it.
memories.source_text: "Gregorovitch had the Elder Wand a long time ago," he said. "I saw You-Know-Who trying to find him. When he tracked him down, he found that Gregorovitch didn’t have it anymore: It was stolen from him by Grindelwald."

memories.description: Dumbledore got the Elder Wand and kept it at Hogwarts. Voldemort knows that and he's already gone after it.
memories.source_text: "Dumbledore had the Elder Wand?" "At Hogwarts," said Harry.

memories.description: Dumbledore didn't want me chasing the Elder Wand. He wanted me focused on the Horcruxes. I see now why he set things up that way.
memories.source_text: "Dumbledore didn’t want me to have it. He didn’t want me to take it. He wanted me to get the Horcruxes."

memories.description: My whole body is dead from holding on to this dragon, I can barely keep my grip.
memories.source_text: Every part of Harry ached with the effort of holding on to the dragon’s back.

memories.description: We're getting lower, I can see mountains and a lake down there, the view is getting clearer.
memories.source_text: Harry looked down and saw deep green mountains and lakes, coppery in the sunset.

memories.description: I reckon the dragon might be homing in on that lake because it saw the sunlight on the water.
memories.source_text: he wondered whether it had divined the presence of fresh water by the flashes of reflected sunlight.

memories.description: The dragon is spiraling down toward that smaller lake, it's definitely aiming for it.
memories.source_text: Lower and lower the dragon flew, in great spiraling circles, honing in, it seemed, upon one of the smaller lakes.

memories.description: I lit my wand to find things fast. Point, bright, get on with it.
memories.source_text: "Lumos!"

memories.description: Don't touch the treasure. Touching makes copies and burns you. Simple as that.
memories.source_text: "Okay, don’t touch anything!"

memories.description: I thought the goblin would help if we needed the sword. I had to try bargaining and then use the sword to get the cup. I can't rely on goblins to keep their side.
memories.source_text: "If you want the sword, Griphook, then you’ll have to help us more than — wait! Can I touch stuff with the sword? Hermione, give it here!"

memories.description: I can yank someone down from being hoisted and use that moment to grab what we need. Quick spells, quick moves.
memories.source_text: "Liberacorpus!"

memories.description: When things go wrong, blasting forward works. I will stun and force a way through rather than wait around.
memories.source_text: "Stupefy!"

memories.description: If you break the dragon's chains the dragon will get free and you can use it as your escape. Dangerous, but desperate times call for desperate moves.
memories.source_text: "Relashio!"

memories.description: Griphook betrayed us the moment he could. I gave him my trust and he chose the sword over his promise. I will not be naive about goblins taking what they can.
memories.source_text: "Get it!"

memories.description: My ribs hurt and I'm starving, but I couldn't stop laughing — lying back on the grass, I just laughed to keep myself going.
memories.source_text: "Harry’s ribs ached, he felt lightheaded with hunger, but he lay back on the grass beneath the reddening sky and laughed"

memories.description: We ducked behind the counter and up a rickety staircase into a grubby sitting room. It's the Hog's Head and it's as dingy as you'd expect.
memories.source_text: "They ran behind the counter and through a second doorway, which led to a rickety wooden staircase that they climbed as fast as they could."

memories.description: I recognized the barman. He wasn't hooded like the others. He stood out, plain as day.
memories.source_text: "Their savior, whom Harry now recognized as the Hog’s Head’s barman, was the only person not wearing a hood."

memories.description: The barman shouted he wouldn't stand for dementors in his street and that he'd send a Patronus back. He sounds stubborn and protective of his place.
memories.source_text: "So what? You send dementors down my street, I’ll send a Patronus back at ’em! I’m not having ’em near me, I’ve told you that, I’m not having it!"

memories.description: Someone accused the Patronus of being a stag and called it mine. They think the stag Patronus belongs to me.
memories.source_text: "That wasn’t your Patronus!" said a Death Eater. "That was a stag, it was Potter’s!"

memories.description: The barman yelled 'Stag' and pulled his wand like he meant to fight. He was ready to act, wand out and loud about it.
memories.source_text: "Stag!" roared the barman, and he pulled out a wand. "Stag!"

memories.description: We're under the Invisibility Cloak, sneaking to see what's happening without being spotted.
memories.source_text: "Still wearing the Invisibility Cloak, they crept toward the grimy window and looked down."

memories.description: You're a lifesaver. I owe you one, plain and simple.
memories.source_text: "I don't know how to thank you. You've saved our lives twice."

memories.description: It is true. We did break into Gringotts and we did escape on a dragon.
memories.source_text: "Yeah, it's true," said Harry.

memories.description: All the old passages are sealed up and guarded. There is no safe way in or out through them now.
memories.source_text: "There’s no chance of getting through any of them now, not with curses over the entrances and Death Eaters and dementors waiting at the exits."

memories.description: We'll jump when it gets low enough, straight into the water before it realises the dragon spots us
memories.source_text: I say we jump when it gets low enough! Straight into the water before it realizes we're here!

memories.description: I got the Horcrux, but we don't have the sword. I even had to drip dittany on the burn from my ripped jeans
memories.source_text: At least we can't wear it this time, that'd look a bit weird hanging round our necks

memories.description: No sword. That's messed everything up, it's annoying and I need to figure out how to cope without it
memories.source_text: No sword

memories.description: I will not let them give anyone the Dementor's Kiss. I can't, I won't stand for that.
memories.source_text: "He could not, would not, suffer the Dementor’s Kiss, whatever happened afterward."

memories.description: Dementors home in on fear and despair. When people are terrified they come faster.
memories.source_text: "Could they sense fear in the vicinity? ... tasting despair on the air, closing in"

memories.description: I shouted Expecto Patronum and a silver stag came out of my wand. It works for me.
memories.source_text: "He whispered, 'Expecto Patronum!' The silver stag burst from his wand"

memories.description: Ron and Hermione are everything right now. I thought of them the second I cast the Patronus.
memories.source_text: "It was of Ron and Hermione that he thought as he whispered, 'Expecto Patronum!'"

memories.description: Right now I have to use Imperio. If I don't act quick I lose control of the whole plan.
memories.source_text: "Act now, act now," whispered Griphook in Harry’s ear, "the Imperius Curse!"

memories.description: The Imperius actually makes people look blank and do exactly what I tell them when it takes hold.
memories.source_text: "They’re Imperiused," he added, in response to Hermione and Ron’s confused queries about Travers and Bogrod, who were both now standing there looking blank.

memories.description: I can't half-arse an Unforgivable. If I don't mean it properly it might not work.
memories.source_text: "I don't think I did it strongly enough, I don't know. . . ."

memories.description: There's a defense in Gringotts that washes away enchantments and disguises. It ruined our cover and stripped Hermione back to herself.
memories.source_text: "The Thief’s Downfall!" said Griphook, clambering to his feet and looking back at the deluge onto the tracks, which, Harry knew now, had been more than water.

memories.description: We can't open a vault without a goblin. We need Bogrod and those Clankers to get past the dragon.
memories.source_text: "We need him," said Griphook, "we cannot enter the vault without a Gringotts goblin. And we need the Clankers!"

memories.description: The goblins will play along if they think it's their orders. I can use that to manipulate them with Imperio when I must.
memories.source_text: "Good, good! So, if you will follow me, Madam Lestrange," said the old goblin, hopping down off his stool and vanishing from sight, "I shall take you to your vault."

memories.description: Once the goblin touches the vault it opens. Getting a goblin to press the door is the key to getting inside.
memories.source_text: "Make him press his hand to the door!" Griphook urged Harry, who turned his wand again upon Bogrod. The old goblin obeyed, pressing his palm to the wood, and the door of the vault melted away to reveal a cavelike opening crammed from floor to ceiling with golden coins and goblets..."

memories.description: That mirror showed me Aberforth has been watching us. He buys mirrors like that and keeps an eye out.
memories.source_text: "It’s your eye I’ve been seeing in the mirror."

memories.description: Aberforth sent Dobby to help us. He expected the elf to be around with us.
memories.source_text: "You sent Dobby."

memories.description: Dobby is dead. Bellatrix killed him and I buried him. That matters to me and it will matter to how I carry on.
memories.source_text: "He’s dead," said Harry. "Bellatrix Lestrange killed him."

memories.description: Aberforth bought Sirius’s mirror from Dung. He knew what it was and has been trying to keep watch.
memories.source_text: "Bought it from Dung ’bout a year ago," said Aberforth.

memories.description: Dumbledore was not free of the past. He was tormented and not the untouchable figure people make him out to be.
memories.source_text: "He thought he was back there with you and Grindelwald, I know he did," said Harry.

memories.description: I still trust Dumbledore enough to follow his plan. I know there are things he hid, but I'm committed to finishing what he started.
memories.source_text: "Professor Dumbledore cared about Harry, very much," said Hermione in a low voice.

memories.description: Right, so Hogwarts is basically under their control. The Carrows run discipline and it's brutal. They're teaching Dark Arts and forcing kids to use the Cruciatus on others.
memories.source_text: "You’re right," said Harry, "but tell us about Hogwarts, Neville, we haven’t heard anything."

memories.description: That's worse than I thought. This isn't just harsh rules, it's deliberate torture and humiliation, and the whole place has been twisted into something cruel.
memories.source_text: "They’re in charge of all discipline. They like punishment, the Carrows."

memories.description: People still took courage from what I did. I didn't realize how much my actions mattered to students like Neville.
memories.source_text: "The thing is, it helps when people stand up to them, it gives everyone hope. I used to notice that when you did it, Harry."

memories.description: They kidnapped Neville's gran to try to control him. That's brutal and desperate.
memories.source_text: "They what?" said Harry, Ron, and Hermione together.

memories.description: We're in some kind of hideout — it looks like the Room of Requirement they've set up as a D.A. base.
memories.source_text: "Where are we?"

memories.description: People here clearly trust and cheer me — I'm a symbol for them, and they're glad I'm back.
memories.source_text: "Look who it is! Didn’t I tell you?" As Harry emerged into the room beyond the passage, there were several screams and yells: "HARRY!" "It’s Potter, it’s POTTER!" "Ron!" "Hermione!"

memories.description: If Hermione uses Bellatrix’s actual wand, people will buy her as Bellatrix. That will help our disguise.
memories.source_text: “And you’ll be using her actual wand,” said Harry, nodding toward the walnut wand, “so I reckon you’ll be pretty convincing.”

memories.description: That wand is dangerous and feels wrong. I suddenly want to get rid of it, smash it with the sword, because it feels like a bit of her.
memories.source_text: “This is the wand that tortured Neville’s mum and dad, and who knows how many other people? This is the wand that killed Sirius!”

memories.description: I’m on edge around Griphook. I reach for the sword when he comes in, and I don’t trust him. I want him gone as soon as possible.
memories.source_text: The door of the bedroom opened and Griphook entered. Harry reached instinctively for the hilt of the sword and drew it close to him, but regretted his action at once: He could tell that the goblin had noticed.

memories.description: Hermione must change into Bellatrix before we leave. Bill and Fleur must not know what we’re up to.
memories.source_text: They had been firm on this point, because Hermione would need to transform into Bellatrix before they left, and the less that Bill and Fleur knew or suspected about what they were about to do, the better.

memories.description: Ron’s disguise works enough that only I can pick him out. I know him that well.
memories.source_text: It was just possible to discern Ron under his disguise, but only, Harry thought, because he knew him so well.

memories.description: I stood here as a kid and thought Gringotts was magical and safe. Now I’m back planning a break-in. That feels wrong and huge.
memories.source_text: Gringotts had seemed a place of wonder that day, the enchanted repository of a trove of gold he had never known he possessed, and never for an instant could he have dreamed that he would return to steal.

memories.description: We have to play Bellatrix properly. Politeness will blow the act. I want Hermione to be ruthless and nasty while we’re inside.
memories.source_text: “Too polite,” Harry whispered in Hermione’s ear as they passed out of the inn into the tiny backyard. “You need to treat people like they’re scum!”

memories.description: He knows about our Horcruxes and he is going to check them. One of the Horcruxes is at Hogwarts.
memories.source_text: "He knows, and he’s going to check where the others are, and the last one is at Hogwarts."

memories.description: I was in his head when he found out about the cup. He is furious and terrified that we know.
memories.source_text: "I saw him find out about the cup, I — I was in his head, he’s... he’s seriously angry, and scared too"

memories.description: He believes the Hogwarts Horcrux is safest because Snape is at school. He might check the Hogwarts Horcrux last, but he could be there very soon.
memories.source_text: "He thinks the Hogwarts one is safest, because Snape’s there, because it’ll be so hard not to be seen getting in, I think he’ll check that one last, but he could still be there within hours"

memories.description: If he notices the other Horcruxes are gone he could move the Hogwarts one or take other drastic steps. We need to act fast.
memories.source_text: "Can you imagine what he’s going to do once he realizes the ring and the locket are gone? What if he moves the Hogwarts Horcrux, decides it isn’t safe enough?"

memories.description: We are going to Hogsmeade to check the school's protections and try to figure out how to get in. We will stick together under the Invisibility Cloak.
memories.source_text: "We’ll go to Hogsmeade, and try to work something out once we see what the protection around the school’s like. Get under the Cloak, Hermione, I want to stick together this time."

memories.description: I pushed the wall and it just melted away under my hand. I can get through parts of the castle that way if I need to.
memories.source_text: "He gave the wall a little push. It melted away at his touch and they slipped outside"

memories.description: The Marauder's Map shows me exactly where Luna and I are. We're on the fifth floor right now.
memories.source_text: "Holding it close to his nose he searched, and located his and Luna’s dots at last. "We’re up on the fifth floor," he whispered"

memories.description: I used to think sneaking around Hogwarts was routine, but this time it's different. My heart's racing and I know getting through safely actually matters.
memories.source_text: "Harry had prowled the castle at night many times before, but never had his heart hammered this fast, never had so much depended on his safe passage through the place."

memories.description: If anything's going to ruin this, it's going to be Peeves. I'm on edge listening for him the whole time.
memories.source_text: "He expected to encounter an obstacle at any moment; his worst fear was Peeves"

memories.description: When we reached Ravenclaw Tower I half expected a password. Instead the door asks riddles and you have to answer to get in.
memories.source_text: "What? Isn’t there just a password?"

memories.description: The riddle-answering actually works. Give the right answer and the door opens.
memories.source_text: "Well reasoned," said the voice, and the door swung open."

memories.description: My face is a mess, it's all puffed up and I can barely see. I got stung.
memories.source_text: "Stung," Harry muttered. "Been stung."

memories.description: I lied my way through with a name. I said I was Vernon Dudley to try to get us out of trouble.
memories.source_text: "Dudley," said Harry. "And your first name?" "I — Vernon. Vernon Dudley."

memories.description: I made up that my dad works at the Ministry, Department of Magical Accidents and Catastrophes, hoping that might scare them off.
memories.source_text: "He works at the Ministry," Harry lied. "Department of Magical Accidents and Catastrophes."

memories.description: When they asked about Slytherin I blurted out something I thought they'd expect, the dungeons under the lake and all that, to sound convincing.
memories.source_text: "It’s in the dungeons," said Harry clearly. "You enter through the wall. It’s full of skulls and stuff and it’s under the lake, so the light’s all green."

memories.description: They found a sword that looks goblin-made. If they think it's important they might use it as leverage on us.
memories.source_text: "Ve-e-ry nice," said Greyback appreciatively, taking it from his companion. "Oh, very nice indeed. Looks goblin-made, that."

memories.description: They've seen Hermione's face in the Prophet and they think she's traveling with me. That could make things a lot worse for her.
memories.source_text: "’ermione Granger,'" Scabior was saying, "'the Mudblood who is known to be traveling with 'arry Potter.'"

memories.description: Dean was here too, tied up with us. We're not alone in this, which is something at least.
memories.source_text: "Harry?" It was a new, but familiar, voice, and it came from directly behind Harry, from the person tied to Hermione’s left. "Dean?" "It is you!"

memories.description: My scar flared and I felt Voldemort's thoughts reach for me. I had to force myself to shut him out so I wouldn't lose control.
memories.source_text: "As Scabior said it, Harry’s scar, which was stretched tight across his distended forehead, burned savagely."

memories.description: I’m going to do it. I’ll go under the Cloak and be back as soon as I can. I’ll take the risk and get it myself.
memories.source_text: "You stay here and look after Hermione, and I’ll go and get it —” Harry cut across Ron. “You two stay here, I’ll go under the Cloak and I’ll be back as soon as I —”

memories.description: Dumbledore left this to the three of us. I'm supposed to do this with Ron and Hermione and no one else.
memories.source_text: Dumbledore left the three of us a job

memories.description: We can't tell anyone about what we're doing. It has to be just the three of us. I can't risk more people getting involved.
memories.source_text: We — we can't tell you. We've got to do it — alone.

memories.description: My scar's burning again. It's a sign something's wrong and it's making it hard to think straight.
memories.source_text: My scar was still searing.

memories.description: They trust me and they're loyal to Dumbledore. I know they're ready to fight, but I can't put them in danger with what we have to do.
memories.source_text: Everyone in here's proven they're loyal to Dumbledore — loyal to you.

memories.description: I keep saying they don't understand because I can't explain. I'm frustrated and desperate and I need them to accept that we must go on alone.
memories.source_text: You don't understand.

memories.description: They came because of the message. People are willing to risk everything for me and for the cause, which makes this even harder.
memories.source_text: We got your message, Neville! Hello you three, I thought you must be here!

memories.description: He's on his way right now. He's coming for me and fast.
memories.source_text: "Professor McGonagall, Voldemort’s on the way."

memories.description: He already knows where I am. That scar tells me when he's close.
memories.source_text: "He already knows where I am."

memories.description: There might be something hidden in the castle that could be the Ravenclaw diadem. I have to find it.
memories.source_text: "Professor, do you know where the diadem of Ravenclaw is?" "The d-diadem of Ravenclaw? Of course not — hasn't it been lost for centuries?"

memories.description: I'm acting on Dumbledore's orders. I have to trust that's what he would have wanted me to do.
memories.source_text: "You’re acting on Dumbledore’s orders?"

memories.description: There's a passageway into the Hog's Head that can get students out. If Death Eaters are watching the boundaries, they won't check people disappearing from a pub.
memories.source_text: "There’s a way," said Harry quickly, and he explained about the passageway leading into the Hog’s Head.

memories.description: Snape was patrolling and was looking for me. He noticed something, he was ready to insist on finding me.
memories.source_text: "Have you seen Harry Potter, Minerva? Because if you have, I must insist —"

memories.description: Snape escaped. He leapt from the window and isn't dead. He still has a wand and has picked up dangerous tricks.
memories.source_text: "He jumped," said Professor McGonagall ... "No, he’s not dead," said McGonagall bitterly. "Unlike Dumbledore, he was still carrying a wand . . . and he seems to have learned a few tricks from his master."

memories.description: Something huge and batlike is flying toward the perimeter wall. Voldemort's forces are arriving now.
memories.source_text: "With a tingle of horror, Harry saw in the distance a huge, batlike shape flying through the darkness toward the perimeter wall."

memories.description: McGonagall and the other teachers will try to hold him off while I search. I can't just run; I have to keep looking for Horcruxes.
memories.source_text: "We shall secure the school against He-Who-Must-Not-Be-Named while you search for this — this object."

memories.description: We have to find whatever it is quickly, and we do not have to tell everyone it's a Horcrux.
memories.source_text: [We’ve got to find it fast. We don’t have to tell them it’s a Horcrux.]

memories.description: Okay. I am going to let Ron and Hermione in on this. I do not have to carry it all by myself.
memories.source_text: [All right,]

memories.description: I used to think keeping things secret was right because Dumbledore did it, but I am worried about blind trust. I do not want to end up repeating his mistakes.
memories.source_text: [Dumbledore had warned him against telling anyone but Ron and Hermione about the Horcruxes. Secrets and lies, that’s how we grew up, and Albus . . . he was a natural. . . . Was he turning into Dumbledore, keeping his secrets clutched to his chest, afraid to trust? But Dumbledore had trusted Snape, and where had that led? To murder at the top of the highest tower . . .]

memories.description: There is an object hidden at Hogwarts that can help us beat You-Know-Who. It might be connected to Ravenclaw.
memories.source_text: [There’s something we need to find. Something — something that’ll help us overthrow You-Know-Who. It’s here at Hogwarts, but we don’t know where. It might have belonged to Ravenclaw.]

memories.description: If no one has seen anything like it, a very old lost object like Ravenclaw's diadem seems unlikely to be the Horcrux we're after.
memories.source_text: [And none of you have ever seen anything that looks like it?] They all shook their heads.

memories.description: He spat at Professor McGonagall. I saw it happen and I knew I couldn't stand by while that went unpunished.
memories.source_text: "He spat in her face."

memories.description: I used the Cruciatus Curse. It worked exactly like Bellatrix said it would when you actually mean it — it throws someone into real agony.
memories.source_text: "Crucio!"

memories.description: I used to think some spells were just about words and wandwork. Now I know for certain that intent matters — a lot. You have to mean it, or it won't have the force you want.
memories.source_text: "I see what Bellatrix meant," said Harry, the blood thundering through his brain, "you need to really mean it."

memories.description: I care about Professor McGonagall. Hearing her defend me like that made me feel proud and protective of her.
memories.source_text: "Why would Harry Potter try to get inside Ravenclaw Tower? Potter belongs in my House!"

memories.description: I spoke up and acted when someone crossed a line. I will step in and fight when people I respect are attacked.
memories.source_text: "You shouldn't have done that."

memories.description: She admits she stole the diadem from her mother. That means someone else could have taken it later but it definitely left Ravenclaw hands because she ran off with it.
memories.source_text: "I stole the diadem"

memories.description: The diadem was hidden in a hollow tree in a forest in Albania. Of course Voldemort could have come and taken it from there.
memories.source_text: "Concealed inside a hollow tree."

memories.description: It makes sense he brought the diadem back to Hogwarts the night he applied for the job. So the Horcrux is likely hidden somewhere in the castle now.
memories.source_text: "He hid the diadem in the castle, the night he asked Dumbledore to let him teach!"

memories.description: I nearly forgot about the Horcrux in the chaos. I can't let that happen. Finding the diadem is urgent and I need to get on with it right now.
memories.source_text: "What? Oh," said Harry, "oh yeah!"

memories.description: Hagrid turned up to join the fight. He shows up when it matters and I can count on him being here to help.
memories.source_text: "Harry, yer here! Yer here!"

memories.description: They reckon the dementors would find me quick. I can't risk trying a Patronus because it would give me away.
memories.source_text: Let ’em have free rein, they’d find him quick enough!

memories.description: They think the Dark Lord wants my life, not my soul, and that a Kiss from a dementor would make me easier to kill.
memories.source_text: The Dark Lord wants Potter’s life, not his soul. He’ll be easier to kill if he’s been Kissed first!

memories.description: We couldn't Disapparate. The Death Eaters' charms were stopping us from moving.
memories.source_text: They could not Disapparate

memories.description: The darkness and cold rolled in so fast the stars disappeared and the cold bit into me. It felt like everything was being drained away.
memories.source_text: Light was sucked from the environment right up to the stars, which vanished.

memories.description: If I can find and hit that single knot in the bark the Willow will be paralyzed. That's the target and that's what will stop it.
memories.source_text: trying to see the single knot in the bark of the old tree that would paralyze it

memories.description: I'm knackered and I'm having to be careful. I need to edge round those swiping branches and steady myself to get a clear shot at that knot.
memories.source_text: Panting and gasping, Harry slowed down, skirting the Willow’s swiping branches, peering through the darkness toward its thick trunk

memories.description: Colin's dead. He must've sneaked back even though he's underage, just like Malfoy and his mates. He's so small in death it felt like a punch in the stomach.
memories.source_text: Colin Creevey, though underage, must have sneaked back just as Malfoy, Crabbe, and Goyle had done. He was tiny in death.

memories.description: Voldemort knows one Horcrux is gone. If he comes to Hogwarts now we will miss our chance. We have to move, and we have to move fast.
memories.source_text: He looked at Ron and Hermione, trying to tell them without words that Voldemort had just discovered the loss of one of the other Horcruxes. Time was running out fast

memories.description: Dumbledore left me, Ron and Hermione a job. This is something only the three of us can do. We have to do it alone.
memories.source_text: There’s something we — Ron, Hermione, and I — need to do, and then we’ll get out of here

memories.description: My scar is burning and it still hurts. I need to keep control or I will lose it to whatever he is feeling.
memories.source_text: He rubbed his scar, trying to soothe the pain

memories.description: Run! The giants are fighting and I need to get Hermione out of the way, so I grabbed her hand and dragged her down the steps. I'm not hanging about.
memories.source_text: "RUN!"

memories.description: That's mental out there with all that noise and smashing. I know this is dangerous and loud and we have to move fast.
memories.source_text: the night was full of hideous yells and blows as the giants wrestled

memories.description: People are in shock all over the place. They're comforting each other, drinking, kneeling over the dead. It's chaos and grief.
memories.source_text: People were moving around, trying to comfort each other, drinking, kneeling beside the dead

memories.description: I can't see Hermione, Ron, Ginny, any of the Weasleys, or Luna. They're not where I expect them to be and that terrifies me.
memories.source_text: he could not see any of the people he loved, no hint of Hermione, Ron, Ginny, or any of the other Weasleys, no Luna

memories.description: I wanted one last look at them so badly I'd give everything for it, but if I kept looking I wouldn't be able to stop. It's better this way. I have to go without that goodbye.
memories.source_text: He felt he would have given all the time remaining to him for just one last look at them; but then, would he ever have the strength to stop looking? It was better like this.

memories.description: We have to move now, heads down, wrap the Cloak tight and get through the fight before we get caught.
memories.source_text: [“LET’S GO!” Harry yelled, and he, Ron, and Hermione gathered the Cloak tightly around themselves and pelted, heads down, through the midst of the fighters...]

memories.description: Peeves will cause chaos for us, like dropping those Snargaluff pods to distract the Death Eaters.
memories.source_text: [There came a great “Wheeeeeeeeeeee!” and, looking up, Harry saw Peeves zooming over them, dropping Snargaluff pods down onto the Death Eaters...]

memories.description: Voldemort is coming. We're not guessing it. He's on his way here.
memories.source_text: "He-Who-Must-Not-Be-Named is coming," she told the other teachers.

memories.description: Dumbledore wants me doing some job in the castle right now while everyone else bolsters protections. I'm supposed to stay and do it.
memories.source_text: "We need to put in place every protection of which we are capable while Potter does what he needs to do."

memories.description: No matter what spells we throw up, we can only delay him. We can slow him down, not stop him forever.
memories.source_text: "You realize, of course, that nothing we do will be able to keep out You-Know-Who indefinitely?" squeaked Flitwick. "But we can hold him up," said Professor Sprout.

memories.description: The Ravenclaw diadem? Nobody's seen it for ages. If that's the Horcrux, it's been lost for a very long time.
memories.source_text: "— Protego Horribilis — the diadem of Ravenclaw?" squeaked Flitwick. "Seen it? Nobody has seen it in living memory! Long since lost, boy!"

memories.description: Snape has fled. He ran. That changes things for how we expect events to play out inside the castle.
memories.source_text: "Snape's run for it — What are you doing here? How did you know?"

memories.description: The D.A. called the Order. People rallied. I can't believe how many of them showed up to stand and fight alongside us.
memories.source_text: "We sent messages to the rest of Dumbledore’s Army," Fred explained. "You couldn’t expect everyone to miss the fun, Harry, and the D.A. let the Order of the Phoenix know, and it all kind of snowballed."

memories.description: Percy finally came back to the family. He's ashamed and apologizing. He's not the same distance he used to be with Mum and Dad.
memories.source_text: "I was a fool!" Percy roared... "I was an idiot, I was a pompous prat, I was a — a —" "Ministry-loving, family-disowning, power-hungry moron," said Fred.

memories.description: The younger kids are being evacuated to the Great Hall. Underage witches and wizards will be sent away from the fighting.
memories.source_text: "You can’t do this. Everyone underage will have to leave, it’s only right."

memories.description: Ginny wants to stay and fight. I shook my head. I can't let her stay in the middle of this even though she begged me. That hurt both of us.
memories.source_text: "I can’t go home!" Ginny shouted... Her eyes met Harry’s for the first time. She looked at him beseechingly, but he shook his head and she turned away bitterly.

memories.description: Ron and Hermione are not with me. They said something about a bathroom and might be in the castle somewhere. I need to find them when I can.
memories.source_text: "Where’s Ron?" asked Harry. "Where’s Hermione?" "They must have gone up to the Great Hall already," Mr. Weasley called over his shoulder. "They said something about a bathroom," said Ginny.

memories.description: This is part of the plan. I have something I have to do on my own and I might be out of sight for a while.
memories.source_text: "It’s all part of the plan," said Harry. "There’s something I’ve got to do. Listen — Neville —"

memories.description: I took the Cloak off to make absolutely sure. I needed to check it for myself.
memories.source_text: Harry had pulled off the Cloak: The idea had come to him out of nowhere, born out of a desire to make absolutely sure.

memories.description: I lied to Neville about handing myself over. I can't let him know everything right now.
memories.source_text: "Harry, you’re not thinking of handing yourself over?" "No," Harry lied easily.

memories.description: I have to run. I can't stand here thinking about everyone I love; I need to get to the snake and Voldemort because that's the only way to stop this.
memories.source_text: "The Whomping Willow," said Harry, "go!"

memories.description: I'm moving faster than I've ever moved in my life because I won't let anything stop me from reaching that tree and whatever's at its roots.
memories.source_text: he ran so fast that they were halfway toward the forest before they were brought up short again

memories.description: I care about Fred and Hagrid and everyone back at the castle, but right now I have to put that aside and focus on ending this.
memories.source_text: Thoughts of Fred and Hagrid, and his terror for all the people he loved, scattered in and outside the castle, must all wait

memories.description: This rotten thing was a Horcrux, the diadem. I grabbed it, it was scorched and leaking a tarry blood. It fell to bits in my hands.
memories.source_text: "It was still hot, blackened with soot, but as he looked at it closely he was just able to make out the tiny words etched upon it: WIT BEYOND MEASURE IS MAN’S GREATEST TREASURE."

memories.description: That fire was Fiendfyre. Dangerous as anything, but it destroys Horcruxes. Crabbe's spell did what we needed even if he didn't mean to.
memories.source_text: "It must have been Fiendfyre!"

memories.description: Crabbe is dead. I didn't want any of this, but Crabbe's recklessness killed him.
memories.source_text: "He’s dead," said Ron harshly.

memories.description: Malfoy wanted me alive, but that did not stop his mates trying to kill us. I can't trust that his position means he'll protect me.
memories.source_text: "The Dark Lord wants him alive —" "So? I’m not killing him, am I?"

memories.description: I can still move under pressure. I caught the diadem even as that cursed fire was trying to eat us.
memories.source_text: "The diadem seemed to fall in slow motion, turning and glittering as it dropped toward the maw of a yawning serpent, and then he had it, caught it around his wrist"

memories.description: They're not giving up. Neville grabbed my wrist and made it clear everyone will keep fighting whether I want them to or not.
memories.source_text: "We’re all going to keep fighting, Harry. You know that?"

memories.description: People I love are proud of me. James and Neville think I'm nearly there and brave, and that matters more than I can say.
memories.source_text: "You’ve been so brave." "You are nearly there," said James. "Very close. We are . . . so proud of you."

memories.description: Sirius says dying does not hurt and that it is quick and easy. That is what they want me to know so I don't panic.
memories.source_text: "Dying? Not at all," said Sirius. "Quicker and easier than falling asleep."

memories.description: They think I will want it to be quick. I can almost believe that now because they make it sound bearable.
memories.source_text: "And he will want it to be quick."

memories.description: I tried to move on but Neville stopped me. I said thank you and I couldn't finish what I was going to say, which shows how stuck I am in this moment.
memories.source_text: "Thanks, Neville." "Yeah, I —"

memories.description: HAGRID, come back, I can't just leave him out there with those spiders.
memories.source_text: “HAGRID, COME BACK!”

memories.description: Hagrid got swallowed up by the spiders in the grounds, buried in the middle of them even as the spells drove the swarm off.
memories.source_text: he saw it happen: Hagrid vanished amongst the spiders, and with a great scurrying, a foul swarming movement, they retreated under the onslaught of spells, Hagrid buried in their midst.

memories.description: Something huge stepped out of the darkness and smashed the ground, blocking me from reaching Hagrid.
memories.source_text: He thought he could make out an enormous arm waving from the midst of the spider swarm, but as he made to chase after them, his way was impeded by a monumental foot, which swung down out of the darkness and made the ground on which he stood shudder.

memories.description: Glass smashed down and I had to dive back into the doorway. I need to stay under cover.
memories.source_text: glass rained down upon Harry, forcing him back under the shelter of the doorway.

memories.description: There is a huge giant smashing at the castle and roaring. This is dangerous and I have to help people get to safety.
memories.source_text: the gargantuan monster trying to crush people on the upper floors looked around and let out a roar.

memories.description: Grawp is an undersized giant. He is a giant, but smaller than the others.
memories.source_text: only now did Harry realize that Grawp was, indeed, an undersized giant.

memories.description: I know what the Ravenclaw diadem looks like and where Voldemort hid it. He put it where I'd hidden my old Potions book. Of course he thought he was the only one who knew.
memories.source_text: "I know what the diadem looks like, and I know where it is," said Harry, talking fast.

memories.description: He hid the Horcrux in a place people have always used to hide things. That means anyone could get in, not just him.
memories.source_text: "He hid it exactly where I hid my old Potions book, where everyone’s been hiding stuff for centuries. He thought he was the only one to find it."

memories.description: Tom Riddle was arrogant. He assumed he was the only one clever enough to find certain secrets. That's a mistake he made.
memories.source_text: "Tom Riddle, who confided in no one and operated alone, might have been arrogant enough to assume that he, and only he, had penetrated the deepest mysteries of Hogwarts Castle."

memories.description: I still trust Dumbledore's choices. I don't think he would have kept Slytherins hostage even if it might have helped.
memories.source_text: "It wouldn’t stop Voldemort," said Harry, "and your brother would never have done it."

memories.description: He wants me to go where he wants me. I can't let him lead us into something just because he wants me there.
memories.source_text: Voldemort wanted him to do this, wanted him to come

memories.description: The way on is straight through that snake. It's where Voldemort is, and Voldemort is at the end of the tunnel. Kill the snake, get to him. That's it. No other choice.
memories.source_text: The only way forward was to kill the snake, and the snake was where Voldemort was, and Voldemort was at the end of this tunnel

memories.description: Ron and Hermione are with me. They're backing me up. I can't duck out on them when they're risking themselves for me.
memories.source_text: “Harry, we’re coming, just get in there!” said Ron, pushing him forward.

memories.description: Three people will always know about the Horcruxes. Neville's taking my place so the secret stays safe. That's the plan.
memories.source_text: "Dumbledore had died knowing that three people still knew about the Horcruxes; now Neville would take Harry’s place: There would still be three in the secret."

memories.description: If I get the chance and they're tied up, I have to kill the snake. Kill the snake. Plain and simple.
memories.source_text: "Just in case they’re — busy — and you get the chance —" "Kill the snake?" "Kill the snake," Harry repeated.

memories.description: I have to keep a cool head like Dumbledore and make sure there are backups. We can't rely on just one person.
memories.source_text: "This was crucial, he must be like Dumbledore, keep a cool head, make sure there were backups, others to carry on."

memories.description: I can't let anyone else risk themselves. It has to be me standing here and finishing this.
memories.source_text: "I don't want anyone else to try to help," Harry said loudly, and in the total silence his voice carried like a trumpet call. "It's got to be like this. It's got to be me."

memories.description: There are no Horcruxes left. It's just him and me and one of us has to go for the other to stop existing.
memories.source_text: "There are no more Horcruxes. It's just you and me. Neither can live while the other survives, and one of us is about to leave for good."

memories.description: My mother's sacrifice wasn't an accident. Her protection matters and it ties me to the people I'm trying to protect.
memories.source_text: "Accident, was it, when my mother died to save me?"

memories.description: I was ready to die to stop him and that decision put a real shield around the people here. He can't hurt them now.
memories.source_text: "You won't be killing anyone else tonight," said Harry as they circled, and stared into each other's eyes, green into red. "You won't be able to kill any of them ever again. Don't you get it? I was ready to die to stop you from hurting these people —"

memories.description: Snape was never the wand's master. He did not win it from Dumbledore.
memories.source_text: "Severus Snape was never the true master of the Elder Wand. He never defeated Dumbledore."

memories.description: Dumbledore planned his own death so the Elder Wand would die with him and stay undefeated.
memories.source_text: "Dumbledore’s death was planned between them! Dumbledore intended to die undefeated, the wand’s last true master! If all had gone as planned, the wand’s power would have died with him, because it had never been won from him!"

memories.description: Having the wand in your hand does not make it truly yours. The wand has to choose you.
memories.source_text: "Possessing the wand isn’t enough! Holding it, using it, doesn’t make it really yours. Didn’t you listen to Ollivander? The wand chooses the wizard."

memories.description: He wants it over. That means whatever is about to happen, it's what he wants and we can't talk him out of it.
memories.source_text: "He wants it over," said Lupin.

memories.description: I didn't want any of them to die. I feel guilty and I have to say I'm sorry, even if it doesn't change anything.
memories.source_text: "I didn’t want you to die," Harry said. "Any of you. I’m sorry —"

memories.description: Remus, I'm sorry. I can't stop thinking about you losing your son and I feel closer to you and more desperate to make things right.
memories.source_text: "— right after you’d had your son . . . Remus, I’m sorry —"

memories.description: I let him kill me and the bit of his soul that was inside me got destroyed. My soul is whole and completely my own now.
memories.source_text: "You did," said Dumbledore, nodding. "Go on!"

memories.description: Voldemort used my blood to rebuild himself. My blood in his veins kept me tied to life while he lived.
memories.source_text: "He took your blood and rebuilt his living body with it! Your blood in his veins, Harry, Lily's protection inside both of you! He tethered you to life while he lives!"

memories.description: That broken thing under the chair is beyond our help. It is left to whatever it is now and I can't fix it.
memories.source_text: "Something that is beyond either of our help," said Dumbledore, referring to the maimed creature.

memories.description: Dumbledore had the Cloak the night my parents died. He told me he took the chance to have two Hallows to himself after my father died.
memories.source_text: "It was a Cloak the likes of which I had never seen, immensely old, perfect in every respect . . . and then your father died, and I had two Hallows at last, all to myself!"

memories.description: Dumbledore admitted he resented his family and chased glory. He feels awful about what he did and thinks I should despise him. I don't despise him, but I do know he made terrible choices.
memories.source_text: "You know what happened. You know. You cannot despise me more than I despise myself."

memories.description: Grindelwald wanted Godric's Hollow because of Ignotus Peverell's grave and the Hallows. That helped explain why they were both obsessed with the same things.
memories.source_text: "He wanted to come to Godric's Hollow, as I am sure you have guessed, because of the grave of Ignotus Peverell."

memories.description: I beat Grindelwald and took the wand. Plain and simple. That duel happened and the wand is mine.
memories.source_text: "I won the duel. I won the wand."

memories.description: Dumbledore actually put the Resurrection Stone on. He wanted to see Ariana and our parents again. He told me he picked it up and put it on.
memories.source_text: "You tried to use the Resurrection Stone."

memories.description: If what Dumbledore says is right, being the master of death isn't about cheating death. It's about accepting it. That makes me the kind of person who can walk into what's coming without trying to run from it.
memories.source_text: "You are the true master of death, because the true master does not seek to run away from Death."

memories.description: Dumbledore planned his death with Snape and meant for Snape to end up with the Elder Wand. He wanted things arranged. That changes how I see what was planned around me.
memories.source_text: "I admit that was my intention," said Dumbledore, "but it did not work as I intended, did it?"

memories.description: I was offered a choice to stay away instead of going back. I could take a train and not return to the fight. The choice was actually mine.
memories.source_text: "We are in King’s Cross, you say? I think that if you decided not to go back, you would be able to . . . let’s say . . . board a train."

memories.description: Voldemort is obsessed with the Elder Wand. He thinks it will make him invincible, so he will go after it and most likely won't care about the other Hallows.
memories.source_text: "He believes that the Elder Wand removes his last weakness and makes him truly invincible."

memories.description: You said you'll stay with me. I'm not letting you go anywhere. I want you there with me until it's over.
memories.source_text: "You'll stay with me?"

memories.description: They're part of me and no one else can see them. That means I won't be alone in front of him.
memories.source_text: "We are part of you," said Sirius.
