memories.description: That thing made me feel awful, like I'd never be cheerful again. It sucked the happiness right out of me.
memories.source_text: "'I felt weird,' said Ron, shifting his shoulders uncomfortably. 'Like I'd never be cheerful again.'"

memories.description: I kept telling myself no one screamed and trying to stay calm, but I was really rattled and nervous around the dementor.
memories.source_text: "'No one screamed,' said Ron, more nervously still."

memories.description: Malfoy ordered me to slice his caterpillars. Bloody cheeky of him to boss me around like that.
memories.source_text: "Weasley, slice my caterpillars for me."

memories.description: Sirius Black's been sighted nearby. Blimey, that could be trouble if he really is around here.
memories.source_text: "Hey, Harry," said Seamus Finnigan, leaning over to borrow Harry’s brass scales, "have you heard? Daily Prophet this morning — they reckon Sirius Black’s been sighted."

memories.description: A Muggle saw him and probably thinks he's just another criminal. That means the sighting might get muddled with Muggle confusion.
memories.source_text: "It was a Muggle who saw him. ’Course, she didn’t really understand. The Muggles think he’s just an ordinary criminal, don’t they?"

memories.description: Bloody hell, spiders are my nightmare. If one that big comes at me I’m not going to stand there calmly.
memories.source_text: A giant spider, six feet tall and covered in hair, was advancing on Ron, clicking its pincers menacingly.

memories.description: I might bluff my way into being brave when I have to, but I'm still terrified inside. I can throw myself at it, but I'm buzzing with fear the whole time.
memories.source_text: Ron leapt forward.

memories.description: Blimey, I can't stand Snape picking on Hermione, so I shouted back because it was unfair to ask a question and then ignore the answer.
memories.source_text: "You asked us a question and she knows the answer! Why ask if you don't want to be told?"

memories.description: Of course I got detention for sticking up for Hermione. Snape does not forgive being challenged.
memories.source_text: "Detention, Weasley,"

memories.description: Seeing Hermione upset makes me angry at Snape. I will defend her, even if it gets me into trouble.
memories.source_text: "Hermione went very red, put down her hand, and stared at the floor with her eyes full of tears."

memories.description: There's always the feast. Come on, Harry, at least we'll have the Halloween food. It's something to look forward to.
memories.source_text: “There’s always the feast,” said Ron, in an effort to cheer Harry up. “You know, the Halloween feast, in the evening.”

memories.description: I suggested the cloak because, well, it might help. Bloody hell, it was only an idea.
memories.source_text: Ron halfheartedly suggested the Invisibility Cloak, but Hermione stamped on that one...

memories.description: Blimey, McGonagall's being dead strict about this. I told her a few choice names in my head anyway.
memories.source_text: Ron called Professor McGonagall a lot of names that greatly annoyed Hermione;

memories.description: Blimey, I shouted Riddikulus and made that spider lose its legs so it just rolled to Harry's feet
memories.source_text: "Riddikulus!" bellowed Ron, and the spider's legs vanished

memories.description: When I get stuck I can still shout the spell and do something useful in a hurry
memories.source_text: "Riddikulus!" bellowed Ron

memories.description: We grabbed as many sweets as we could carry for Harry. Told you we could fit loads in our pockets.
memories.source_text: “There you go,” said Ron. “We got as much as we could carry.”

memories.description: Blimey, Lupin drank that smoking goblet from Snape. Is he mad or what?
memories.source_text: “Lupin drank it?” he gasped. “Is he mad?”

memories.description: We went all over Hogsmeade. Zonko’s, Dervish and Banges, the Three Broomsticks for butterbeer, the lot. Honest to God it was brilliant.
memories.source_text: By the sound of it — everywhere. Dervish and Banges, the wizarding equipment shop, Zonko’s Joke Shop, into the Three Broomsticks for foaming mugs of hot butterbeer, and many places besides.

memories.description: Blimey, Snape's making me do proper disgusting jobs. Scrubbing bedpans without magic is mental and it makes me furious.
memories.source_text: D’you know what that is making me do? I’ve got to scrub out the bedpans in the hospital wing. Without magic!

memories.description: I thought, if Black had hidden in Snape's office, Snape might have sorted him out. That's what I wanted to happen.
memories.source_text: Why couldn’t Black have hidden in Snape’s office, eh? He could have finished him off for us!

memories.description: Spiders are my worst nightmare. My first thought is always 'take its legs off' — anything to stop it moving, honestly.
memories.source_text: Ron was muttering to himself, “Take its legs off.”

memories.description: Blimey, I was soaked and covered in mud but I was right there with Harry when he woke up.
memories.source_text: "Ron and Hermione were also there, looking as though they’d just climbed out of a swimming pool."

memories.description: Bloody hell, I really thought he'd died. That was proper terrifying.
memories.source_text: "We thought you’d died," said Alicia, who was shaking.

memories.description: We're a team and we stick together. Seeing him like that made it clear how much he matters to us.
memories.source_text: "The Gryffindor Quidditch team, spattered with mud from head to foot, was gathered around his bed."

memories.description: He magicked you onto a stretcher and walked up to school with you floating. Everyone was staring, absolutely stunned.
memories.source_text: "Then he magicked you onto a stretcher," said Ron. "And walked up to school with you floating on it. Everyone thought you were . . ."

memories.description: Blimey, the Whomping Willow doesn't like being hit. Not a good place for a broom to land.
memories.source_text: "It — it doesn't like being hit."

memories.description: We lost a match for the first time. I still can't quite take it in, it's a proper shock.
memories.source_text: "We lost . . . for the first time ever, he had lost a Quidditch match."

memories.description: Blimey, I'm not having Harry go chasing Black. It's not worth him getting himself killed just to get revenge.
memories.source_text: "Like trying to go after Black," said Ron sharply.

memories.description: Fudge said Black is different in Azkaban. If that's true, then locking him up won't mean the same thing as it does for anyone else. All the more reason Harry shouldn't go charging about.
memories.source_text: "You heard what Fudge said. Black isn't affected by Azkaban like normal people are."

memories.description: My dad told me how bad Pettigrew was left after Black got him. That makes me sure Black's a right lunatic and really dangerous. I want Harry to take that seriously and stop thinking he can handle it alone.
memories.source_text: "Dad told me — the Order of Merlin, First Class, and Pettigrew's finger in a box. That was the biggest bit of him they could find. Black's a madman, Harry, and he's dangerous —"

memories.description: Hey, it's the holidays. We should try to do something normal like visit Hagrid. Get away from all this and not stew on it all day.
memories.source_text: "Look," said Ron, obviously casting around for a change of subject, "it's the holidays! It's nearly Christmas! Let's — let's go down and see Hagrid."

memories.description: Blimey, I thought Harry could Apparate. I'm gobsmacked at first. Then I find out it's the Marauder's Map. Still, that's mental.
memories.source_text: "Wow!' said Ron, looking very impressed, 'you've learned to Apparate!' 'Course I haven't,' said Harry.

memories.description: I reckon dementors patrolling Hogsmeade makes it unlikely Black could sneak into Honeydukes at night. It's safer than Hermione thinks.
memories.source_text: Ron pointed to a notice pasted on the inside of the sweetshop door. "——— BY ORDER OF ——— THE MINISTRY OF MAGIC Customers are reminded that until further notice, dementors will be patrolling the streets of Hogsmeade every night after sundown.

memories.description: It's Christmas. Harry deserves a break and a bit of fun. Let's not be so grim about the whole thing.
memories.source_text: "Come on, Hermione, it's Christmas. Harry deserves a break.'

memories.description: I love these sweets. Fred once gave me an Acid Pop that burned a hole through my tongue. Mum gave him a right telling off. I bet Fred would take Cockroach Clusters if I said they were peanuts.
memories.source_text: "Seen the Fizzing Whizbees, Harry?' said Ron, grabbing him and leading him over to their barrel. 'And the Jelly Slugs? And the Acid Pops? Fred gave me one of those when I was seven — it burnt a hole right through my tongue. I remember Mum walloping him with her broomstick.'

memories.description: Blimey, Lupin looks poorly. I can't help staring and wondering what's wrong with him.
memories.source_text: What d’you reckon’s the matter with him?

memories.description: She doesn’t know what we’re talking about. I reckon Hermione’s just trying to get us to chat with her again and she’s being all clever about it.
memories.source_text: She doesn’t know,

memories.description: Blimey, making a cuppa is what Mum does when someone's upset. It's small, but it's what I can do to try and help Hagrid settle down.
memories.source_text: Er — shall I make a cup of tea?

memories.description: Someone's bought Harry a Firebolt and it's ridiculously expensive. Whoever did it must be serious about giving him the best broom.
memories.source_text: Blimey, who’d spend that much on you?

memories.description: I can't wait to rub this in to Malfoy. If Harry rides that broom, Malfoy will be speechless. I'm dead keen to see his face.
memories.source_text: Malfoy! Wait till he sees you on this!

memories.description: Blimey, Harry got a Firebolt for Christmas. A real one. That's mental.
memories.source_text: "He got a Firebolt for Christmas," said Ron.

memories.description: Moony still looks ill to me. What d'you reckon's the matter with him? I can't work it out.
memories.source_text: "Still looks ill, doesn't he?" said Ron as they walked down the corridor, heading to dinner.

memories.description: Hermione's being all clever. She doesn't really know what's going on with Lupin; she's only trying to get our attention. Typical.
memories.source_text: "She doesn't know," said Ron, staring resentfully after Hermione. "She's just trying to get us to talk to her again."

memories.description: I can't believe they confiscated the Firebolt to check for jinxes. Bloody hell, that leaves Harry stuck with that rubbish Shooting Star for the match.
memories.source_text: "Don't get excited, Oliver," said Harry gloomily. "I haven't got it anymore. It was confiscated." And he explained all about how the Firebolt was now being checked for jinxes.

memories.description: Right, Hogsmeade weekend’s the first one. End of October, Halloween. Mark it down, that’s when we can get into town.
memories.source_text: "First Hogsmeade weekend," said Ron, pointing at a notice that had appeared on the battered old bulletin board. "End of October. Halloween."

memories.description: That cat’s out to get Scabbers. I’m telling you, Crookshanks has it in for him and Scabbers is poorly. Keep that cat away from him, I mean it.
memories.source_text: "That cat’s got it in for Scabbers!" said Ron, ignoring the people around him, who were starting to giggle. "And Scabbers was here first, and he’s ill!"

memories.description: I’m backing Harry to go to Hogsmeade. He shouldn’t be the only third year left behind. I’ll push him to ask McGonagall.
memories.source_text: "Ask McGonagall if you can go this time, Harry. The next one might not be for ages —" "Ron!" said Hermione.

memories.description: Blimey, Harry's got his Firebolt back and I need a go on it tomorrow. I can't wait to try it.
memories.source_text: "She gave it to you? Excellent! Listen, can I still have a go on it? Tomorrow?"

memories.description: I lost the common room passwords. That's a right mess and caused a row with Neville and Sir Cadogan.
memories.source_text: "I’ve lost the passwords!" / "I made him tell me what passwords he was going to use this week, because he keeps changing them, and now I don’t know what I’ve done with them!"

memories.description: Bloody hell, Scabbers is gone and there was blood. This is serious and I am terrified something awful happened to him.
memories.source_text: "SCABBERS! LOOK! SCABBERS!" / "BLOOD! HE’S GONE! AND YOU KNOW WHAT WAS ON THE FLOOR?"

memories.description: That was brilliant. I was whooping and dragging Harry into the crowd, buzzing with the win.
memories.source_text: "Yes!" Ron yelled, yanking Harry's arm into the air. "Yes! Yes!"

memories.description: I threw myself into the celebration and made sure Harry got the cheers. I was right at his side as everyone went mad.
memories.source_text: Before he knew it, he had been engulfed by the cheering crowd. "Yes!" Ron yelled, yanking Harry’s arm into the air.

memories.description: Seeing Malfoy humiliated made me laugh like mad. I'm still fiercely loyal to Harry and this just made us closer in the moment.
memories.source_text: Ron, who had fought his way through to Harry's side, doubled up with laughter as they watched Malfoy fighting to extricate himself from the robe

memories.description: I reckon Hagrid wants to hear everything about Saturday night and about Sirius Black.
memories.source_text: “He probably wants to hear all about Black!” said Ron.

memories.description: I'm ready to tell Hagrid what happened on Saturday night if that's why he wanted us.
memories.source_text: “All right, Hagrid!” said Ron. “S’pose you want to hear about Saturday night, do you?”

memories.description: I'm furious at Hermione's cat for eating Scabbers and it's caused a rift between us and Hermione right now.
memories.source_text: “— ate Scabbers!” Ron interjected angrily.

memories.description: I feel uneasy and guilty too because I forgot about Buckbeak's trial and that we promised to help Hagrid prepare a defense.
memories.source_text: Harry felt a nasty pang of guilt. He had completely forgotten that Buckbeak’s trial was so near, and judging by the uneasy look on Ron’s face, he had too.

memories.description: How's she doing it? I can't believe Hermione keeps showing up to everything. That's mental.
memories.source_text: "How’s she doing it?" Ron muttered to Harry one evening as Harry sat finishing a nasty essay on Undetectable Poisons for Snape.

memories.description: Blimey, Hermione's schedule is impossible. She's at everything and it's driving me mad wondering how she does it.
memories.source_text: "I heard her talking to Professor Vector, that Arithmancy witch, this morning... Ernie Macmillan told me she’s never missed a Muggle Studies class, but half of them are at the same time as Divination, and she’s never missed one of them either!"

memories.description: I’m furious with Hermione and I won’t speak to her while she defends that cat.
memories.source_text: "If she’d just get rid of that cat, I’d speak to her again!"

memories.description: The cat’s dangerous and Hermione won’t listen when I say so; that’s why I’m not talking to her.
memories.source_text: "But she’s still sticking up for it! It’s a maniac, and she won’t hear a word against it!"

memories.description: Blimey, there's clearly a burn on the table from a spilt candle. That's what I see, not visions of anything mystical.
memories.source_text: “Yeah, there’s a burn on this table,” said Ron, pointing. “Someone’s spilled their candle.”

memories.description: I don't need Trelawney to interpret it. It's obvious—there's gonna be fog tonight. I'm just having a laugh and sniggering because the whole thing's a bit mental.
memories.source_text: “I don’t need help,” Ron whispered. “It’s obvious what this means. There’s going to be loads of fog tonight.”

memories.description: It's my fault. I persuaded you to go. Lupin's right, it was stupid and we shouldn't have done it.
memories.source_text: "It’s my fault," said Ron abruptly. "I persuaded you to go. Lupin’s right, it was stupid, we shouldn’t’ve done it —"

memories.description: Are you here to gloat or to tell on us?
memories.source_text: "Come to have a good gloat?" said Ron savagely as she stopped in front of them. "Or have you just been to tell on us?"

memories.description: We would have heard if Honeydukes had been broken into, so that's not how he came in.
memories.source_text: We'd've heard if the shop had been broken into.

memories.description: I'm a bit of a celebrity now. Weird, but I can't deny I'm enjoying people listening to me for once.
memories.source_text: Ron had become an instant celebrity. For the first time in his life, people were paying more attention to him than to Harry

memories.description: I was woken by a ripping noise, there was a draft, the hangings were pulled down and I looked up and there he was, some horrible figure with filthy hair and a massive knife. I screamed and he ran off.
memories.source_text: I was asleep, and I heard this ripping noise, and I thought it was in my dream, you know? But then there was this draft. I woke up and one side of the hangings on my bed had been pulled down. I rolled over and I saw him standing over me like a skeleton, with loads of filthy hair, holding this great long knife, must've been twelve inches

memories.description: Why did he run instead of going for Harry? Beats me. I still want to know why he scarpered.
memories.source_text: Why did he run?

memories.description: I told Neville to get out fast when that Howler came. Best thing for him was to leg it.
memories.source_text: Run for it, Neville,

memories.description: Blimey, I gave Harry that stuff. I bought it in Zonko ages ago.
memories.source_text: "I — gave — Harry — that — stuff," he choked. "Bought — it . . . in Zonko’s . . . ages — ago . . ."

memories.description: I told them straight away it was me who gave Harry the thing, so I'm the one responsible for getting him into this mess.
memories.source_text: "I — gave — Harry — that — stuff," he choked.

memories.description: I panicked when the Cloak slipped. I genuinely thought Malfoy would tattle and that Harry needed to scarper back to the castle or we'd be in proper trouble.
memories.source_text: Harry! you'd better run for it! If Malfoy tells anyone you'd better get back to the castle, quick,

memories.description: I called for Harry, stunned and hopeless when he disappeared. I felt useless and worried he'd be blamed if word got out.
memories.source_text: Harry!

memories.description: Blimey, that was heavy. I went up the marble stairs with Harry, feeling a bit crushed by what Lupin said.
memories.source_text: He walked away, leaving Harry feeling worse by far than he had at any point in Snape’s office. Slowly, he and Ron mounted the marble staircase.

memories.description: Blimey, she nearly knocked me off my chair when she stormed out. That's how sudden it was.
memories.source_text: “Fine!” she repeated, swinging the bag over her shoulder and almost knocking Ron off his chair.

memories.description: Blimey, you've got a Firebolt. That means you're sorted for the match, honestly, it's brilliant.
memories.source_text: "You’ve got a Firebolt!"

memories.description: I missed Cheering Charms and Flitwick hinted it might be on the exams. Brilliant, that's just my luck.
memories.source_text: "I can’t believe I missed Cheering Charms! And I bet they come up in our exams; Professor Flitwick hinted they might!"

memories.description: I honestly thought crystal balls were next term. And keep an eye out for Trelawney, she could be lurking anywhere.
memories.source_text: "I thought we weren’t starting crystal balls until next term," Ron muttered, casting a wary eye around for Professor Trelawney, in case she was lurking nearby.

memories.description: Hogsmeade next weekend. I’m up for it. Come on, what d’you reckon? It’s about time we went again.
memories.source_text: "Hogsmeade, next weekend!" said Ron, craning over the heads to read the new notice. "What d’you reckon?"

memories.description: Blimey, Harry missed out before. You’ve gotta come this time. You haven’t even seen Zonko’s yet.
memories.source_text: "Come on, last time we went you didn’t see anything. You haven’t even been inside Zonko’s yet!"

memories.description: Very haunted up here, isn’t it? I knew those houses would spook even Malfoy’s lot. Makes those big oafs look proper scared.
memories.source_text: "Very haunted up here, isn’t it?" said Ron, with the air of one commenting on the weather.

memories.description: Blimey, Scabbers being gone still gets to me. I keep thinking about the little things he liked. That’s why I snapped at Hermione.
memories.source_text: "If Scabbers hadn’t just been eaten, he could have had some of those Fudge Flies. He used to really like them —"

memories.description: I’m convinced Hermione won’t say sorry and she’s not treating Scabbers’ disappearance seriously. I’m annoyed and I won’t let it slide.
memories.source_text: "No," said Ron flatly. "If she just acted like she was sorry — but she’ll never admit she’s wrong, Hermione. She’s still acting like Scabbers has gone on vacation or something."

memories.description: Black was in our dormitory. He was standing over me with a knife and he slashed the curtains. I saw him and I screamed.
memories.source_text: "Black! Sirius Black! With a knife!" "Here! Just now! Slashed the curtains! Woke me up!"

memories.description: I told everyone to ask Sir Cadogan if he let someone in. I’m sure I saw Black and I want someone to back me up.
memories.source_text: "Ask him!" said Ron, pointing a shaking finger at the back of Sir Cadogan’s picture. "Ask him if he saw —"

memories.description: Blimey, at first I thought Lupin might've sent it because he likes Harry, but then I admitted it didn't make much sense that he could afford it.
memories.source_text: "I know who it could’ve been — Lupin!" "Lupin? Listen, if he had this much gold, he’d be able to buy himself some new robes."

memories.description: That Firebolt is the best broom. It's proper expensive. Whoever sent it spent a fortune.
memories.source_text: "It’s the best broom there is, Hermione," he said. "So it must’ve been really expensive..."

memories.description: Crookshanks is dangerous around Scabbers. That cat nearly ripped my pajamas and made Scabbers panic.
memories.source_text: "You’d better take that cat out of here, Hermione," said Ron furiously...

memories.description: I learned McGonagall is taking the broom to be checked. I wanted a go but she says it must be cleared first.
memories.source_text: "W-what?" said Harry, scrambling to his feet. "Why?" "It will need to be checked for jinxes," said Professor McGonagall.

memories.description: Scabbers is ill and I'm worried about him. I reckon the stress and that big stupid cat aren't helping one bit.
memories.source_text: "He’s not looking too good, is he?" "It’s stress!" said Ron.

memories.description: I was half asleep and couldn't see a thing. It's all dark, so I didn't spot anything and thought Harry was making a fuss.
memories.source_text: ["Huh?" "S’all dark, Harry," Ron muttered thickly. "What’re you on about?"]

memories.description: Blimey, I must've nodded off again. Can't help it, I'm knackered.
memories.source_text: A loud snore told him Ron had fallen asleep again.

memories.description: Blimey, that's Scabbers. He's been hiding and he looks terrible, all thin and patchy.
memories.source_text: "Scabbers!"

memories.description: I grabbed him and kept telling him it's okay. I won't let anything hurt him here.
memories.source_text: "No cats! There’s nothing here to hurt you!"

memories.description: Bloody hell, Hagrid's right. We have to scarper now or we'll be found by Fudge and the others.
memories.source_text: "They mustn’ find yeh here."

memories.description: If they go for Harry they have to go through me and Hermione. I’m not letting Harry face that alone.
memories.source_text: "If you want to kill Harry, you’ll have to kill us too!"

memories.description: My leg is badly damaged. I can barely stand and I need to hold on but it’s serious.
memories.source_text: "Lie down," he said quietly to Ron. "You will damage that leg even more."

memories.description: I’m fiercely loyal to Harry and Hermione. I’d rather risk everything than see them hurt.
memories.source_text: "You’ll have to kill all three of us!"

memories.description: Get away from him, get away. Scabbers, come here. Blimey, I wasn't going to lose him to that cat.
memories.source_text: Get away from him — get away — Scabbers, come here —

memories.description: Gotcha. Get off, you stinking cat. I pinned Scabbers down and shoved him back in my pocket.
memories.source_text: Gotcha! Get off, you stinking cat —

memories.description: I ended up flat on the ground, but Scabbers was safe in my pocket. I was holding him tight like my life depended on it.
memories.source_text: He was sprawled on the ground, but Scabbers was back in his pocket; he had both hands held tight over the quivering lump.

memories.description: Blimey, I said Buckbeak might get off and not be executed. I wanted to believe there was a chance.
memories.source_text: "Then you might not have to witness an execution at all! The hippogriff might get off!"

memories.description: I started to think Hermione might be right that Trelawney is a fraud. It felt like she was making a mess of the Divination testing.
memories.source_text: "You know, I’m starting to think Hermione was right about her"

memories.description: I couldn’t see anything in the crystal and had to fake it. That was rubbish and I reckon Trelawney knew.
memories.source_text: "Couldn’t see a thing, so I made some stuff up. Don’t think she was convinced, though."

memories.description: It’s awkward with Fudge around. Hermione and I are on edge and don’t want to be on speaking terms with him right now.
memories.source_text: "Hermione and Ron, not being on speaking terms with the Minister of Magic, hovered awkwardly in the background."

memories.description: Blimey, he's pointing at me. Am I supposed to do something? This is mental, I'm being singled out right now.
memories.source_text: [Black raised his empty hand and pointed straight at Ron.]

memories.description: Blimey, this is mental. Everyone's supposed to be relaxing and they're acting like it's exam panic already.
memories.source_text: "Call this a holiday! The exams are ages away, what’re they playing at?"

memories.description: I've got Buckbeak's appeal to worry about and when I'm not on my own stuff I'm buried in these huge books about hippogriffs. Bloody hell, it's a nightmare.
memories.source_text: "Ron had taken over responsibility for Buckbeak’s appeal. When he wasn’t doing his own work, he was poring over enormously thick volumes with names like The Handbook of Hippogriff Psychology and Fowl or Foul?"

memories.description: Blimey, I was out of it and breathing like mad on the bed. I was knocked about and not much use right then.
memories.source_text: "Ron’s ragged breathing came from the bed"

memories.description: What the hell, I was down and useless, and everyone else had to deal with things while I was panting on the floor.
memories.source_text: "His eyes flickered over Ron, lying on the floor"

memories.description: Not a dog, that's the thing — it's an Animagus. Bloody hell, it's a trap, he's been the dog all along.
memories.source_text: "Not a dog," "Harry, it's a trap" "He's the dog, he's an Animagus"

memories.description: Blimey, we’re not going back to Hagrid. If they find out we’ve been to see him, he’ll be in proper trouble.
memories.source_text: "We can’t," said Ron, who was paper-white. "He’ll be in worse trouble if they know we’ve been to see him. . . ."

memories.description: Keep still, Scabbers. Don’t make a fuss or we’re done for.
memories.source_text: "Scabbers, keep still," Ron hissed, clamping his hand over his chest. The rat was wriggling madly.

memories.description: What’s the matter with you, you stupid rat? Ouch, he bit me. Stuff like this always happens to me.
memories.source_text: "What’s the matter with you, you stupid rat? Stay still — OUCH! He bit me!"

memories.description: Bloody hell, Crookshanks is creeping up on us. He looks right at Scabbers and he’s not messing about.
memories.source_text: But Harry had just seen — slinking toward them, his body low to the ground, wide yellow eyes glinting eerily in the darkness — Crookshanks.

memories.description: No way was anyone with Harry and me. I know we were only two. I can't believe Lupin thinks two of us went into the Willow.
memories.source_text: "One of us!" "No, Ron," "Two of you."

memories.description: Someone wants to look at Scabbers. That makes me nervous and defensive because Scabbers is mine and I won't let him go without a fight.
memories.source_text: "Do you think I could have a look at the rat?" "What's Scabbers got to do with it?"

memories.description: Scabbers is mine and I cling to him. If anyone says he's not a rat I'll freak out. He's been with me so long I can't imagine him being anything else.
memories.source_text: Scabbers thrashing; Ron seizing his tail

memories.description: Blimey, Dumbledore actually hired a werewolf. Is he mental? I can't get my head around that.
memories.source_text: "Dumbledore hired you when he knew you were a werewolf?" Ron gasped. "Is he mad?"

memories.description: I was skittish and backing off, trying not to get involved while all this was exploding around us.
memories.source_text: Ron edged away from both of them, dragging his leg.

memories.description: Blimey, that dog grabbed my arm and started dragging me. It was like being yanked about like a rag doll.
memories.source_text: "As the dog sprang back toward them he pushed Harry aside; the dog’s jaws fastened instead around Ron’s outstretched arm."

memories.description: My leg cracked — it broke — and then my foot was pulled out of sight. Bloody hell, that was terrifying and awful.
memories.source_text: "Ron’s leg had broken, and a moment later, his foot vanished from sight."

memories.description: I tried to hook my leg around a root to stop being dragged in. I fought like mad but I was slipping down.
memories.source_text: "All they could see now was one of Ron’s legs, which he had hooked around a root in an effort to stop the dog from pulling him farther underground —"

memories.description: Sunset's when it's happening. Blimey, that doesn't give us much time and we'd never be allowed to just go wandering off.
memories.source_text: Sunset, though

memories.description: Hermione's gone and done something daft again. She's off her head brave lately, getting the Cloak and all. It's mental but it might work.
memories.source_text: Hermione, I don’t know what’s gotten into you lately!

memories.description: I thought Hermione was just leaving the room for a minute. I couldn't believe she actually went to fetch the Cloak. That's typical of her.
memories.source_text: She hasn’t gone to get it?

memories.description: I didn't want to hand Scabbers over and I asked what they'd do with him but in the end I gave him because I was desperate to stop it all
memories.source_text: "What are you going to do with him if I give him to you?" Ron asked Lupin tensely.

memories.description: Blimey Scabbers isn't just a rat any more He's not what I thought at all
memories.source_text: There was another blinding flash of light and then -- It was like watching a speeded-up film of a growing tree.

memories.description: Blimey, I can't believe it. Get away from me, werewolf. I want nothing to do with him.
memories.source_text: "Get away from me, werewolf!"

memories.description: Bloody hell, I'm in bits and I can't trust this bloke right now. I'm hurt and terrified by what's happening.
memories.source_text: Ron made a valiant effort to get up again but fell back with a whimper of pain.

memories.description: I handed Scabbers over even though I was tense about it. I wanted to know what would happen to him, and I didn't know whether he was safe to give up.
memories.source_text: "What are you going to do with him if I give him to you?"

memories.description: Blimey, the rat wasn't a normal pet. He screamed and twisted and then turned into a man right in front of us. That's mental.
memories.source_text: "Scabbers began to squeak without stopping, twisting and turning, his tiny black eyes bulging in his head."

memories.description: Blimey, you’re saying Pettigrew escaped Azkaban just to find Scabbers? That sounds mad to me.
memories.source_text: "Come off it," he said weakly. "Are you trying to say he broke out of Azkaban just to get his hands on Scabbers? I mean . . ."

memories.description: Of course, even if Pettigrew can turn into a rat there are millions of rats. How the bloody hell would he know which one is Scabbers if he’d been locked up?
memories.source_text: "Okay, say Pettigrew could turn into a rat — there are millions of rats — how’s he supposed to know which one he’s after if he was locked up in Azkaban?"

memories.description: Get away from him. I’m holding on to Scabbers and I’m not letting anyone take him.
memories.source_text: Ron clutched Scabbers closer to his chest.

memories.description: Look, Scabbers has a missing toe. I still want to defend him but that is something I can't ignore.
memories.source_text: "What about it?" said Ron defiantly. "He’s got a toe missing," said Black. "Of course," Lupin breathed."

memories.description: He's been with my family for ages. Blimey, twelve years is a long time and I kept thinking that proves he's just our rat, but now I'm not so sure.
memories.source_text: "Look, Scabbers probably had a fight with another rat or something! He’s been in my family for ages, right —" "Twelve years, in fact," said Lupin."

memories.description: Scabbers has been terrified of Crookshanks. I thought the cat was just mad, but that fear might mean something else.
memories.source_text: "He’s been scared of that mad cat!" said Ron, nodding toward Crookshanks."

memories.description: I still care about Scabbers and feel defensive. I won't just give up on him without being sure.
memories.source_text: "We — we’ve been taking good care of him!" said Ron."

memories.description: Blimey, he actually changed into a werewolf right in front of us!
memories.source_text: [He had transformed.]

memories.description: That dog just flew at the werewolf and hauled it off us, grabbed it by the neck and pulled it back. Thank Merlin for that!
memories.source_text: [The enormous, bearlike dog bounded forward. As the werewolf wrenched itself free of the manacle binding it, the dog seized it about the neck and pulled it backward, away from Ron and Pettigrew.]

memories.description: Blimey, I went for his wand too. I wasn't about to hang back when Harry was being threatened.
memories.source_text: Both Ron and Hermione had tried to Disarm Snape at exactly the same moment.

memories.description: Blimey, I thought they were mad. I can't believe they're saying Scabbers might be Peter Pettigrew. That's mental and I don't want to hear it.
memories.source_text: ["You're nutters, both of you," said Ron shakily, looking round at Harry and Hermione for support.]

memories.description: Scabbers is my pet. Of course he's Scabbers. I'm not just going to hand him over because two grown-ups start accusing him.
memories.source_text: ["HE'S NOT PETER, HE'S SCABBERS!" Ron yelled, trying to force the rat back into his front pocket.]

memories.description: I'm fed up and scared. I want out of this whole thing. If everyone thinks my pet's some dangerous rat, I'm not sticking around to find out more without being convinced.
memories.source_text: ["I've had enough of this. I'm off."]

memories.description: Blimey, my leg's knackered and I went down hard.
memories.source_text: Ron, unsteady on his bandaged leg, fell.

memories.description: While I was lying there, Pettigrew's rat tail slipped through the manacle on my arm and he scarpered.
memories.source_text: Harry saw his bald tail whip through the manacle on Ron’s outstretched arm

memories.description: What the hell, I was out cold one minute and helpless the next.
memories.source_text: There was a bang, a burst of light — and Ron lay motionless on the ground.

memories.description: Blimey, I was stuck chained to Pettigrew and Lupin and I lunged in. Sirius had to grab me and fling me back or I'd be right in the middle of it.
memories.source_text: Ron was chained to Pettigrew and Lupin. He leapt forward but Sirius caught him around the chest and threw him back.

memories.description: What the hell, Sirius left us when Lupin went feral. That thing's proper dangerous and I don't want to be anywhere near it.
memories.source_text: As the werewolf reared, snapping its long jaws, Sirius disappeared from Harry’s side.

memories.description: Blimey, I was just lying there, out of it and motionless in the end bed.
memories.source_text: It was empty except for Ron, who was still lying motionless in the end bed.

memories.description: Blimey, I'm here and I'm injured, but I'm alive. I can hear them talking outside even if I can't speak yet.
memories.source_text: Ron’s red hair was visible beneath Madam Pomfrey’s arm.

memories.description: Blimey, Buckbeak's gone and everyone's been celebrating all night. That's mental and I can hardly believe it.
memories.source_text: "Beaky! He escaped! He’s free! Bin celebratin’ all night!"

memories.description: I know I shouldn't be laughing after what happened last night, but I can't help it, it's brilliant that Beaky got away.
memories.source_text: "That's wonderful!" said Hermione, giving Ron a reproving look because he looked as though he was close to laughing.

memories.description: Blimey, he's pointing at me like I'm the guilty one. Scabbers is my rat and this is mental, I don't like being accused like that.
memories.source_text: There!

memories.description: Blimey, I was knocked out and being carried on a stretcher back toward the castle. I was out cold while all this was happening.
memories.source_text: A fourth stretcher, no doubt bearing Ron, was already floating at his side.

memories.description: Blimey, so he’s gone already and says he can’t risk it happening again. That’s mental. Feels like we’re stuck, doesn’t it?
memories.source_text: Resigned firs’ thing this mornin’. Says he can’t risk it happenin’ again.

memories.description: Blimey, I was standing there listening while Lupin talked about his school years and how Snape found out. I took it all in, stunned.
memories.source_text: He looked up at Harry, Ron, and Hermione.

memories.description: Blimey, Dudley is ridiculous and we both nearly cracked up at him. Can't help it, that bloke's a prat.
memories.source_text: He and Ron exchanged glances and then quickly looked away from each other; the temptation to burst out laughing was almost overwhelming.

memories.description: The twins make daft, dangerous jokes like Ton-Tongue Toffees and they're proper proud of them. They're going to cause trouble if someone doesn't stop them.
memories.source_text: George asked eagerly, "How big did his tongue get?" "It was four feet long before his parents would let me shrink it!"

memories.description: I've still got the family on my side. Bill and Charlie are around and it's good to see older brothers who actually seem sound.
memories.source_text: Ron and George were sitting at the scrubbed wooden table with Bill and Charlie.

memories.description: Blimey, I come out of the fire and wonder what on earth is happening. I sound worried and confused at first.
memories.source_text: "What are we doing here? Has something gone wrong?"

memories.description: I call for Dad and hope Harry can help. I reckon Harry might be able to do something since we're stuck in the fireplace.
memories.source_text: "Maybe Harry can hear us, Dad — maybe he'll be able to let us out —"

memories.description: Fred and George are already joking about being stuck. I'm with them and we all muck about together, even when things go wrong.
memories.source_text: "Yeah, we're having the time of our lives here," said George, whose voice sounded muffled.

memories.description: Blimey, I call Pigwidgeon 'Pig' because he’s daft and annoying, and I’m not shy about saying it.
memories.source_text: "Shut up, Pig," said Ron, edging his way between two of the four beds"

memories.description: Ginny gave the owl a cute name and I tried to change it but he wouldn’t take to any other name, so I stuck with calling him Pig.
memories.source_text: "Ginny named him," he explained to Harry."

memories.description: Percy’s all self-important about work, he gets his own room because he’s obsessed with his job and behaves like he’s above the rest of us.
memories.source_text: "Percy gets to keep his room all to himself because he’s got to work."

memories.description: Bloody hell, I’m really worried about Sirius and I want to know if he’s safe, I can’t help asking even when it’s awkward around Ginny.
memories.source_text: "So — have you heard from Sirius lately?"

memories.description: Blimey, a hundred thousand wizards turn up for the World Cup. They're staggering arrivals, only a few use Muggle transport, some Apparate to safe points, and lots use Portkeys.
memories.source_text: "The trouble is, about a hundred thousand wizards turn up at the World Cup, and of course, we just haven't got a magical site big enough to accommodate them all."

memories.description: Slimy gits. That's what they are. I can't stand people like Malfoy and his lot.
memories.source_text: “Slimy gits,” Ron muttered as he, Harry, and Hermione turned to face the field again.

memories.description: Blimey, I was right beside Harry, shoved up against him with Hermione too. We all got knocked about when it started.
memories.source_text: "he could feel Ron and Hermione on either side of him, their shoulders banging into his;"

memories.description: Bloody hell, that Portkey threw me. I staggered straight into Harry and we all went down. That was proper disorienting.
memories.source_text: "His feet slammed into the ground; Ron staggered into him and he fell over;"

memories.description: Blimey, the Malfoys are here. That's awkward as anything.
memories.source_text: Harry, Ron, and Hermione turned quickly.

memories.description: My dad and Malfoy can't stand each other. That little stare-off just proves they haven't smoothed things over.
memories.source_text: Mr Weasley and Mr Malfoy looked at each other and Harry vividly recalled the last time they had come face-to-face: It had been in Flourish and Blotts bookshop, and they had had a fight.

memories.description: They're probably from a foreign school. I reckon there are other schools out there, I've just never met anyone from one.
memories.source_text: 'Spect they go to some foreign school," said Ron. "I know there are others. Never met anyone who went to one, though.

memories.description: Bill once had a penfriend in Brazil and wanted to go on exchange, but Mum and Dad couldn't afford it. That's why I've never met anyone from a foreign school either.
memories.source_text: Bill had a penfriend at a school in Brazil this was years and years ago and he wanted to go on an exchange trip but Mum and Dad couldn’t afford it.

memories.description: Blimey, I saved up all summer for this and then that cursed hat business happened. I really wanted to get stuff and I've been counting my Galleons.
memories.source_text: "His penfriend got all offended when he said he wasn’t going and sent him a cursed hat. It made his ears shrivel up." "Been saving my pocket money all summer for this," Ron told Harry as they and Hermione strolled through the salesmen, buying souvenirs.

memories.description: What the hell, I want those Omnioculars more than this daft shamrock. I regret spending on the hat when those would be brilliant.
memories.source_text: "Wish I hadn’t bought this now," said Ron, gesturing at his dancing shamrock hat and gazing longingly at the Omnioculars.

memories.description: I'm always touchy about Harry's money. I don't like being reminded that he can buy things I can't, even if I'm glad he gives stuff sometimes.
memories.source_text: "No — don’t bother," said Ron, going red. He was always touchy about the fact that Harry, who had inherited a small fortune from his parents, had much more money than he did.

memories.description: Blimey, I was there frozen like I was going to dive right into the stadium; couldn't move, just staring
memories.source_text: Next to him, Ron was frozen in an attitude that looked as though he were about to dive from a springboard

memories.description: Huh? I was just absentmindedly tearing the shamrocks on my hat to bits while I gaped at the veela
memories.source_text: Ron, meanwhile, was absentmindedly shredding the shamrocks on his hat. "Huh?" said Ron

memories.description: Like we'd say anything else surrounded by that lot. We're not about to admit we're backing anyone else when they're watching.
memories.source_text: "Like we’d say anything else surrounded by that lot," said Ron.

memories.description: Krum. Viktor Krum is the Bulgarian Seeker. He's famous and everyone knows him.
memories.source_text: "Krum," said Ron quietly. "What?" said Hermione. "Krum!" said Ron. "Viktor Krum, the Bulgarian Seeker!"

memories.description: Who cares what he looks like? He's unbelievable. He's only about eighteen and he's a proper genius. Wait until tonight, you'll see.
memories.source_text: "He looks really grumpy," said Hermione. "Who cares what he looks like? He’s unbelievable. He’s really young too. Only just eighteen or something. He’s a genius, you wait until tonight, you’ll see." said Ron.

memories.description: Blimey, the kids are mental. One of them just stomped a slug and it popped. That was gross and made a right fuss.
memories.source_text: "You bust slug! You bust slug!"

memories.description: Bloody hell, there are people from America here with a big banner. This place is buzzing, and everyone is getting up and doing their own thing.
memories.source_text: "THE SALEM WITCHES’ INSTITUTE."

memories.description: People are already bragging about old Quidditch players. Everyone seems to be trading stories while they sort out breakfast.
memories.source_text: "And he was the best Beater the Wimbourne Wasps ever had."

memories.description: Here, take these coins for the Omnioculars — and you owe me a Christmas present, yeah? Don't forget it.
memories.source_text: “There you go,” Ron yelled happily, stuffing a fistful of gold coins into Harry’s hand, “for the Omnioculars! Now you’ve got to buy me a Christmas present, ha!”

memories.description: Brilliant — gold raining from a giant shamrock! That's mental, absolutely brilliant.
memories.source_text: “Excellent!” yelled Ron as the shamrock soared over them, and heavy gold coins rained from it, bouncing off their heads and seats.

memories.description: That's Krum! That's him — got to watch him, he's the one everyone's been talking about.
memories.source_text: “That’s him, that’s him!” yelled Ron, following Krum with his Omnioculars.

memories.description: Blimey, everything's gone green! The whole place is covered in shamrocks, it's mental.
memories.source_text: Er, is it my eyes, or has everything gone green?

memories.description: Seamus is sitting with his mum and Dean and he spotted us straight away. They're still sound with us, and his mum's proud as anything about the decorations.
memories.source_text: "Harry! Ron! Hermione!"

memories.description: Yeah, go on then, dump your stuff in my room. I’ll do the same. What's up, Harry? I'm eager and worried in the same breath.
memories.source_text: "All right if I go and dump my stuff in your room, Ron?" "Yeah . . . think I will too," "What's up, Harry?"

memories.description: Blimey, Harry's scar's been hurting again. That's worrying. I can't just shrug that off.
memories.source_text: "There’s something I haven’t told you," "On Saturday morning, I woke up with my scar hurting again."

memories.description: Blimey, I can't believe it, but it seems your scar hurting has matched up with when You-Know-Who turned up before.
memories.source_text: "But - he wasn't there, was he? You-Know-Who? I mean - last time your scar kept hurting, he was at Hogwarts, wasn't he?"

memories.description: I want to believe it's just a nightmare and nothing more, to keep this from being real.
memories.source_text: "It was only a dream," said Ron bracingly.

memories.description: Don't say his name. Bloody hell, the name itself makes me furious and scared.
memories.source_text: "Don't - say - his - name!" Ron hissed through gritted teeth.

memories.description: No, Mum. I'm not having my bits fussed with right now.
memories.source_text: "No, Mum."

memories.description: I'm sitting here playing chess with Bill while all this fuss goes on.
memories.source_text: "Bill, who was playing chess with Ron."

memories.description: I reckon Sirius will know what to do. That's what I'd bet on.
memories.source_text: "Good thinking!" said Ron, his expression clearing. "I bet Sirius'll know what to do!"

memories.description: Blimey, come on Harry, let's play Quidditch. It'll cheer you up. Try out the Wronski Feint with us.
memories.source_text: "Come and have a game of Quidditch in the orchard, Harry," said Ron. "Come on — three on three, Bill and Charlie and Fred and George will play. . . . You can try out the Wronski Feint. . . ."

memories.description: I fiddle with my stuff when I'm nervous. It's how I show I'm worried but trying to keep things light.
memories.source_text: There was a silence in which Ron fidgeted absentmindedly with a hole in his Chudley Cannons bedspread.

memories.description: I'm not wearing those. Never. I mean it, I'm sticking to my guns.
memories.source_text: [“I’m never wearing them,” Ron was saying stubbornly. “Never.”]

memories.description: Brilliant. Mum's going to embarrass me and expects Harry to take a picture. Just great.
memories.source_text: [“Fine,” snapped Mrs. Weasley. “Go naked. And, Harry, make sure you get a picture of him. Goodness knows I could do with a laugh.”]

memories.description: Blimey, the hat sings a different song every year. That must be a dull job, thinking up new songs forever.
memories.source_text: "It’s got to be a pretty boring life, hasn’t it, being a hat? I suppose it spends all year making up the next one."

memories.description: I joke with Hermione loads and wind her up, but I still look out for her. And I can be a prat, like spraying Harry by accident, sorry mate.
memories.source_text: "Oooh c’mon, ’Er-my-knee," said Ron, accidentally spraying Harry with bits of Yorkshire pudding.

memories.description: Bloody hell, Peeves causes trouble in the kitchens and gets everyone stirred up. Nothing surprises me about him.
memories.source_text: "Yeah, we thought Peeves seemed hacked off about something," said Ron darkly.

memories.description: Blimey, I threw my dress robes over Pigwidgeon so he wouldn't get drenched while we forced our way through the storm.
memories.source_text: Ron left his dress robes over Pigwidgeon as they left the train, heads bent and eyes narrowed against the downpour.

memories.description: We all piled into a carriage and slammed the door shut to stop the rain. Couldn't get in there quick enough.
memories.source_text: Harry, Ron, Hermione, and Neville climbed gratefully into one of them, the door shut with a snap, and a few moments

memories.description: Blimey, why is everything I own rubbish? I'm furious about always ending up with rubbish stuff.
memories.source_text: Why is everything I own rubbish?

memories.description: Nah, if Sirius had been caught it would be all over the Prophet. The Ministry would want the publicity, that's obvious.
memories.source_text: "Nah, it would’ve been in the Daily Prophet," said Ron. "The Ministry would want to show they’d caught someone, wouldn’t they?"

memories.description: Mum's bought Harry stuff from Diagon Alley and even took gold from his vault. She's done his lot and washed his socks too. Mum does everything.
memories.source_text: "Look, here’s the stuff Mum got for you in Diagon Alley. And she’s got some gold out of your vault for you . . . and she’s washed all your socks." He heaved a pile of parcels onto Harry’s camp bed and dropped the money bag and a load of socks next to it."

memories.description: What is that supposed to be? I was horrified when I saw what looked like a long maroon velvet dress. I couldn't believe Mum would give me anything like that.
memories.source_text: "What is that supposed to be?" He was holding up something that looked to Harry like a long, maroon velvet dress."

memories.description: I thought Mum had given me Ginny's new dress because it looked that bad. I was sure she'd mixed them up.
memories.source_text: "Mum, you’ve given me Ginny’s new dress," said Ron, handing it out to her."

memories.description: I'd sooner go starkers than wear those dress robes. I'm not wearing that, no way.
memories.source_text: "I’ll go starkers before I put that on," said Ron stubbornly."

memories.description: Apparently everyone has dress robes and Dad's even got some for smart parties. Fine, everyone wears them, so I can't exactly refuse without looking odd.
memories.source_text: "Everyone wears them, Ron!" said Mrs. Weasley crossly. "They’re all like that! Your father’s got some for smart parties!"

memories.description: Blimey, I asked to look at Uranus in class because I was curious. I don't care if it sounds daft.
memories.source_text: "Can I have a look at Uranus too, Lavender?" said Ron.

memories.description: That was a rotten bit of teaching. Trelawney going all strict on homework? That's mental. It'll take all weekend and I'm not happy about it.
memories.source_text: "Miserable old bat," said Ron bitterly as they joined the crowds...

memories.description: My dad's been made fun of in the Prophet and they printed a picture of Mum. I'm furious and shaking with rage. Don't rub it in.
memories.source_text: Malfoy...brandishing a copy of the Daily Prophet..."Your dad’s in the paper, Weasley!"

memories.description: Blimey, I rolled my eyes at Harry because he wasn't paying attention. I can't help being deadpan about some of this nonsense.
memories.source_text: Ron rolled his eyes at Harry

memories.description: I muttered Harry's name to snap him out of nodding off. Don't be an eejit, I was thinking.
memories.source_text: “Harry!” Ron muttered.

memories.description: I mocked Trelawney by doing her whispery voice and taking the piss about two Neptunes. I can't resist winding him up.
memories.source_text: “Aaaaah, when two Neptunes appear in the sky, it is a sure sign that a midget in glasses is being born, Harry.”

memories.description: Blimey, Bagman was going to tell everyone what's going on at Hogwarts, but Mum won't say anything. That's annoying and makes me wonder what she's hiding.
memories.source_text: "Bagman wanted to tell us what’s happening at Hogwarts," he said grumpily, sitting down next to Harry. "At the World Cup, remember? But my own mother won’t say. Wonder what —"

memories.description: Blimey, yeah, the Imperius Curse. Dad's warned me about it before.
memories.source_text: "Er," said Ron tentatively, "my dad told me about one. . . . Is it called the Imperius Curse, or something?"

memories.description: Bloody hell, to see someone control another creature like that is terrifying. It's proper total control.
memories.source_text: "Total control," said Moody quietly as the spider balled itself up and began to roll over and over.

memories.description: That's mental, Moody can make things change size and then make them suffer with the Cruciatus. Stay well away.
memories.source_text: "The spider swelled. It was now larger than a tarantula."

memories.description: Blimey, I'm starving. I could eat a hippogriff, I really could.
memories.source_text: Oh hurry up, I could eat a hippogriff.

memories.description: My hair's soaked and I'm properly cross about being drenched. It's annoying and I'm grumpy about it.
memories.source_text: Ron muttering furiously under his breath as he pushed his sopping hair off his face.

memories.description: What d'you three know that we don't? I want to know what’s going on. Don’t keep me in the dark, that’s mental.
memories.source_text: "What d’you three know that we don’t?"

memories.description: Mum, seriously. She’s hinting at something between us and Dumbledore and it’s doing my head in.
memories.source_text: "Mum!" said Ron irritably.

memories.description: There’s something coming this year that might make it an interesting term. I’m expecting trouble or excitement and I’m ready for it.
memories.source_text: "A bit of what?" said Ron.

memories.description: Blimey I thought he might be staying but Moody says he's only here for one year.
memories.source_text: "What, aren’t you staying?"

memories.description: Turns out my dad helped Moody out recently and Moody knows him. That's why Moody's doing Dumbledore a favor and sticking around for a year.
memories.source_text: "You’ll be Arthur Weasley’s son, eh? Your father got me out of a very tight corner a few days ago."

memories.description: So they usually don't teach the nasty curses until sixth year but Moody's going to show us sooner.
memories.source_text: "I’m not supposed to show you what illegal Dark curses look like until you’re in the sixth year."

memories.description: Where the hell is Durmstrang? What country is it in?
memories.source_text: "Where is it? What country?" said Ron.

memories.description: Come off it. A massive castle like that can't just be hidden. That's mental.
memories.source_text: "Come off it," said Ron, starting to laugh. "Durmstrang's got to be about the same size as Hogwarts — how are you going to hide a great big castle?"

memories.description: Blimey, imagine pushing Malfoy off a glacier. Would have been brilliant. Shame his mum fusses over him.
memories.source_text: "Ah, think of the possibilities," said Ron dreamily. "It would've been so easy to push Malfoy off a glacier and make it look like an accident. . . . Shame his mother likes him. . . ."

memories.description: Blimey, I want to remember Malfoy as the bouncing ferret forever. That's up there with the best things ever.
memories.source_text: "Don’t talk to me," Ron said quietly to Harry and Hermione as they sat down at the Gryffindor table a few minutes later, "Because I want to fix that in my memory forever," said Ron, his eyes closed and an uplifted expression on his face. "Draco Malfoy, the amazing bouncing ferret . . ."

memories.description: Bloody hell, Moody is teaching Defense and I don't get him until Thursday. I'm gutted I'll have to wait.
memories.source_text: "We haven’t got him till Thursday!" he said in a disappointed voice.

memories.description: Moody is absolutely brilliant. I think he's proper cool and someone you actually want teaching Defense.
memories.source_text: "Moody!" he said. "How cool is he?" "Beyond cool," said George.

memories.description: I had a nightmare with that curse and it hit me worse than Harry. Moody says it should wear off by lunchtime, so I just need to hang on.
memories.source_text: "Yeah, I know," said Ron, who was skipping on every alternate step. He had had much more difficulty with the curse than Harry, though Moody assured him the effects would wear off by lunchtime.

memories.description: Moody is proper paranoid. No wonder the Ministry were glad to be rid of him. That's mental.
memories.source_text: "Talk about paranoid . . ." Ron glanced nervously over his shoulder to check that Moody was definitely out of earshot and went on. "No wonder they were glad to get shot of him at the Ministry."

memories.description: Blimey, Malfoy had the nerve to mock my robes in front of everyone. He thinks he can make me look daft.
memories.source_text: "Weasley . . . what is that?" said Malfoy, pointing at Pigwidgeon’s cage. A sleeve of Ron’s dress robes was dangling from it... "Weasley, you weren’t thinking of wearing these, were you? I mean — they were very fashionable in about 1890"

memories.description: My dad's not useless. He could've had more, but he likes what he does. I won't have Malfoy sneer at him.
memories.source_text: "‘Father’s always associated with the top people at the Ministry.’ . . . Dad could’ve got a promotion any time . . . he just likes it where he is. . . ."

memories.description: I snapped at Malfoy and made it clear I won't take his insults. I'm furious and I'm protective of my family.
memories.source_text: "Eat dung, Malfoy!" said Ron, the same color as the dress robes as he snatched them back out of Malfoy’s grip.

memories.description: I lost my temper and slammed the door. I was raging at how Malfoy was making us feel small.
memories.source_text: Ron got to his feet and slammed the sliding compartment door so hard behind them that the glass shattered.

memories.description: Blimey, the thought of Moody turning Snape into a horned toad and bouncing him around the dungeon made me laugh, I could nearly cry thinking about it.
memories.source_text: Imagine if Moody turned Snape into a horned toad," said Ron, his eyes misting over, "and bounced him all around his dungeon.

memories.description: I was dead relieved when Moody said he's staying for a year. Hearing my dad's name pop up made me feel chuffed and a bit proud.
memories.source_text: You’ll be Arthur Weasley’s son, eh? Your father got me out of a very tight corner a few days ago. . . . Yeah, I’m staying just the one year. Special favor to Dumbledore.

memories.description: Neville managed to melt his sixth cauldron in Potions. Poor bloke, Snape gave him detention and it knocked him about.
memories.source_text: Neville melting his sixth cauldron in Potions.

memories.description: Blimey, not the library. I’m sick of always going there for answers when it’s all guesswork and stress.
memories.source_text: "Not the ruddy library again?"

memories.description: I reckon Dumbledore and Moody do what they think is right even if the Ministry complains. Moody’s rough but he gets things done, even if it’s a bit mad.
memories.source_text: "Yeah, probably," said Ron. "But Dumbledore’s always done things his way, hasn’t he, and Moody’s been getting in trouble for years, I reckon. Attacks first and asks questions later — look at his dustbins. Balderdash."

memories.description: Bloody hell, making up fortunes is easier than pretending we understand that Divination waffle. If she’s happy with misery, give her misery.
memories.source_text: "You know," said Ron, "I think it’s back to the old Divination standby." "What — make it up?" "Yeah," said Ron, sweeping the jumble of scrawled notes off the table, dipping his pen into some ink, and starting to write.

memories.description: I know how Hermione reacts when she’s worried. Wind her up with drama and she’ll take it seriously. I can use that to get a reaction or deflect attention.
memories.source_text: "You know her — just put in loads of misery, she’ll lap it up."

memories.description: Blimey, that was mental. I nearly fell off my seat when Moody killed that spider. It was like a punch to the stomach seeing it done so cleanly.
memories.source_text: Ron had thrown himself backward and almost toppled off his seat as the spider skidded toward him.

memories.description: Of course I'm uneasy hearing the name Avada Kedavra uttered in class. It's horrible to think anyone would actually use it, and worse to know there's no countercurse. That's proper scary.
memories.source_text: Several people looked uneasily around at her, including Ron.

memories.description: Blimey, they're pulling out a big old casket for the Goblet. I wasn't expecting that either.
memories.source_text: "The what?" Harry muttered. Ron shrugged.

memories.description: So the Goblet picks the champions. Three champions, one from each school, and whoever does best after three tasks wins the Cup. Sound mental, doesn't it?
memories.source_text: "The champions will be chosen by an impartial selector: the Goblet of Fire."

memories.description: Blimey, Hermione would never miss this. We both knew she'd stick around no matter what. That's just her, really.
memories.source_text: Harry and Ron grinned at each other. They knew Hermione would rather eat bubotuber pus than miss such an important lesson.

memories.description: Bloody hell, Moody made everyone do daft things. Nobody could fight it, they all did what they were told until he lifted it.
memories.source_text: Moody began to beckon students forward in turn and put the Imperius Curse upon them. Harry watched as, one by one, his classmates did the most extraordinary things under its influence.

memories.description: Must be Mad-Eye Moody. Blimey, he looks proper rough.
memories.source_text: [Must be]

memories.description: I'm dead keen on trying for the Triwizard. A thousand Galleons would be brilliant.
memories.source_text: [I’m going for it!]

memories.description: Being a champion sounds ace. You get to do things you normally couldn't and there's loads of prize money.
memories.source_text: [I’m going for it! ... The champions’ll get to do all sorts of stuff you’d never be allowed to do normally. And a thousand Galleons prize money!]

memories.description: Dumbledore might stop us entering but maybe the judge is the one who actually picks champions. So there might be a way round it.
memories.source_text: [Dumbledore knows you’re not of age, though, ... Yeah, but he’s not the one who decides who the champion is, is he?]

memories.description: If we really wanted to fool the judge we could try Aging Potion or some dodge like that. Sounds risky but tempting.
memories.source_text: [I reckon a couple of drops of Aging Potion might do it, George.]

memories.description: A thousand Galleons is stuck in my head. That'd sort out loads of stuff for me and my family.
memories.source_text: [Yeah, a thousand Galleons . . .]

memories.description: We might not have the experience for the tasks and they might want older students. I ain't sure we're ready.
memories.source_text: [I s’pose they might want someone older. . . . Dunno if we’ve learned enough. . . .]

memories.description: Hagrid, what's that? Blimey, he’s wearing cologne and acting all awkward about it.
memories.source_text: "Hagrid, what's that?"

memories.description: He fancies her, honestly. Hagrid's gone and proper fallen for Madame Maxime.
memories.source_text: "He fancies her!"

memories.description: Well, if Hagrid and Madame Maxime ever have kids they'll be massive, won't they? Bet any baby of theirs would weigh about a ton.
memories.source_text: "Well, if they end up having children, they’ll be setting a world record — bet any baby of theirs would weigh about a ton."

memories.description: No! I couldn't believe it when Cedric was called. I wanted him to be shouted about differently, I don't know, it felt like a shock.
memories.source_text: "No!" said Ron loudly, but nobody heard him except Harry;

memories.description: Why do you keep swapping owls? It seems daft to use different ones all the time, especially if we're trying to be quiet about things.
memories.source_text: “Why d’you have to keep changing owls?” Ron asked in a low voice.

memories.description: It's nearly six. I'm on watch for their arrival and I'm getting impatient, staring down the drive like you do when you're waiting for something good to happen.
memories.source_text: “Nearly six,” said Ron, checking his watch and then staring down the drive that led to the front gates.

memories.description: Maybe Hagrid's beasts have got out. That would be awesome to see, though maybe a bit worrying. Still, imagine it, wild creatures everywhere.
memories.source_text: “Maybe they’ve escaped,” said Ron hopefully.

memories.description: Blimey, I reacted straight away when Malfoy attacked Hermione. I’ll stand up for her and shout it out when she’s been hurt.
memories.source_text: "Malfoy got Hermione!"

memories.description: We both got punished by Snape even though it was a mutual attack. That’s so unfair and it makes me furious.
memories.source_text: "Fifty points from Gryffindor and a detention each for Potter and Weasley."

memories.description: What the hell, I thought, when Goyle got nailed. It showed our spells landed and we weren’t just causing trouble for no reason.
memories.source_text: "— and he hit Goyle — look —"

memories.description: Blimey, Hermione's gone on about house-elves loads and I still don't get why everyone is up in arms about it.
memories.source_text: "What are you on about?"

memories.description: I paid two Sickles for a S.P.E.W. badge, but only to shut Hermione up. I wasn't serious about joining her campaign.
memories.source_text: "True, both of them had paid two Sickles for a S.P.E.W. badge, but they had only done it to keep her quiet."

memories.description: I roll my eyes at Hermione's constant nags. Honestly, sometimes I just tune out and let her get on with it.
memories.source_text: "Ron now rolled his eyes at the ceiling, which was flooding them all in autumn sunlight,"

memories.description: Anyone put their name in yet? I'm dying to know who’s trying for the Tournament.
memories.source_text: "Anyone put their name in yet?" Ron asked a third-year girl eagerly.

memories.description: I reckon some people might have sneaked their names in during the night. I would have, if I wanted to avoid a crowd watching me.
memories.source_text: "Bet some of them put it in last night after we’d all gone to bed," said Harry. "I would’ve if it had been me . . . wouldn’t have wanted everyone watching. What if the goblet just gobbed you right back out again?"

memories.description: She's old enough. I mean, Angelina's definitely seventeen. Can't see a beard, can you?
memories.source_text: "’Course she is, can’t see a beard, can you?" said Ron.

memories.description: Blimey, Hermione and her causes. I find her obsession with things like badges a bit much sometimes.
memories.source_text: "What is it with her?" said Ron, exasperated, as Hermione ran away up the marble staircase.

memories.description: If we go see Hagrid I just hope he does not expect me to lose any fingers to those blasted skrewts.
memories.source_text: "Okay," said Ron, "just as long as he doesn’t ask us to donate a few fingers to the skrewts."

memories.description: Blimey, I stood there with Dean and Seamus and did nothing. I wasn't joining in the laughing but I didn't speak up for Harry either.
memories.source_text: Ron was standing against the wall with Dean and Seamus. He wasn’t laughing, but he wasn’t sticking up for Harry either.

memories.description: Blimey, I shouldn't have poked my nose in. I'll just bugger off and go to bed then.
memories.source_text: "I just wondered where you —" Ron broke off, shrugging. "Nothing. I’m going back to bed."

memories.description: Right, you're furious and I'm sorry. I get that you want to be left alone, even if I'm not sure what's going on.
memories.source_text: "Sorry about that," said Ron, his face reddening with anger. "Should’ve realized you didn’t want to be disturbed. I’ll let you get on with practicing for your next interview in peace."

memories.description: I'll stick with Harry. I said I’d wait for him and I will. Can’t leave him on his own right now.
memories.source_text: Ron said he would wait, so Harry reentered the tent

memories.description: Blimey, it wasn’t just me cheering. Most of the school was on Harry’s side and Cedric’s too.
memories.source_text: It wasn’t just Ron . . . those weren’t only Gryffindors cheering in the crowd.

memories.description: Blimey, I was terrified and stunned when Harry pulled it off, I just stood there white as a sheet staring at him like a ghost.
memories.source_text: Ron was "very white and staring at Harry as though he were a ghost."

memories.description: Well, seeing him come out of that mess alive and with the egg changed everything for me, it was just mental.
memories.source_text: Ron entered the tent closely after Hermione.

memories.description: Hagrid's been in trouble loads of times but Dumbledore never sacks him. Blimey, Dumbledore sticks by Hagrid.
memories.source_text: "Hagrid’s been in loads of trouble before, and Dumbledore’s never sacked him," said Ron consolingly.

memories.description: Worst that can happen is Hagrid'll just have to get rid of the skrewts. That's about it, really.
memories.source_text: "Worst that can happen is Hagrid’ll have to get rid of the skrewts."

memories.description: Blimey, Krum's date is good-looking. I was laughing but I noticed it.
memories.source_text: She was quite good-looking

memories.description: Bloody hell, the professor springing a test on us at the last minute is evil. It spoils the end of term for everyone.
memories.source_text: Evil, he is

memories.description: Of course I stick up for Harry. He deserves a breather after everything he's done.
memories.source_text: Leave him alone, Hermione, he’s earned a bit of a break

memories.description: Blimey, I even banged on the window and nothing. He's not answering us at all.
memories.source_text: [Ron even went and banged on one of the windows]

memories.description: That's mental. If Hagrid's shut himself away for a whole week, something's happened and it's not good.
memories.source_text: [They hammered on it for ten more minutes; ... but there was no response.]

memories.description: Blimey, I reckon Krum might be trying to worm information out of Hermione to get to Harry. I don't trust him around her like that.
memories.source_text: "Then he’s hoping you’ll help him find out what his egg means! I suppose you’ve been putting your heads together during those cozy little library sessions —"

memories.description: Honestly, I think the whole Triwizard thing is about winning. Friends and making pals are secondary to the competition.
memories.source_text: "No it isn’t!" shouted Ron. "It’s about winning!"

memories.description: Hagrid being half-giant is a big deal. Giants are vicious, everyone knows that. No wonder Hagrid kept it quiet.
memories.source_text: "Did you know? About Hagrid being half-giant?" "No," Harry said, shrugging.

memories.description: I was jealous and annoyed Hermione went with Krum. I don't like being last choice and I wanted her attention. That's why I snapped and called him 'Vicky'.
memories.source_text: "Why don’t you go and find Vicky, he’ll be wondering where you are," said Ron. "Don’t call him Vicky!" Hermione jumped to her feet and stormed off"

memories.description: Blimey, that's shocking. I can't believe they'd print that about Hagrid and his mother.
memories.source_text: [Harry finished reading and looked up at Ron, whose mouth was hanging open.]

memories.description: Well, that's just daft. If anyone's laughing, it's daft, because Hagrid's not someone you poke fun at like that.
memories.source_text: [Ron was sniggering, apparently very pleased with himself.]

memories.description: We have to bite the bullet and do it. No faffing about. Just go and ask them.
memories.source_text: ["Harry — we’ve just got to grit our teeth and do it," said Ron on Friday morning, in a tone that suggested they were planning the storming of an impregnable fortress.]

memories.description: I'm convinced we'll sort partners tonight. I'm not letting us end up without someone.
memories.source_text: ["When we get back to the common room tonight, we’ll both have partners — agreed?"]

memories.description: Fancy a game of chess, Harry. It's a proper way to calm down and I know I can beat you if I play right.
memories.source_text: "Want a game of chess, Harry?"

memories.description: Bloody hell, they're only socks, but yeah I feel chuffed. I get embarrassingly proud when someone notices what I gave.
memories.source_text: "They’re only socks," said Ron, who had gone slightly pink around the ears, though he looked rather pleased all the same.

memories.description: Animal magnetism. I keep telling myself that's why I and Harry got dates. It sounds daft but I need to believe I've got some charm.
memories.source_text: "I still can’t work out how you two got the best-looking girls in the year," muttered Dean. "Animal magnetism," said Ron gloomily, pulling stray threads out of his cuffs.

memories.description: What the hell? Hermione looks different and I don't like it. I walked past her because I was annoyed and didn't fancy making a fuss.
memories.source_text: "Ron was watching Hermione pass with narrowed eyes."

memories.description: My dress robes are pants. I had to Severing Charm the ruff and cuffs because otherwise I'd look ridiculous. Still looks a bit frayed but better than lace.
memories.source_text: "There was just no getting around the fact that his robes looked more like a dress than anything else."

memories.description: She's going to come for you next, Hermione. I can see it, and that worries me.
memories.source_text: She'll be after you next, Hermione," said Ron in a low and worried voice as they walked quickly back up the street.

memories.description: I'm serious, Hermione. Don't go poking Rita. She'll dig something up on you and it'll cause trouble. Blimey, it could get messy.
memories.source_text: You don't want to go upsetting Rita Skeeter," said Ron nervously. "I'm serious, Hermione, she'll dig up something on you —

memories.description: Blimey, Hagrid's really upset. I feel gutted for him and want him back with us at school.
memories.source_text: “Yeh — yeh’re not half-giant!” said Hagrid croakily.

memories.description: Obviously we made a noise trying to get in. I wasn't going to sit there while Hagrid was miserable.
memories.source_text: Hermione, Harry, and Ron still seem to want to know you, judging by the way they were attempting to break down the door.

memories.description: Good on Dumbledore. I reckon Hagrid's coming back and that's what matters. No faffing about.
memories.source_text: Dumbledore stood up. “I refuse to accept your resignation, Hagrid, and I expect you back at work on Monday,” he said.

memories.description: Blimey, that squid is still out there. Krum swimming near the lake and the squid makes this mental.
memories.source_text: Yeah, but there’s still the giant squid.

memories.description: I reckon Percy might be plotting to get Crouch out of the way so he can get promoted. Sounds daft but it could happen.
memories.source_text: Maybe Percy’s poisoning him. Probably thinks if Crouch snuffs it he’ll be made Head of the Department of International Magical Cooperation.

memories.description: I don’t much care if Cedric gets help. If anyone deserves a fair go it is him but I am not fussed about Bagman favouring one champion over another.
memories.source_text: Who cares if Diggory’s getting help?

memories.description: I like Dobby. I'll lend him Mum's Christmas jumper. He can have it, maroon and all.
memories.source_text: “I’ll give you the one my mum knits me this Christmas, I always get one from her. You don’t mind maroon, do you?”

memories.description: Right, the house-elves are only too happy to hand out food. No need to be impressed with Fred and George for taking it. That's mental really.
