memories.source_text: “All these years I’ve been really impressed with Fred and George, nicking food from the kitchens — well, it’s not exactly difficult, is it? They can’t wait to give it away!”

memories.description: Winky clearly loves Mr Crouch, even though she's free. It's weird and a bit sad but you can see how stuck she is in her loyalty.
memories.source_text: “She seems to love him,” said Ron thickly (he had just started on a cream cake).

memories.description: Given a choice I'd pick someone like Bagman over Crouch. Bagman might be a bit of a toss up but at least he can crack a joke. Percy wouldn't understand any of that.
memories.source_text: “I’d still rather work for him than old Crouch,” said Ron. “At least Bagman’s got a sense of humor.”

memories.description: Blimey, I walked up to Fleur and just asked her to the ball with no idea why I did it. It was mad.
memories.source_text: "I don\'t know what made me do it!"

memories.description: Fleur looked at me like I was nothing. She didn\'t even answer me properly. That was humiliating.
memories.source_text: "She looked at me like I was a sea slug or something. Didn\'t even answer."

memories.description: What the hell, I only just noticed Hermione is a girl. Suddenly she looks different to me. That\'s mental.
memories.source_text: "Hermione, Neville\'s right \- you are a girl . . ."

memories.description: Hermione insists she\'s already going with someone else. I don\'t believe her, but Ginny thinks she\'s telling the truth.
memories.source_text: "She\'s not," said Ginny quietly.

memories.description: Barking mad. Come on Harry they re putting up your scores so stop standing about.
memories.source_text: [Barking mad said Ron shaking his head Harry c mon they ll be putting up your scores.]

memories.description: Honestly you were the best. Cedric tried to distract the dragon by turning a rock into a dog.
memories.source_text: [You were the best you know no competition Cedric did this weird thing where he Transfigured a rock on the ground turned it into a dog ...]

memories.description: Fleur's charm made the dragon nod off then it snored fire and set her skirt on fire, she put it out with water from her wand. Mad stuff.
memories.source_text: [Well that kind of worked too it went all sleepy but then it snored and this great jet of flame shot out and her skirt caught fire she put it out with a bit of water out of her wand.]

memories.description: Krum hit the dragon and made it go mental so it smashed a load of eggs. They docked him points for doing damage.
memories.source_text: [Krum he wasn t supposed to do any damage to them they took marks off for that he wasn t supposed to do any damage to them.]

memories.description: Marks are out of ten from each judge. Maxime did a silver figure eight thing, Crouch put up a nine, Dumbledore a nine, Bagman gave a ten and Karkaroff gave a four.
memories.source_text: [It s marks out of ten from each one Madame Maxime ... Mr. Crouch nine ... Dumbledore nine ... Ludo Bagman ten ... Karkaroff four.]

memories.description: What the hell? Karkaroff's a biased idiot if he gives Krum a ten and me a four. That s just unfair.
memories.source_text: [Four? You lousy biased scumbag you gave Krum ten!]

memories.description: I m dead proud of Harry. I ll shout for him and get angry on his behalf every time.
memories.source_text: [Harry don t complain Ron yelled excitedly Ron s indignation on his behalf was worth about a hundred points to him.]

memories.description: Blimey, he's right. Dumbledore is a great bloke.
memories.source_text: "Yeah, he is."

memories.description: I'm casual with Hagrid, I can joke and help myself to his cakes. He's one of ours.
memories.source_text: "Can I have one of these cakes, Hagrid?"

memories.description: Blimey, I'm stuck between Hermione and Cho and tied to that massive statue. This is mental. I need to get out of this fast.
memories.source_text: Four people were bound tightly to the tail of the stone merperson. Ron was tied between Hermione and Cho Chang.

memories.description: That's Fleur's sister there, poor kid's asleep like the rest of us. This isn't just about me and the others now, it's everyone. I can't leave any of them.
memories.source_text: There was also a girl who looked no older than eight, whose clouds of silvery hair made Harry feel sure that she was Fleur Delacour’s sister.

memories.description: I stood outside and gave the Fat Lady the password banana fritters. I waited there for Harry so he could sneak through.
memories.source_text: “banana fritters”

memories.description: I muttered good luck to Harry as he went past me. I wasn’t coming with him, just doing the password duty and wishing him well.
memories.source_text: “Good luck,”

memories.description: Blimey, I warned Hermione not to annoy Rita Skeeter. I'm annoyed and I feel protective about Hermione because that article makes her look awful.
memories.source_text: "I told you!" "I told you not to annoy Rita Skeeter!"

memories.description: I realised Hermione was keeping something about Viktor from me. I was jealous and desperate to know what she told him because I care and I can't help being nosy about it.
memories.source_text: "And what did you say?" "And what did you say?"

memories.description: Blimey, I'm out cold and floating near the lake bottom. I can't move or do anything until someone gets these ropes off me.
memories.source_text: Ron floated, unconscious, a few inches above the lake bottom, drifting a little in the ebb of the water.

memories.description: Blimey, they're all over me and the little girl. This is bad, really bad. If they decide to drag us down I'm done for.
memories.source_text: the mermen now closed in around Ron and the little girl, shaking their heads at him.

memories.description: Blimey, I just turned up and demanded to know what they were doing here. It looked dodgy to me.
memories.source_text: "What’re you doing here?" Ron and Fred said at the same time.

memories.description: Who are you blackmailing? I wasn't going to let that slide. If you're extorting someone that's my business.
memories.source_text: "Who’re you blackmailing?" he said.

memories.description: I genuinely think this is serious. If they're blackmailing someone they could land themselves in real trouble and I won't stand for it.
memories.source_text: "It’s my business if you’re blackmailing someone," said Ron. "George’s right, you could end up in serious trouble for that."

memories.description: Bloody hell, what did you bring her for? I couldn't believe Harry had grabbed her in the first place.
memories.source_text: Then he spotted Fleur’s sister. “What did you bring her for?”

memories.description: Wet this, isn't it? I was soaked to the bone and trying to get my breath back.
memories.source_text: “Wet, this, isn’t it?”

memories.description: Harry, you prat. I thought that song was just to get you back in time. I didn't think Dumbledore would let us drown, so why risk it?
memories.source_text: “Harry, you prat,” said Ron, “you didn’t take that song thing seriously, did you? Dumbledore wouldn’t have let any of us drown!”

memories.description: It was only to make sure you got back inside the time limit. I hope you weren't mucking about down there trying to be a hero.
memories.source_text: “It was only to make sure you got back inside the time limit!” said Ron. “I hope you didn’t waste time down there acting the hero!”

memories.description: Blimey, maybe Moody is watching Snape as well as Karkaroff. That would mean Snape is under suspicion.
memories.source_text: "What . . . d’you reckon Moody’s here to keep an eye on Snape as well as Karkaroff?" Ron whispered

memories.description: Bloody hell, what if Moody thinks Snape put Harry's name in the Goblet? That would explain all this searching.
memories.source_text: "Harry . . . maybe Moody thinks Snape put your name in the Goblet of Fire!"

memories.description: You do not like Crouch because of Winky. That is why you jump to think Snape is guilty.
memories.source_text: "You just don’t like Crouch because of that elf, Winky," said Ron

memories.description: I reckon if someone attacked Harry in front of Moody he might do the turning for him. It is not a perfect plan but it might work.
memories.source_text: "Yeah, I don’t fancy walking around with a periscope sticking out of my head," said Harry. "I s’pose I could always attack someone in front of Moody; he might do it for me. . . ."

memories.description: Blimey, I was a wreck and needed Pomfrey. Pepperup and a blanket fixed me up a bit.
memories.source_text: Madam Pomfrey had gone to rescue Ron from Percy’s clutches; she led him over to Harry and the others, gave him a blanket and some Pepperup Potion

memories.description: I helped out, sort of. I want people to think I did more than I did, but I did my bit.
memories.source_text: "Yeah," said Ron, looking extremely hopeful, "yeah, a bit"

memories.description: Blimey, what's he wanting to know that for? I kept asking why Sirius needed the Hogsmeade date, because it seemed odd to me.
memories.source_text: What's he want to know about the next Hogsmeade weekend for?" said Ron.

memories.description: Bloody hell, I reckon Lucius Malfoy could easily have done it. He’s the sort who’d do something like that.
memories.source_text: “I bet it was Lucius Malfoy!” said Ron suddenly, so loudly that his voice echoed all around the cave,

memories.description: Come off it, Bagman being the one to conjure the Dark Mark sounds daft, but he was in the forest and he’s a bit odd so you can’t rule him out.
memories.source_text: “Come off it,” said Ron incredulously. “Are you saying you reckon Ludo Bagman conjured the Dark Mark?”

memories.description: Told you Hermione’s obsessed with house-elves. Still, she might be onto something about how people treat their servants being telling.
memories.source_text: “Told you,” said Ron, looking meaningfully at Sirius, “told you she’s obsessed with house —”

memories.description: Blimey, I reckon Snape avoiding Karkaroff and Crouch snooping about could mean Snape's up to something.
memories.source_text: “Yeah, it does!”

memories.description: I might ask Percy about Crouch, but I won't say anything that makes Percy think badly of him. Percy idolizes Crouch.
memories.source_text: “I can try,” said Ron doubtfully. “Better not make it sound like I reckon Crouch is up to anything dodgy, though. Percy loves Crouch.”

memories.description: Bloody hell, just because Dumbledore's brilliant doesn't mean someone clever can't be bad. I'm not ready to dismiss that possibility.
memories.source_text: “Oh give it a rest, Hermione,”

memories.description: Blimey, when Harry talked about being bugged I first thought of something daft like fleas. Then I began to get interested in these hidden muggle devices.
memories.source_text: "What . . . put fleas on her or something?"

memories.description: My mum gets Witch Weekly for the recipes. That's why she reads it even if it's a bit rubbish.
memories.source_text: "Yeah," said Ron, "Gets it for the recipes."

memories.description: Do we really need another thing to worry about? A vendetta against Rita sounds like overkill with everything else going on.
memories.source_text: "Haven’t we got enough to worry about?"

memories.description: My family spoils each other. Mum sends Easter eggs and Percy writes, and I get stuck with massive toffee ones. It's all a bit Weasley.
memories.source_text: "Your mum doesn’t read Witch Weekly, by any chance, does she, Ron?" "Yeah," said Ron, whose mouth was full of toffee.

memories.description: Blimey, those eclairs are brilliant. I’m always on the lookout for more food when the house-elves are about.
memories.source_text: “No chance of more of those eclairs, is there?” said Ron, who was looking around at the beaming and bowing house-elves.

memories.description: I’m fed up with being poor. I really wish I had more money. It’s rubbish having to watch everyone else with things you can’t afford.
memories.source_text: “I hate being poor.”

memories.description: That leprechaun gold I handed over for the Omnioculars vanished. I thought I was paying Harry back but it turns out it doesn’t stick around.
memories.source_text: “The leprechaun gold I gave you for my Omnioculars. In the Top Box. Why didn’t you tell me it disappeared?”

memories.description: I’d love a niffler. They find gold everywhere. If I had one I reckon I could sort myself out a bit.
memories.source_text: “Wish I had a niffler.”

memories.description: Who're you blackmailing? If you're messing about like that it could get you into proper trouble.
memories.source_text: "Who're you blackmailing?"

memories.description: George's right. I actually think this could land someone in deep trouble, so I can't just stand by.
memories.source_text: "George's right, you could end up in serious trouble for that."

memories.description: I don't want to be like Percy and I won't be made a prefect by acting like him. Don't even joke about it.
memories.source_text: "You're starting to sound a bit like our dear older brother, you are, Ron. Carry on like this and you'll be made a prefect." "No, I won't!"

memories.description: They're totally obsessed with making money lately. They're going on about their future and starting a joke shop and they need gold to get going.
memories.source_text: "Well . . ." said Ron slowly, "I dunno if they would. They’re . . . they’re obsessed with making money lately, I noticed it when I was hanging around with them — when — you know —"

memories.description: I reckon they might do dodgy stuff to get cash. They don't exactly mind breaking rules, so who knows, they could cross the line.
memories.source_text: "Yeah, but blackmail . . ." "It’s this joke shop idea they’ve got," said Ron.

memories.description: Tell Percy? No way. He'd squeal on them straight away. I won't dob Fred and George in to Percy.
memories.source_text: "Are you mad?" said Ron. "Tell Percy? He’d probably do a Crouch and turn them in."

memories.description: Who is this woman and where's Hagrid? I'm gobsmacked that Hagrid's not at his own door.
memories.source_text: "Who're you?" and "Where's Hagrid?"

memories.description: Blimey, I half thought Hagrid might've been attacked by one of his creatures, but Malfoy says he's too ashamed to show his face, which makes me even more worried.
memories.source_text: "What d’you reckon’s wrong with him? You don’t think a skrewt — ?"

memories.description: That article in the Prophet about Hagrid being part-giant and dangerous really shocked me. I can't believe they'd print that about him.
memories.source_text: Narration: "Harry finished reading and looked up at Ron, whose mouth was hanging open."

memories.description: Blimey, I reckon Crouch did a runner. That's why he wasn't there when Harry and Dumbledore turned up.
memories.source_text: "It must've been Crouch," said Ron at once. "That's why he was gone when Harry and Dumbledore got there. He'd done a runner."

memories.description: Right, here's a mad one. What if Krum attacked Crouch and then accidentally Stunned himself? That's mental but could explain things.
memories.source_text: "Okay . . . how's this for a theory," said Ron excitedly. "Krum attacked Crouch — no, wait for it — and then Stunned himself!"

memories.description: Oh yeah, that's not convincing. Still, something weird happened and we need to sort it out.
memories.source_text: "Oh yeah . . ."

memories.description: Blimey, I'm furious that Hermione's been cozying up to Krum. He's from Durmstrang and he's competing against us. That's the whole point.
memories.source_text: "He's from Durmstrang!" spat Ron. "He's competing against Harry! Against Hogwarts!"

memories.description: Obviously I reckon Hermione's been letting him hang about in the library to get close to her. I don't trust it and I'm not holding back.
memories.source_text: "I s'pose he asked you to come with him while you were both in the library?" "Yes, he did," said Hermione, the pink patches on her cheeks glowing more brightly.

memories.description: I ignored Padma while sulking. I wasn't interested in sitting civilly. I was glaring at Hermione and Krum and not bothering to hide it.
memories.source_text: Padma was sitting with her arms and legs crossed, one foot jiggling in time to the music. Every now and then she threw a disgruntled look at Ron, who was completely ignoring her.

memories.description: Blimey, he was raving half the time. A lot of what he said might not mean anything.
memories.source_text: "But he was out of his mind, like you said, so half of it was probably just raving,"

memories.description: Maybe Snape actively tried to stop me getting there. What the hell, why would he do that?
memories.source_text: "Maybe he didn't want you to get there!" said Ron quickly.

memories.description: How fast could he have gotten to the forest? Could he have beaten me and Dumbledore there? Sounds mad, but we have to consider it.
memories.source_text: "Maybe - hang on - how fast d'you reckon he could've gotten down to the forest? D'you reckon he could've beaten you and Dumbledore there?"

memories.description: Wouldn't put it past him, really. I can imagine anything with that lot.
memories.source_text: "Not unless he can turn himself into a bat or something," said Harry. "Wouldn't put it past him," Ron muttered.

memories.description: If Crouch was outside the grounds the Map wouldn't show him. That could explain it.
memories.source_text: "Unless Crouch was already outside the grounds," said Ron, "because it only shows up to the boundaries, doesn't -"

memories.description: Blimey, Dumbledore thinks You-Know-Who is getting stronger again. That's terrifying.
memories.source_text: "Dumbledore reckons You-Know-Who's getting stronger again as well?" Ron whispered.

memories.description: He trusts Snape despite Snape being a Death Eater. I don't like it, but if Dumbledore does, maybe I should keep my mouth shut about it.
memories.source_text: "He really trusts Snape, even though he knows he was a Death Eater?"

memories.description: Malfoy was up to something suspicious with Crabbe and Goyle, acting like he had a walkie-talkie. Probably showing off or setting me up to be mocked.
memories.source_text: "What’s Malfoy doing?" Ron said. "He looks like he’s using a walkie-talkie,"

memories.description: Honestly, that Skeeter woman is poisonous. Seeing that article about me makes me boil. She's gone too far.
memories.source_text: "No way. Not today. That old cow." reaction to newspaper

memories.description: Hermione hated Skeeter enough to risk missing an exam to chase this. She really is furious about what that reporter's done.
memories.source_text: "We’ve got our History of Magic exam in ten minutes! Blimey," he said, turning back to Harry, "she must really hate that Skeeter woman to risk missing the start of an exam."

memories.description: All right, so what actually happened then? Come on, tell us straight.
memories.source_text: "Well, what, then?" said Ron.

memories.description: Blimey, that was everything they had. That's rotten luck and it makes me angry for them.
memories.source_text: "But that was all your savings!" said Ron.

memories.description: I told Mum to shut up and tried to calm things down. I was defending Harry, making sure she didn't make things worse.
memories.source_text: "Mum, shut up!" Ron yelled. "It's okay!"

memories.description: Blimey, Fleur's English is pretty good already. I couldn't help being a bit uselessly jealous, really.
memories.source_text: It’s very good already, said Ron in a strangled sort of voice.

memories.description: Bloody hell, I actually asked Krum for his autograph. I can't believe I did that, but I wanted it, plain and simple.
memories.source_text: Can I have your autograph?

memories.description: What the hell? Rita Skeeter's a beetle. I saw her in the jar and I couldn't believe it at first, but Hermione's nailed it. She's been sneaking about like some creepy bug.
memories.source_text: That’s never — you’re kidding — No, I’m not ... I caught her on the windowsill in the hospital wing.

memories.description: Who? I asked because I wanted to know who was here. I can't help being nosy and I say things straight out.
memories.source_text: "Who?" called Hagrid, coming to the door. "Harry!" ... "Who?" said Ron curiously.

memories.description: Blimey, I asked if Hagrid and Madame Maxime had made up. I was curious and a bit cheeky about them getting on again.
memories.source_text: "Madame Maxime, o’ course!" said Hagrid. "You two made up, have you?" said Ron.

memories.description: When Hagrid brushed it off, I went along with it but I was still watching. If Hagrid's hiding something, that's mental.
memories.source_text: "Dunno what yeh’re talkin’ about," said Hagrid airily.

memories.description: When Hagrid said he knew Voldemort would come back, we were all stunned. Bloody hell, that's terrifying and it means it's real.
memories.source_text: Harry, Ron, and Hermione looked up at him, shocked.

memories.description: Give him a minute, will ya? I’m here for Harry, backing him up and trying to calm Hermione down.
memories.source_text: "Let him breathe, Hermione," said Ron, grinning, closing the door behind Harry.

memories.description: We asked Dumbledore about telling you and he told us not to. He's been busy and we only saw him a couple of times
memories.source_text: "We told Dumbledore we wanted to tell you what was going on," "We did, mate. But he’s really busy now, we’ve only seen him twice since we came here and he didn’t have much time, he just made us swear not to tell you important stuff when we wrote, he said the owls might be intercepted"

memories.description: We're not in the big meetings either. Mum won't let us go because she thinks we're too young
memories.source_text: "We’re not!" "Mum won’t let us near the meetings, she says we’re too young"

memories.description: Don't be thick, Harry. It isn't that Dumbledore thinks you can't be trusted, stop jumping to the worst conclusions
memories.source_text: "Don’t be thick,"

memories.description: Blimey, Mum's terrified but I know Sirius isn't a threat to Harry and I back him and Harry no matter what
memories.source_text: "Mum, shut up!" Ron yelled. "It’s okay!"

memories.description: Fudge is refusing to accept the obvious and that makes me furious because we all saw what happened
memories.source_text: "Bill, Ron, and Hermione were staring at Fudge."

memories.description: This place is the Order of the Phoenix's headquarters. I know it straight away. Didn't want him to be left out, really.
memories.source_text: “Headquarters of the Order of the Phoenix,” said Ron at once.

memories.description: We've met about twenty members of the Order so far, but there must be more. It's bigger than we thought.
memories.source_text: “— we’ve met about twenty of them,” said Ron, “but we think there are more . . .”

memories.description: Fred and George have made Extendable Ears. They're dead useful for eavesdropping, though Mum went mad when she found them.
memories.source_text: “Fred and George have invented Extendable Ears, see,” said Ron. “They’re really useful.”

memories.description: I've been stuck at Privet Drive for four weeks scrapping around to find out what's been happening. I'm not happy about being left out or kept in the dark.
memories.source_text: “FOUR WEEKS I’VE BEEN STUCK IN PRIVET DRIVE, NICKING PAPERS OUT OF BINS TO TRY AND FIND OUT WHAT’S BEEN GOING ON —”

memories.description: Blimey, so me and Hermione are stuck upstairs while the meeting's started without us. We’re meant to wait quietly until it finishes.
memories.source_text: "No, Harry, the meeting’s only for members of the Order. Ron and Hermione are upstairs, you can wait with them until the meeting’s over..."

memories.description: Blimey, some of them are on guard duty. They keep banging on about guard duty like it’s the only thing that matters.
memories.source_text: "— and some of them are standing guard over something," "They’re always talking about guard duty."

memories.description: Oh yeah, I suddenly twigged what Harry meant. It all makes sense now.
memories.source_text: "Oh yeah," said Ron, with a look of dawning comprehension.

memories.description: We were all on edge around Harry because we thought he might blow up. I feel bad seeing him like that and it makes me watch him more carefully.
memories.source_text: "Both of them were watching him apprehensively, as though they feared that he would start shouting again now that everyone else had gone."

memories.description: Blimey, Hedwig's been ferocious bringing letters. She nearly pecked me to bits and I even got a proper cut for my trouble.
memories.source_text: "She’s been in a right state," said Ron. "Pecked us half to death when she brought your last letters, look at this —" He showed Harry the index finger of his right hand, which sported a half-healed but clearly deep cut.

memories.description: We wanted to tell you everything, mate, but Dumbledore made us promise not to. We were only obeying orders.
memories.source_text: "We wanted to give them to you, mate," said Ron.

memories.description: I reckon Dumbledore honestly believed keeping you with the Dursleys was safer. I don't agree with how it went, but that's what he thought.
memories.source_text: "I think he thought you were safest with the Muggles," Ron began.

memories.description: Well, I feel guilty that Harry thinks we kept things from him. We were trying to follow Dumbledore and keep him safe, not to shut him out.
memories.source_text: "Had to look after myself after all, didn’t I?" said Harry. "He was so angry," said Hermione in an almost awestruck voice. "Dumbledore. We saw him."

memories.description: Blimey, she really does not trust us, does she? It’s rubbish but bloody obvious.
memories.source_text: She doesn’t trust us at all, you know

memories.description: I got furious when that elf insulted Hermione. Bloody hell, calling her a Mudblood was not on, and I said so straight away.
memories.source_text: Don’t call her a Mudblood!

memories.description: I was thinking about Mum's reaction to Mundungus bringing dodgy cauldrons here. I knew she’d go mad.
memories.source_text: Blimey, Mum won’t like that . . .

memories.description: I think it’s unfair that Harry might get to ask questions and we don’t. I want to know what’s going on too. If he’s allowed, why not me?
memories.source_text: "We’re of age!" Fred and George bellowed together. "If Harry’s allowed, why can’t I?" shouted Ron.

memories.description: Mum’s strict about who stays in the kitchen and who gets told things. I’m right behind Harry and Ginny in wanting in, but Mum won’t hear it.
memories.source_text: "Mum, I want to!" wailed Ginny. "NO!" shouted Mrs Weasley.

memories.description: We all laughed at Mundungus’s story. I thought it was brilliant. It lightened the mood before things got tense again.
memories.source_text: "I don’t think we need to hear any more of your business dealings, thank you very much, Mundungus," said Mrs Weasley sharply, as Ron slumped forward onto the table, howling with laughter.

memories.description: They didn’t tell us anything we hadn’t already worked out. Don’t see the point of all that fuss if it was obvious.
memories.source_text: “Well, they didn’t tell us much we couldn’t have guessed, did they?”

memories.description: We’d already picked up most of that by eavesdropping with the Extendable Ears. It wasn’t new information to us.
memories.source_text: “We already knew nearly everything they told us, from using the Extendable Ears.”

memories.description: If something worse than killing exists, I can’t even imagine it. What’s worse than death?
memories.source_text: “But there can’t be anything worse than the Avada Kedavra curse, can there?”

memories.description: If there is a weapon, I’d rather it’s on our side. I’m nervous about who’s got it.
memories.source_text: “I hope it’s our side,”

memories.description: I guessed it might be kept at Hogwarts. If Dumbledore has it, that at least makes me feel slightly safer.
memories.source_text: “Where?”

memories.description: Blimey, Fred and George just Apparated on me and it hurt. Don’t do that in the dark.
memories.source_text: “You two just Apparated on my knees!”

memories.description: Blimey, Dumbledore doesn't want lots of owls swooping about. We can't let Hedwig and Pigwidgeon hunt every night or it looks suspicious.
memories.source_text: "We can’t let them out to hunt every night," Ron explained.

memories.description: I'm bolting the door because of Kreacher. He turned up in the middle of the night before. You do not want him prowling your room, honestly.
memories.source_text: "Kreacher," said Ron as he turned off the light. "First night I was here he came wandering in at three in the morning. Trust me, you don’t want to wake up and find him prowling around your room."

memories.description: What's worse than death? I can't imagine anything nastier than the Killing Curse, but if this weapon exists it might be worse. That's worrying.
memories.source_text: "But there can’t be anything worse than the Avada Kedavra curse, can there?" said Ron. "What’s worse than death?"

memories.description: I half hope our side has it. If it is safe with us, Dumbledore's probably keeping it at Hogwarts. That would make me feel a bit better.
memories.source_text: "If it is, Dumbledore’s probably keeping it," said Fred. "Where?" said Ron quickly. "Hogwarts?" "Bet it is!" said George.

memories.description: Brilliant, I'm starving. Give me food now, those chops look perfect. Honestly, I'm not thinking about anything else right this second.
memories.source_text: "Excellent," said Ron, with a kind of groan of longing, and he seized the nearest plate of chops and began

memories.description: Harry’ll tell us everything, right? Don’t leave me out, I’m not having it.
memories.source_text: "Harry’ll tell me and Hermione everything you say anyway!" said Ron hotly. "Won’t — won’t you?" he added uncertainly, meeting Harry’s eyes.

memories.description: Looks like the situation is dangerous and complicated. People can’t just go around warning everyone because of politics and bounties and all that.
memories.source_text: "Well, as everyone thinks I’m a mad mass murderer and the Ministry’s put a ten-thousand-Galleon price on my head, I can hardly stroll up the street and start handing out leaflets, can I?" said Sirius restlessly.

memories.description: That's Kreacher, the house-elf who lives here. He's a weird one, honestly.
memories.source_text: The house-elf who lives here,

memories.description: He's a right nutter, I tell you. I've never seen a house-elf like that before.
memories.source_text: Nutter. Never met one like him.

memories.description: Apparently Kreacher's idea of a good life is insane stuff like having his head stuck on a plaque. That's just mental.
memories.source_text: His life's ambition is to have his head cut off and stuck up on a plaque just like his mother,

memories.description: Hermione still believes in that Society for Elfish Welfare thing. She won't drop it.
memories.source_text: Hermione still hasn't given up on spew —

memories.description: I'm starving, so let's go to dinner. I can't hang about listening to all this.
memories.source_text: C'mon, I'm starving.

memories.description: Wait up. If they're still in the hall we might be able to hear something, so don't move yet.
memories.source_text: Hold it!

memories.description: Snape doesn't eat here. Thank goodness for that.
memories.source_text: Snape never eats here,

memories.description: Once Dumbledore backed you, it was a done deal. I knew you would get off. Of course he swung it for you.
memories.source_text: "'Course, once Dumbledore turned up on your side, there was no way they were going to convict you," said Ron happily

memories.description: I was hoping Dumbledore would come round to celebrate. It would mean a lot to have him here with us.
memories.source_text: "I bet Dumbledore turns up this evening to celebrate with us, you know," said Ron happily.

memories.description: I am actually a prefect. I still cannot quite believe it but Mum is over the moon and the twins are taking the mickey. It is a massive deal for me and the family.
memories.source_text: "Prefect?" said Fred, staring incredulously at the letter. "Prefect?"

memories.description: Everyone is making a fuss about my prefect badge. Mum is thrilled and the twins are joking but I am proud even if it is embarrassing.
memories.source_text: "Get him red and gold to match his badge," said George, smirking.

memories.description: Help around the headquarters is hard work and I moan about it but I know we need to do it. Still, blimey it is a lot of scrubbing.
memories.source_text: "I feel like a house-elf," grumbled Ron.

memories.description: He can't have just left. Hagrid wouldn't do that.
memories.source_text: "He can’t have left,"

memories.description: Okay, maybe Hagrid's away on that job for Dumbledore. That settles it for now.
memories.source_text: "Yeah . . . yeah, that’ll be it,"

memories.description: Blimey, Umbridge's cardigan is ridiculous. I can't help sneering at her.
memories.source_text: "Nice cardigan,"

memories.description: The Sorting Hat went beyond its usual lines and even tried to give the school advice this year. That's unusual.
memories.source_text: "Branched out a bit this year, hasn’t it?"

memories.description: Blimey, I was just asking if there was anything worth a look. I don't take the Quibbler too seriously but I was curious.
memories.source_text: "Anything good in there?" asked Ron as Harry closed the magazine.

memories.description: Give us another Chocolate Frog, yeah? I was still messing about and hadn't clocked how tense Harry and Hermione were.
memories.source_text: "Chuck us another Frog," said Ron, who had clearly noticed nothing.

memories.description: I laughed with the others because that's what you do, but I can see now I missed how worried Harry was. I should pay more attention when he looks like that.
memories.source_text: Ron, Hermione, Ginny, and Neville laughed.

memories.description: How can a hat know when the school's in danger? That's mad. A hat can't pick up danger like a person can.
memories.source_text: "Ow kunnit nofe skusin danger ifzat?" (How can it know if the school's in danger if it's a hat?)

memories.description: He's terrified of the Bloody Baron. Honestly, Nick's all puffed up about bravery but he's scared of that ghastly bloke.
memories.source_text: "Only because you’re terrified of him," said Ron.

memories.description: Blimey, he just left us and scarpered off on his own. Fine by me, see you later then.
memories.source_text: "See you later," he said to Ron and Hermione and he made his way out of the Great Hall alone,"

memories.description: Blimey, Sirius hasn't seen much daylight. He's not causing trouble on purpose, he's just starving for some freedom.
memories.source_text: "Oh lighten up," said Ron, "he hasn't seen daylight for months, poor bloke."

memories.description: Right, I'm supposed to go to the prefect carriage with Hermione. It's a pain but rules are rules.
memories.source_text: "We’re — well — Ron and I are supposed to go into the prefect carriage," Hermione said awkwardly.

memories.description: Bloody hell, I'm not taking this prefect thing like Percy's going to. I don't like it and I'm not pretending I do.
memories.source_text: "I’m not enjoying it, I’m not Percy," he finished defiantly.

memories.description: I don't want to leave Harry alone. I feel bad about being pulled away by prefect duties and I hope we see each other later.
memories.source_text: "Yeah, definitely," said Ron, casting a shifty, anxious look at Harry.

memories.description: Blimey, I'm only trying to ask a simple question and suddenly I'm the villain. That's a bit much, isn't it?
memories.source_text: "I’m not allowed to ask a simple question?"

memories.description: That speech was dreadfully dull. Honestly, it was one of the dullest things I've sat through, and I've endured Percy.
memories.source_text: "That was about the dullest speech I’ve ever heard, and I grew up with Percy."

memories.description: I got carried away and called the first years names. I didn't mean to be cruel, I was just being loud and stupid.
memories.source_text: "Hey - hey you lot! Midgets!"

memories.description: Blimey, today is horrendous. Loads of nightmare classes all in one go and I’m not looking forward to it.
memories.source_text: That’s the worst Monday I’ve ever seen.

memories.description: Being an Auror sounds dead brilliant. It’s elite and you have to be really good, but yeah I’d love that.
memories.source_text: Well, it’d be cool to be an Auror

memories.description: Fred and George have more money than I expected. I’m wondering where they got it from and that’s a bit suspicious.
memories.source_text: They bought me a new set of dress robes this summer, and I couldn’t understand where they got the Galleons

memories.description: I can be clueless and tactless. I upset Cho by being daft about her badge and Hermione is right to tell me off.
memories.source_text: You don’t support them, do you?

memories.description: Blimey, I was fussing with my prefect badge, checking how it looked in the window, making sure it was on right.
memories.source_text: She and Ron pinned their prefect badges carefully to their chests.

memories.description: Where's Pig? I kept asking, worried because Pigwidgeon had gone with Luna and I hadn't got him back yet.
memories.source_text: "Where's Pig?" said Ron's voice, right behind Harry.

memories.description: I was seriously worried about Harry when he started going on about things I couldn't see. I asked him if he was all right because it looked odd.
memories.source_text: "Are you feeling all right, Harry?"

memories.description: Bloody hell, I wasn't seeing the horses and I thought Harry might be losing it, so I hesitated and just wanted him to get on with us.
memories.source_text: "Shall we get in, then?" said Ron uncertainly, looking at Harry as though worried about him.

memories.description: Blimey, I'm starving and a Chocolate Frog will sort me out. Always room for food, honestly.
memories.source_text: I’m starving

memories.description: Malfoy got made a prefect. Of course he did. That's just wonderful, isn't it?
memories.source_text: And guess who’s a Slytherin prefect? Malfoy

memories.description: Yeah, I went with Padma. She didn't enjoy it much because I wouldn't dance with her properly. Not my fault, but awkward all the same.
memories.source_text: You went to the Yule Ball with Padma Patil

memories.description: I'll make Goyle do lines and he's going to hate it. That's the sort of thing I can get away with as a prefect, so why not have a bit of fun?
memories.source_text: I’ll make Goyle do lines, it’ll kill him, he hates writing

memories.description: Luna found me hilarious for some reason and laughed her head off. I was baffled, honestly. What the hell was that about?
memories.source_text: Are you taking the mickey? Baboon’s backside!

memories.description: Blimey, I couldn't believe I'd been made a prefect. I honestly thought Harry would get it.
memories.source_text: "I never thought it would be me!" he said, shaking his head, "I thought it would be you!"

memories.description: Well, Mum's going to try and get me a new Cleansweep. I know she won't be able to afford a Nimbus but I'll be happy with that.
memories.source_text: "She says she’ll get the Cleansweep if she can."

memories.description: I wanted to be pleased for Harry when he congratulated me, and I am. It still means a lot that he said well done.
memories.source_text: "Listen — Ron — well done, mate." The smile faded off Ron’s face."I never thought it would be me!"

memories.description: I know the twins think prefects are prats, but I'm looking forward to getting a new broom, and that makes being a prefect feel worth it.
memories.source_text: "They’ve always said only prats become prefects. . . . Still," he added on a happier note, "they’ve never had new brooms!"

memories.description: Blimey, when Harry said Voldemort's back it shocked everyone. We're shaken but we're with Harry on this.
memories.source_text: Ron gasped

memories.description: Bloody hell, things are getting tense. I'm backing Harry even when it's risky. He needs us to stick by him.
memories.source_text: "Harry, no!" said Hermione in a warning voice, tugging at his sleeve, but Harry jerked his arm out of her reach.

memories.description: She's trying to get people to spy on us. Remember she asked us to report anyone saying You-Know-Who's back? That's dodgy.
memories.source_text: "And she’s trying to get people to spy for her," said Ron darkly. "Remember when she said she wanted us to come and tell her if we hear anyone saying You-Know-Who’s back?"

memories.description: Blimey, we can't exactly tell them off for handing out sweets. It's awkward.
memories.source_text: "No — come on, Hermione — we can’t tell them off for giving out sweets . . ."

memories.description: She'll handle it. I'll back off and let Hermione sort them out. Don't want to get in her way.
memories.source_text: Ron rose halfway out of his chair, hovered uncertainly for a moment or two, then muttered to Harry, "She’s got it under control," before sinking as low in his chair as his lanky frame permitted.

memories.description: I didn't help much with Hermione and the twins. I kept my head down. Bit useless, really.
memories.source_text: "Thank you for your support, Ron," Hermione said acidly. "You handled it fine by yourself," Ron mumbled.

memories.description: Blimey, I nearly missed that. I fobbed her off with 'I dreamed I was buying a new pair of shoes' so she can't get anything weird from me. Worked well enough.
memories.source_text: Ron, who had been fast asleep when Harry got back to the dormitory, muttered something about “doing other stuff,” bent low over his parchment, and scrawled a few words. “That’ll have to do,” he said, slamming the diary shut, “I’ve said I dreamed I was buying a new pair of shoes, she can’t make anything weird out of that, can she?”

memories.description: She didn't let him off for Friday. That's rotten. Poor Harry, that's tough luck.
memories.source_text: “Hey — I forgot — did she let you off for Friday?” “No,” said Harry. Ron groaned sympathetically.

memories.description: That's not on. I reckon Hermione's trying to trick house-elves into being set free and that might not be what the elves want.
memories.source_text: "That’s not on," said Ron angrily. "You’re trying to trick them into picking up the hats. You’re setting them free when they might not want to be free."

memories.description: If someone's going to pick up a hat they should at least see it. I cleared the rubbish off so they know what they're grabbing.
memories.source_text: "They should at least see what they’re picking up," he said firmly.

memories.description: I can't finish the homework on my own. I haven't a clue about moonstones and need Hermione to sort it out.
memories.source_text: "There’s no point trying to finish this now, I can’t do it without Hermione, I haven’t got a clue what you’re supposed to do with moonstones, have you?"

memories.description: Blimey, the odds of Umbridge letting me off are about zero. She's not exactly the forgiving type.
memories.source_text: "What d'you reckon are the odds of Umbridge letting you off on Friday?" said Ron skeptically.

memories.description: I moaned about everything piling up and then got all awkward about the weather. I'm easily distracted and not great at hiding it.
memories.source_text: Ron moaned and for some reason glanced up at the ceiling. "And it looks like it's going to rain."

memories.description: I get embarrassed and say stuff to cover it up. I hate being caught out and I turn red like a beetroot.
memories.source_text: "Nothing," said Ron at once, his ears reddening.

memories.description: Blimey, that’s Percy's writing all right. He’s sent me a letter.
memories.source_text: "That’s definitely Percy’s handwriting," said Ron

memories.description: What’s he written to me? I need to know what he thinks about my becoming a prefect.
memories.source_text: "What d’you reckon?"

memories.description: That letter’s full of Percy’s smug congratulations and advice. Bloody hell, he’s acting like he’s superior and expecting me to follow his rules.
memories.source_text: When he had finished reading, he looked disgusted.

memories.description: Percy still sees me as childish and is trying to peg me as the one who should behave like him. That’s made things awkward between us.
memories.source_text: "I must admit that I have always been afraid that you would take what we might call the 'Fred and George' route"

memories.description: Blimey, I went in too hard for that catch and totally lost my footing. Ended up all sideways and bright red.
memories.source_text: Ron, who had pelted toward the ground to catch the Quaffle before it landed, pulled out of the dive untidily, so that he slipped sideways on his broom, and returned to playing height, blushing.

memories.description: I felt awful when I hit Katie in the face with the Quaffle. I shot straight over to check she was okay.
memories.source_text: "Sorry!" Ron groaned, zooming forward to see whether he had done any damage.

memories.description: I know I looked a right mess after that. Proper embarrassing, but I kept at it until I actually caught the Quaffle.
memories.source_text: "It would have been hard to say whether Ron’s face or the Quaffle was a deeper scarlet when he returned again to playing height."

memories.description: When I finally caught it I overdid the pass out of relief and hit Katie. I’m useless at calming down once I’m wound up.
memories.source_text: "On his third attempt, Ron caught the Quaffle; perhaps out of relief he passed it on so enthusiastically that it soared straight through Katie’s outstretched hands and hit her hard in the face."

memories.description: Fred and George look out for people when something goes wrong. They’ll shove a quick fix into someone’s hand and make it better fast.
memories.source_text: "Fred and George converged on Katie. 'Here, take this,' Fred told her, handing her something small and purple from out of his pocket."

memories.description: Well, I told her and she said she was pleased. I felt a bit put out about it all.
memories.source_text: "Well, she said she was pleased when I told her," said Ron, looking slightly put out.

memories.description: I moved off to try on Oliver's old robes when they called me over.
memories.source_text: "Come here, Ron, and see if Oliver’s old robes fit you"

memories.description: People are being blunt about me. Angelina thinks I'm not fabulous but she expects me to improve with training.
memories.source_text: "Look, I know he’s your best mate, but he’s not fabulous," said Angelina

memories.description: I’m feeling quiet and tense before the match. Don’t ask for a chat, I’m focusing.
memories.source_text: "Yeah," said Ron, who had become quieter and quieter all the way down to the pitch.

memories.description: Blimey, their sneering about my broom gets to me. I’m not having that—I'll show them it flies just fine.
memories.source_text: "Why would anyone put a Flying Charm on a moldy old log like that?"

memories.description: These robes fit surprisingly well even if they were Wood’s. Lucky me, I suppose.
memories.source_text: "They fitted him well considering they had been Oliver Wood’s, who was rather broader in the shoulder."

memories.description: When I dropped the Quaffle and they laughed, it stung. That’s embarrassing but I’m not going to let it finish me off.
memories.source_text: "The Slytherins, led by Malfoy, roared and screamed with laughter."

memories.description: Poisonous toadstools don't change. Snape's a nastypiece and I don't trust him any more now than I ever did.
memories.source_text: Poisonous toadstools don’t change their spots

memories.description: I keep thinking, show me proof Snape stopped working for You-Know-Who. I don't trust him just because Dumbledore says so.
memories.source_text: where’s the evidence he ever really stopped working for You-Know-Who?

memories.description: Bloody hell, we've got tons of homework. Binns, Snape, Trelawney, and now Umbridge. O.W.L. year is going to be a nightmare if she piles more on.
memories.source_text: D’you realize how much homework we’ve got already? ... that Umbridge woman had better not give us any

memories.description: Hang on, we're not going to use magic in Defence? That's daft. How are we supposed to learn to fight if we never practise spells?
memories.source_text: We’re not going to use magic?

memories.description: Blimey, someone's telling me to be loyal to the school and the Ministry instead of Dumbledore like it's the obvious thing to do!
memories.source_text: "Your loyalty, Ron, should be not to him, but to the school and the Ministry."

memories.description: Bloody hell, they reckon Sturgis Podmore, a mate of Dumbledore's, got sent to Azkaban for trespass at the Ministry. That's meant to make my family open their eyes apparently.
memories.source_text: "a certain Sturgis Podmore, who is a great friend of Dumbledore’s, has recently been sent to Azkaban for trespass at the Ministry."

memories.description: So they're saying someone can't live with their parents any more because the parents are mixed up with Dumbledore's crowd. That's mental and a bit personal, isn't it?
memories.source_text: "I am afraid I can no longer live under their roof while they remain mixed up with the dangerous crowd around Dumbledore"

memories.description: They're basically saying helping Umbridge now could get you Head Boy later. Bloody hell, that's a proper carrot to dangle at students.
memories.source_text: "a student who shows himself willing to help Professor Umbridge now may be very well placed for Head Boyship in a couple of years!"

memories.description: Right, they've congratulated me on becoming a prefect. Well, cheers for that I suppose.
memories.source_text: "congratulations again on becoming prefect."

memories.description: Blimey, people know I'm a prefect now because the Minister went and let it slip.
memories.source_text: From something the Minister let slip when telling me you are now a prefect

memories.description: So everyone's clocked that I'm still hanging about with Harry. Great.
memories.source_text: I gather that you are still seeing a lot of Harry Potter

memories.description: I can't lose my badge over Harry. If people say I'm risking it by sticking with him then I have to be careful, otherwise I might actually get into trouble.
memories.source_text: nothing could put you in danger of losing your badge more than continued fraternization with that boy

memories.description: Apparently Dumbledore might not be running the place for much longer. That's worrying.
memories.source_text: Dumbledore may not be in charge at Hogwarts much longer

memories.description: Harry had that big hearing at the Wizengamot over the summer and people reckon he didn't come out well. Dad even took him to court, so it's out there.
memories.source_text: given that our father escorted him to court, Potter had a disciplinary hearing this summer in front of the whole Wizengamot and he did not come out of it looking too good

memories.description: Loads of people think Harry only escaped on a technicality and still suspect him. I can't pretend that won't stick to me by association.
memories.source_text: He got off on a mere technicality if you ask me and many of the people I’ve spoken to remain convinced of his guilt

memories.description: If I keep being seen with Harry it could damage my future. That makes me think twice about how openly I hang out with him.
memories.source_text: Seriously, Ron, you do not want to be tarred with the same brush as Potter, it could be very damaging to your future prospects

memories.description: They reckon I should go chat to Umbridge if I'm worried. Yeah right, like I'd trust her, but that's what they're saying I should do.
memories.source_text: I urge you to speak to Dolores Umbridge, a really delightful woman, who I know will be only too happy to advise you

memories.description: Oh, sorry. I know I mess up by drifting off; I feel rubbish when they're shouting at me and I apologize straight away.
memories.source_text: “Oh . . . sorry . . .”

memories.description: I'm hovering on the left hoop and leaving the others wide open. I try to cover things but I can drift and that leaves gaps.
memories.source_text: Ron, who was hovering in front of the left-hand hoop, leaving the other two completely unprotected.

memories.description: Blimey, I get told off for shifting about. I should either hold center or circle the hoops properly instead of drifting and letting goals in.
memories.source_text: “You keep shifting around while you’re watching the Chasers!” said Angelina. “Either stay in center position until you have to move to defend a hoop, or else circle the hoops, but don’t drift vaguely off to one side, that’s how you let in the last three goals!”

memories.description: I go bright red and say sorry when I'm called out. I know I look a right mess and it bothers me.
memories.source_text: “Sorry . . .” Ron repeated, his red face shining like a beacon against the bright blue sky.

memories.description: I can't believe how much homework we've got. It's mental, honestly.
memories.source_text: "I can’t believe how much homework we’ve got,"

memories.description: I was out for a walk. I felt like getting away for a bit, all right?
memories.source_text: "I was . . . I fancied a walk,"

memories.description: Blimey, I'm not the only one hiding stuff. Everyone's keeping things to themselves right now.
memories.source_text: Harry had the distinct impression that he was not alone in concealing things at the moment.

memories.description: Blimey, I'm going to try out for Keeper now I've got a decent broom. I know it's a bit much but I'm serious.
memories.source_text: "I-I thought I’d try out for Gryffindor Keeper now I’ve got a decent broom. There. Go on. Laugh."

memories.description: I've been practicing every night since Tuesday, trying to get Quaffles to come to me. It's been tricky but I'm giving it a go.
memories.source_text: "Every evening since Tuesday . . . just on my own, though, I’ve been trying to bewitch Quaffles to fly at me, but it hasn’t been easy and I don’t know how much use it’ll be."

memories.description: They're going to wind me up rotten. Fred and George won't stop laughing and taking the mickey out of me over this.
memories.source_text: "Fred and George are going to laugh themselves stupid when I turn up for the tryouts. They haven’t stopped taking the mickey out of me since I got made a prefect."

memories.description: I'm hiding from Fred and George right now because I don't want them to see me practicing or laugh at me.
memories.source_text: "I’m — I’m hiding from Fred and George, if you must know," said Ron.

memories.description: The old hag's gone too far. That's sick, we should go to McGonagall or Dumbledore about this.
memories.source_text: "The old hag!" Ron said in a revolted whisper as they came to a halt in front of the Fat Lady...

memories.description: I actually made it in. I'm Keeper now. I can't believe it, I'm in the team.
memories.source_text: "Harry, I did it, I’m in, I’m Keeper!"

memories.description: I laughed at Harry's sarcastic line because it was dead funny, but I'm still with him. If anyone gives him trouble, I'll back him even if I tease him first.
memories.source_text: Ron laughed, but Hermione frowned.

memories.description: Bloody hell, some people find the idea of Hagrid getting the sack funny. Not me, but I laughed with the lot for the moment because that's how things go sometimes.
memories.source_text: Ron laughed at the idea of Hagrid being sacked along with Crabbe and Goyle's guffaws.

memories.description: Blimey, I thought practice was dreadful. I felt awful about how it went.
memories.source_text: “Completely lousy,” said Ron in a hollow voice, sinking into a chair beside Hermione.

memories.description: I don't like being blamed for everything. Don't assume it was me who ruined practice.
memories.source_text: “Who said it was me who made it lousy?” snapped Ron.

memories.description: Blimey, Hermes actually turned up. Percy sent me a letter. That explains who the owl was for.
memories.source_text: “Blimey, it is!” said Ron quietly, throwing down his quill and getting to his feet.

memories.description: I'm fed up and snappy after practice. I storm off when I'm overwhelmed, but I still try to get on with homework afterwards.
memories.source_text: “I’m going to get started on some homework,” said Ron angrily and stomped off to the staircase to the boys’ dormitories and vanished from sight.

memories.description: Blimey, I did the dream thing last time so it was Harry's turn. I do not want to keep repeating it.
memories.source_text: I did it last time

memories.description: Okay, dream details can be a mess. I was busy doing the sums about age and letters and it was all a faff, but we managed to make something up.
memories.source_text: It doesn’t matter, pick any of them

memories.description: Umbridge is the sort who snaps at us and takes control. We all hate her more now, and I'm right there with Harry and Hermione about that.
memories.source_text: She snapped her long fingers under Harry’s nose, uncharacteristically brisk.

memories.description: The Hog's Head bloke looks like he'd sell anything. I was thinking we could get proper drinks in here like firewhisky.
memories.source_text: We could order anything we liked in here, I bet that bloke would sell us anything

memories.description: I'm a prefect. That bloody spoils messing about with drinks for me, doesn't it.
memories.source_text: You are a prefect

memories.description: I'm with Harry. I'm nervous too but I'm backing him and sitting right by him. I'll help pull up chairs and support him as needed.
memories.source_text: Hi, Harry

memories.description: Fred and George turned up with Zonko's stuff and decided to buy drinks for everyone. The whole thing blew up into a massive crowd.
memories.source_text: Could we have ... twenty-five butterbeers, please?

memories.description: She's gone too far this time. Umbridge is completely out of order with how she treats Harry.
memories.source_text: "I know, mate," said Ron sympathetically, "she’s bang out of order."

memories.description: Good. I want Umbridge to get put in her place. We'll see her mishaps and enjoy it.
memories.source_text: "Excellent," whispered Ron, as they sat down in their usual seats. "Let's see Umbridge get what she deserves."

memories.description: Small victories count. If the class is doing all right and Hagrid wouldn't be let down, that's good enough for now.
memories.source_text: "Well, it’s a start," said Ron, holding up a long, wriggling mouse tail and dropping it back into the box Lavender was passing around.

memories.description: Blimey, I did think the idea of Harry teaching was good from the beginning. Once I knew Harry wasn't going to shout I was all for it.
memories.source_text: I thought it was a good idea from the start

memories.description: Er, I got a bit jumpy about Viktor and Hermione. I think Viktor fancied her more than just pen pals and I wasn't happy about it.
memories.source_text: He didn’t only want to be your pen pal

memories.description: Sirius has been on the run for ages and I'd understand why he'd want to get out. But I still reckon he wouldn't be stupid enough to turn up in Hogsmeade and risk it.
memories.source_text: Well, you can't blame him for wanting to get out and about

memories.description: I believe Sirius actually listens to Dumbledore and wouldn't do anything that would make Dumbledore furious. So he's probably staying put.
memories.source_text: Dumbledore'd go mad if he did and Sirius listens to Dumbledore even if he doesn't like what he hears

memories.description: Hermione is brilliant and kinder than anyone gives her credit for. I feel like an idiot for being rude sometimes and I meant it when I said she's the most wonderful person I've met.
memories.source_text: [Hermione, you are honestly the most wonderful person I’ve ever met, and if I’m ever rude to you again —]

memories.description: I couldn't believe Harry just slid off his chair and started staring into the fire. I asked him what on earth he was doing because it was weird and worrying.
memories.source_text: [Why are you down there?]

memories.description: I didn't know Harry had written to Sirius. That surprised me and made me feel out of the loop; I reckon I should pay more attention next time.
memories.source_text: [You didn’t say you’d written to Sirius!]

memories.description: Percy's a bloody git. I'm not having him tell me to drop Harry or rat him out. Burn that rubbish.
memories.source_text: “Give it back,” said Ron, holding out his hand. “He is —” Ron said jerkily, tearing Percy’s letter in half, “the world’s” — he tore it into quarters — “biggest” — he tore it into eighths — “git.” He threw the pieces into the fire.

memories.description: Blimey, we've got to finish before dawn. Let's crack on and get this done.
memories.source_text: “Come on, we’ve got to get this finished some time before dawn,” he said briskly to Harry, pulling Professor Sinistra’s essay back toward him.

memories.description: Hermione's a lifesaver, honestly. I can't believe she'd do this for us.
memories.source_text: “Are you serious? Ah, Hermione, you’re a lifesaver,” said Ron, “what can I — ?”

memories.description: I'm knackered and I'll do whatever it takes to get this finished. I'll help, but Hermione's sorting most of it.
memories.source_text: Thanks a million, Hermione,” said Harry weakly, passing over his essay and sinking back into his armchair, rubbing his eyes.

memories.description: I think Umbridge is favouring Slytherin or playing favourites. It's not fair and it's obvious she's enjoying the power.
memories.source_text: "She’s given the Slytherins permission, why not us?"

memories.description: Mum told me not to join the secret group or I'll be expelled and my future will be ruined. She really means it.
memories.source_text: "She says on no account whatsoever are you to take part in an illegal secret Defense Against the Dark Arts group. She says you’ll be expelled for sure and your future will be ruined."

memories.description: We learned Mundungus is dodgy and has a history. I wanted to see him but he was hiding for a reason.
memories.source_text: "He was banned from the Hog’s Head twenty years ago," said Sirius, "and that barman’s got a long memory."

memories.description: I liked Sirius's suggestion about the Shrieking Shack. I'm excited about any decent place to meet and practise.
memories.source_text: "How about the Shrieking Shack?" suggested Sirius. "Hey, that’s an idea!" said Ron excitedly,

memories.description: Blimey, Neville just charged Malfoy like that. I can't work out why he exploded like that either.
memories.source_text: "What in the name of Merlin," said Ron slowly, as they followed Neville, "was that about?"

memories.description: Well, Hermione can argue all she likes, but I think it's rich of her to complain about Harry skipping lessons when she walked out on Divination herself.
memories.source_text: "Hark who’s talking, you walked out of Divination, you hate Trelawney!" said Ron indignantly.

memories.description: I'm on Harry's side about Snape's essay and all that. We bicker with Hermione but we stick together when it matters.
memories.source_text: "You can’t skive off Divination," said Hermione severely. "Hark who’s talking, you walked out of Divination, you hate Trelawney!" said Ron indignantly.

memories.description: Blimey, it sounds like Umbridge was practically on top of Sirius. We're lucky she didn't catch him.
memories.source_text: "Harry, Ron, and Hermione’s whispered discussion about how Umbridge had nearly caught Sirius went quite unnoticed."

memories.description: Charms class is perfect for whispering stuff because of all the noise and chaos. Good place to plan without anyone listening.
memories.source_text: "There was generally so much movement and activity that the danger of being overheard was very slight. Today, with the room full of croaking bullfrogs and cawing ravens..."

memories.description: Blimey, in Defense all we do is read that stupid textbook and we don't get to practise any spells.
memories.source_text: "All we do is read the stupid textbook," said Ron.

memories.description: That's mental, the idea that we're being kept from learning because Fudge thinks we're an army is the daftest thing I've heard.
memories.source_text: "That's the stupidest thing I've ever heard, including all the stuff that Luna Lovegood comes out with."

memories.description: I'd hate for Sirius to get sent back to Azkaban, so I'm with Harry on not wanting him to risk coming here where people like Malfoy might spot him.
memories.source_text: "I would, I just don't want you chucked back in Azkaban!" said Harry. There was a pause in which Sirius looked out of the fire at Harry, a crease between his sunken eyes.

memories.description: So we haven't heard for sure what happened to Hagrid, he was meant to be back by now and that worries us.
memories.source_text: "So you haven't had any news about Hagrid, either?"

memories.description: Blimey, I say things half-joking when I'm angry. Sometimes I go too far but I mean how awful Umbridge is.
memories.source_text: "I suggested poison," said Ron grimly.

memories.description: Actually, the thought of Harry teaching us Defense makes sense. I didn't expect to be serious about extra work but this matters.
memories.source_text: "That's an idea."

memories.description: I care about Harry and I'm worried when he gets upset. I don't want him to think we're mocking his experiences.
memories.source_text: "We weren't saying anything like that, mate," said Ron, looking aghast.

memories.description: The Ministry will back Umbridge and there's bugger all we can do about her official position. We have to find other ways to learn.
memories.source_text: "'S too late, isn't it? She got the job, she's here to stay, Fudge'll make sure of that."

memories.description: I reckon Sirius won't risk sending an owl again. He's not daft and he knows how close he came to getting caught.
memories.source_text: "I don’t reckon he’ll risk it again," said Ron. "He’s not stupid, he knows she nearly got him."

memories.description: Blimey, ravens are tougher to deal with than frogs. That's that.
memories.source_text: "Ravens are harder than frogs," said Ron testily.

memories.description: Hermione going on about worrying sounds like Mum to me. I don't always agree but I can see her point sometimes.
memories.source_text: "Sirius is right," he said, "you do sound just like my mother."

memories.description: Blimey, these cushions and instruments will be brilliant for practicing Stunning.
memories.source_text: These will be good when we’re practicing Stunning,

memories.description: Looks comfy and useful. Perfect for practice rounds, honestly.
memories.source_text: prodding one of the cushions with his foot.

memories.description: I don\'t think we\'re going to be as lucky as Harry. Something is off and I reckon we are in trouble.
memories.source_text: "I don\'t think we\'re going to be as lucky, though, do you?" he asked Harry as the second years hurried away.

memories.description: Zacharias looks dodgy to me and Michael Corner gave me a shifty look. One of them might have told Umbridge. Blimey, I can think of suspects.
memories.source_text: "Zacharias Smith!" said Ron at once, punching a fist into his hand. "Or \u2014 I thought that Michael Corner had a really shifty look too \u2014"

memories.description: I want to protect Hermione and be there for her. I rush to tell her when I think she might be affected.
memories.source_text: "Let\'s go and tell her," said Ron. He bounded forward, pulled open the door, and set off up the spiral staircase.

memories.description: We can\'t go into the girls\' dorms. I tried and ended up sliding down the stair like an idiot. That taught me not to break rules like that, well not without thinking first.
memories.source_text: "I don\'t think we\'re allowed in the girls\' dormitories," said Harry, pulling Ron to his feet and trying not to laugh.

memories.description: Blimey, I was practising with Neville and Hermione when Harry asked us to take turns. Basic drills are worth doing even if they seem dull.
memories.source_text: "Listen, Neville, can you take it in turns to practice with Ron and Hermione for a couple of minutes so I can walk around and see how the rest are doing?"

memories.description: Right, everyone switched into pairs straight away. It was proper chaotic but at least we were all actually trying.
memories.source_text: "Everybody got to their feet at once and divided up."

memories.description: Blimey, ravens are trickier to charm than frogs. Who knew they'd be such a pain?
memories.source_text: "Ravens are harder than frogs," said Ron testily.

memories.description: I get flustered when everyone watches me. I botched the first try but I can get it right when I concentrate.
memories.source_text: "Wha — ? Oh — oh, right," said Ron, very flustered. "Er — Silencio!"

memories.description: Bloody brilliant, the team's back. I’m buzzing to get on the pitch tonight. We need to make up time before the first match.
memories.source_text: "I’ve got permission! To re-form the Quidditch team!" "Yeah," said Angelina, beaming. "So I want you down at the pitch at seven o’clock tonight…"

memories.description: I noticed Hermione's off and it worries me. She’s not herself when she’s quiet, and that makes me worry about her.
memories.source_text: "Hope this clears up . . . What’s up with you, Hermione?"

memories.description: Blimey, Hagrid’s in a shocking state and no way is it nothing. I called him out on it straight away.
memories.source_text: "Come off it," said Ron, "you’re in a right state!"

memories.description: Bloody hell, I pointed out how obvious it was that Hagrid had been attacked. You don’t look like that for no reason.
memories.source_text: "Would you say it was nothing if one of us turned up with a pound of mince instead of a face?" Ron demanded.

memories.description: I wondered why Muggles don’t notice where giants are. It struck me as odd that they’d get away with it.
memories.source_text: "So why don’t Muggles — ?"

memories.description: A month to get there? That’s mental. I can’t get my head around a journey that long.
memories.source_text: "A month?" said Ron, as though he had never heard of a journey lasting such a ridiculously long time.

memories.description: I spent the whole day helping round people up who signed the list. Blimey, asking everyone where to meet took ages but we got them together.
memories.source_text: Together with Ron they had spent most of the day seeking out those people who had signed their names to the list in the Hog’s Head and telling them where to meet that evening.

memories.description: I'm with Harry and Hermione on this. We're heading out together tonight to use that map and see what's what. Bloody nerve-wracking, but I'm in.
memories.source_text: At half-past seven Harry, Ron, and Hermione left the Gryffindor common room, Harry clutching a certain piece of aged parchment in his hand.

memories.description: Blimey, I was just asking if Hermione had sorted Hagrid's lessons. I wanted to know if he'd follow the proper plan.
memories.source_text: "So?" said Ron, looking up when she entered. "Got all his lessons planned for him?"

memories.description: Why isn't Hagrid calling the creatures properly? I was still looking around, expecting him to shout again.
memories.source_text: "Why doesn’t Hagrid call again?"

memories.description: Blimey, that door just turned up out of nowhere. Looks a bit dodgy, but I suppose we ought to see what's inside.
memories.source_text: Ron was staring at it, looking slightly wary.

memories.description: I wandered off after the match and froze out in the snow. I couldn't face everyone when things went wrong.
memories.source_text: "I think he’s avoiding us," "Walking,"

memories.description: I'm gutted. I honestly think I'm hopeless at Quidditch and I want to quit. Blimey, I feel like I let the team down.
memories.source_text: "For thinking I can play Quidditch," "I'm going to resign first thing tomorrow."

memories.description: Umbridge wants to ban me and the twins from Quidditch for life. That's mental and it's ruining everything for us.
memories.source_text: "Yes, Mr. Potter, I think a lifelong ban ought to do the trick"

memories.description: I've never felt so low. It really is the worst. I don't know how to fix it right now.
memories.source_text: "This is the worst I’ve ever felt in my life."

memories.description: Blimey, I let a couple of goals in and everyone knows. I walked off alone because I felt proper rubbish about it.
memories.source_text: all except Ron, who had dismounted from his broom over by the goalposts and was making his way slowly back to the changing rooms alone.

memories.description: Harry caught the Snitch and basically saved my neck. I owe him one and I know everyone'll remember the win, not my mistakes.
memories.source_text: “Saved Weasley’s neck, haven’t you?” he said to Harry.

memories.description: Well, okay, maybe nobody'll harp on about my goals now that we won. Still, I can't shake feeling embarrassed.
memories.source_text: They were saved, it did not matter that Ron had let in those goals, nobody would remember as long as Gryffindor had won

memories.description: I'm stunned and pale and I can't get my words out. Everything's happening and I don't know what to say.
memories.source_text: "Ron was still white-faced and silent."

memories.description: I'm backing Harry right now even if I can't speak. A nod's about as much as I can manage, but I'm with him.
memories.source_text: "Harry looked at Ron, who made a funny movement somewhere between a nod and shrug, and they sat down too."

memories.description: How did you see this? I'm stunned and asking questions because I need to know if my dad is really hurt.
memories.source_text: How did you see this

memories.description: I'm white as a sheet and can't speak at first. I'm terrified for Dad and it's all I can do to stand there.
memories.source_text: Ron looked from Harry to Dumbledore white-faced and shocked

memories.description: My dad is seriously injured and that fact has hit me hard. Everything else feels secondary right now.
memories.source_text: Is Arthur seriously injured Yes said Harry emphatically

memories.description: They actually walked into a giant camp. Blimey, they just went straight up to them after watching from afar.
memories.source_text: "Just like that?" said Ron, looking awestruck.

memories.description: You spot the Gurg because he's the biggest, ugliest and laziest. Karkus sat there waiting to be fed, sounded mental.
memories.source_text: "How could you tell which one was the Gurg?" asked Ron.

memories.description: You don't give them ordinary food. Dumbledore gave them magic — the Gubraithian fire branch — because giants like magic but hate it used against them.
memories.source_text: "What do you give a giant?" asked Ron eagerly.

memories.description: They managed to talk to Karkus and he listened because he knew of Dumbledore. Then everything went wrong when the giants started fighting and Karkus ended up dead.
memories.source_text: "And you talked to him?"

memories.description: I was stunned and shaken hearing they were nearly killed and had to hide. I thought it would be quick but it turned into a proper dangerous mess.
memories.source_text: "Blimey, Hagrid," said Ron quietly.

memories.description: Mum says dinner's ready and she'll save you some if you want to stay in bed. Don't worry, we've got you covered at dinner if you can't face everyone yet.
memories.source_text: Harry," said Ron's voice, from far, far away, "Mum says dinner's ready, but she'll save you something if you want to stay in bed

memories.description: I felt awkward about the whole thing and kept my head down. I don't want to make it worse for Harry but I'm not great at saying the right thing.
memories.source_text: Ron looked down at his feet but Ginny seemed quite unabashed.

memories.description: Blimey, Macnair's involvement means the giants might be siding with Voldemort. That's dangerous and explains why Golgomath's gang are a real threat.
memories.source_text: So Macnair's persuaded the giants to join You-Know-Who?

memories.description: I was hopeful the giants might help us fight. I wanted to believe we'd get backup, but it's obvious now that's not likely.
memories.source_text: Well that's not bad — are they going to come over here and start fighting You-Know-Who with us?

memories.description: Umbridge is a proper menace. She snoops around and scares everyone, so we have to be extra careful and cover our tracks.
memories.source_text: Blimey, inspectin' people, is she?

memories.description: Healers are not like Muggle doctors. They're proper magical healers, not those Muggle types who cut people up.
memories.source_text: Doctors? Those Muggle nutters that cut people up? Nah, they’re Healers.

memories.description: Arthur is on the first floor in the Dai Llewellyn ward. That's where we need to go to see him.
memories.source_text: "Arthur Weasley?" said the witch, running her finger down a long list in front of her. "Yes, first floor, second door on the right, Dai Llewellyn ward."

memories.description: Blimey, Umbridge calls the thestrals dangerous. I heard her say it and I was ready to believe her for a second, but I'm not completely convinced.
memories.source_text: Umbridge said they're dangerous

memories.description: Well, it's odd to see three people in one class who can see thestrals. That's not something you expect and it made me wonder how rare it is.
memories.source_text: Three in a class —

memories.description: Bloody hell, Malfoy and his mates can be proper cruel. I got mocked and it made me red as anything. I hate being the joke.
memories.source_text: D'you reckon if you saw someone snuff it you'd be able to see the Quaffle better? He, Crabbe, and Goyle roared with laughter as they pushed past on their way to the castle and then broke into a chorus of 'Weasley Is Our King.' Ron's ears turned scarlet.

memories.description: Hermione will step in and try to fix things when I'm cornered. She gets annoyed and doesn't put up with rubbish.
memories.source_text: Ignore them, just ignore them, intoned Hermione, pulling out her wand

memories.description: Ha. I sniggered because it's brilliant and a bit ridiculous. Can't help it.
memories.source_text: Ron sniggered, breaking off when Hermione caught his eye.

memories.description: I was buzzing when Harry said he kissed Cho. Couldn't help celebrating a bit loudly.
memories.source_text: "HA!" Ron made a triumphant gesture with his fist and went into a raucous peal of laughter

memories.description: Come on, that's mental. No one can be feeling everything Hermione listed all at once.
memories.source_text: "One person can't feel all that at once, they'd explode."

memories.description: I reckon I wouldn't blame Harry for being awkward. If it happened to me I'd be the same.
