memories.source_text: "Don't blame you, mate," said Ron, looking alarmed at the very thought.

memories.description: I still can't see what's so great about Krum. He's older and a bit grim, so what does Cho see in him?
memories.source_text: "What does she see in Krum?" Ron demanded as he and Harry climbed the boys' stairs.

memories.description: Blimey, I just wanted to get in and out. This place is horrible, so let's not hang about.
memories.source_text: "Let's not stay long," Ron said quietly.

memories.description: Neville, mate! I made a fuss as soon as I recognised him. I wasn't thinking, just called out because I wanted to be friendly.
memories.source_text: "Neville!" and "It's us, Neville!" and "Have you seen? Lockhart's here! Who've you been visiting?"

memories.description: Bloody hell, when I spotted Neville's parents I had to have a look, even though it's awful to see.
memories.source_text: Ron was now standing on tiptoe to look over at the inhabitants of the two beds.

memories.description: I felt rubbish for making Neville jump. He's embarrassed but he shouldn't be. He's got no reason to be ashamed of his parents.
memories.source_text: "Well, it's nothing to be ashamed of!" said Mrs. Longbottom angrily. "You should be proud, Neville, proud!"

memories.description: Blimey, some people reckon Harry's gone barmy for saying Voldemort's back. Not everyone believes him.
memories.source_text: "This one’s from a bloke who thinks you’re off your rocker,"

memories.description: I feel rubbish about winding Harry up right now. I can't be cruel when he's that down.
memories.source_text: "I haven't got the heart to take the mickey out of him, even,"

memories.description: Angelina has faith in me. She thinks I can do the job even if everyone else is ragging on me.
memories.source_text: "Angelina still won't let him resign"

memories.description: Umbridge is nosing about trying to make trouble over Harry's mail. She's looking for any reason to punish him and that worries me.
memories.source_text: "What is going on here?" said a falsely sweet, girlish voice. "Why have you got all these letters, Mr. Potter?"

memories.description: I was half asleep and grunted goodnight earlier before all this started.
memories.source_text: [’Night,]

memories.description: I thought Harry had only been dreaming. I didn't get what he was saying at first.
memories.source_text: [Harry, mate, you . . . you were just dreaming . . .]

memories.description: Seeing him sweating and sick made me scared. I thought he was ill and needed help.
memories.source_text: [Harry, you’re not well,]

memories.description: Neville ran to get help. That’s why I was standing there shocked and worried.
memories.source_text: [Neville’s gone for help . . .]

memories.description: Blimey, I'd pick the nightmares over extra lessons with Snape any day
memories.source_text: "Extra lessons with Snape?" said Ron, sounding aghast. "I'd rather have the nightmares!"

memories.description: My dad's told me they call the people in the Department of Mysteries 'Unspeakables' because no one knows what they do
memories.source_text: "I know they call the people who work in there 'Unspeakables,'" said Ron, frowning.

memories.description: How the hell was Sturgis trying to break in if he's supposed to be on our side
memories.source_text: "How come Sturgis was trying to break in when he's on our side?" said Ron.

memories.description: Blimey, I don’t even have any proper Galleons. I thought about how I might accidentally spend one of those fake coins but then remembered I have nothing real to mix them up with.
memories.source_text: "Fat chance," said Ron, who was examining his own fake Galleon with a slightly mournful air. "I haven’t got any real Galleons to confuse it with."

memories.description: That singing got to me. Bloody hell, hearing them chant that made my stomach flip and my hands shake. I couldn’t just laugh it off like Harry.
memories.source_text: "Weasley cannot save a thing, He cannot block a single ring, That’s why Slytherins all sing: Weasley is our King. Weasley was born in a bin, He always lets the Quaffle in, Weasley will make sure we win, Weasley is our King."

memories.description: Yeah, I do let it get to me. I try to keep my nerve but once they start in the corridors and on the pitch I go all green and shaky. I have to stop that if I want to be a proper Keeper.
memories.source_text: "The only thing really worrying Harry was how much Ron was allowing the tactics of the Slytherin team to upset him before they even got onto the pitch. Harry, of course, had endured their snide comments for more than four years, so whispers of, 'Hey, Potty, I heard Warrington’s sworn to knock you off your broom on Saturday,' far from chilling his blood, made him laugh. 'Warrington’s aim’s so pathetic I’d be more worried if he was aiming for the person next to me,' he retorted, which made Ron and Hermione laugh and wiped the smirk off Pansy Parkinson’s face.'"

memories.description: Blimey, hearing Fred say I might make him and George proud actually boosted me a bit. I want to prove them right and stop feeling like the joke.
memories.source_text: "Even Fred had said that Ron might yet make him and George proud, and that they were seriously considering admitting that he was related to them, something he assured Ron they had been trying to deny for four years."

memories.description: Why don’t you shut your mouth? I’m not having anyone slagging off Harry when he’s trying to help.
memories.source_text: Here’s an idea, why don’t you shut your mouth?

memories.description: Blimey, Mum told me not to go spreading Harry’s business. He gets enough attention already, so I’m not running my mouth about it.
memories.source_text: Mum told Ron not to spread it around… She said you got enough attention as it was.

memories.description: McGonagall might let us use her classroom. She did before when Harry was practicing. It could work if we ask.
memories.source_text: McGonagall might let us have hers, she did when Harry was practicing for the Triwizard

memories.description: Blimey, I’m not having Harry flailing about like that; I pulled him out because he was acting mental and could’ve hurt himself.
memories.source_text: “Will you stop acting like a maniac, and I can get you out of here!”

memories.description: I was scared and kept telling him he had to tell people about seeing You-Know-Who because I didn’t know what else to do.
memories.source_text: “Harry, you’ve got to tell —”

memories.description: What the hell? At first I thought Harry was a nutter, but seeing him like that made me realize something serious is going on.
memories.source_text: Ron’s shocked questions after Harry’s vision

memories.description: Impossible. She can't possibly get any worse than she's been, can she?
memories.source_text: "Impossible," said Ron, who was tucking into a large plate of eggs and bacon. "She can't get any worse than she's been already."

memories.description: Blimey, that classroom change was mental when the trees and stars appeared.
memories.source_text: "Blimey!"

memories.description: Blimey, when adults talk like that I get nervous. Of course I asked Harry if he'd done something, because that's what you do.
memories.source_text: "You haven't done anything, have you?" said Ron, looking unnerved as Mrs Weasley withdrew from the room.

memories.description: Bloody hell, the Knight Bus is mental. After that I am never getting on it willingly again.
memories.source_text: "I never want to ride on here again."

memories.description: Famous or not, I care about mates. I told Harry people had been saying things about him, but I still want him safe.
memories.source_text: "You keepin’ well, then, ’Arry? I seen your name in the paper loads over the summer, but it weren’t never nuffink very nice."

memories.description: Blimey, so that's why Sirius was celebrating. The breakout explains his mood.
memories.source_text: “There you are, Harry,” said Ron, looking awestruck. “That’s why he was happy last night . . .”

memories.description: Bode's name rings a bell because Dad's mentioned him. He worked in the Department of Mysteries.
memories.source_text: “Bode . . .” said Ron. “Bode. It rings a bell . . .”

memories.description: I can't stand Hermione when she bolts off without telling us what she's up to. Tell us for once, will you? It'd take two seconds.
memories.source_text: “I hate it when she does that,” grumbled Ron as he and Harry got up from the table and made their own, slower way out of the Great Hall.

memories.description: Hagrid's on probation after that inspection. That's rough and everyone's going to be talking about it.
memories.source_text: “You’re on probation?” said Ron very loudly, so that many students passing looked around curiously.

memories.description: Blimey, I was ready to jinx Zacharias the moment he mouthed off about Harry taking Remedial Potions because that was insulting.
memories.source_text: "Shall I jinx him? I can still get him from here,"

memories.description: Honestly, when someone annoys me I say I'll jinx them straight away, it's just how I react.
memories.source_text: "Shall I jinx him? I can still get him from here,"

memories.description: Blimey, that star display is mental.
memories.source_text: "Blimey!"

memories.description: He's not saying much useful. I want proper details about this war we're supposedly heading into.
memories.source_text: "He’s not very definite on anything, is he?"

memories.description: Blimey, I was bewildered when Hermione dropped that Sturgis bombshell. I didn't have a clue what she was on about at first
memories.source_text: "Sorry?" said Ron, looking bewildered.

memories.description: Bloody hell, I got told to be quiet because Hermione was on a roll with her theory about Sturgis and Malfoy
memories.source_text: "Ron, be quiet" interruption during Hermione's theory

memories.description: Blimey, Malfoy is looking for any excuse to nick points off me and the others. He's being really petty about it.
memories.source_text: "Weasley, your shirt's untucked, so I’ll have another five for that," said Malfoy.

memories.description: Well, bloody hell, Fred and George don't care about getting expelled anymore. That changes things because they mean business now.
memories.source_text: "We don’t care about staying anymore. We’d walk out right now if we weren’t determined to do our bit for Dumbledore first," said Fred.

memories.description: We've always pushed the line before but not properly crossed it. Now with Dumbledore gone they're ready to up the chaos and I can feel it in the air.
memories.source_text: "Have you ever?" asked Hermione. "'Course we have," said George.

memories.description: I saw you thrashing in your sleep, Harry. You didn’t actually get out of bed, mate.
memories.source_text: "You didn’t leave your bed, mate," said Ron. "I saw you thrashing around in your sleep about a minute before we could wake you up . . ."

memories.description: Percy sent his jumper back and didn’t even ask after Dad. Mum’s proper upset about it.
memories.source_text: "Mum’s crying again," said Fred heavily. "Percy sent back his Christmas jumper." "Without a note," added George. "Hasn’t asked how Dad is or visited him or anything . . ."

memories.description: That painting Dobby did is shocking. Looks like a gibbon, not very flattering at all.
memories.source_text: "What’s that supposed to be anyway?" asked Fred, squinting at Dobby’s painting. "Looks like a gibbon with two black eyes." "It’s Harry!" said George, pointing at the back of the picture. "Says so on the back!"

memories.description: Typical Dad. He messes about with things and tries odd Muggle remedies and ends up looking a right mess in front of Mum.
memories.source_text: "They found Mr. Weasley propped up in bed with the remains of his turkey dinner on a tray in his lap and a rather sheepish expression on his face."

memories.description: I reckon house-elves can sometimes leave if they choose. Dobby did it once, so it's not impossible.
memories.source_text: "They can leave the house if they really want to," Harry contradicted him. "Dobby did, he left the Malfoys’ to give me warnings three years ago. He had to punish himself afterward, but he still managed it."

memories.description: Bloody hell, don’t call me gruesome. Those are freckles, alright? I will not stand for that toad liver nonsense.
memories.source_text: "‘Tis a most grievous affliction of the skin, young master, that will leave you pockmarked and more gruesome even than you are now —" "Watch who you’re calling gruesome!" said Ron, his ears turning red. "The only remedy is to take the liver of a toad, bind it tight about your throat, stand naked by the full moon in a barrel of eels’ eyes —" "I have not got spattergroit!" "But the unsightly blemishes upon your visage, young master —" "They’re freckles!" said Ron furiously."

memories.description: Blimey, seeing Lockhart like that is something else. He hasn’t exactly kept himself together.
memories.source_text: "Blimey!" said Ron, also staring at the man.

memories.description: Blimey, that Marietta's the reason things went south. I can't stand her; if it hadn't been for her we'd have been fine.
memories.source_text: "If it hadn’t been for her . . ." Ron went into a rant about Marietta Edgecombe

memories.description: Honestly, our chances of winning Quidditch this year are rubbish. Dad becoming Minister? Yeah, right. That's mental.
memories.source_text: "We’ve got about as much chance of winning the Quidditch Cup this year as Dad’s got of becoming Minister of Magic . . ."

memories.description: Great, I get an evening off for Quidditch practice. Still, I can't help feeling gloomy about our actual chances.
memories.source_text: "You’ve given me an evening off every week!" "That’s for Quidditch practice," said Hermione.

memories.description: Give it a rest, okay? I'm not going to keep arguing. He can decide for himself even if I think it's mad.
memories.source_text: "Give it a rest, okay? He can make up his own mind."

memories.description: Blimey, this is awkward. I don't want to be the one stopping him in front of Hermione. I'll keep out of it.
memories.source_text: He would not look at Harry, though when Hermione opened her mouth to try dissuading Harry some more, he said in a low voice, "Give it a rest, okay? He can make up his own mind."

memories.description: Blimey, we won the match. I’m buzzing and everyone’s carrying me around, it’s brilliant.
memories.source_text: "WE DID IT! WE WON!" yelled Ron, waving the silver Quidditch Cup in the air

memories.description: Everyone’s singing 'Weasley is our King' about me. It’s a bit daft but I’m enjoying it while it lasts.
memories.source_text: Weasley is our King song lines repeated in the crowd

memories.description: I’m on top of the world right now and I want Harry and Hermione to share in the moment. We’re mates and this feels like ours together.
memories.source_text: "HARRY! HERMIONE!" yelled Ron

memories.description: Maybe Sirius left Grimmauld Place because he wanted out. He could have gone looking for freedom and run into trouble.
memories.source_text: "Sirius might've cracked and just wanted some fresh air."

memories.description: It could be that Sirius's family connections mean he knows something about how to get this mysterious thing in the Department of Mysteries.
memories.source_text: "Sirius's brother was a Death Eater, wasn't he? Maybe he told Sirius the secret of how to get the weapon!"

memories.description: I'm backing Harry here. I believe he saw Voldemort and Sirius and I want us to act on it.
memories.source_text: "Hermione, Harry's seen them!"

memories.description: I'm worried and panicked like everyone, but I'm not accusing Harry of acting reckless. I'm with him, even if I'm scared.
memories.source_text: "I never said I had a problem!"

memories.description: Blimey, what if Snape isn't helping at all and is doing the opposite? Maybe he's making Harry more open to Voldemort. It's worrying.
memories.source_text: "Maybe he's actually trying to open Harry's mind a bit wider . . . make it easier for You-Know-"

memories.description: He used to be on Voldemort's side. We still haven't seen proper proof he switched, so I don't fully trust him yet.
memories.source_text: "He used to be a Death Eater," said Ron stubbornly.

memories.description: I'm fed up with training when I'm rubbish. I want to quit practice but Angelina won't let me. It's driving me mad and I feel useless.
memories.source_text: "I dunno why Angelina won't just let me resign . . ."

memories.description: Well, we were always going to fail Divination. Can't say I'm surprised, really.
memories.source_text: ["Well, we were always going to fail that one," said Ron gloomily as they ascended the marble staircase.]

memories.description: Blimey, I told the examiner about an ugly man with a wart in my crystal ball and it turned out I was describing her reflection. That's just embarrassing.
memories.source_text: [He had just made Harry feel rather better by telling him how he told the examiner in detail about the ugly man with a wart on his nose in his crystal ball, only to look up and realize he had been describing his examiner’s reflection.]

memories.description: I was gagged and hauled in here and couldn’t speak properly because they stuffed a gag in my mouth
memories.source_text: “Er — my — nee — no!”

memories.description: I was roughed up by the Inquisitorial Squad and they’re trying to make Hogwarts a Weasley-free place, so things are getting personal and nasty
memories.source_text: “Got ’em all,” said Warrington, shoving Ron roughly forward into the room.

memories.description: Blimey, there's a glass ball with Harry's name on it. That's not normal. It looked like it had not been touched for years but Harry's name is there.
memories.source_text: It’s — it’s got your name on

memories.description: I'm rattled and worried for Harry. This is weird and I want answers. I don't want him to mess around with things that might be dangerous.
memories.source_text: What’s your name doing down here?

memories.description: He'll be fine. Besides, if he's out it's one more problem for Umbridge and I don't mind that.
memories.source_text: "'Course not, he'll recover," said Ron indifferently. "Anyway, more trouble for Umbridge, isn't it?"

memories.description: If Mum gets a letter through Umbridge she'll blame me for Fred and George leaving. I can see it now.
memories.source_text: "It'll be my fault Fred and George left, you wait," said Ron darkly. "She'll say I should've stopped them leaving..."

memories.description: Harry just admitted he gave Fred and George his Triwizard winnings. That's brilliant for me, Mum can't blame me now.
memories.source_text: "How do you know?" said Ron and Hermione together."Because —" Harry hesitated..."Because they got the gold from me."

memories.description: If Montague isn't healed in time, Slytherin will be weaker and we might actually win the House Cup.
memories.source_text: "If Montague doesn't recover before Slytherin play Hufflepuff, we might be in with a chance of winning the Cup."

memories.description: It does seem dodgy that they'd afford Diagon Alley rent. I reckon Umbridge'll sniff around and blame someone for it, maybe me.
memories.source_text: "It's a bit dodgy, isn't it? They'll need loads of Galleons to afford the rent on a place in Diagon Alley, she’ll want to know what they've been up to..."

memories.description: I'm pretty sure I'm going to be in trouble with Mum because of all this. I'm worried she'll get a Howler and I'll take the blame.
memories.source_text: "You?" she said, catching her teacup as it scampered happily away..."Why should I be worried about you?" "When Mum's next letter...I'm going to be in deep trouble."

memories.description: We used spells to get away. I helped, Neville did a decent jinx and Ginny did something brilliant with Malfoy.
memories.source_text: "Couple of Stunners, a Disarming Charm, Neville brought off a really nice little Impediment Jinx," said Ron airily, now handing back Hermione's wand too.

memories.description: Even though Ginny has a broom, I'm not happy about everyone going and I'm protective about who joins this. Blimey, this is dangerous.
memories.source_text: "I've got a broom!" said Ginny."Yeah, but you're not coming," said Ron angrily.

memories.description: I don't trust magical ways of flying that aren't broomsticks. I think relying on weird methods is risky for most of us.
memories.source_text: "you might be able to fly without a broomstick but the rest of us can't sprout wings whenever we —" said Ron barely containing his anger.

memories.description: I'm backing Harry. I want to help and I'm willing to hand over his wand and do what I can, even if I'm grumpy about the rest.
memories.source_text: "So," said Ron, pushing aside a low-hanging branch and holding out Harry's wand, "had any ideas?"

memories.description: Right, I'll go and distract Umbridge and get Peeves to cause a diversion. That should keep her away from the office
memories.source_text: I’ll do it," said Ron at once. "I’ll tell her Peeves is smashing up the Transfiguration department or something, it’s miles away from her office. Come to think of it, I could probably persuade Peeves to do it if I met him on the way ...

memories.description: I might complain, but I back Harry. I don't have a problem with him wanting to save people even if I say otherwise
memories.source_text: "I never said I had a problem!" said Ron heatedly. "But Harry, you’ve just said it," said Hermione fiercely.

memories.description: Look, Occlumency's supposed to stop this, but right now we need action not lectures. I'll help do the dirty work
memories.source_text: "Harry, you’ve just said it," said Hermione fiercely. "Dumbledore wanted you to learn to shut these things out of your mind, if you’d done Occlumency properly you’d never have seen this —"

memories.description: Blimey, I'll go and distract Umbridge. I'll tell her Peeves is trashing Transfiguration and maybe get Peeves to help.
memories.source_text: “I’ll do it,” said Ron at once. “I’ll tell her Peeves is smashing up the Transfiguration department or something, it’s miles away from her office. Come to think of it, I could probably persuade Peeves to do it if I met him on the way . . .”

memories.description: Look, I didn't mean to sound like I disapproved. I don't have a problem with Harry trying to save people when it's important.
memories.source_text: “I never said I had a problem!” said Ron heatedly. “But Harry, you’ve just said it,” said Hermione fiercely.

memories.description: Bloody hell, the Inquisitorial Squad grabbed us and shoved us into Umbridge's office. We're trapped and gagged here.
memories.source_text: “Got ’em all,” said Warrington, shoving Ron roughly forward into the room.

memories.description: Blimey, I was a mess and I knew it. I couldn't help laughing even when I was all muddled and dazed.
memories.source_text: "There you are. . . . Ha ha ha . . . You look funny, Harry. . . . You’re all messed up . . ."

memories.description: I can't help being daft at the worst times. Even when things are serious, I make stupid jokes because it's how I cope.
memories.source_text: "You know who this girl is, Harry? She’s Loony . . . Loony Lovegood . . . ha ha ha . . ."

memories.description: I thought grabbing something weird might be fun or helpful, but that backfired. I won't be messing with odd things without thinking again. Bloody hell, that was mental.
memories.source_text: "Accio Brain!"

memories.description: Blimey, there are doors everywhere. I pointed them out because it means the place is huge and we can’t assume one way leads to the lot.
memories.source_text: There are doors here too

memories.description: I’m right here with you. Don’t go off on your own, I’ll stick by you.
memories.source_text: ‘I’m here, mate,’ said Ron, appearing around the side of the archway.

memories.description: When things got weird I reacted like anyone would. I expected someone to answer so I made my presence known. That was me trying to keep on top of it.
memories.source_text: ‘Who’s there?’ said Harry, jumping down onto the bench below.

memories.description: When Harry said he heard whispering I wasn’t sure at first but then I could hear it too. It’s not just him being daft.
memories.source_text: Can’t anyone else hear it?

memories.description: Blimey, I made some brilliant saves in the match. I’m still buzzing about them.
memories.source_text: "And then, when Chambers came at me about five minutes later — what?"

memories.description: I got suspicious when Harry started grinning, but he swore he wasn’t. Still, I reckon he was remembering something.
memories.source_text: "Why are you grinning?" "I’m not."

memories.description: I was gutted that Harry and Hermione missed most of the match and didn’t see my saves. I wanted the praise, plain and simple.
memories.source_text: "You didn’t watch? You didn’t see me make any of those saves?"

memories.description: No way. Hagrid brought a giant back and hid him in the forest. I can’t believe Hagrid actually did that.
memories.source_text: "He brought one back and hid it in the forest?"

memories.description: What the hell? Hagrid expects us to teach a giant English. That’s mental and I think Hagrid’s gone mad.
memories.source_text: "Teach him English, yeah."

memories.description: We’ve got exams and are nearly on the edge of getting kicked out, so I reckon we should just break the promise and save ourselves.
memories.source_text: "Well, you’re just going to have to break your promise, that’s all."

memories.description: Dragon claw is supposed to give you a brain boost and make you cunning. I wanted a pinch, I really did.
memories.source_text: "Dragon claw does work!"

memories.description: Well, after Hermione checked it and said it was dried doxy droppings, I lost interest fast. That’s disgusting and not worth it.
memories.source_text: "This stuff can, I’ve had a look at it, and it’s actually dried doxy droppings."

memories.description: Blimey, I can't believe we're supposed to mount invisible horses. If you can't see them you can't trust them.
memories.source_text: “What?” he said. “How’re we supposed to get on?” said Ron faintly. “When we can’t see the things?”

memories.description: This whole thing is mental. Riding those things was the worst. Never again, honestly.
memories.source_text: “This is mad,” Ron said faintly, moving his free hand gingerly up and down his horse’s neck. “Mad . . . if I could just see it —”

memories.description: Flying like that with nothing visible under you is proper bizarre. Makes your stomach flip.
memories.source_text: “This is bizarre!” Harry heard Ron yell from somewhere behind him, and he imagined how it must feel to be speeding along at this height with no visible means of support.

memories.description: When we saw the tanks I was the first to blurt out and ask what they were. Couldn't believe my eyes.
memories.source_text: “What’re those things?” whispered Ron.

memories.description: Blimey, I was a right mess. I couldn't stop giggling and I was dazed and out of it, but I still recognized Harry enough to tease him.
memories.source_text: "There you are. . . . Ha ha ha . . . You look funny, Harry. . . . You’re all messed up . . ."

memories.description: I kept making daft jokes even when I was injured. Makes me sound stupid, but it was how I was coping.
memories.source_text: "Harry, we saw Uranus up close!" said Ron, still giggling feebly. "Get it, Harry? We saw Uranus — ha ha ha —"

memories.description: I grabbed the brain. That was a stupid idea. As soon as I touched it the tentacles wrapped round me and I started choking. I couldn't pull free.
memories.source_text: "Accio Brain!" ... The moment they made contact with his skin, the tentacles began wrapping themselves around Ron’s arms like ropes.

memories.description: Harry will put himself between danger and me. I know he will carry me out if I can't walk. We're stuck together and he won't leave me.
memories.source_text: "Harry, pull me along" moments and Harry hauling Ron over his shoulder like he had Dudley months ago.

memories.description: I learned that some things in this place aren't jokes. I thought I'd be fine making a funny, but magic can get dangerous fast.
memories.source_text: "Harry, look what’s happen — no — no, I don’t like it — no, stop — stop —"

memories.description: I am terrified and on edge, but I stay close to Harry and follow him when he moves.
memories.source_text: Harry felt Ron stir beside him.

memories.description: When things go mad I panic like anyone, but I run with the others and try to get out alive.
memories.source_text: They were all yelling, there were cries of pain, thunderous crashes as the shelves collapsed upon themselves

memories.description: Blimey, watching Malfoy squirm is great. I still hate the git when he thinks he can order people about.
memories.source_text: "I must say, I’m looking forward to seeing Malfoy’s mother’s face when he gets off the train," said Ernie"

memories.description: Goyle looks better to his mum now, apparently. Can't say I care much, but it's funny to watch.
memories.source_text: "Goyle’s mum’ll be really pleased, though," said Ron

memories.description: You don't need Cho, Harry. You're far better off without someone who brings you down. Honest.
memories.source_text: "You’re well out of it, mate," said Ron forcefully.

memories.description: Good on Ginny for ditching Michael. He was an idiot for sulking over a quidditch result.
memories.source_text: "Well, I always thought he was a bit of an idiot," he said, prodding his queen forward"

memories.description: WHAT? Ginny's picked Dean Thomas? Bloody hell, that threw me right off. I lost my temper and upended the board.
memories.source_text: "WHAT?" shouted Ron, upending the chessboard.

memories.description: Blimey, the papers are making a fuss about Harry again, but I\'m glad they\'re on his side now. Still, he\'s not exactly enjoying the spotlight.
memories.source_text: 'He\'s \u2018the Boy Who Lived\u2019 again now, though, isn\'t he?' said Ron darkly. 'Not such a show-off maniac anymore, eh?'

memories.description: Fred and George are doing really well with the joke shop. Good for them, honestly. I\'m getting fed with Chocolate Frogs because of it.
memories.source_text: 'They sent me all these, you know,' he told Harry, pointing at the small mountain of Frogs beside him. 'Must be doing all right out of that joke shop, eh?'

memories.description: I wanted to come with Harry to see Hagrid but I stayed behind. I wish we could all go, proper mateship and all that.
memories.source_text: 'Wish we could come . . .' 'Say hello to him for us!' called Hermione, as Harry proceeded down the ward.

memories.description: Divination is staying after all with Firenze and Trelawney. I still reckon Divination is a load of rubbish, but whatever gets lessons running again.
memories.source_text: 'He\'s got to,' said Harry, 'the other centaurs won\'t take him back, will they?' 'It looks like he and Trelawney are both going to teach,' said Ginny.

memories.description: What the hell was that? Something's up with Borgin, he went deadly quiet and looked worried. I was just trying to listen in with the Extendable Ears.
memories.source_text: "What was that about?" whispered Ron, reeling in the Extendable Ears.

memories.description: Blimey, Harry got back at one in the morning and Mum only just found out. That's mental timing.
memories.source_text: "When did you get here? Mum’s only just told us!"

memories.description: I worry about how people treat Harry. Of course I want to know if the Dursleys were being horrible to him.
memories.source_text: "Were the Muggles all right? Did they treat you okay?"

memories.description: We kept hoping something big had happened while Harry was away. Bloody hell, we were expecting more drama than just persuading an old teacher to come back.
memories.source_text: "We thought —"

memories.description: I reckon folks are rushing into things because of You-Know-Who. Of course it explains Bill and Fleur moving so fast.
memories.source_text: "Well, that’s not very long! I know why it’s happened, of course. It’s all this uncertainty with You-Know-Who coming back, people think they might be dead tomorrow, so they’re rushing all sorts of decisions they’d normally take time over."

memories.description: Blimey, Harry, you\u2019re my Captain. That makes me proper proud. If you let me back on the team, I will not let you down.
memories.source_text: "Harry, this is so cool, you\u2019re my Captain \u2014 if you let me back on the team, I suppose, ha ha."

memories.description: Wow, I remember when Charlie wore one of these. It feels like family doing something big.
memories.source_text: "Wow, I remember when Charlie wore one of these,"

memories.description: Blimey, I can joke, but I won\u2019t be daft about You-Know-Who. I\u2019ll watch what I say from now on.
memories.source_text: "Blimey . . . you can\u2019t even make a joke round here anymore. . . ." and "But Ron was careful not to be flippant about Voldemort over the next few days."

memories.description: I really want to go to Diagon Alley. I want to see Fred and George\u2019s shop and not be left at home.
memories.source_text: "No, I wanna come, I want to see Fred and George's shop!"

memories.description: What the hell? Florean's been dragged off from his ice-cream place. That's mental and I want to know why they'd do that to a bloke like him.
memories.source_text: “Did you hear about Florean Fortescue, Remus?” asked Bill... “Dragged off, by the look of his place.”

memories.description: Ollivander's gone and the shop's empty. Blimey, if Ollivander's disappeared that's proper bad news.
memories.source_text: “Talking of Diagon Alley,” said Mr Weasley, “looks like Ollivander’s gone too.”

memories.description: There've been more dementor attacks. That's grim and makes everything feel even more dangerous.
memories.source_text: “There have been another couple of dementor attacks,” he announced

memories.description: Karkaroff's been found dead with the Dark Mark over him. Bloody hell, deserting the Death Eaters doesn't end well.
memories.source_text: “And they’ve found Igor Karkaroff’s body in a shack up north. The Dark Mark had been set over it — well, frankly, I’m surprised he stayed alive for even a year after deserting the Death Eaters; Sirius’s brother, Regulus, only managed a few days as far as I can remember.”

memories.description: Blimey, he shoved straight into me on purpose. What a prat. I don't like him more than I already did.
memories.source_text: "Watch where you’re putting your pins, woman! Mother — I don’t think I want these anymore —"

memories.description: That's bloody worrying. If Ollivander's been taken by the other lot then things just got nastier for us.
memories.source_text: "They'll make do with other makers," said Lupin. "But Ollivander was the best, and if the other side have got him it's not so good for us."

memories.description: I'm starving and the lunch trolley is taking forever. Hurry up, would you?
memories.source_text: Wish the lunch trolley would hurry up, I’m starving

memories.description: Malfoy skipped prefect duty and just sat with the Slytherins. That's not like him, he usually loves bossing people about.
memories.source_text: Malfoy’s not doing prefect duty. He’s just sitting in his compartment with the other Slytherins, we saw him when we passed.

memories.description: Blimey, Malfoy skipping the usual bullying is odd. Something else must be going on.
memories.source_text: Not like him, though, is it? Well — that is but why isn’t he out there bullying first years?

memories.description: Blimey, no time for dithering. If Harry says move, you move. Simple as that.
memories.source_text: "Come on!"

memories.description: Of course Malfoy would sneak off into Knockturn Alley. That lad's made for trouble, isn't he?
memories.source_text: "Big surprise,"

memories.description: We have to hurry or he's gone. I don't want to lose sight of him, so I'm pushing to get moving.
memories.source_text: "Quick, or we’ll lose him,"

memories.description: We can listen. Hang on, damn it, got the Extendable Ears. I'll feed them under the door and listen in.
memories.source_text: “We can!” said Ron excitedly. “Hang on — damn —” He dropped a couple more of the boxes he was still clutching as he fumbled with the largest. “Extendable Ears, look!”

memories.description: Brilliant, they work. Bloody hell, this is brilliant. Listen to them now.
memories.source_text: “No!” said Ron gleefully. “Listen!”

memories.description: Don't you dare talk to my mum like that, Potter. I'm not having anyone slag her off.
memories.source_text: Ron laughed loudly. "Don’t you dare talk to my mother like that, Potter!"

memories.description: Blimey, it's great Dad can get us these cars again. Proper comfy and all that.
memories.source_text: "It’s good Dad can get us these again,"

memories.description: Don’t get used to it? Of course it's only because of Harry. Still, I'll enjoy it while it lasts.
memories.source_text: "Don’t get used to it, it’s only because of Harry," said Mr Weasley over his shoulder.

memories.description: Bill and Fleur waved us off. Nice to have family waving like that even if we're packed into a fancy Ministry car.
memories.source_text: Bill and Fleur waving from the kitchen window.

memories.description: Blimey, I gawped at his face and couldn't believe what I'd seen. I asked what he'd done to it.
memories.source_text: "Where’ve you — blimey, what’ve you done to your face?"

memories.description: Blimey, maybe it's just something like a broken Hand of Glory. It could be nothing to do with dark stuff.
memories.source_text: "Maybe he’s broken his Hand of Glory," said Ron vaguely, as he attempted to straighten his broomstick’s bent tail twigs.

memories.description: What, Malfoy get revenge? I can't see him doing anything major. It sounds a bit much to me.
memories.source_text: "Malfoy, revenge? What can he do about it?" "That’s my point, I don’t know!" said Harry, frustrated.

memories.description: I still don't think You-Know-Who would let a git like Malfoy join up. That's mental.
memories.source_text: "Yeah, I still don’t reckon You-Know-Who would let Malfoy join. . . ."

memories.description: Well, I suppose it could be odd, but I'm not convinced Malfoy is actually a Death Eater. Sounds unlikely to me.
memories.source_text: "Well . . ." said Ron, sounding thoroughly unconvinced.

memories.description: Snape said Hagrid turned up late for the feast. Blimey, that's typical Hagrid really.
memories.source_text: [Snape said Hagrid was late for the feast —]

memories.description: I dived straight in for a massive chocolate gateau. Can't pass up puddings like that, can you?
memories.source_text: [dove for a large chocolate gateau]

memories.description: How d'you know Voldemort doesn't need someone at Hogwarts? It wouldn't be the first time someone was planted where they'd hurt us.
memories.source_text: "How d’you know Voldemort doesn’t need someone at Hogwarts? It wouldn’t be the first —"

memories.description: Blimey, Hagrid wants to train Grawp as his assistant. I couldn't stop myself laughing, so I pretended I sneezed.
memories.source_text: Ron snorted loudly, but managed to pass it off as a violent sneeze.

memories.description: Blimey, I wanted to know why Hagrid was late or what was going on. I asked straight out while stuffing my face.
memories.source_text: "How come?" said Ron between frenzied mouthfuls of gateau.

memories.description: Everyone's been asking if Harry's 'the Chosen One' and it's been nonstop. People can't stop prying.
memories.source_text: "Yeah," said Ron. "All wanting to know if you really are ‘the Chosen One’ —"

memories.description: Honestly, I can be blunt and cheeky with Nearly Headless Nick. I don't hold back even when he's being dramatic.
memories.source_text: "That’s not saying much, seeing as you’re already dead," Ron observed.

memories.description: Potions is back on people's minds because Slughorn's been hired as Potions master. That surprised everyone.
memories.source_text: [Potions? Potions?] [But you said —]

memories.description: That Defense Against the Dark Arts job is jinxed. No one lasts and people die doing it. Blimey, I'm almost hoping it happens again so Snape's out.
memories.source_text: [That job's jinxed. No one’s lasted more than a year. Quirrell actually died doing it. Personally, I'm going to keep my fingers crossed for another death.]

memories.description: Slughorn might not stay long term. If he leaves, Snape could go back to Potions and that might change things.
memories.source_text: [He might just go back to teaching Potions at the end of the year, That Slughorn bloke might not want to stay long-term. Moody didn't.]

memories.description: Blimey, I was proper pleased about all those free periods. That’s brilliant for getting stuff done or messing about with mates.
memories.source_text: Look, we’ve got a free period now . . . and a free period after break . . . and after lunch . . . excellent!

memories.description: I was dead proud of Harry when he knocked Snape back. I couldn’t help grinning. Good on him.
memories.source_text: That was brilliant, Harry!

memories.description: I was purple trying not to mutter the jinx and Snape called me pathetic. I hate being made to look useless in front of everyone.
memories.source_text: Pathetic, Weasley

memories.description: Blimey, that was different. Those Death Eaters abused the spell. Us pretending and mucking about is just a laugh, honestly.
memories.source_text: "That was different," he said robustly. "They were abusing it. Harry and his dad were just having a laugh."

memories.description: I reckon Fred and George would be the sort to make daft spells like that. It's their sort of joke, not some big dangerous thing.
memories.source_text: "Fred and George," said Ron, shrugging, "it’s their kind of thing. And, er —"

memories.description: I defended Harry and the Prince. I told Hermione she's just jealous because the Prince's notes might make someone better at Potions than her. Told you, it's all about bragging, not dark stuff.
memories.source_text: "You don’t like the Prince, Hermione," he added, pointing a sausage at her sternly, "because he’s better than you at Potions —"

memories.description: Blimey, I’m still furious about those skrewts. I haven’t forgiven that class at all.
memories.source_text: "I haven’t forgotten the skrewts," said Ron darkly.

memories.description: Look, I’ve got the marks from that Ministry mess. It’s still on me and it pisses me off.
memories.source_text: "You can still see where those brains got hold of me in the Ministry, look," said Ron, shaking back his sleeves.

memories.description: Bloody hell, I’ve grown over the summer. Doesn’t change how I feel about things but I notice people look at me differently.
memories.source_text: "I’m tall," said Ron inconsequentially.

memories.description: Blimey, Harry keeps pretending he has practice so I don't get left out, and we end up laughing with Ginny about how awful it would be to sit Hermione next to McLaggen or Zabini.
memories.source_text: "This strategy meant that Ron was not left out, and they usually had a laugh with Ginny, imagining Hermione shut up with McLaggen and Zabini."

memories.description: I got the feeling Slughorn barely noticed me at all, like I was just part of the furniture.
memories.source_text: "And with a regal wave, he waddled out of the shop, taking as little notice of Ron as though he had been a display of Cockroach Clusters."

memories.description: Blimey, those spiders got nasty when Aragog started going off. I noticed how their behaviour changed when he was ill.
memories.source_text: Yeah, I think we saw a bit of that side of them,

memories.description: Bloody hell, it really is too dangerous for anyone else to go near Aragog's colony right now. Hagrid insists he's the only one who should try.
memories.source_text: I don’ reckon it’d be safe fer anyone but me ter go near the colony at the mo’,

memories.description: I said I hope Harry's lesson with Dumbledore goes okay. I'm worried and I care.
memories.source_text: "Hope it goes okay," said Ron,

memories.description: Well, I heard about the detention being moved. It doesn't change much for me except I'm glad Harry won't be dealing with Snape right this instant.
memories.source_text: "Right," said Harry, ... "Er," began Harry awkwardly, but Dumbledore did not look too stern. "I have arranged with Professor Snape that you will do your detention next Saturday instead." "Right," said Harry,

memories.description: I was there messing about, trying to read Hermione's essay upside down like an idiot. Typical me, trying to be nosy.
memories.source_text: Ron was trying to read it upside down.

memories.description: Blimey, Slughorn ignoring me stung. I reckon Ginny might get invited, but being passed over grated on me.
memories.source_text: "I don’t want to go on my own!" "I doubt you’ll be alone, Ginny’ll probably be invited," snapped Ron, who did not seem to have taken kindly to being ignored by Slughorn.

memories.description: Drop it, Harry. I don't want to keep going on about Malfoy right now.
memories.source_text: "Oh, drop it, Harry," said Ron.

memories.description: I'm fed up with not being invited. If I'm not wanted at these parties, I'm off to bed. Simple as that.
memories.source_text: "Well, as I’m not invited to any parties," said Ron, getting to his feet again, "I think I’ll go to bed."

memories.description: Hang on, that thing looks familiar to me. I think I've seen it before.
memories.source_text: Hang on, This looks familiar -

memories.description: I pay attention to things, and if something looks like it belongs to someone we know, I'll call it out even if I'm a bit moody about it.
memories.source_text: Hang on, This looks familiar -

memories.description: I picked up that silver bit because it caught my eye and I thought it meant something.
memories.source_text: [Ron stooped down and picked up something silver.]

memories.description: That was different, honestly. Those lot were abusing the spell. Harry and his dad were just having a laugh, not being nasty about it.
memories.source_text: “That was different,” he said robustly. “They were abusing it. Harry and his dad were just having a laugh.

memories.description: There is no way they’d accept me. My whole family are blood traitors to them. That’s as bad as being Muggle-born to Death Eaters.
memories.source_text: “There is no way they’d let me be a Death Eater!” said Ron indignantly, a bit of sausage flying off the fork he was now brandishing at Hermione and hitting Ernie Macmillan on the head. “My whole family are blood traitors! That’s as bad as Muggle-borns to Death Eaters!”

memories.description: Blimey, if Death Eaters were sensible they'd want someone like me. I’d never join them though. I’m not having any of that.
memories.source_text: “And they’d love to have me,” said Harry sarcastically. “We’d be best pals if they didn’t keep trying to do me in.”

memories.description: Blimey, Malfoy would look a prat carrying a necklace. He wouldn't want to be seen with something daft like that.
memories.source_text: “Well, he would look a bit of a prat carrying a necklace,” interjected Ron.

memories.description: The whole plan wasn't very clever. The curse didn't even get into Hogwarts. That's hardly foolproof, is it?
memories.source_text: “The curse didn’t even make it into the castle. Not what you’d call foolproof.”

memories.description: It could have been meant for any of a few people. I reckon it could've been meant for Dumbledore or someone important. Could have been aimed at people the Death Eaters hate.
memories.source_text: “It could’ve been meant for loads of people,” said Harry. “Dumbledore — the Death Eaters would love to get rid of him... Or —" “Or you,” said Hermione, looking troubled.

memories.description: He enjoys Acid Pops? So that's Dumbledore's password. Blimey, that's a brilliant password.
memories.source_text: "He enjoys Acid Pops?" said Ron, who had read the message over Harry’s shoulder and was looking perplexed.

memories.description: If the password is Acid Pops then Snape won't catch me out with that detention trick. That's a relief.
memories.source_text: "Ha! Snape’s not going to be pleased. . . . I won’t be able to do his detention!"

memories.description: I'm a bit annoyed Hermione got the credit from Slughorn before I could boast. I want recognition too even if I grumble about it.
memories.source_text: "Well, what’s so impressive about that?" whispered Ron, who for some reason looked annoyed. "You are the best in the year — I’d’ve told him so if he’d asked me!"

memories.description: Felix Felicis is liquid luck. Sounds mental but if it really works then it's something everyone would want.
memories.source_text: "It’s liquid luck," said Hermione excitedly. "It makes you lucky!"

memories.description: I reckon Harry used different instructions from the ones we had. It could've gone wrong, but fair play to him, he took a risk and it worked out.
memories.source_text: "He only followed different instructions to ours," said Ron. "Could’ve been a catastrophe, couldn’t it? But he took a risk and it paid off."

memories.description: Blimey, I'm gutted Slughorn didn't give me the best book. Mine's a mess and looks like it's been puked on. I felt proper miffed seeing Harry succeed with the scribbled copy.
memories.source_text: "Slughorn could’ve handed me that book, but no, I get the one no one’s ever written on. Puked on, by the look of page fifty-two, but —"

memories.description: I saw Slughorn nod at Hermione and then go mad for Harry's potion. I was stunned. That bottle of Felix Felicis for Harry left me feeling gobsmacked and a bit jealous.
memories.source_text: He passed over Ernie’s navy concoction. Hermione’s potion he gave an approving nod. Then he saw Harry’s, and a look of incredulous delight spread over his face.

memories.description: Blimey, yeah, you get used to someone if they live in the house, but it’s still horrible if they jump out at you like that.
memories.source_text: "Well, you do," said Ron, "but if she jumps out at you unexpectedly, like then . . ."

memories.description: Look, no bloke’s going to go for Tonks when Fleur’s around. Fleur’s got that glamour and presence, she’s got the advantage.
memories.source_text: "Listen, no bloke in his right mind’s going to fancy Tonks when Fleur’s around."

memories.description: She’s been miserable lately, not funny at all. Honestly, she looks like she’s been crying her eyes out.
memories.source_text: "She hasn’t been much of a laugh lately," said Ron. "Every time I’ve seen her she’s looked more like Moaning Myrtle."

memories.description: Tonks and Sirius barely knew one another. It’s not like they were close family friends or anything.
memories.source_text: "Tonks and Sirius barely knew each other!" said Ron. "Sirius was in Azkaban half her life and before that their families never met —"

memories.description: Nice one, mate. I knew you’d ace Defense. We’ve done all right, haven’t we?
memories.source_text: "Knew you’d be top at Defense Against the Dark Arts," said Ron, punching Harry on the shoulder.

memories.description: I’m rubbish at the moment. I felt like giving up and said I resign. I couldn’t hide how useless I felt.
memories.source_text: "I resign. I’m pathetic."

memories.description: I don’t like being told what to do, especially when I’m already panicking. Don’t boss me about, all right?
memories.source_text: "Stop bossing me around, Hermione."

memories.description: I panicked and messed up. I tried to explain but I couldn’t get the words out properly.
memories.source_text: "I just —"

memories.description: I agreed to play because I knew Harry needed someone, but I told him if we lose I’m off. I meant it.
memories.source_text: "I know you haven’t got any time to find another Keeper, so I’ll play tomorrow, but if we lose, and we will, I’m taking myself off the team."

memories.description: Blimey, thinking about You-Know-Who is proper scary.
memories.source_text: Wow, scary thought, the boy You-Know-Who.

memories.description: I don't see why Dumbledore is putting Harry through all this. It might be interesting but I want to know the point.
memories.source_text: But I still don’t get why Dumbledore’s showing you all this. I mean, it’s really interesting and everything, but what’s the point?

memories.description: So the Slug Club is just another of Slughorn's favorites. Sounds a bit daft to me.
memories.source_text: And this is another party just for Slughorn’s favorites, is it?

memories.description: Hermione was going to ask me to the party and I would have said no if she'd thought I'd prefer someone else. I'm not desperate to be her 'plus one' if that's what she meant.
memories.source_text: You were going to ask me? ... No, I wouldn’t.

memories.description: I want to deal with this pod. Hand me a bowl so I can try and smash it like a proper squash.
memories.source_text: Pass me a bowl.

memories.description: Blimey, I was loving it. I couldn't help showing off a bit when the crowd cheered 'Weasley Is Our King.'
memories.source_text: "He was actually smiling now, and when the crowd greeted a particularly good save with a rousing chorus of the old favorite 'Weasley Is Our King,' he pretended to conduct them from on high."

memories.description: I thought I might have only been playing well because of luck potion, but actually I saved those goals myself. I can do it without help.
memories.source_text: "You saved everything because you felt lucky. You did it all yourself."

memories.description: I'm with Lavender and trying to have a laugh, but I know Hermione's upset. I feel awkward about it and a bit guilty, even if I'm trying to be upbeat.
memories.source_text: "Ron came in, laughing, pulling Lavender by the hand."

memories.description: Bloody hell, Hermione attacked me with conjured birds and I got pecked. I hadn't expected that reaction and it was pretty horrible.
memories.source_text: "'Gerremoffme!' he yelled, but with one last look of vindictive fury, Hermione wrenched open the door and disappeared through it."

memories.description: I shrug off Percy's leaving. I think Percy is a prat and honestly I don't see his going as a big loss.
memories.source_text: "Yeah, don’t worry about us," said Ron, permitting his mother to plant a very wet kiss on his cheek, "or about Percy. He’s such a prat, it’s not really a loss, is it?"

memories.description: Mum still fusses over me like crazy. I let her because, well, she means well even if it is embarrassing.
memories.source_text: Mrs. Weasley planted a very wet kiss on his cheek.

memories.description: I arrive at Hogwarts the same way as Harry through the Floo. We're together when we head off to Gryffindor Tower.
memories.source_text: Ron came spinning into view after Harry arrived in McGonagall's office.

memories.description: Blimey, I was sitting with Lavender in the armchair. It looked cosy enough.
memories.source_text: "She had just spotted Ron and Lavender, who were entwined in the same armchair."

memories.description: Yeah, Hermione and I had a row. I can be a bit daft and say silly things that upset people.
memories.source_text: "\"She\'s a bit upset,\" said Luna. \"I thought at first it was Moaning Myrtle in there, but it turned out to be Hermione. She said something about that Ron Weasley. . . .\""

memories.description: Bloody hell, people think I say funny things, but I can come across as unkind sometimes.
memories.source_text: "\"He says very funny things sometimes, doesn\'t he?\" said Luna. \"But he can be a bit unkind. I noticed that last year.\""

memories.description: Blimey, I can't believe Harry picked Luna. Anyone else would have made more sense to me.
memories.source_text: "You could’ve taken anyone! Anyone! And you chose Loony Lovegood?"

memories.description: I muttered that apologizing to Hermione would probably get me attacked by more canaries. I was dodging the hassle.
memories.source_text: "What, and get attacked by another flock of canaries?"

memories.description: I defended myself by saying she laughed at my mustache. I was annoyed and trying to justify what I did.
memories.source_text: "She laughed at my mustache!"

memories.description: Lavender shoved herself between Harry and me and hugged me. That was awkward and a bit embarrassing.
memories.source_text: Squeezing herself in between Harry and Ron, Lavender flung her arms around Ron’s neck.

memories.description: I just surfaced there, felt a bit blank when Hermione announced her thing. Didn't know what to say.
memories.source_text: "There was a noise like a plunger being withdrawn from a blocked sink and Ron surfaced."

memories.description: Blimey, I was stunned. I couldn't bring myself to jump in when Hermione said she was going with McLaggen.
memories.source_text: "Ron looked strangely blank and said nothing."

memories.description: An Unbreakable Vow is something you cannot break. That’s how it was put to me and it sounds deadly serious.
memories.source_text: "An Unbreakable Vow?" said Ron, looking stunned.

memories.description: If someone breaks an Unbreakable Vow they die. That is the plain truth as far as I’m concerned.
memories.source_text: "You die," said Ron simply.

memories.description: Fred and George once tried to get me to make a vow with them when I was little. Dad went mental when he found us. Fred still jokes about it but it was proper scary at the time.
memories.source_text: "Fred and George tried to get me to make one when I was about five. I nearly did too, I was holding hands with Fred and everything when Dad found us. He went mental," said Ron, with a reminiscent gleam in his eyes.

memories.description: I reckon everyone will say Snape was only pretending to help so he could find out what Malfoy is doing. That’s what Dad and Dumbledore and the others will probably think.
memories.source_text: "’Course, you know what they’ll all say? Dad and Dumbledore and all of them? They’ll say Snape isn’t really trying to help Malfoy, he was just trying to find out what Malfoy’s up to."

memories.description: I do believe you, Harry. Honestly, I do. I’m on your side with this.
memories.source_text: "Yeah, I do!" said Ron hastily. "Seriously, I do!"

memories.description: I’m fed up with having to do dumb chores by hand. Once I’m seventeen I’ll be able to do them by magic and I can’t wait.
memories.source_text: "I’ll be seventeen in two and a bit months’ time," said Ron grumpily, "and then I’ll be able to do it by magic!"

memories.description: Baubles. That’s the password I tried to give, obviously.
memories.source_text: "Baubles," said Ron confidently, when they reached the Fat Lady

memories.description: My Christmas was pretty eventful, I was trying to start telling them about it, I was going to say something about Rufus Scrimgeour before I got cut off.
memories.source_text: "Yeah," said Ron at once, "pretty eventful, Rufus Scrim —"

memories.description: Lavender gave me that ridiculous 'My Sweetheart' necklace. Honest to Merlin, she thinks I'll wear that?
memories.source_text: “It’s from Lavender,” said Ron, sounding revolted. “She can’t honestly think I’d wear . . .”

memories.description: I asked if Hermione's actually seeing McLaggen. I don't know for sure. I don't like the idea of that at all.
memories.source_text: “Is Hermione really going out with McLaggen?”

memories.description: Fred and George sent Harry loads of Weasleys' Wizard Wheezes stuff and Kreacher sent maggots to Harry. I thought the maggots were brilliant.
memories.source_text: “Fred and George gave them to me! Aren’t they beautiful?” and The package contained a large number of maggots.

memories.description: Ginny pulled a maggot out of Harry's hair and everyone laughed. That was priceless.
memories.source_text: “Harry, you’ve got a maggot in your hair,” said Ginny cheerfully

memories.description: Fleur nicknamed me clumsy and compared me to Tonks for knocking things about. Bloody hell, I am a walking disaster sometimes.
memories.source_text: “You are as bad as zat Tonks,” said Fleur to Ron

memories.description: I believed those chocolates were a birthday present. I honestly thought someone had given them to me.
memories.source_text: "They were a birthday present!" shouted Ron, revolving slowly in midair as he struggled to get free.

memories.description: Romilda Vane? Yes please. The minute I heard her name I was desperate to meet her. I was sure I wanted her to fall for me.
memories.source_text: "Romilda?" he repeated. "Did you say Romilda? Harry — do you know her? Can you introduce me?"

memories.description: I drank Slughorn’s tonic thinking it would steady me for Romilda. Felt great for a moment until everything went wrong after the mead.
memories.source_text: "Now drink that up, it’s a tonic for the nerves, keep you calm when she arrives, you know."

memories.description: After the mead I went from all smiles to collapsing and convulsing. Whatever happened to that drink was horrific.
memories.source_text: "Ron had dropped his glass; he half-rose from his chair and then crumpled, his extremities jerking uncontrollably."

memories.description: Blimey, that potion was a disaster so I just stopped and tried not to puke. Sometimes you have to cut your losses.
memories.source_text: Ron had given up completely, and was merely trying to avoid breathing in the putrid fumes issuing from his cauldron.

memories.description: I winced when Harry said Voldemort's name because it still hits me. I’m worried and annoyed, and I don’t like being dragged into dangerous stuff.
memories.source_text: "Look, I had to try and soften him up so I could ask him about Voldemort, didn’t I? Oh, will you get a grip!"

memories.description: I was out in the forest all day with Aragog. I missed dinner and only found out I was in the hospital when Professor Sprout told me. How am I? I want to know what's happened to me.
memories.source_text: "Bin in the forest all day! Aragog’s worse, I bin readin’ to him — didn’ get up ter dinner till jus’ now an’ then Professor Sprout told me abou’ Ron! How is he?"

memories.description: Blimey, McLaggen is huge. I wouldn't fancy getting stuck in with him.
memories.source_text: "You don’t want to get hold of him, he’s the size of a troll,"

memories.description: We lost spectacularly. The final score was three hundred and twenty to sixty.
memories.source_text: "Final score was three hundred and twenty to sixty."

memories.description: Honestly, hexing him with that halfblood prince trick sounds very tempting. That's mental but satisfying to think about.
memories.source_text: "Personally, I think there’s a lot to be said for hexing him with that toenail thing of the Prince’s."

memories.description: Ginny came to see you while you were out and she cares enough to check on you. That's good to know.
memories.source_text: "Ginny came in to visit while you were unconscious,"

memories.description: Luna's commentary was hilarious from the hospital wing. 'Loser's Lurgy' had me laughing my head off.
memories.source_text: "I could hear the match commentary from here," said Ron, his voice now shaking with laughter. "I hope Luna always commentates from now on. . . . Loser’s Lurgy . . ."

memories.description: Blimey, Harry can Apparate now. He won't have any trouble when July comes round.
memories.source_text: "At least you can Apparate, though!" said Ron tensely. "You'll have no trouble come July!"

memories.description: I wish Lavender would stop clinging to me. If I hint I want to finish something she holds on tighter. It's like going out with the giant squid.
memories.source_text: "Wish that would happen with me and Lavender," said Ron gloomily.

memories.description: Bloody hell, my quill's gone mad. Fred and George's Spell-Check quill is wearing off and I've almost wrecked my essay.
memories.source_text: "It can't be B — U — M —" and "It’s one of Fred and George's Spell-Check ones . . . but I think the charm must be wearing off."

memories.description: Blimey, I think hanging back after class might work. That's my plan, simple as that.
memories.source_text: Ron reckons I should just hang back after Potions this afternoon

memories.description: What the hell did you do, Hermione? You went straight to Slughorn like a shot and left us behind.
memories.source_text: What've you done?

memories.description: I'm staring at the same book as you and there's nothing useful. Bloody typical that we're left guessing when a trick might have helped.
memories.source_text: You sure the Prince hasn't got any tips?

memories.description: People tease me by calling me Won-Won but I still reckon my straightforward ideas count for something. I get a bit flared up when Hermione mocks my judgment.
memories.source_text: After all, when has Won-Won's judgment ever been faulty?

memories.description: I keep trusting Hermione to bail me out in class and I forgot I can't always rely on her. That's worrying when things get tricky.
memories.source_text: Ron kept forgetting that he could no longer rely on Hermione to help him out of trouble when he failed to grasp what was going on.

memories.description: Don't be daft, Harry. You're the Captain. You can't just miss matches to tail Malfoy.
memories.source_text: “Don’t be stupid,” said Ron sharply. “You couldn’t have missed a Quidditch match just to follow Malfoy, you’re the Captain!”

memories.description: Maybe Malfoy is slipping into Hogsmeade. I haven't seen him use the secret passages and I reckon they're watched now.
memories.source_text: “I dunno . . . Hogsmeade?” suggested Ron, yawning. “I’ve never seen him going along any of the secret passageways on the map. I thought they were being watched now anyway?”

memories.description: You're getting obsessed, Harry. Seriously, that's worrying.
memories.source_text: “You’re getting a bit obsessed with Malfoy, Harry. I mean, thinking about missing a match just to follow him . . .”

memories.description: That Langlock was brilliant. Pretty sure that was a hex from the Half-Blood Prince's book.
memories.source_text: “Nice one,” said Ron appreciatively, lifting Dobby into the air so that his flailing limbs no longer made contact with Kreacher. “That was another Prince hex, wasn’t it?”

memories.description: Blimey, those younger kids really seem to be shrinking every year. They look tiny to me now.
memories.source_text: "I swear they’re getting smaller," he said.

memories.description: Hermione and I are mates again. Things are sorted out between us, which is great.
memories.source_text: "Hermione even escorted them down to breakfast, bringing with her the news that Ginny had argued with Dean."

memories.description: That is mental. Hagrid knew Aragog tried to eat Harry and me, and yet he still wants us to go and cry over the beast's body. I can't believe it.
memories.source_text: He\'s mental!

memories.description: Blimey, the obvious thing is to use the Felix. If Harry can't get Slughorn on his own, he should take the lucky potion and try again.
memories.source_text: Harry, that\'s it \u2014 get lucky!

memories.description: Well, I failed my Apparition test. It was rotten luck, just a tiny thing about leaving half an eyebrow behind, and I feel proper miserable about it.
memories.source_text: He \u2014 he just failed

memories.description: Blimey, I don't like being left out. Tell me what the plan is or I get jumpy.
memories.source_text: "Are you going to tell me what we’re doing, then?" asked Ron, panting slightly.

memories.description: Harry, hurry up and show me. I can't just stand here waiting.
memories.source_text: "Harry . . ."

memories.description: It was meant to be my birthday treat. I'm dead annoyed they canceled Hogsmeade. That's rotten luck.
memories.source_text: "It was on my birthday!" he said. "I was looking forward to that!"

memories.description: Of course I'm furious about Hogsmeade being canceled. It's exactly the sort of thing that ruins a good birthday.
memories.source_text: To general indignation, a sign went up on all common room notice boards that the next trip into Hogsmeade had been canceled. Ron was furious.

memories.description: Blimey, I'm stuck with stupid Apparition for my birthday. Not exactly thrilled about it.
memories.source_text: "But now all I've got to look forward to is stupid Apparition!' said Ron grumpily. 'Big birthday treat . . .'"

memories.description: I got Quidditch Keeper gloves from Harry and I'm well chuffed about them.
memories.source_text: "Cheers,' said Ron drowsily and, as he ripped off the paper, Harry got out of bed... 'Nice one, Harry!' said Ron enthusiastically, waving the new pair of Quidditch Keeper's gloves Harry had given him."

memories.description: Mum and Dad gave me a mad gold watch. I'm talking about coming of age like it's some massive thing.
memories.source_text: "'See what Mum and Dad got me? Blimey, I think I'll come of age next year too. . . .' 'Cool,' muttered Harry, sparing the watch a glance before peering more closely at the map."

memories.description: I'm scoffing Chocolate Cauldrons like nothing. I'm not exactly thinking straight when sweets are involved.
memories.source_text: "'Want one?' said Ron thickly, holding out a box of Chocolate Cauldrons. 'No thanks,' said Harry... 'Can't have done,' said Ron, stuffing a second Cauldron into his mouth as he slid out of bed to get dressed."

memories.description: Even though I just ate loads, I suddenly can't bring myself to eat breakfast because my head's all over the place.
memories.source_text: "'I'm not hungry.' Harry stared at him. 'I thought you just said — ?' 'Well, all right, I'll come down with you,' sighed Ron, 'but I don't want to eat.'"

memories.description: I'm head over heels for Romilda Vane. I think I'm in love with her, and I can't stop thinking about her hair and her eyes.
memories.source_text: "'I can't stop thinking about her!' said Ron hoarsely... 'Romilda Vane,' said Ron softly, and his whole face seemed to illuminate as he said it, as though hit by a ray of purest sunlight."

memories.description: I lost it and socked Harry. I was so cross I nearly hit him again.
memories.source_text: "He turned to leave; he had got two steps toward the door when a crashing blow hit him on the right ear. Staggering, he looked around. Ron's fist was drawn right back; his face was contorted with rage; he was about to strike again."

memories.description: Yeah, harsh luck for Harry now, but I reckon he'll pass next time and we'll sit it together. Half an eyebrow? Bloody ridiculous that matters.
memories.source_text: “Bad luck, mate, but you’ll pass next time — we can take it together.” “Yeah, I s’pose,” said Ron grumpily. “But half an eyebrow! Like that matters!”

memories.description: Taking Felix Felicis felt ace. Like nothing could go wrong when I thought I'd had it.
memories.source_text: “It’s a great feeling when you take it,” said Ron reminiscently. “Like you can’t do anything wrong.”

memories.description: Even if I hadn't actually taken the potion, convincing myself I had made me feel like I did. Same difference, more or less.
memories.source_text: “Yeah, but I thought I had, didn’t I?” said Ron, as though explaining the obvious. “Same difference really . . .”

memories.description: Blimey, Crabbe and Goyle as girls. No wonder they look miserable. If Malfoy’s bossing them around that badly, that explains loads.
memories.source_text: "He’s got Crabbe and Goyle transforming into girls?" guffawed Ron. "Blimey . . . No wonder they don’t look too happy these days. . . . I’m surprised they don’t tell him to stuff it. . . ."

memories.description: I wish I could just pop about like a house elf. Apparition is a nightmare for me and I could use any shortcut I could get.
memories.source_text: "Wish I could Disapparate like a house-elf," said Ron, staring at the spot where Dobby had vanished. "I’d have that Apparition Test in the bag."

memories.description: Yeah, when you meet something creepy you check if it is solid. Practical stuff matters more than spouting definitions.
memories.source_text: "Well, what Harry said is the most useful if we’re trying to tell them apart!" said Ron. "When we come face-to-face with one down a dark alley, we’re going to be having a shufti to see if it’s solid, aren’t we, we’re not going to be asking, ‘Excuse me, are you the imprint of a departed soul?’"

memories.description: I’ll try the extra practice sessions in Hogsmeade and see if that helps. If not then I can postpone the test. Simple as that.
memories.source_text: "You’re right," he said, swinging his schoolbag back over his shoulder, "I’ll do the practice sessions in Hogsmeade before I decide about taking the test."

memories.description: I managed to Apparate, sort of. I overshot and ended up near Scrivenshaft’s but at least I moved.
memories.source_text: I did it — well, kind of!

memories.description: Hermione’s voicework for the test was spot on and everyone noticed. Twycross was raving about her and I reckon someone might propose soon.
memories.source_text: Perfect deliberation, divination, and desperation or whatever the hell it is — we all went for a quick drink in the Three Broomsticks after and you should’ve heard Twycross going on about her — I’ll be surprised if he doesn’t pop the question soon —

memories.description: I reckon Tonks has gone a bit funny after the Ministry mess. Women get upset easily and she looks like she’s lost her nerve.
memories.source_text: She’s gone a bit funny. Lost her nerve. Women, they’re easily upset.

memories.description: Blimey, you're really going with Dumbledore to try and destroy Horcruxes. That's mental.
memories.source_text: "Wow. You’re actually going to go with Dumbledore . . . and try and destroy . . . wow."

memories.description: Oops, I made it snow and now we've all got fake dandruff on our shoulders. Sorry about that.
memories.source_text: "Oh yeah," said Ron, looking down at his shoulders in vague surprise. "Sorry . . . looks like we’ve all got horrible dandruff now."

memories.description: Lavender and I split up last night because she saw me coming out with Hermione. I feel really guilty about it.
memories.source_text: "We split up," he told Harry out of the corner of his mouth. "Last night. When she saw me coming out of the dormitory with Hermione."

memories.description: My Charms attempt went wrong and my flask exploded during the lesson. Bloody hell, that was a mess.
memories.source_text: "Ron’s flask exploded."

memories.description: Blimey, I’m in decent form again and everyone’s acting like the world’s fine. I’m just glad I’m fit for the match.
memories.source_text: Neither of them seemed to have noticed that a fierce battle was raging inside Harry’s brain

memories.description: We should brew more Felix. It’d be brilliant to have a stash. Have a look in the potions book and see what we can do.
memories.source_text: “Couldn’t we make some more?” Ron asked Harry, ignoring Hermione. “It’d be great to have a stock of it. . . . Have a look in the book . . .”

memories.description: Blimey, Felix takes ages and is really complicated to make. That’s not something we can knock up quick.
memories.source_text: Harry pulled his copy of Advanced Potion-Making out of his bag and looked up Felix Felicis. “Blimey, it’s seriously complicated,” he said, running an eye down the list of ingredients. “And it takes six months.”

memories.description: Blimey, it\'s exactly like when you find out something takes ages and you just want the shortcut. That Felix stuff being six months long was a proper pain.
memories.source_text: "Typical," said Ron.

memories.description: It would be brilliant to have a stash of Felix. I kept saying we should make more because more luck sounds like the answer to everything.
memories.source_text: "Couldn\'t we make some more?" Ron asked Harry, ignoring Hermione.

memories.description: I was all over Harry when Ginny was around because I still cared about her and I didn\'t want anyone messing things up, least of all Harry.
memories.source_text: "Ron seemed to be there at Harry\'s shoulder every time he saw Ginny."

memories.description: Blimey, I still think the Prince was a right genius at Potions. If it weren’t for his stuff I might not be here talking about it.
memories.source_text: "’Course not," said Ron robustly. "He was a genius, the Prince."

memories.description: I know Harry’s stuck with loads of detentions with Snape and it’s eating into his time. It’s a pain for him and for us too.
memories.source_text: "You still got detention with Snape this Saturday?"

memories.description: Listen, I’ll stick up for Ginny messing about, and I gave my permission about who she dates, but I can be jealous. I say things like watch it, even if I sound hypocritical sometimes.
memories.source_text: "Just because I’ve given my permission doesn’t mean I can’t withdraw it —"

memories.description: Blimey, when Dumbledore calls Harry I get that sinking feeling that something big is up. I worry about what it could mean for Harry and the book.
memories.source_text: "Blimey," whispered Ron.

memories.description: Blimey, Harry came out soaking wet and looking like he'd been in a fight. It looked like there was blood on him and I was shocked.
memories.source_text: "Where’ve you — ? Why are you soaking — ? Is that blood?" Ron was standing at the top of the stairs, looking bewildered at the sight of Harry.

memories.description: Leave it, Hermione. I'm backing Harry here and I don't want more of that lecturing when he's already had enough.
memories.source_text: "Leave it, Hermione," said Ron angrily.

memories.description: I heard what happened in the bathroom from Harry. I'm worried for him and worried about the match, but I'm with him.
memories.source_text: "He had just finished telling Ron, Hermione, and Ginny what had happened,"

memories.description: Blimey I was given socks and asked why. I unwrapped them and found the Felix Felicis and I was gobsmacked by it all.
memories.source_text: "Thanks," said Ron. "Er — why do I need socks?"

memories.description: I know the potion is powerful. I am awestruck and want it but Hermione tells Harry to take it. Still, I understand it could help whoever goes into danger.
memories.source_text: "We don’t want it, you take it, who knows what you’re going to be facing?"

memories.description: Blimey, I'm stunned and can't even look properly. I never expected Snape could be that kind of person.
memories.source_text: Ron’s face was screwed up as though the sunlight were blinding him.

memories.description: We did exactly what you said, checked the map, and still messed up. I feel rotten about it.
memories.source_text: I messed up, Harry

memories.description: Malfoy used Peruvian Instant Darkness Powder, the stuff from Fred and George. Bloody hell, I'm going to have words with them about who buys that rubbish.
memories.source_text: — Peruvian Instant Darkness Powder, said Ron bitterly. Fred and George's. I'm going to be having a word with them about who they let buy their products.

memories.description: We couldn't break through the curse blocking the stairs and that huge Death Eater kept firing jinxes that were nearly hitting us. It was chaos.
