memories.description: Blimey, Snargaluff pods will stick to the Cloak and cover you in slimy tubers. That was disgusting and nearly gave us away.
memories.source_text: [A fistful of tubers had hit the Cloak over Ron’s head; the slimy green roots were suspended improbably in midair as Ron tried to shake them loose.]

memories.description: What the hell, the Cloak makes things obvious if someone points. We can’t rely on it being completely safe when people are shouting.
memories.source_text: [“Someone’s invisible there!” shouted a masked Death Eater, pointing.]

memories.description: I can see where we need to get in, and I really reckon if we'd had Crookshanks again he'd sort it out. Blimey, he would spot something.
memories.source_text: [“How — how’re we going to get in?” panted Ron. “I can — see the place — if we just had — Crookshanks again —”]

memories.description: Oh right yeah, I can do the levitation charm. Wingardium Leviosa works for shifting things into place, so that twig will do the job for us.
memories.source_text: [Ron looked around, then directed his wand at a twig on the ground and said, “Wingardium Leviosa!” The twig flew up from the ground, spun through the air as if caught by a gust of wind, then zoomed directly at the trunk through the Willow’s ominously swaying branches.]

memories.description: Crabbe's dead. That's brutal but he brought it on himself by setting Fiendfyre loose.
memories.source_text: "He’s dead," said Ron harshly.

memories.description: Blimey, I was worried the Room of Requirement might be ruined, but the point is getting out and making sure everyone is alive.
memories.source_text: "Blimey, d’you reckon it’ll still work after that fire?"

memories.description: I can feel sorry for people sometimes, but not for someone trying to murder us. Crabbe had it coming.
memories.source_text: "If he hadn’t tried to kill us all, I’d be quite sorry he was dead."

memories.description: That's right, we've saved his life twice tonight, and I'm not letting him forget it, you two-faced git.
memories.source_text: “And that’s the second time we’ve saved your life tonight, you two-faced bastard!”

memories.description: I punched Malfoy from under the Cloak, nailed him good, and he went straight on top of that Death Eater. Brilliant.
memories.source_text: Ron punched him from under the Cloak. Malfoy fell backward on top of the Death Eater, his mouth bleeding, utterly bemused.

memories.description: How do we get out of here? Blimey, everything's going mental and we need to move.
memories.source_text: “How do we get out?” yelled Ron over all the screaming,

memories.description: Don't cast a spell at it right now!
memories.source_text: “DON'T!”

memories.description: Stunning that giant will just make it smash the castle. Blimey, don't do something that will make everything collapse.
memories.source_text: “Stun him and he’ll crush half the castle —”

memories.description: It was my idea to use the basilisk venom from the Chamber of Secrets to destroy Horcruxes. Bloody brilliant if I say so myself.
memories.source_text: "Chamber of Secrets," said Ron.

memories.description: So yeah, we destroyed another Horcrux. I kept the remains. I still can't believe we did it but I'm well chuffed.
memories.source_text: "So we're another Horcrux down," said Ron, and from under his jacket he pulled the mangled remains of Hufflepuff’s cup.

memories.description: Blimey, Hermione kissed me and I kissed her back. It's now or never, isn't it? We're together.
memories.source_text: Running at Ron, she flung them around his neck and kissed him full on the mouth. Ron threw away the fangs and broomstick he was holding and responded with such enthusiasm that he lifted Hermione off her feet.

memories.description: I don't want house-elves fighting and dying for us. We can't send them out to die. That's not on.
memories.source_text: "No," said Ron seriously, "I mean we should tell them to get out. We don't want any more Dobbies, do we? We can't order them to die for us."

memories.description: Blimey, I'm right behind you. We're coming with you, so get on with it and get in there.
memories.source_text: Harry, we’re coming, just get in there!

memories.description: Blimey, we all know about the Horcruxes. If anything happens to me or Hermione, Neville can step in so the secret stays with three people.
memories.source_text: "Ron and Hermione know that, but just in case they —"

memories.description: Kill the snake? Right, that's what we mean. If Harry gets a chance and they're busy, he has to take it and kill the snake. Simple as that.
memories.source_text: "Kill the snake?"

memories.description: Harry's determined and trying to stay calm. I'm worried but I'll keep backing him. We're in this together, no messing about.
memories.source_text: "All right, Harry. You’re okay, are you?" "I’m fine."

memories.description: What? Are you mental? I could not believe Harry wanted to give up the Elder Wand. It seemed mad to me.
memories.source_text: "What?" said Ron loudly. "Are you mental?"

memories.description: Blimey, I was staring at the wand like it was something sacred. I was awed and worried about its power.
memories.source_text: Ron and Hermione looked at it with a reverence that, even in his befuddled and sleep-deprived state, Harry did not like to see.

memories.description: Blimey, are you sure about that? I wouldn't mind holding the Elder Wand, it looks proper tempting.
memories.source_text: "Are you sure?" said Ron.
